It seemed like it had been dropped by someone. She picked it up and discovered it was broken. Amy could see the wallet's photo holder was full of pictures of a family. She wondered whose wallet it was and why it had been left in the street. Curious to find out more, she opened it up and peeped inside. Amy was surprised to find coins, sweets and bubble-gum wrappers in the wallet. She smiled and quickly closed the wallet. Suddenly she heard a voice behind her. "Hey, that wallet is mine!" Amy turned around to see a little boy with a sad expression. Amy smiled. She handed the wallet to the boy. "I found this wallet on the street. It's broken, but here you go!" The boy was so thankful and hugged Amy. He then said goodbye and ran away, wallet in hand. Amy watched him go, feeling happy she had done the right thing.

One day, a little boy named Tim went with his dad to the park. They wanted to play a game of chess. Tim was still learning how to play, but he liked it a lot. They sat on the grass and set up the chess pieces. As they played, a big dog named Max came running through the park. Max was very happy and did not see the chess game. He stumbled over the chess board and knocked all the pieces down. Tim was sad and said, "Oh no, Max, that was bad!" Max felt bad for making a mess. Tim's dad said, "It's okay, Max. We can set up the game again." So, they put the pieces back on the board and started a new game. Max sat and watched, making sure not to stumble again.

Once upon a time, there was an incredible dolphin named Dolly. Dolly loved to swim in the big, blue sea. She had many friends who liked to play with her. One day, Dolly saw a sad fish named Finny. Finny had a broken fin. Dolly asked, "Why are you sad, Finny?" Finny said, "I can't swim fast with my broken fin." Dolly wanted to help her new friend. Dolly had an idea. She went to find her friend, Crabby the crab. Crabby was good at fixing things. Dolly told Crabby about Finny's broken fin. Crabby said, "I can repair it!" They went to Finny and Crabby fixed the fin. Finny was so happy. He said, "Thank you, Dolly and Crabby! Now I can swim fast again!" Dolly, Finny, and Crabby played in the sea all day. They were the best of friends. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big truck. The truck was broken. A mechanic was there to fix it. Tim liked to watch the mechanic work. Tim's mom said, "Look, Tim! Can you point to the mechanic?" Tim pointed to the mechanic and smiled. The mechanic waved at Tim and said, "Hi, Tim! I am fixing the truck." After the truck was fixed, Tim and his mom went to get ice cream. Tim got a yummy ice cream cone. Tim said, "Mom, I like the mechanic and the yummy ice cream!" Tim's mom smiled and they had a fun day at the park.

One day, Mommy and Jack went to the park. Jack saw an old robot sitting on the ground. He was very excited to see it. Mommy said to Jack that they could bring the robot home and paint it. Jack loved the idea! They took the robot home, and Jack got to work. He picked out the colours he wanted to use and carefully painted the robot. Once the robot was painted, Mommy said it was time to put the robot away. Jack was very careful with the robot and made sure it was put away safely. A few days later, Jack's friend, Toby, came over. Toby was very excited to see the robot and wanted to paint it. Jack showed Toby how to paint the robot but Toby quickly got carried away and painted it in a very careless way. When Mommy saw what Toby had done, she told Jack and Toby that it`s important to always be careful with things. Jack was glad he had been careful with the robot the first time.

One day, a huge dog named Biggie went to the park. He saw a small cat sitting on a bench. The cat looked sad. Biggie wanted to help, so he walked over and sat next to the cat. "Hi, I am Biggie. Why are you sad?" asked the huge dog. The cat said, "I am Spirit. I lost my toy and now I feel bad." Biggie wanted to help Spirit find her toy, so they looked all around the park. They looked under the slide, behind the trees, and in the sandbox. They found the toy in a bush! Spirit was happy again. They both sat on the bench and played with the toy together. In the end, Biggie and Spirit became good friends. The moral of the story is: when you help others, you make friends and feel good.

One Sunday, a big, thick cat named Tom went for a walk. Tom liked to walk in the sun. He saw a little bird on a tree. The bird said, "Hi, Tom! Do you want to play with me?" Tom said, "Yes, I want to play with you!" They played a game of tag. Tom was happy to have a new friend. But then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came and yelled, "Woof! Woof!" The dog wanted to play too, but Tom and the bird were scared. The dog was too big and loud for them. They ran away to hide. The dog felt sad and said, "I just wanted to play." Tom and the bird heard him and came back. They said, "Okay, you can play with us, but please don't yell." The big dog, the thick cat, and the little bird played together all day on that sunny Sunday. They had lots of fun and became the best of friends.

It was a cold night. Sam and his mom went outside to look at the sky. They saw many stars. They were bright and shiny. Sam liked the stars. He pointed at them and said their names. "That is the Big Bear," his mom said. "And that is the Little Bear. And that is the North Star. It is the brightest star of all." Sam nodded. He wanted to see more stars. But he was also cold. He shivered. He hugged his mom. His mom hugged him back. She put a warm hat on his head and a scarf around his neck. "Let's go inside, Sam," she said. "We can have some hot cocoa and read a book. Then we can go to bed and dream of the stars." Sam smiled. He liked hot cocoa and books. He liked his mom. He liked the stars. He thought it was a great night. He followed his mom inside. He was happy.

Once upon a time there was a boy who liked to pretend. He found a pan and imagined all kinds of wild adventures. He pretended that he was a pirate sailing the seas. He imagined that the pan was a boat and he was the captain. He sailed to an island where he found a wild parrot! The parrot squawked and tweeted and the boy fed it crackers. He pretended the parrot was his best friend and they shared many exciting adventures. They pretended to find buried treasure, they pretended they flew and they pretended they fought a sea monster! The boy and the parrot had so much fun playing and pretending together.

Once upon a time, in a cool blue sea, there was a big navy boat. The boat had a very important job. It had to test how fast it could go. The boat wanted to be the best and help its friends. One sunny day, the boat started its test. It went faster and faster, making big splashes in the water. The boat felt happy and strong. It loved to feel the cool water on its sides as it raced through the sea. As the boat finished its test, it knew it had done a good job. It was now the fastest boat in the navy. All the other boats were proud of their friend. They knew they could count on the fast boat to keep them safe and help them when they needed it. And they all lived happily in the cool blue sea.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to do everything together. They play, read, and sing with each other. They share their toys, clothes, and snacks. They are very happy. But one day, their mom and dad tell them something new. They say that Anna and Ben will go to different places soon. They will go to university. University is a big place where big kids learn new things. Mom and dad say that university is good for Anna and Ben. They will make new friends and have fun. Anna and Ben do not like this news. They do not want to go to different places. They want to stay together. They feel sad and scared. "Why do we have to split?" Anna asks mom and dad. "Because you have different dreams, my dear," mom says. "You like to draw and paint. You are very good at art. You will go to a university that has a lot of art classes. You will learn how to make beautiful pictures." "And you, Ben, you like to build and fix things. You are very good at math and science. You will go to a university that has a lot of math and science classes. You will learn how to make cool machines." Anna and Ben think about what mom and dad say. They know that they like different things. They know that they are good at different things. But they still want to be together. "Can we visit each other?" Ben asks mom and dad. "Of course, my sweet," dad says. "You can call, write, and video chat with each other. You can also come home for holidays and weekends. You will always be twins. You will always be family. You will always love each other." Anna and Ben hug mom and dad. They hug each other. They feel a little better. They know that going to university will be difficult. They know that they will miss each other. But they also know that they will have new adventures. They know that they will learn new things. They know that they will always be together in their hearts.

One day, a cat named Tom was very tired. He wanted to take a good nap. He found a big, soft bed and let himself lay down on it. Tom was so happy to sleep on the bed. As Tom was napping, a little mouse named Tim came into the room. Tim saw the cat sleeping and thought it was funny. Tim had an idea. He would play a trick on Tom. Tim let out a loud squeak to wake up Tom. Tom woke up with a start. He saw Tim and wanted to chase him. But when Tom tried to move, he found that he could not. Tim had tied Tom's tail to the bed while he was napping! Tom looked at Tim and they both laughed. From that day on, Tom and Tim became good friends and played together all the time.

Once upon a time there was best friends, Max and Leo. They were very busy building their sand tower at the beach. Max was bigger so he made most of the tower but Leo was still helping. Suddenly a big mean dog came and started barking at them. The little two were scared so the ran away. But the mean dog kept following them and barking. When they reached a safe place they stopped and thought of a plan. Max said they should run together to distract the dog so Leo agreed. As they ran away the dog followed them. Max demanded Leo to keep running but Leo was so tired he couldn't do it anymore. So he stopped and sat down. The mean dog was very angry so it growled and bite Leo. Max was so sad and scared he ran away and never looked back. Leo was lucky he did not get hurt badly. The story shows how important it is to be kind and help each other. Never demand too much from each other and always be there for each other in difficult times.

One day, a boy named Tom wanted to eat pasta. He asked his mom to make some for him. His mom said yes and went to the kitchen to cook. Tom was happy and waited for his pasta. While Tom's mom was cooking, she added a bitter lemon to the pasta. She thought it would taste good. When the pasta was ready, she gave it to Tom. Tom took a big bite and made a funny face because of the bitter taste. Tom did not like the bitter pasta. He picked up a piece of pasta and slapped it on the table. The pasta made a funny sound. Tom laughed and his mom laughed too. They decided to make new pasta without the bitter lemon. They ate the new pasta and it was yummy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted to go to the other side of the river, but she couldn't get there because there was no bridge. She was very sad, but she started to look for things to build a bridge with. She picked up some stones, some sticks and some grass and started to build the bridge. It wasn't easy, but she kept trying. Her mom saw what she was doing and came to help. She encouraged the little girl to keep going, no matter how hard it was. Finally, the bridge was finished. It wasn't very strong, but it was enough for the little girl to cross. She was so excited, and she ran across the bridge to the other side of the river. The mom was very proud of her little girl. She had helped her daughter make something successful. Even though the bridge wasn't perfect, it had done the job. The mom smiled and hugged the little girl to encourage her.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Bow. Bow was a very useful dog. He liked to help his family with many things. He would carry small things in his mouth and bring them to his family when they needed them. One day, Bow was very tired. He decided to take a nap under a big tree. While he was napping, a small bird saw Bow and wanted to play with him. The bird flew down and landed on Bow's nose. Bow woke up and saw the bird. He did not feel mad, he wanted to play too! Bow and the bird played all day. They ran and jumped and had lots of fun. When the sun started to go down, Bow went back to his family. The bird flew back to its nest. Bow was very happy to have a new friend.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a gray dog. The gray dog loved to play with a mask. One day, the dog lost the mask. He was very sad. The gray dog looked for the mask everywhere. He asked his friends, the cat and the bird, to help him find the mask. They all looked and looked, but they could not find the mask. The gray dog was worried that his mom would punish him for losing the mask. Then, something unexpected happened. The gray dog's mom found the mask under his bed. She was not mad at him. Instead, she gave the mask back to the gray dog and told him to be more careful next time. The gray dog, the cat, and the bird were all very happy and played with the mask all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her grumpy cat, Mr. Whiskers. Lily loved to play outside and wave to all her friends. One sunny day, Lily found a pretty gift under a big tree. She was very happy and excited. She wanted to show her grumpy cat, Mr. Whiskers, the gift she found. Lily ran to her house and showed the gift to Mr. Whiskers. When Mr. Whiskers saw the gift, he was not grumpy anymore. He waved his tail and played with Lily all day long. They were both very happy.

One day, a big orange fish was swimming in the sea. The orange fish liked to play in the waves when the tide was high. The orange fish had many friends, and they all liked to play together. One day, while they were playing, something bad happened. A big shark came near the orange fish and his friends. The shark wanted to eat the orange fish. The orange fish was scared, and he swam away as fast as he could. The orange fish had an idea. He swam to a place where the tide was very low. The shark could not follow him there. The orange fish was safe, and he went back to playing with his friends. They were all happy, and they played in the sea all day long.

Lila and Tom were playing in the park. They saw a dove on a tree. The dove had a ribbon on its neck. The ribbon was red and shiny. "Look, a dove!" Lila said. "It has a pretty ribbon. Can we play with it?" Tom nodded. He liked the ribbon too. He wanted to touch it. He climbed the tree. He reached for the dove. The dove was scared. It flew away. "Come back, dove!" Tom shouted. He followed the dove. He jumped from one tree to another. He was fast and brave. Lila watched Tom. She was worried. She did not like to climb trees. She was afraid of falling. She called Tom. "Tom, be careful! The dove does not want to play. It wants to be free. Come down, please!" Tom did not listen. He was too excited. He saw the dove land on a big rock. He jumped to the rock. He grabbed the ribbon. He tried to tie it to his wrist. He wanted to keep the dove. The dove was angry. It pecked Tom's hand. It made a loud noise. It flapped its wings. It broke the ribbon. It flew away again. Tom was hurt. He was sad. He was confused. He did not understand why the dove did not like him. He looked at his wrist. He saw a piece of ribbon. He cried. Lila ran to Tom. She hugged him. She kissed his hand. She said sorry. "Tom, I'm sorry. The dove was not a toy. It was a living thing. It had feelings. It did not like to be tied. It wanted to fly and be happy. You should not chase it. You should let it go." Tom sniffed. He nodded. He understood. He said sorry too. "Lila, I'm sorry. I was silly. I did not think. I wanted the ribbon. I did not care about the dove. I should not grab it. I should be gentle and kind." Lila smiled. She gave Tom the piece of ribbon. She said it was a gift. "Tom, this is for you. It is a reminder. A reminder to be nice to animals. A reminder to respect their freedom. A reminder to love them from afar." Tom smiled too. He thanked Lila. He said it was a good gift. He said he learned a lesson. They held hands. They walked back to the park. They saw the dove again. It was on another tree. It looked at them. It cooed softly. They waved at the dove. They said goodbye. They wished it well. They went home. They were happy.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Charlie and Mary. Charlie and Mary loved to run in the park together every day. One day as they were running, there was a beautiful rose. Mary wanted to pick it for Charlie so he could enjoy its beauty. When Mary gave it to Charlie, he was very excited and started to chew on it. Mary quickly told him that he should not chew the rose, because it was special. Charlie sadly threw the rose to the ground and they continued to run together. Later, they stopped at the park and found a few wildflowers. Mary showed him that he could pick a flower and smell it, or he could try to chew the petals. This time, Charlie was excited and chose a yellow flower. He carefully smelled it and was amazed at its beauty. He realized that sometimes things can be special if you don't destroy them. The moral of the story is to be careful when handling special things, because if you try to chew it, you can accidentally ruin it.

Once upon a time, there was a little fridge. The fridge was very proud because it could keep food cold and fresh. It loved to help the family that lived in the house. One day, it started to rain outside. The rain made the grass wet and the flowers happy. The family stayed inside the house to keep dry. They played games and had fun together. The little fridge was happy to help the family on this rainy day. It gave them cold drinks and yummy snacks to eat while they played. The family was very thankful for the proud little fridge. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there were two puppies, one was named Spot and the other was named Max. Spot was so cheerful and playful, he loved to run around outside and enjoy the sunshine. Max was quite different though, he was much more shy and preferred to stay inside all day. One day it was raining outside so Spot and Max couldn't go out and play. Even though Spot was sad he still decided to try and cheer Max up. He started to display such a playful attitude, trying to invite Max to come out and play even though it was raining. However, Max wanted to stay inside and remain safe. Although Spot was sad he understood why Max wanted to stay. Spot taught Max a valuable lesson that day - it is OK to feel uncertain and scared, but it is important to be brave and try something new sometimes. Even if it is hard.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim lived in a tight cage. He did not like the cage. He wanted to fly and play with his friends. One day, Tim saw a key near the cage. He used his beak to open the cage. He was free! Tim was so happy that he could count the big trees and play with his friends. But, there was a big cat named Tom. Tom saw Tim and wanted to catch him. Tim was scared. He flew fast and hid from Tom. Tim's friends helped him. They all worked together to trick Tom. In the end, Tom could not catch Tim. Tim was safe and happy with his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had very long hair. One day, his mom said, "Tim, you need a haircut." Tim did not want a haircut, but he knew his mom was right. They went to the open haircut place near their home. The haircut lady said, "Hello! Please sit down. I will give you a nice haircut." Tim was a little scared, but he sat down. The haircut lady was very nice. When the haircut was done, Tim looked in the mirror. He liked his new haircut! He said, "Thank you, haircut lady! I like my own haircut now." Tim and his mom went home, and Tim showed his dad his new haircut. His dad said, "Wow, Tim! You look great!" Tim was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a curious cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to join her friends, the birds, in their games. One day, while playing, Kitty saw a big, red ball near a tree. "Wow! What is that?" Kitty asked her friend, Birdy. Birdy looked at the ball and said, "I don't know. Let's go see!" Kitty and Birdy went to the big, red ball. Kitty was so curious that she put her mouth on the ball. "It's fun to play with!" Kitty said. Birdy agreed and they played with the ball all day long. From that day on, Kitty and Birdy always played with the big, red ball together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a birdcage in her room. The birdcage was very boring. It was just a plain, old birdcage with nothing fun inside. Sue wanted to make the birdcage more fun for her pet bird, Bob. Sue had an idea. She would replace the boring birdcage with a new, fun birdcage. Sue went to the store with her mom. They looked at all the birdcages. Sue found a birdcage with lots of fun toys and a swing for Bob to play on. Sue and her mom took the new birdcage home. They put Bob in the new birdcage. Bob was very happy. He played with the toys and swung on the swing. Sue was happy too, because her pet bird was no longer in a boring birdcage.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was only three years old. Sarah loved playing with figures. She had lots of cool ones, some that were figures of animals and some that were of people she knew. One day, Sarah's mom was helping her to sort out the figures. She asked Sarah to pick up each figure and tell her the name of it. After they finished, they carefully put the figures in order. Sarah and her mom both smiled. She was so proud of her figures all neatly sorted out. "You did such a good job" said Sarah's mom "Now we can play with all of the cool figures together". Sarah was so excited. She smiled and said" Yay! Let's play a game." They played for hours until it was time for Sarah to go home. She hugged her mom and thanked her for helping with the figures. Then Sarah said goodbye and ran home, feeling very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bright hat. A girl named Sue loved her bright hat very much. She wore it every day. The hat made her very happy. It was red and yellow, and it made her look like the sun. One day, Sue went to the park to play. She played with her friends and had lots of fun. But when it was time to go home, she could not find her bright hat. Sue was very sad. She looked and looked, but her hat was gone. Sue had lost her bright hat. As Sue walked home, she saw a big tree. She looked up and saw her bright hat in the tree! The wind had blown it up there. Sue was very happy to find her hat. She got a long stick and got her bright hat down from the tree. Sue put on her hat and went home with a big smile.

Tom and Mia like to play in the park. They run and jump and slide and swing. They have fun with their friends and their toys. One day, they see a new sign in the park. It is big and bright and has words and pictures on it. Tom and Mia want to know what it says. They run to the sign and look at it. The sign says: "Do not kick the flowers. They are growing and need care. Thank you." It has a picture of a flower and a foot and a cross. Tom and Mia think the sign is silly. They do not like flowers. They like to kick things. They kick the sign and laugh. They kick the sign harder and harder. They do not see the man who is coming. The man is the gardener. He works in the park and takes care of the flowers. He sees Tom and Mia kicking the sign. He is angry and sad. He shouts at them and tells them to stop. He says they are hurting the sign and the flowers. He says they are bad and rude. Tom and Mia are scared and sorry. They stop kicking the sign and run away. They do not laugh anymore. They feel bad and ashamed. They learn their lesson. They do not kick the sign or the flowers again. They say sorry to the gardener and the sign and the flowers. They play nicely in the park. They have fun with their friends and their toys.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park with her mom. Mia wore her favorite skirt that was pink and had flowers on it. Her mom held her hand as they walked to the park. Mia was excited to learn something new today. At the park, Mia saw her friend Tom. Tom was eating a spicy snack. "Hi Tom, can I try your snack?" Mia asked. "Sure, but it's spicy," Tom warned. Mia tried a small piece and her mouth felt hot. "Wow, that is spicy!" Mia said, and they both laughed. Mia and Tom played on the swings and the slide. Mia's mom watched them and smiled. After playing, Mia said goodbye to Tom. She was happy because she learned that spicy food can be fun to try. Mia and her mom walked home, holding hands, with Mia's skirt twirling in the wind.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a toy car that she loved very much. She played with the car every day. But one day, the car was broken. Sue was very sad. Sue's mom told her, "Don't worry, we will go to the toy fixer next week." Sue felt a little better. She could not wait for the week to go by. She counted the days until they could go to the toy fixer. Finally, the day came for them to leave and go to the toy fixer. Sue and her mom walked to the toy fixer's shop. The toy fixer looked at Sue's broken car and said, "I can fix this!" Sue was so happy. The toy fixer fixed the car, and Sue played with it every day again.

One day, a boy named Tim found a dull fork on the ground. He wanted to show his friend, Sam, the fork. But Sam lived far away. Tim had an idea. He would mail the fork to Sam. Tim put the fork in a box and went to the mail place. He met a man there. The man said, "I can help you mail your fork to your friend." Tim was happy and gave the box to the man. But the man was not nice. He took the box and ran away. Tim was sad. He never saw the dull fork or the man again. Sam never got the fork in the mail.

One day, Tom and his mom went to the park. They saw a big plane in the sky. Tom stared at the plane. He wanted to fly like the plane. The plane was slow, but it went very high. Tom said, "Mom, can I fly like the plane?" Mom smiled and said, "Not now, but maybe when you are big, you can fly in a plane." Tom and his mom played in the park. They saw a little bug. The bug was slow too. Tom stared at the bug and said, "Hi, little bug! You are slow like the plane." The bug did not talk, but Tom knew the bug liked him. Tom and his mom had a fun day at the park. They went home and Tom told his dad about the slow plane and the slow bug.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a lizard and a bee, who were playing in the garden one day. The bee flew up high and zipped around, spinning around and around. But the lizard was a bit too slow to race with the bee, so he stayed on the ground. The bee came down and asked the lizard why he didn't join in the game and the lizard replied, "I can't fly as fast as you can, so I can't zip around like you do. It's not fair". The bee thought the lizard was being a bit too selfish and so he said, "I have an idea. Why don't I help you fly too? I can carry you on my back and then you can zip around with me. What do you say?" The lizard was so excited and said yes right away! The bee carried the lizard on his back and flew high in the sky. The lizard flew with the bee and zipped around the sky like never before! He was so happy! The two friends flew around and played together until the sun was setting. When the sky got dark, the bee carried the lizard back home, so he could sleep for the night. The two friends promised to fly around and zip together again soon. The end.

John and his mom walked into the living room. On the table there was a beautiful vase. John's mom said, "Be careful John! Don't shake the vase, ok?" John nodded and put his hand on the vase. He wanted to touch it, but he was careful. John was curious and wanted to know what was inside of it. He asked, "What's inside, Mommy?" John's mom smiled and said, "That's a surprise. For now, just be careful. Don't shake it!" John listened and took his hand off the vase. He was careful not to shake it. He sat down on the couch to think about what might be inside the vase. Time passed and suddenly, a voice asked, "Did you find out what's inside yet?" John smiled, realizing that his mom had been playing a game with him. He said, "No Mom, but I'm still being careful and not shaking it, just like you said!"

Sara likes to play with her plastic toys. She has a plastic doll, a plastic car, a plastic cup and a plastic spoon. She likes to make pretend tea and cake for her doll and her car. She seats them on a wide mat on the floor and gives them each a cup and a spoon. One day, Sara sees a new plastic toy in the store. It is a plastic chair. It is pink and shiny and has a sticker of a princess on it. Sara wants the plastic chair very much. She asks her mom if she can have it. Her mom says no, it is too expensive and she has enough toys. Sara is sad. She goes home and plays with her plastic toys. But she does not have fun. She thinks about the plastic chair all the time. She wishes she could seat her doll and her car on the plastic chair and make them feel like royalty. The next day, Sara's mom has a surprise for her. She says she found something in the garage that she can use for her play. She gives Sara a big cardboard box. Sara does not understand. She says she does not want a box, she wants a plastic chair. Her mom smiles and says, "Look, you can make a chair out of this box. You just need to cut a hole for the seat and decorate it with some paper and stickers. It will be your own special chair, and you can seat your doll and your car on it." Sara thinks about it. She likes the idea of making her own chair. She says thank you to her mom and gets some scissors, paper and stickers. She works hard to cut and glue and stick. She makes a beautiful chair out of the box. It is not pink and shiny, but it is colorful and cozy. She seats her doll and her car on the chair and gives them some tea and cake. She is happy. She does not want the plastic chair anymore. She loves her cardboard chair.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Timmy. Timmy loved to follow his friends around the big tree. They would play all day long. One day, Timmy saw a big red roof. He thought it looked like a fun place to play. Timmy told his friends about the red roof. They all wanted to see it too. So, they followed Timmy to the big red roof. When they got there, they found a big bowl of delicious fruit. They were so happy and began to eat. But, surprise! The fruit was magic! When they ate it, they could sing beautiful songs that everyone loved. Timmy and his friends became very famous and sang for all the animals in the forest. They were so happy they found the big red roof and the delicious magic fruit.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Binky. Binky lived with his mom and dad in a small hole in the ground. They loved to play and eat together. Binky's favorite thing to do was to jump and run in the spring when the flowers were out. One day, Binky saw a big, dead tree. It was not like the other trees he saw in the spring. It had no leaves, and it was not green. Binky was scared of the tree, but his mom and dad said, "Don't worry, Binky. Trust us, it's just a tree." Binky trusted his mom and dad. They all played near the dead tree, and soon Binky was not scared anymore. They had a lot of fun that spring, jumping and running around the tree. Binky knew he could trust his mom and dad to keep him safe and happy. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to swim in the pond near his home. One sunny day, Ducky went to the pond to play with his friends. While they were swimming, Ducky saw a frog named Freddy. Freddy was wet from jumping in the water. "Hi, Freddy!" said Ducky. "Do you want to swim with us?" Freddy smiled and said, "Yes, I love to swim!" As they swam and played, they saw a big fish named Fin. Fin liked to clap his fins to make music. Ducky, Freddy, and their friends swam, clapped, and danced in the water. They had so much fun together. At the end of the day, Ducky, Freddy, and their friends were tired but happy. They said goodbye and went back to their homes. And they knew they would have more fun days at the pond together.

Lily and Tom are playing in the park. They like to slide, swing and run. They see a big light in the sky. It is yellow and round. It is the sun. "Look, Lily, the sun is going down. It is getting dark," Tom says. "Let's go home, Tom. Mommy and Daddy are waiting for us," Lily says. They rush to their bikes. They put on their helmets. They ride fast on the road. They see many lights on the way. They are from cars, houses and shops. They are noisy and bright. "Be careful, Lily, Tom. The road is busy. Stay close to me," Mommy says. She is riding behind them. She has a light on her bike too. It is red and small. It blinks. They reach their home. They park their bikes. They hug Mommy and Daddy. They go inside. They have dinner. They brush their teeth. They put on their pajamas. They go to bed. "Good night, Lily, Tom. I love you," Mommy says. "Good night, Mommy. I love you too," Lily and Tom say. They close their eyes. They dream of the sun, the park and the lights. They are happy.

Zara and Zane love to zoom on their bikes. They zoom fast and slow, up and down, and around and around. They zoom to the park, to the shop, and to the zoo. They like to see the animals at the zoo, but their favorite is the seal. The seal is big and gray, and has a shiny nose. He likes to swim and splash in the icy water. He can jump and spin and clap his flippers. He makes funny noises that sound like "arf arf". Zara and Zane like to watch him and say "hello seal". One day, when they zoom to the zoo, they see a sign that says "Seal Show". They are very happy and want to see the seal do tricks. They zoom to the pool where the seal is, but they see a lot of people there. They try to find a spot where they can see, but they are too small and the people are too big. They feel sad and mad. They want to see the seal, but they can't. They zoom around the pool, looking for a way in. They see a gate that says "Staff Only". They think maybe they can go in there and see the seal better. They zoom to the gate and push it open. They zoom inside and see the seal. He is resting on a big rock. He sees them and says "arf arf". Zara and Zane are very happy and say "hello seal". They zoom closer to him and want to touch him. But they don't know that the gate is for the people who work at the zoo and take care of the seal. They don't know that the seal is not used to strangers and might get scared or angry. They don't know that they are in trouble. Soon, they hear a loud voice that says "Hey, what are you doing here? This is not for visitors. Get out of here, now!" They turn around and see a man in a blue shirt. He is the seal keeper. He is not happy. He is very angry. He runs to them and grabs their bikes. He says "You are not supposed to be here. You could have hurt the seal or yourself. You are very naughty. I'm going to tell your parents." Zara and Zane are very scared and sorry. They say "We're sorry, we just wanted to see the seal. We like the seal. Please don't be mad. Please don't tell our parents." They start to cry. The seal keeper sees that they are just kids who made a mistake. He is still angry, but he is also kind. He says "OK, OK, calm down. I won't tell your parents, but you have to promise me that you will never do this again. You have to respect the animals and the rules. Do you understand?" Zara and Zane nod and say "Yes, we understand. We promise. We're sorry." The seal keeper gives them their bikes and says "Now, go back to the main gate and wait for me there. I'll take you to the seal show and show you how to watch the seal safely and properly. But don't ever zoom in here again. Deal?" Zara and Zane say "Deal. Thank you. We're sorry." They zoom out of the gate and wait for the seal keeper. They feel bad for what they did, but they also feel glad that they can still see the seal. They hope the seal is not mad at them. They hope he will do tricks for them. They hope he will say "arf arf" again. They love the seal.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely little girl named Mia. She lived in a small house near a big tree. Mia had no friends to play with, and she felt very sad. One day, she went for a walk and saw a small green plant. It was a mint plant. Mia liked the mint plant and took it home with her. She took care of it every day. The mint plant grew bigger and bigger. Mia was happy to have a friend, even if it was just a plant. But one day, Mia saw a big bug on her mint plant. She did not recognize it. The bug was eating her mint plant. Mia tried to stop the bug, but it was too strong. The bug ate all the leaves, and the mint plant died. Mia was lonely again, and she cried.

Once upon a time, there was a big red barn. In the barn, there was a poor, sad hen. The hen had no eggs to lay. She was very sad. One day, the hen went outside to play. She saw a big, round stone. The stone looked like an egg. The hen had an idea. She took the stone to the barn and lay on it like it was her egg. After some days, the stone cracked open. But it was not a chick inside. It was a baby dinosaur! The dinosaur was very small and cute. The hen was happy. She took care of the dinosaur like it was her baby. Now, the poor hen was not sad anymore. She had a new friend to love and take care of. The hen and the dinosaur lived happily in the big red barn. And they played together every day.

One day, a deer was walking in the woods. The sun was shining very bright. The deer liked to feel the warm shine on her fur. She looked up at the sky and saw the big, heavy clouds. The deer knew it would rain soon. The deer saw a little bird sitting on a branch. The bird looked sad. "Why are you sad?" asked the deer. "I am sad because the heavy rain will come soon, and I have no place to hide," said the bird. The deer thought for a moment. "Come with me," she said. They walked together until they found a big tree with many leaves. The deer and the bird hid under the tree. They stayed dry and warm while the rain fell all around them. When the rain stopped, the sun shined again, and they were both happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Ben. Ben loved to eat radishes. One day, he saw the biggest radish he had ever seen in his life. He wanted to eat it so bad! Ben asked his mom, "Can I eat that big radish, please?" His mom said, "Promise me you will share it with your brother and sister." Ben said, "I promise, Mom!" Ben went to get the big radish. But when he pulled it out of the ground, he found out it was not a radish at all. It was a door handle! Ben opened the door and saw a room full of toys. He was so happy! He ran to tell his brother and sister. They played with the toys all day and forgot all about the radish.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the zoo with his mom. They saw many animals like lions, bears, and monkeys. Tim liked the zoo a lot. He wanted to find a rare animal, a leopard. He asked his mom, "Can we find the leopard?" As they walked, they saw a big tree. Tim heard a noise and looked up. He saw a big cat with spots. "Mom, look! It's the rare leopard!" he said. But his mom smiled and said, "No, Tim. That's a cheetah. Let's keep looking." They walked some more and Tim saw a big rock. Behind the rock, there was a big cat with spots. "Mom, I found the leopard!" he said. But his mom looked and said, "No, Tim. That's a jaguar. Let's keep looking." Finally, they went to a big cage. Inside, there was a big cat with spots. The sign said "Leopard." Tim was so happy. He said, "Mom, we found the rare leopard!" But then, something unexpected happened. The leopard spoke! "Hi, Tim. I'm not a real leopard. I'm a robot leopard!" Tim and his mom were very surprised. They never thought they would find a robot leopard at the zoo.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful cat. The cat loved to dance and play all day. One day, the cat saw a big clock. The clock had a minute hand that moved very slow. The cat wanted to play with the minute hand. So, the cat jumped on the clock. The cat started to dance and play with the minute hand. But, the minute hand did not like it. The minute hand said, "Stop! I do not like this. Please get off." The cat did not listen. The cat kept playing with the minute hand. The minute hand got very mad. The minute hand pushed the cat off the clock. The cat fell down and got hurt. The cat felt regret for not listening to the minute hand. The cat was sad and could not dance and play anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little girl named Lily. She loved to open her toy box and play with her toys. One day, she saw a pick on the ground. She picked it up and looked at it. It was small and shiny. Lily went to her friend Sam and showed him the pick. Sam said, "Wow! What a nice pick! Let's open my toy box and see if we can use it." They went to Sam's house and opened his toy box. Inside, they found a treasure chest that was locked. Lily used the pick to open the treasure chest. When they opened it, they found pretty stones and shiny coins. They were so happy! Lily and Sam shared the treasure and played with it all day. And from that day on, Lily wasn't shy anymore.

One day there was a boy named Joe. Joe was 3 years old and loved to take naps. He felt nice and snuggly when he was in his bed. Joe had a special lamp beside his bed. It was a fine lamp - it was just the right size for Joe. One day Joe asked his mom if he could take a nap. His mom said yes and said goodbye to Joe. She turned on his lamp and told him to have a nice nap. Joe thanked his mom and said he would take a nap. Joe lay down in his bed, feeling so nice and warm. He closed his eyes and started to drift off. His lamp was making soft, yellow light. Before long, Joe was sound asleep. He had a fine nap, the best one ever! When he woke up he felt refreshed and happy. Joe was so thankful for his lamp. It was always just the right light for taking a nap.

One day, Mommy was very sad. She was sitting all alone in her room, not saying a word. She had a radio sitting near her on the bed. The little girl asked her Mommy why she was so sad. Mommy said she felt lonely, as she hadn't talked to anyone for a long time. The little girl asked Mommy if she wanted to talk to someone. Mommy said yes, she would like to talk to someone. So the little girl took Mommy's hand and they went outside. She brought Mommy to a special phone booth. It was like a box, but with a phone and a window. Mommy reached inside and picked up the phone. She spoke into it and asked to speak to someone. Mommy said hello to the person on the other end of the line. She smiled and was so happy to talk to someone again. But suddenly, the person on the other end stopped talking. Mommy looked confused. She called out a few more times, but there was no response. Eventually, Mommy knew that this person wasn't going to talk to her. She put the phone back in its regular place and the two of them walked home. Mommy was sad again and the little girl didn't understand why. She tried to cheer up Mommy with a hug and a song, but nothing worked. The little girl

One day, a little bug wanted to crawl up a high tree. The bug wanted to find a big, yummy egg to eat. But the tree was very high, and the bug was scared. As the bug started to crawl up, a mean bird saw it. The bird wanted the egg too. The bug and the bird raced to see who could get to the egg first. The bug was fast, but the bird was faster. The bird got to the egg first and started to eat it. The little bug was sad. But then, the bug saw another egg in a lower tree. The bug crawled to the egg and ate it. The bug was happy, and the bird was happy too.

Once upon a time there was a bear called Bob. He was a happy bear who liked to run around in the forest. One day, Bob went to pick some berries in the forest. As he was picking the berries, the ground suddenly split! Bob got scared and ran away. He ran until he saw a pass. The pass went up high in the mountains and Bob wanted to take it. He thought that if he took the pass he would reach the other side of the forest. Bob was a brave bear and he decided to take the pass. But it was very slippery and dangerous. Bob started to climb up but then he made a mistake. He stepped on a bad, spoiled spot and he slipped down to the bottom. Bob was sad and he said to himself, "I need help!" Then suddenly, he heard a voice from behind. It was a squirrel who said, "Don't worry! I can help you." The squirrel showed Bob how to climb up without slipping and Bob thanked him. He was so grateful that he gave the squirrel the berries he had picked. The squirrel smiled and said, "You're welcome!" Bob climbed all the way up to the top and he finally reached the other side of the forest! He was so happy! From then on, Bob and the squirrel were very good friends.

Once upon a time, in a big jungle, there was a little leopard. The little leopard was scared because he lost his mom. He looked behind the trees and under the rocks, but he could not find her. The scared little leopard did not know what to do. As the little leopard walked, he saw a big bird. The big bird saw the scared little leopard and asked, "Why are you scared, little leopard?" The little leopard said, "I lost my mom, and I can't find her." The big bird wanted to help the little leopard, so they went to look for his mom together. They looked all around the jungle, and finally, they found the little leopard's mom. She was so happy to see her little leopard. They all went back to the leopard's home and settled down for a nice nap. The little leopard was not scared anymore, and he was very thankful for the big bird's help.

One day, a little girl named Mia found a big sack in her room. She did not know where it came from. She was very curious and wanted to find out what was inside. She tried to open the sack, but it was very hard to do. Mia felt sleepy, but she did not want to sleep. She wanted to open the sack. Mia tried to turn the sack around to see if there was a way to open it. But the sack was too heavy for her. She asked her friend Tom to help her. Tom was strong, and he could turn the sack. They tried to open it together, but it was still hard. Mia and Tom were very tired and sleepy, but they did not give up. They asked their big sister to help them. She knew how to open the sack. She pulled a string, and the sack opened. Inside the sack, there were many toys for Mia and Tom to play with. They were very happy and played all day. At night, they were so sleepy that they fell asleep with their new toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She liked to explore and examine things. One sunny day, she went on a walk with her mom. They walked to a big tree, and Lucy saw something shiny on a low branch. She asked her mom, "What is that?" Her mom said, "That is a special pepper. It is spicy and has a magic power. If you touch it, something fun will happen. But we have to wait until we get to the end of our walk." Lucy was excited and couldn't wait to find out what the magic power was. At the end of their walk, they reached a big hill. Lucy's mom pointed to the shiny pepper and said, "Now you can touch it." Lucy touched the pepper, and it made her feel very warm. Suddenly, Lucy could run very fast! She ran up and down the hill, laughing and having fun. The spicy pepper's magic power made her day even more special.

There was a little red house with a big roof. A nice family lived in the house. One day, it was very hot outside. The sun was shining bright, and the family was feeling hot inside the house too. The dad said, "We need to fix the roof to make the house cooler." So, the family called a man to help them. The man came and looked at the roof. He said, "I can fix the roof, but you need to pay me." The family did not have enough money to pay the man. They were sad. The dad had an idea. He asked his friend to help him fix the roof. The friend said yes. They worked together to fix the roof. Now, the house was cooler, and the family was happy. They thanked the friend for his help. The family learned that working together can solve problems.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to climb trees and play outside. One day, he found a big tree in his yard. It was so amazing! Tim wanted to climb it and see how high he could go. As Tim climbed, he saw a big jug in the tree. He thought, "How did that get there?" He wanted to get the jug, so he climbed higher and higher. He was so brave! When Tim reached the jug, he found it was full of yummy candy. He was so happy! He climbed back down the tree with the jug. Tim shared the candy with his friends, and they all had a fun day playing together.

Tim and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their dad's hats and glasses. They pretend to be different people. Tim likes to wear a big hat and a cool mustache. Sam likes to wear a small hat and big glasses. One day, their dad comes home and sees his hats and glasses all over the floor. He is not happy. He tells Tim and Sam to sort them and put them back in the closet. Tim and Sam say sorry and start to sort them. Tim picks up a hat and a mustache. He puts them on and says, "Look, I am a cowboy!" Sam laughs and picks up a hat and glasses. He puts them on and says, "Look, I am a teacher!" They have fun sorting the hats and glasses and trying them on. Their dad comes back and sees them playing. He smiles and joins them. He puts on a hat and a mustache and says, "Look, I am a pirate!" Tim and Sam clap and say, "Wow, you are a cool pirate, dad!" They hug their dad and finish sorting the hats and glasses. They put them back in the closet and say, "Thank you, dad, for letting us play with your hats and glasses. We love you!" Their dad says, "I love you too, Tim and Sam. You are my cool boys!" They all go to the kitchen and have some cookies and milk.

One day, a little boy named Tim went outside to play. He saw the sky turn dark and heard a big wind coming. Tim knew a tornado was near! He needed to hide and be safe. Tim ran to his house and found a brilliant spot to hide. It was under his bed, where it was dark and cozy. He felt safe from the tornado there. Tim waited for the big wind to pass. After a while, the wind stopped and the sky was bright again. Tim came out from under his bed and saw that everything was okay. He was happy that he found a brilliant place to hide from the tornado. Now, Tim could go back to playing outside.

Once upon a time, there was a popular girl named Lily. She was nice and liked to clean her room. One day, Lily's mom asked her to clean the house. Lily said, "Yes, Mom. I will clean the house." Lily started to clean. She cleaned the kitchen, the living room, and her room. As she cleaned, she found a big box. The box had the word "year" on it. Lily was curious and opened the box. Inside the box, Lily found her old toys from last year. She was happy and played with them. Then, she cleaned up the toys and put them away. Lily's mom was proud of her, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy bear named Ben. Lily loved to spend time with Ben. They played all day and had fun. One day, Lily met a new friend named Tim. Tim wanted to play with Lily and Ben. But Lily was selfish. She didn't want to share Ben with Tim. Tim was sad and said, "Can we all play together, please?" Lily thought about it and remembered how happy she was when she played with Ben. She wanted Tim to feel happy too. So, Lily said, "Yes, we can all play together!" From that day on, Lily, Tim, and Ben played together and made many happy memories.

Tom and Lily wanted to buy a gift for Mom. They had some coins in their piggy bank. They put on their coats and hats and went to the shop. They held hands and looked at the things in the window. "Look, Lily, a pretty flower!" Tom said. He pointed to a pink rose in a vase. "I like it, Tom. But it is too big. We need a small gift," Lily said. She saw a shiny necklace with a heart. "How about this?" Tom nodded. He liked the necklace too. They went inside the shop and asked the lady how much it was. The lady smiled and said it was five coins. "Perfect! We have five coins!" Tom said. He gave the coins to the lady and took the necklace. He and Lily thanked the lady and left the shop. They ran back home, happy and excited. They wrapped the necklace in some paper and put a bow on it. They hid it under their bed and waited for Mom to come home. When Mom came home, they ran to hug her. They said they had a surprise for her. They took her to their room and showed her the gift. "Wow, what is this?" Mom asked, opening the paper. "It is a necklace for you, Mom. We bought it with our own coins. Do you like it?" Tom and Lily asked. Mom gasped and smiled. She put on the necklace and hugged them. "I love it, my sweeties. It is beautiful. Thank you so much. You are very kind and thoughtful. I am so proud of you." Tom and Lily beamed. They felt happy and warm. They had made Mom happy. They had done a good thing. They sprang up and down and clapped their hands. They loved Mom and Mom loved them.

Once upon a time there was a mysterious nail. Everyone wanted to know what was inside but nobody knew how to open it. One day, a three year old girl named Molly decided to take a look. She asked her mummy, "Can I play with the nail?" Mummy said, "No, Molly. That nail is too mysterious. We don't know what's inside it." But Molly still wanted to know. She thought and thought and found an idea. She asked her mummy, "Can I please try using a hammer?" Mummy was surprised. She said yes. Molly picked up the hammer and gently hit the nail. She smiled when she heard a noise from inside. It was ticking like a clock. How mysterious! Molly kept on hitting the nail until it opened. Inside, there was a special surprise. Molly was so happy! She had found the secret of the mysterious nail.

Once upon a time, there was a calm little girl named Amy. Amy liked to look out her window and see the world outside. One day, she saw a big red ball in the store across the street. Amy asked her mom, "Can we go buy the big red ball, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, let's go buy it." They walked to the store and bought the big red ball. Amy was very happy. She played with the ball all day long, and when she was done, she looked out her window and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman named Tim. He lived near a big blue sea. Tim had a fancy hat that he wore every day. He loved to catch fish in the sea. One day, Tim met a little crab. The crab said, "Please do not catch my friends, the fish." Tim wanted to help the crab. He thought of a way to prevent catching the fish. Tim said, "I will catch only the big fish, not the little ones." The crab was happy. From that day, Tim only caught the big fish. The crab and the fish were safe and happy. And Tim, the fisherman, wore his fancy hat with a big smile.

Once upon a time, in a big white house, there lived a kind old man. He had a big garden with many pretty flowers. The old man loved his flowers very much and took care of them every day. One day, a naughty rabbit came into the garden. The rabbit wanted to eat the flowers. The old man did not want the rabbit to eat his flowers, so he tried to prevent the rabbit from getting to them. He built a small fence around his garden. The fence was a success and the rabbit could not reach the flowers anymore. The old man was happy that his flowers were safe, but he also felt sad for the hungry rabbit. So, he decided to plant some extra flowers outside the fence for the rabbit to eat. The rabbit was very thankful and they became friends. The moral of the story is that we can solve problems with kindness and care for others.

Once upon a time there was a little bird. The bird was hurt and couldn't fly. The bird sat in the garden and said "Help, I'm hurt and I can't fly!" A little girl heard the bird and said "I can help you, bird!" She went over to the bird and put her hands around it. The little girl said "Let's get you to my house. That way you won't be hurt anymore!" So the little girl put the bird in her basket and took it back to her house. The little girl put the bird in her room, she said "You can stay here and rest. Then you won't be hurt anymore." The bird was so happy and said "Thank you, little girl! I'm so glad you put me in your room and let me rest." The little girl was happy too. The End.

One day, a little girl named Sue found a lucky bow. She put it on her head and went to play outside. She felt very happy with her new bow. She showed it to all her friends and they thought it was very pretty. While playing, Sue saw a little bird with a hurt wing. She wanted to help the bird. Sue took off her lucky bow and put it on the bird's wing. The bird felt better and could fly again. Sue was happy she could help the bird, but now she did not have her lucky bow. The next day, Sue went outside to play again. She saw the bird she helped, and it had a surprise for her. The bird had found a new bow for Sue. The bird replaced her lucky bow with an even prettier one. Sue felt so happy and knew that helping the bird was the right thing to do.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a hunter. He had a fancy hat that he wore every day. The hunter loved to go into the woods to find animals. One day, he saw a big deer and wanted to catch it. The hunter chased the deer for a long time. He was very tired and thirsty. He found a small river and decided to drink water from it. He took off his fancy hat and used it to pour water into his mouth. While the hunter was drinking water, the big deer ran away. The hunter was very sad because he could not catch the deer. His fancy hat was now wet and dirty. The hunter went back to the village with nothing. His hat was ruined and he was still very tired and thirsty. The day was not good for the hunter.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a poor boy named Tom. He had a little pet dog named Max. They were best friends. Tom and Max liked to play in the park every day. One day, Tom was very hungry. He wanted to eat a snack. He looked in the kitchen, but there was no food. Tom was sad. Max saw Tom was sad, so he went outside to find a snack for him. Max found a snack on the ground. It was a big, red apple. Max picked up the apple with his mouth and brought it back to Tom. Tom was happy to see the snack. He took the apple and started to eat it. But the apple was bad. Tom's face turned red, and he felt sick. Max was sad that he gave Tom a bad snack. Tom lay down on his bed, feeling very sick. Max stayed by his side, but they both knew that things were not going to be okay.

One day, a fat cat named Tom wanted to play a sport. He saw a big ball in the yard. Tom thought it would be fun to push the ball with his paws. So, he went outside to play. Tom met a small dog named Max. Max saw Tom playing with the ball and wanted to play too. "Can I play with you?" Max asked. Tom said, "Yes, you can play with me. We can push the ball together." They both started to push the ball and had lots of fun. But then, a big bird came and took the ball away. Tom and Max were sad. They wanted their ball back. They decided to work together to get the ball back from the bird. They jumped and barked at the bird until it dropped the ball. Tom and Max were happy again. They learned that working together is the best way to solve problems.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy cat named Kitty. Tim and Kitty did everything together. They played, ate, and even slept together. One day, Tim had an opinion about Kitty. He thought Kitty could raise her paw to say "hello". Tim was so excited to try it out. Tim's mom saw him playing with Kitty. She saw Tim's happy face and asked, "What are you doing, Tim?" Tim said, "I think Kitty can raise her paw to say hello!" Mom smiled and said, "That's a nice opinion, Tim. Let's try it together!" They practiced with Kitty, but Kitty didn't raise her paw. Tim felt a little sorry. The next day, Tim's dad came home with a surprise. It was a new toy cat that could raise its paw! Tim was so happy to see the new cat. He knew his opinion was right. Tim played with both Kitty and the new cat, and they all said hello to each other. Tim was not sorry anymore. He knew that sometimes, opinions can come true.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who loved to sing. Every day, the bird would sit on a strip of grass and sing happy songs. The bird was very patient and would wait for her friends to come and listen. One day, while the bird was singing, a big wind came and blew her off the strip of grass. The bird was scared, but she kept singing. She hoped her friends would hear her and come to help. Then something unexpected happened! The wind blew the bird high into the sky, and she could see all her friends down below. They heard her singing and looked up. They saw the bird and started to sing too. The wind heard their songs and gently brought the bird back to the strip of grass. The bird was happy to be with her friends again, and they all sang together.

Tim and Jen are twins. They like to play with toys and books. Sometimes they share, sometimes they fight. One day, they find a big box in the garage. They want to make a fort with the box. They ask their parent if they can use the box. Their parent says yes, but they have to be careful. The box is useful for keeping things inside. They can't break the box or lose the things. Tim and Jen are happy. They take the box to their room. They cut a door and a window in the box. They put a blanket on top of the box. They put some pillows and toys inside the box. They have a cozy fort. They take turns to go inside the box. They pretend to be kings and queens, pirates and explorers, astronauts and aliens. They have a lot of fun. They also let their parent come inside the box. Their parent tells them stories and jokes. They laugh and hug. They thank their parent for letting them use the box. They say they will put the box back in the garage when they are done. Their parent says they are good and clever. They feel proud and happy. They love their parent and their fort.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big plastic toy. The toy was a dog. Tim loved to play with the dog toy every day. One day, Tim was troubled because he could not find his toy dog. Tim looked everywhere for his toy dog. He looked under his bed, in the closet, and behind the door. Tim was very sad. He thought he had lost his toy dog forever. Then, something unexpected happened. Tim saw his real dog, Max, running towards him. Max had the plastic toy dog in his mouth. Max had bitten the toy dog and taken it outside to play. Tim was so happy to see his toy dog again. He hugged Max and played with both his real dog and his plastic toy dog.

Lily and Ben were playing with a big box. They wanted to make a house with the box. They cut a door and a window with scissors. They drew flowers and stars with crayons. They needed something to hold the box together. "Look, I have pins!" Ben said. He showed Lily a handful of pins. They were shiny and sharp. Some were purple, some were blue, some were red. "Wow, pins are good!" Lily said. She took a purple pin from Ben. She liked purple. It was her favorite color. She tried to push the pin into the box. But the pin was too hard and the box was too thick. She could not make a hole. "Ouch!" Lily said. She dropped the pin. It hurt her finger. She started to cry. "Are you okay?" Ben asked. He saw a drop of blood on Lily's finger. He felt sorry for her. He gave her a hug. "Don't cry, Lily. We can find another way to make our house. Maybe we can use tape or glue. Or we can ask Mom for help. We will succeed, don't worry." Ben said. Lily stopped crying. She smiled at Ben. He was a good friend. She wiped her finger with a tissue. She said, "Thank you, Ben. You are right. We will succeed. We will make the best house ever. And we can use the pins to decorate it. They are so pretty. Can I have another purple pin, please?"

One day, a sweet cat named Mimi was playing in the living room. She saw a pretty vase with flowers on the table. Mimi wanted to sniff the flowers, so she jumped up on the table. As Mimi sniffed the flowers, her tail hit the vase. The vase fell and broke on the floor. The flowers and water scattered all over the floor. Mimi was scared and ran away to hide. Mimi's mom came into the room and saw the mess. She cleaned up the broken vase and scattered flowers. Mimi came out from her hiding spot and said sorry. Her mom gave her a hug and said it was okay. They both smiled and went to play outside.

Once upon a time, there was a charming little house. In the house lived a girl named Lily. She liked to play with her toys all day. One day, Lily found a new toy. It was a figure of a cat. Lily loved the cat figure. She played with it all the time. She welcomed the cat figure into her toy family. The cat figure and Lily were very happy together. One morning, Lily woke up and saw the cat figure was gone. She looked everywhere. Then, she saw the cat figure outside. But wait! It was not a toy anymore. It was a real cat! The cat looked at Lily and meowed. Lily was so happy. They played together and became best friends.

Tom and Anna were friends. They liked to play outside. One day, they went to the lake with their moms. The lake was big and blue. They saw ducks and fish. "Can we feed the ducks?" Anna asked her mom. "Yes, but be careful. Don't go too close to the water," her mom said. Tom and Anna took some bread from their moms. They broke the bread into small pieces. They threw the pieces to the ducks. The ducks came and ate the bread. They quacked and splashed. Tom and Anna laughed. They wanted to see the fish. They walked along the edge of the lake. They looked into the water. They saw some fish swimming. "Look, Anna, a red fish!" Tom said. "Wow, it's pretty!" Anna said. Tom wanted to touch the fish. He leaned over the water. He reached out his hand. But he lost his balance. He fell into the lake. Splash! Anna screamed. Tom's mom and Anna's mom ran to the lake. They saw Tom in the water. He was wet and scared. He cried. "Tom, Tom, are you okay?" his mom asked. She pulled him out of the lake. She hugged him. "I'm sorry, mom, I'm sorry," Tom said. He shivered. "It's okay, Tom, it's okay. You're safe now," his mom said. She wrapped him in a towel. Anna felt sorry for Tom. She walked to him. She gave him a hug. "I'm sorry, Tom, I'm sorry," Anna said. "It's okay, Anna, it's okay. You're my friend," Tom said. He smiled. They both sighed. They were glad they were okay. They learned a lesson. They would not go too close to the water again. They would be careful. They would still play with the ducks and the fish. But from a distance.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little bunny named Ben. Ben lived in a safe and cozy home under a big tree. He loved to hop and play with his friends in the forest. One sunny day, Ben and his friends decided to enjoy a game of hide and seek. As they played, Ben hopped far away from his safe home to find a good hiding spot. He found a bush to hide behind, but he did not see the big, scary fox that was watching him. The fox wanted to catch Ben and his friends. Ben saw the fox and knew he had to be clever to save his friends. He thought of a plan. Ben hopped very fast and led the fox away from his friends. The fox followed Ben, but he could not catch him. Ben was too fast and clever. Finally, Ben led the fox to the edge of the forest, where the fox got scared and ran away. Ben had saved his friends and they were all safe again. They were so happy and proud of clever Ben. They all went back to their safe homes and enjoyed the rest of the day playing together.

Lila and Sam were playing in the park. They saw a big gray bird with a long neck and a red head. It was a goose. "Look, a goose!" Lila said. "Let's feed it some bread." They ran to the goose with some bread in their hands. But the goose was not friendly. It hissed and bit at them. "Ow, it hurts!" Sam cried. "Go away, goose!" Lila was scared. She remembered what her mom told her. When you are scared, you can pray to God. He will help you. She closed her eyes and folded her hands. She said, "Dear God, please make the goose stop biting us. Please make it nice. Thank you. Amen." Then she opened her eyes and saw something amazing. The goose had stopped hissing and biting. It had bowed its head and closed its eyes. It looked like it was praying too. "Wow, look, Sam!" Lila said. "The goose is praying!" Sam looked and smiled. He said, "Maybe it is saying sorry. Maybe it is hungry." They decided to give the goose some bread. The goose took it gently and ate it. Then it nodded and walked away. Lila and Sam were happy. They said, "Thank you, God, for helping us. Thank you, goose, for being nice. Goodbye, goose!" They waved and went back to playing. They had learned a lesson. Praying can help you when you are scared. And sometimes, even a gray goose can be a friend.

Ben and Lily were two frogs who lived in a swamp. They liked to hop and swim and catch flies. One day, they saw a big bird flying over the swamp. It had a long neck and a sharp beak. It was a heron. "Look, Ben, a heron!" Lily said. "It is so big and pretty!" "Yes, it is," Ben said. "But we have to be careful. Herons like to eat frogs." They hid under a water lily and watched the heron. The heron landed on a log and looked around. It saw a fish in the water and snapped it up. Then it saw a snake on the shore and grabbed it. Then it saw a mouse in the grass and caught it. "Wow, the heron is so hungry!" Lily said. "It eats everything!" "Yes, it does," Ben said. "But it does not eat humble frogs like us. We are too small and plain." They felt proud of being humble frogs. They decided to rest on the log and enjoy the sun. They hopped out of the water and climbed on the log. They did not see the heron behind them. The heron saw them and opened its beak. "Hello, humble frogs," the heron said. "You look like a tasty snack." Ben and Lily were scared. They jumped off the log and back into the water. They swam away as fast as they could. They did not rest on the log again. The end.

Sam and Lily were playing in the garden. They saw a big hill of dirt with many ants on it. Sam wanted to see what was inside the hill. He took a stick and poked the hill. "Stop, Sam!" Lily said. "You are hurting the ants. They live in the hill. They make tunnels and rooms and store food there. It is their home." Sam did not listen. He poked harder and harder. He wanted to remove the dirt and see the ants. He did not care about their home. Suddenly, the hill broke open. Sam and Lily saw something incredible. There was a shiny stone in the middle of the hill. It was red and blue and green and yellow. It sparkled in the sun. It was the most beautiful stone they had ever seen. "Wow!" Sam said. "Look at this stone! It is mine. I found it. I want to keep it." "No, Sam!" Lily said. "That is not fair. The ants found it first. They brought it to their hill. It is their treasure. You should not take it. You should put it back." Sam and Lily argued. They both wanted the stone. They did not notice the ants. The ants were angry. They had lost their home and their treasure. They crawled on Sam and Lily and bit them. "Ow! Ow! Ow!" Sam and Lily cried. "The ants are biting us! Help! Help!" They ran to their mom. She saw the bites and the stone. She knew what had happened. She was not happy. She took the stone from Sam and Lily. She said, "You were very naughty. You destroyed the ants' home and took their treasure. You should say sorry to the ants and put the stone back. Then you should go to your room and think about what you did." Sam and Lily felt sorry. They said sorry to the ants and put the stone back. They went to their room and thought about what they did. They learned to respect the ants and their home. They never poked the hill again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah who was trying to have a nap but could not fall asleep. She thought and thought and tried everything but she would not be able to sleep. Then, her mother came and gave her a big hug. Immediately, Sarah's body and mind felt so comfy and she drifted off to sleep easily. Once she woke up, Sarah was refreshed and ready to go. She went outside and shared a modest hug with all of the animals in the neighborhood. The animals were so happy and Sarah felt so content. The moral of the story is: a hug is special. It can make us feel better if we're feeling sad or when we need a nap. A hug is also a gift to share with others, even if it's just a modest one.

One day, Tom and his dog, Spot, plan to go outside to play. The sun is shining, and it is a mild day. Tom's mom gives him a thermometer to see how warm it is. Tom and Spot are very excited. As they play, Spot sees a big red ball. "Look, Tom!" says Spot. "Let's play with the ball!" Tom throws the ball, and Spot runs to catch it. They have lots of fun. But then, something unexpected happens. The ball hits the thermometer, and it breaks! "Oh no!" says Tom. "What will Mom say?" But Spot has an idea. They find a new thermometer and give it to Tom's mom. She is happy, and they all play together.

One day, a big frog named Bob lived near a small pond. Bob was a careless frog and liked to jump and play all day. He had many friends in the pond, like fish and ducks. They all liked to swim and have fun together. One sunny day, Bob saw a new fruit near the pond. It was round and red. He never saw this fruit before. Bob was very hungry, so he wanted to taste it. He jumped to the fruit and took a big bite. As he did, something unexpected happened. The fruit was not a fruit at all! It was a red ball that a little girl lost. The girl saw Bob and laughed. She was happy to find her ball. Bob was surprised, but he laughed too. They became friends and played together near the pond.

Once upon a time there was a brave pirate who loved to explore the sea. He had a ship and a crew, and he wanted to go on many great adventures. One day he saw a large island in the distance. He sailed closer to take a look, but when he got close, he saw it was full of dusty ships, and the sandy beach was filthy. The pirate got worried. He knew that this was the Island of Forgotten Treasures, where only nasty pirates ever go. The brave pirate turned and sailed away, wanting to leave the island behind. But as he sailed away, he heard some voices from the beach. They said, “Please stay! We are sorry for being so filthy. We need your help.” So the brave pirate turned back and he forgave them. He was glad he had the courage to forgive, and with his help, the pirate crew were able to clean up the island and find some wonderful treasure! Moral of the story: Let us learn to forgive, for it can bring us great rewards.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to gather wood with his dad. They walked to the forest near their house. Tim saw many trees and picked up small pieces of wood. He put the wood in a big bag. Tim and his dad saw a big, disgusting bug on a tree. Tim said, "Dad, look at that bug! It's so big and yucky!" His dad said, "Yes, Tim. That bug is very yucky. Let's stay away from it." As they walked away, the big, disgusting bug started to change. It became a beautiful, colorful butterfly! Tim and his dad were so surprised. They never thought the yucky bug would turn into something so pretty. They went home with their wood, and told mom about their amazing day in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a tomato who was happy living in the garden. He liked to talk to the other plants and play games with them. One day, the tomato saw something unusual in the sky - it was a huge dead bird, flying in circles above the garden. The tomato was very scared and he wanted to hide, so he split up the ground and jumped in to hide underground. Other plants in the garden heard a strange noise and when they saw what had happened, they were really worried about the tomato. They worked together to push the ground back together and the tomato was pulled back to the surface. The tomato felt embarrassed about his actions and he learnt an important lesson - it is better to work together and use your courage than to hide away when scared. The tomato used this lesson throughout his life and was happy living in the garden. He made sure to always try to be brave and help other plants in the garden when they were in need.

Once upon a time, there was a small island. On the island, there was a big slide. Many kids liked to play on the slide. One day, a new boy came to the island. His name was Tim. Tim did not know about the slide. He was ignorant about it. Tim saw a girl named Sue playing on the slide. He asked her, "What is that?" Sue looked at him and said, "This is a slide. We play on it. Do you want to try?" Tim was excited and said, "Yes, I want to try!" Sue helped Tim climb up the slide. When they reached the top, Tim was scared. Sue said, "Don't worry, I will hold your hand." They slid down the slide together. Tim laughed and said, "That was fun! Let's do it again!" They played on the slide all day and became good friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a pale man who was a vendor. The vendor was selling yummy ice cream. Tim wanted to buy some ice cream, but he did not have any money. Tim had an idea. He could run fast to his house and get some money. He ran as fast as he could. His legs moved very quickly. He got to his house, took some money, and ran back to the park. When Tim got back to the park, the vendor was still there. Tim gave the vendor the money and got a big ice cream cone. He was so happy! Tim ate the ice cream and played in the park all day.

Once upon a time, there was a red dog. The red dog loved to play with his ball. One day, the ball went near a big blackboard. The blackboard was in a big room. In the room, there was a man. The man was trying to solve a problem on the blackboard. He was not happy. The red dog wanted to help the man. The dog thought if he could solve the problem, the man would be happy and play with him. The red dog tried to help. He jumped up and down near the blackboard. But the dog made a mess on the blackboard. The man was very angry. He did not want the dog's help. The man sent the red dog away. The red dog was sad and went home without his ball.

One day, a large fish named Bob lived in the sea. Bob liked to wave his big tail to say hello to his friends. He had many friends in the sea and they all liked to play together. Bob's best friend was a little fish named Tim. Tim and Bob liked to swim fast and jump out of the water. When they jumped out of the water, they could see the sky and feel the air.
