They needed air, or oxygen, to breathe and live. One day, Bob and Tim saw a big boat. The boat made large waves in the water. Bob and Tim had fun riding the waves and playing together. They waved their tails at the boat, and then swam back to their home in the sea. They were happy and loved their life in the ocean.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy train that he loved to play with. The train had a loud whistle that made Tim laugh. He would load his toy train with small blocks and make it go around the room. One day, Tim's friend, Sam, came over to play. Sam saw Tim's toy train and wanted to play with it too. But Sam was not careful and he broke the train's whistle. Tim was very sad because his favorite toy was spoiled. Tim's mom saw that he was sad and had an idea. She fixed the train's whistle with some glue. Tim and Sam were so happy that they could play with the train again. They learned to share and take turns, so they would not spoil the toy. And from that day on, they played together and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, in a cool small town, there lived a little boy named Tim. He loved big engines and liked to watch them work. Tim had a big dream to drive an engine when he grew up. One sunny day, Tim went to the park to play. He saw a big engine there. Tim was very happy and ran to see it. He climbed up and sat in the driver's seat. Tim felt like he was in his dream. But then, something unexpected happened! The engine started to move! It was not a real engine; it was a magic engine! Tim and the engine went on a fun ride around the town. Tim's dream came true in a twist he never thought would happen.

Once upon a time, there was a little bug named Tom. Tom liked to crawl on the ground all day. One day, as Tom was crawling, he saw a big cloud in the sky. The cloud looked very serious. Tom was scared. Tom went to his friend, the bird. "Bird, can you help me? There is a big, serious cloud in the sky," said Tom. Bird looked at the cloud and said, "Don't worry, Tom. I will fly up and see what is going on." Bird flew up to the cloud. As he got closer, he saw that the cloud was not serious at all. The cloud was just very sad. Bird asked the cloud, "Why are you so sad?" The cloud said, "I am sad because I am all alone." Bird had an idea. He went back down to Tom and told him the news. Tom decided to help the cloud feel better. Tom asked all his friends to come and play under the cloud. They all came and had a fun time. The cloud saw Tom and his friends playing and felt happy again. The cloud was not serious anymore. Tom and his friends had a great day, and they all became friends with the cloud. From that day on, they all played together and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Anna. One sunny day she was walking near the beach when she saw a jet soaring in the sky. Anna was so excited and said, "Wow, that jet looks so cool!" She wanted to join the jet up in the sky. Anna began to run and shout, "Jet, wait for me, I want to join you!" She wanted to join the jet, just like how a bird joins its flock. Suddenly, the jet stopped and hovered above Anna. The jet made a strange sound and opened its door. Anna was surprised but also very happy. She shouted, "Yes! I'll join you!" and jumped inside. The jet flew Anna around the world. Together they soared high above the clouds and saw many beautiful places. They had the most wonderful adventure! When the sky turned dark, the jet flew Anna back to the beach where it all began. Anna said goodbye with a smile on her face, "Thank you for taking me on the coolest adventure ever!" The jet zoomed off into the sky and Anna went home with a happy heart and a pocket full of memories.

One day, a boy named Tim found a whistle. He was very happy. He wanted to play with the whistle all day. Tim asked his mom if he could play with the whistle. His mom said, "Yes, but mind your baby sister, too." Tim played with the whistle and watched his sister. He blew the whistle and made a loud sound. His sister laughed and clapped her hands. Tim felt proud. He liked making his sister laugh. Then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came running to them. The big dog looked at the whistle. Tim was scared, but he had an idea. He blew the whistle again, and the big dog started to dance! Tim and his sister laughed. The big dog was friendly and just wanted to have fun. Tim learned that the whistle could make friends. He was happy that he found a whistle that was available to make everyone happy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a man who liked to sell things. He had a little shop with many toys and treats. One day, a mom came into the shop with her baby. The baby was very spoiled. The mom always bought the baby lots of toys and treats. The man saw the spoiled baby and thought of a plan. He talked to the mom and said, "I have a special toy for your baby. It will make the baby very happy." The mom was excited and bought the toy for her baby. The baby played with the toy, but soon got bored. The next day, the mom came back to the shop. She said, "My baby is still not happy. What can I do?" The man thought for a moment and said, "Maybe your baby needs a friend to play with, not more toys." The mom listened to the man and took her baby to the park to make new friends. The baby played with the other kids and had so much fun. The mom realized that the baby didn't need more toys, but needed friends to be happy. The moral of the story is that having friends and spending time with them is more important than having lots of toys.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play with toys and watch cartoons on the screen. But sometimes they disagree about what to do. One day, Tom wants to play with cars and trucks. He says, "Let's make a big road and have a race." Anna says, "No, I want to play with dolls and tea sets. Let's have a tea party." Tom says, "That's boring. Cars and trucks are more fun." Anna says, "No, they are not. Dolls and tea sets are more fun." They argue and argue. They do not share their toys. They do not listen to each other. They are both bossy. Then, their mom comes in. She sees them fighting. She says, "What's going on here? Why are you not playing nicely?" Tom and Anna both say, "He/she started it. He/she is bossy. He/she does not let me play what I want." Their mom says, "That's not how friends behave. Friends respect each other's choices. Friends take turns. Friends have fun together. Why don't you try to find something you both like to do?" Tom and Anna think for a moment. They look at their toys and the screen. They remember that they both like to watch cartoons. They say, "Sorry, mom. Sorry, friend. Can we watch cartoons together?" Their mom says, "Yes, you can. But only for a little while. Then you have to play with your toys again. And remember to be kind and share." Tom and Anna hug and say, "OK, mom. OK, friend. We will be kind and share." They sit on the couch and watch cartoons. They laugh and smile. They are friends again.

Ben and Mia were twins who liked to play with their toy trains. They had many engines of different colors and sizes, and they made tracks on the floor. Sometimes they pretended to mail letters and packages to each other with their trains. One day, they had a big fight over who could use the red engine. It was their favorite engine, because it was fast and shiny. They both wanted to mail a letter to their grandma with the red engine, and they did not want to share. "Give me the red engine, it's mine!" Ben shouted. "No, it's mine, I saw it first!" Mia yelled. They pulled and pushed the red engine, and it broke in half. They both started to cry. Mom heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. She saw the broken engine and the angry twins. "What happened here?" Mom asked. "Ben broke the red engine!" Mia said. "Mia broke the red engine!" Ben said. Mom shook her head. "You both broke the red engine, because you did not share. Sharing is caring, and caring is loving. Do you love each other?" Ben and Mia nodded, but they still looked sad. Mom hugged them and said, "I'm sorry your red engine is broken, but I have an idea. Why don't you use the blue engine and the yellow engine, and mail your letter together? That way, you can both show grandma how much you love her, and how much you love each other." Ben and Mia liked Mom's idea. They said sorry to each other, and hugged. Then they took the blue engine and the yellow engine, and put their letter in a box. They made a track that went around the room, and took turns driving the engines. They had fun mailing their letter, and they were quiet and happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy liked to learn new words. One day, Amy learned the word "uncomfortable". She thought it was a big word and wanted to use it. Amy wore a new shirt that day. The shirt was itchy and made her feel bad. She told her mom, "Mom, this shirt is uncomfortable!" Her mom smiled and said, "Good job using your new word, Amy! Let's change your shirt." Later, Amy saw her friend Tom. Tom was crying. Amy asked, "Why do you cry, Tom?" Tom said, "I fell down and it hurts." Amy hugged Tom and said, "I'm sorry you feel uncomfortable." Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, Amy. Your big word made me feel better."

Once upon a time, there was a messy little girl named Poppy. Poppy liked to play in the mud and make mud pies. She had a lot of fun, but she always got very dirty. One sunny day, Poppy was playing with her friends in the park. They were all running and laughing. Poppy's mom called out, "Stop, Poppy! It's time to go home and get clean!" Poppy didn't want to stop playing, but she knew she had to listen to her mom. When they got home, Poppy's mom filled the tub with warm water and bubbles. Poppy climbed in and washed all the mud off. She felt so clean and happy, and she promised her mom she would try not to be so messy next time.

Once upon a time, there was a big, peaceful room. In the middle of the room, there was a pretty rug. On the rug, there was a cat named Fluffy and a dog named Spot. Fluffy and Spot liked to play on the rug all day. One day, Fluffy said to Spot, "Let's play a game!" Spot wagged his tail and said, "Yes, let's play!" Fluffy started to tease Spot by running around the rug. Spot chased Fluffy and tried to catch her, but Fluffy was too fast. They played and played until they were both very tired. Fluffy and Spot lay down on the rug and fell asleep. The room was so peaceful and quiet. Fluffy and Spot were very happy to have each other as friends.

Once upon a time, in a small valley, there lived a humble bird named Tiny. Tiny loved to dive and play with his friends. The valley was full of beautiful flowers and big trees. Tiny and his friends would fly high and then dive down to the ground, laughing and having fun. One day, Tiny met a new friend named Flappy. Flappy was very shy and did not know how to dive. Tiny said, "Hi Flappy! Do you want to play with us and dive?" Flappy replied, "I don't know how to dive, Tiny. I'm scared." Tiny wanted to help Flappy. He told Flappy, "Don't be scared. I will teach you how to dive. It's easy and fun!" So, Tiny and Flappy practiced diving together. At first, Flappy was scared, but he soon learned how to dive and started to have fun. All the birds in the valley were happy to see Flappy and Tiny playing together. They learned that helping friends is a good thing to do. The birds in the valley were kind and humble, always helping each other when they needed it. And so, Tiny, Flappy, and their friends played and dived together every day. They had lots of fun, and the valley was filled with laughter and happiness. The moral of the story is: always be kind and help your friends when they need it.

One day, a boy named Tim went to a big building with his mom. They needed to go up, so they went to the elevator. Inside the elevator, it was dark. Tim was a little scared. His mom said, "Don't worry, Tim. We will be out soon." As they went up, Tim held a red ball in his hand. He loved his red ball very much. But suddenly, he felt the ball slip. He tried to hold on tight, but the ball drop from his hand. Tim was sad and said, "Oh no, my red ball!" When the elevator door opened, they saw a kind man holding Tim's red ball. He said, "Is this your ball, little boy?" Tim was happy and said, "Yes, thank you!" The kind man gave the ball back to Tim. Tim and his mom left the elevator and waved goodbye to the kind man. They did not know that the kind man was the owner of the big building.

Once upon a time, there was a large tree in a pretty forest. In the tree, there was a tiny fairy named Lily. Lily had a special job. She had to replace the old leaves on the tree with new ones. One day, Lily met a small bird named Tim. Tim said, "Hi, I am Tim. What are you doing?" Lily replied, "Hello, Tim. I am a fairy. I replace old leaves with new ones." Tim was happy to meet Lily and wanted to help her. Together, they worked to replace the old leaves. Lily would use her magic, and Tim would fly to put the new leaves on the tree. They made the tree look beautiful. They became best friends and played in the forest every day.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful boy named Tim. He liked to help people and make them happy. One day, Tim found a toy sword in his room. He thought it was fun to play with. Tim went to the park with his toy sword. He saw a big girl named Sue, who was being mean to a little boy. The little boy was sad. Tim wanted to help him, so he walked up to Sue and said, "Stop being mean!" Sue looked at Tim and his toy sword and laughed. Tim didn't give up. He waved his toy sword around and made funny faces. The little boy started to laugh. Sue saw how happy the little boy was and she stopped being mean. Everyone began to applaud for Tim, the helpful boy with the toy sword. From that day on, Sue learned to be nice, and they all became friends.

One day, a boy named Tim found a rake in his yard. It was a brilliant rake, with a long handle and many teeth. Tim liked his rake very much. He used it to gather leaves into a big pile. Tim's friend, Sue, came over to play. She saw the rake and asked Tim about it. Tim mentioned that he found it in his yard. Sue thought the rake was brilliant too. They both used the rake to make the leaf pile even bigger. When they finished, Tim and Sue jumped into the big pile of leaves. They laughed and played in the leaves all day. Tim was happy he found the brilliant rake, and Sue was happy that Tim mentioned it. They had a great day playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a big red barn in a green field. In the barn, there lived a flexible snake named Sam. Sam could bend and twist his long body in many ways. He liked to play with his friends, the mice, and the birds. One sunny day, Sam and his friends were playing hide and seek. Sam was very good at this game because he could bend and hide in small places. He sighed as he looked for a new hiding spot. Suddenly, he saw a big box in the corner of the barn. Sam thought it was a good spot to hide. Sam went inside the box and hid. After a while, he heard a strange noise. He peeked out and saw a big, shiny thing. It was a big, round mirror! Sam and his friends had never seen a mirror before. They all gathered around and looked at their reflections. They laughed and played with the mirror, making funny faces and twisting their bodies. The barn was filled with joy and laughter, as they discovered something new and unexpected.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to sail on his toy boat. One day, he went to camp with his mom and dad. At camp, they had a lot of fun. They played games, ate yummy food, and listened to fun songs. At camp, Tim met a new friend named Sam. Sam had a fake toy boat. He said, "Tim, let's sail our boats together!" So, they went to a small pond and sailed their boats. Tim's boat sailed fast, but Sam's fake boat did not sail well. It went slow and wobbly. Tim saw Sam was sad and said, "Don't be sad, Sam. We can make your boat better." They worked together and fixed Sam's boat. Now, both boats sailed fast and smooth. They played all day and had lots of fun. In the end, Tim and Sam learned that helping each other is good. They became best friends and always helped each other. And they always remembered the fun they had at camp with their boats.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was very hungry. He asked his mom, "Please, can I have some food?" His mom said, "Yes, you can have a snack." Tim and his mom went to a big temple. The temple was very pretty. They saw many people there. Tim said, "Hello!" to everyone. The people were happy to see him. At the temple, they found some yummy food. Tim ate the food and was not hungry anymore. He said, "Thank you, Mom!" They went home, and Tim was very happy.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a spring. The spring was very special because it was flexible. It could stretch and bend like a rubber band. All the kids in the village loved to play with the flexible spring. One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to test the spring. He asked his friend, Sally, "Do you want to test the spring with me?" Sally said, "Yes, let's do it!" So, Tim and Sally went to the spring and started to play. They pulled and stretched the spring, and it would always bounce back. They had so much fun testing the flexible spring. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. It was a perfect day for Tim and Sally to play with their favorite toy, the flexible spring.

One day, a little girl named Ava went to the park to play. While she was there, she saw a butterfly. She wanted to match it, so she followed it until she came to a clearing in the grass. Suddenly, Ava heard a noise behind her - it was an invitation! She was invited to a party. Ava was very excited and agreed to go. When she arrived at the party, Ava was a bit scared. All around her were unfamiliar faces. But everyone was so friendly, they soon made her feel at home. At the end of the day, Ava thanked her friends for inviting her and went home feeling happy. She couldn't wait to go back and match the butterfly again!

Sara and Ben were twins who liked to play together. But sometimes they did not agree on what to play. One day, they found a big box in the garage. Sara wanted to make a house out of the box. Ben wanted to make a car out of the box. "I want to make a house," Sara said. "We can pretend to be a family and have a turkey for dinner." "I want to make a car," Ben said. "We can pretend to be racers and go fast and win." They did not agree. They pulled and pushed the box. They shouted and cried. They made a big mess. Mom heard the noise and came to the garage. She saw the box and the twins. She was not happy. "What are you doing?" Mom asked. "Why are you fighting over the box?" Sara and Ben told Mom what they wanted to do. Mom thought for a moment. Then she smiled. "I have an idea," Mom said. "Why don't you make a house and a car out of the box? You can cut the box in half and use one half for each. Then you can play together and share." Sara and Ben liked Mom's idea. They said sorry to each other. They worked together to make a house and a car out of the box. They used crayons and stickers to decorate them. They had fun playing with their new toys. They pretended to be a family and have a turkey for dinner in the house. They pretended to be racers and go fast and win in the car. They also pretended to be neighbors and visit each other. They agreed that playing together was better than fighting. They thanked Mom for helping them. Mom was proud of them. She gave them a hug and a kiss.

One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk. She saw a smooth rock on the ground. It was so round and nice to touch. Lily picked up the rock and put it in her pocket. As she walked, Lily felt cold. She sighed and said, "I wish I had a warm coat." Just then, a big bear came out from behind a tree. The bear wore a big, warm coat. He saw Lily and said, "You look cold. Would you like my coat?" Lily was scared at first, but the bear was nice. She took the coat and said, "Thank you, Mr. Bear." The bear smiled and walked away. Lily put on the warm coat and felt much better. She sighed with happiness and continued her walk, with her smooth rock still in her pocket.

One morning, a teacher was in her classroom. She had a group of pupils in front of her and they were all very excited! The teacher had an ordinary ball and she said, "Let's play a game!" She threw the ball to one of the pupils and said, "Now you throw it!" The pupil smiled and threw the ball to another pupil. The game went on and on, with each pupil throwing the ball to the next. Everyone had fun and the ball kept travelling around the classroom. The teacher was pleased with how everyone was playing together and in the end, each pupil had their turn to throw the ball. It was an ordinary morning, but the teacher and pupils had a great time playing together.

One day, a wet dog named Spot went for a walk. He saw an igloo and wanted to look inside. He went close to the igloo and heard a voice. "Who is there?" the voice questioned. It was a little boy named Tim. Tim was hiding in the igloo because he was playing a game. Spot said, "I am a wet dog. Can I come in?" Tim thought about it and said, "Yes, you can come in." As Spot went inside the igloo, something unexpected happened. The igloo started to shake and it grew bigger and bigger! Tim and Spot were so surprised. They looked at each other and laughed. Now, they had a big igloo to play in together.

One day, a polite giant named Bob went to cook some food. He was very big and tall. He lived in a big house in the woods. Bob liked to cook yummy things for his friends. One day, a little girl named Lily came to Bob's house. She said, "Mr. Giant, can you cook me some food? I am very hungry." Bob was happy to help. He cooked her a big plate of food. Lily was very happy and said, "Thank you, Mr. Giant!" But then, something strange happened. When Lily ate the food, she grew very big! She was as tall as Bob the giant! They both laughed and played together in the woods. Now, they were not just friends, but giant friends. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a thin puzzle in his toy box. He wanted to play with it, but he needed help. So, he went to his big sister, Sue. "Help me with this puzzle, please?" Tim asked Sue. Sue looked at the puzzle and smiled. "Of course, I will help you!" she said. They sat down and started to put the pieces together. As they worked on the puzzle, Mom came into the room. She saw them playing together and was happy. "Do you want a snack?" Mom offered. Tim and Sue said "Yes, please!" They took a break to eat their snack and then finished the puzzle. They were proud of their teamwork.

Lila loved her goat, Nana. Nana was a white goat with brown spots and horns. Nana was obedient and followed Lila everywhere. Lila liked to feed Nana grass and carrots and brush her fur. One day, Lila wanted to take Nana to the park. She asked her mom, "Mom, can I take Nana to the park?" Mom said, "Yes, you can, but you have to be careful. The park is big and there are many people and dogs. You have to hold Nana's leash and not let her run away." Lila nodded and said, "OK, mom. I will be careful and hold Nana's leash. Nana is obedient and will not run away." Lila and Nana walked to the park. They saw many flowers and trees and birds. They also saw many people and dogs. Some dogs barked at Nana and some people smiled at Nana. Lila said, "Hello, this is my goat, Nana. She is obedient and friendly." Some people and dogs wanted to pet Nana and play with her. Lila let them, but she always held Nana's leash and watched her. Nana liked to be petted and played with, but she always stayed close to Lila. Lila and Nana had a lot of fun at the park. They made new friends and saw new things. When it was time to go home, Lila said, "Thank you for playing with us. Bye-bye." Lila and Nana walked back home. They were happy and tired. Mom was waiting for them. She said, "How was the park?" Lila said, "It was great, mom. We met many people and dogs. Nana was obedient and did not run away. She is a good goat." Mom said, "I'm glad you had fun, Lila. And I'm proud of you and Nana. You are a good girl and Nana is a good goat."

Once upon a time, in a small fair town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. He would spring up and down, laughing and having fun. Tim had a best friend named Sam. They played together every day. One day, Tim and Sam found a pair of scissors on the ground. They knew they should not play with the scissors, as they could be dangerous. So, they decided to give the scissors to Tim's mom. She would know what to do. Tim's mom was very happy that the boys did the right thing. She told them they were very smart and fair. To thank them, she gave them a big cookie to share. Tim and Sam enjoyed the cookie, and they continued to spring and play outside, knowing they had done a good thing.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sue. She was 3 years old and loved blue things. One day, Sue went out for a walk. She saw a bakery and opened the door. Inside, she was welcomed with the sweet smell of freshly-baked pastries. She was so excited! She chose a blue pastry and took it with her. Suddenly, dark clouds started forming. Then, it started raining. Sue ran back home, trying to not get her pastry wet. “Mommy!” she shouted, “It's raining!” Her mom hugged her and said, “Don't worry sweetie, let's just eat your pastry before it gets soggy.” Unfortunately, it was too late. Once they opened the pastry box, they found that it was already wet and mushy. Sue was so sad. The moral of the story? Always eat your pastries quickly before it starts raining.

Once upon a time, there was a big alligator. He was very spoiled. He always wanted more and more. One day, the alligator saw a little girl. The girl was playing with her toy. The alligator decided he wanted the toy. He said, "Give me your toy, or I will eat you up!" The little girl was scared, but she did not want to give up her toy. She said, "No, you can't have it!" The alligator got very angry. He tried to take the toy from the girl. But the girl was brave. She held on to her toy very tight. The alligator could not get it from her. In the end, the alligator was too greedy. He tried to eat the girl and the toy. But he was not careful. He got stuck between two trees. The alligator was very sad and the girl was safe. The spoiled alligator did not get the toy, and he could not move.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a very long haircut. One day, Tim went to the park to play. He saw a big rock and thought it would be fun to play with it. Tim tried to rock on the big rock, but his long haircut got stuck. He tried to pull his hair out, but it hurt too much. Tim started to cry. A nice man saw Tim and wanted to help. The man had a yummy cookie in his hand. The man tried to give the yummy cookie to Tim, but Tim was too sad to eat it. The man tried to help Tim get his hair out of the rock, but it was too hard. In the end, Tim's hair stayed stuck and he could not eat the yummy cookie. The nice man went away, and Tim was still sad. The day ended with Tim feeling very bad.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat in a port. The boat was very pretty and had many colors. One day, a foolish bird came to the port. The bird saw the pretty boat and wanted to play with it. The bird landed on the boat and started to dance. The boat started to move and soon, it began to vanish. The bird was scared and did not know what to do. The bird thought the boat was magic and could not believe it was vanishing. But then, the bird saw a man behind the boat. The man was pulling the boat with a rope. The bird felt silly because the boat was not magic after all. The bird flew away and learned not to be foolish again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a big, heavy bag. In the bag, there was a comb and a wash cloth. Sue liked to wash her face and comb her hair every day. One day, Sue went to the park with her heavy bag. She wanted to wash her face and comb her hair under the big tree. But when she opened her bag, her comb and wash cloth were gone! Sue was sad and didn't know what to do. Just then, a small bird flew down from the tree. The bird had Sue's comb and wash cloth in its beak! The bird gave them back to Sue. She was so happy! Sue washed her face and combed her hair. She thanked the bird, and they played together in the park all day.

One day, a little girl named Ann found a troubled cat in her yard. The cat was sad and hungry. Ann wanted to help the cat, so she gave it some food. The cat was happy and said, "Thank you, Ann!" Ann and the cat became best friends. They liked to play with a ball. They would roll the ball in a circle, and the cat would try to catch it. They played this game every day, and they always had fun. One day, while they were playing, the ball rolled into a bush. When the cat went to get the ball, it found a big treasure chest! Ann and the cat opened the chest, and inside was a lot of gold and a note. The note said, "This treasure will end all your troubles." Ann and the cat were so happy that they had found the treasure, and they knew their troubles were over.

One day, a little girl named Lily and her best friend, a funny cat named Tom, wanted to watch a movie. They looked for a movie that they would both like. They found a movie about a big, funny dog that made them both laugh. Before starting the movie, Lily said, "Tom, let's listen to the movie and try to find the funny parts." Tom the cat agreed and said, "Yes, Lily. I will listen very well." They sat down on the soft couch and started the movie. As they watched the movie, they listened carefully to the funny dog's silly barks and laughs. They both laughed and had a great time. When the movie was over, Lily said, "Tom, that was a very funny movie! I'm happy we listened to it together." Tom the cat agreed and said, "Yes, Lily. It was a lot of fun!" They both smiled and looked forward to watching more funny movies together.

Once upon a time, a little blue bird lived in a tree. The bird loved to fly high in the sky. One day, the bird flew very high and saw a big cloud of dust. The bird was curious and wanted to see what was in the dust. As the bird flew closer, it saw a big cat. The cat was playing with a ball. The bird wanted to play too. So, the bird flew down to the cat and asked, "Can I play with you?". The cat said, "Yes, let's play together!" They played with the ball and had a lot of fun. But then, the ball went too far and the bird tried to catch it. The bird flew very fast, but it missed the ball. The ball fell into a hole. The bird and the cat looked into the hole and saw a big surprise. Inside the hole, there was a big pile of shiny, pretty things. The bird and the cat were very happy. They played with the shiny things and forgot about the ball. They became best friends and played together every day.

Sara and Ben were playing on the beach. They liked to look for shells and rocks. Sara found a big shell that was shiny and had many colors. She was very happy. "Look, Ben, look at my shell!" she said. "It is so fancy and pretty!" Ben came to see the shell. He liked it too. He wanted to have it for himself. He tried to take it from Sara's hand. "Give me the shell, Sara!" he said. "I want it!" "No, Ben, no!" Sara said. "It is my shell! I found it first!" They both pulled the shell. They did not want to share. They were angry and loud. Their mom heard them. She came to see what was wrong. She saw them fighting over the shell. "Stop, Sara and Ben, stop!" she said. "Why are you fighting? You have so many shells and rocks. You can share them with each other." She took the shell from their hands. She removed it from their reach. She put it on a high rock. "Look at the shell, Sara and Ben," she said. "It is very fancy and pretty, but it is not worth fighting. Fighting is not nice. Sharing is nice. If you want to play with the shell, you have to take turns. Do you understand?" Sara and Ben nodded. They felt sorry. They said sorry to each other. They hugged and smiled. "Can we play with the shell now, mom?" they asked. "Yes, you can, Sara and Ben," mom said. "But remember to share and be nice. And don't forget to say thank you to the shell for being so fancy and pretty." Sara and Ben said thank you to the shell. They took turns to hold it and look at it. They played nicely on the beach. They were happy.

Jazz is a cat who likes to play. He has a ball, a mouse, and a feather. He runs and jumps and chases them. He is very happy. One day, Jazz sees a bird outside the window. He wants to catch the bird. He runs to the window and jumps. But the window is closed. Jazz hits his head on the glass. He falls to the floor. He feels hurt. Jazz cries. He makes a loud noise. He wants his mom. His mom hears him and comes to see. She sees Jazz on the floor. She sees the window. She knows what happened. She picks up Jazz and hugs him. She kisses his head. She says, "It's okay, Jazz. You are brave. The bird is safe. The window is hard. You need to be careful." Jazz stops crying. He feels better. He purrs. He looks at his mom. He sees her smile. He smiles too. He laughs. He loves his mom. His mom loves him. They are happy.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a wise old owl. He lived in a tall tree. The owl had many friends, like the rabbit, the squirrel, and the mouse. One day, the wise owl found a magic flower. The flower could make things shrink. The owl wanted to show his friends. He picked the flower with his beak and put it on his palm. The owl showed the flower to his friends. The rabbit wanted to try it. He touched the flower with his paw. But, oh no! The rabbit shrunk! He was so small now. His friends were scared. The wise owl knew he had to find a way to help the rabbit. They all worked together to find a way to make the rabbit big again. And they did! The rabbit was happy and thanked the wise owl. They all learned to be careful with magic.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little girl named Lily. Lily loved to ride her red bike around the park. One sunny day, she saw her friend Timmy sitting on a bench, looking sad. Lily rode to Timmy and asked, "Why are you sad, Timmy?" Timmy replied, "It's my birthday, but no one gave me a present." Lily thought for a moment, then had an idea. She said, "I will find a present for you, Timmy!" Lily rode her bike around the park, looking for a present. She found a pretty flower and gave it to Timmy. He smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily! This is the best present ever!" They played together in the park all day, and Timmy was happy again. The moral of the story is that even small things can make someone happy. It's the thought and love that counts when giving a present.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a fancy red dress that she loved to wear. One day, Lily went to pick apples from a tree in her yard. She saw her friend, the big bear, who always had a big smile on his face. Lily asked the bear, "Can you help me carry the apples?" The bear said, "Yes, I can!" So, they picked the apples together. The bear carried the apples in a big basket. Lily wore her fancy red dress, and the bear had a big smile. As they walked back to Lily's house, they met a little bird. The bird sang a happy song. They all laughed and danced together. Lily, the bear, and the bird had so much fun. They shared the apples and had a great day.

There was once a little girl and her name was Jane. Every day she would wake up and eat breakfast with her family. Then she would go outside to play. Today she wanted to have some fun. She ran and jumped, laughed and danced. She skipped around far away from their house. Jane felt so distant and free. Before long, Jane was feeling very tired and her legs were feeling achy. Jane decided it was time to rest! She found a comfortable spot in the grass and lay down. The sun warmed her face and the birds in the trees sang to her. Jane felt so relaxed and safe. She fell asleep in that spot and stayed there for a long time. When she woke up again, Jane felt energised and excited. She hopped up and started running around again, enjoying her fun day outside.

Anna and Ben are sister and brother. They like to play with their toys and make funny noises. One day, they find a big lemon in the kitchen. They wonder how it tastes. "Let's try it!" Ben says. He cuts the lemon in half and gives one piece to Anna. They both lick the lemon and make a face. "Yuck! It is sour!" Anna says. She spits out the lemon and wipes her tongue. "Me too! It is sour!" Ben says. He throws the lemon in the trash and drinks some water. They look at each other and laugh. They think the lemon is a bad joke. "Let's play something else," Anna says. She picks up her doll and hugs it. "OK," Ben says. He grabs his car and zooms it around. They play happily and forget about the sour lemon. They succeed in having fun. They love each other very much. They are a good sister and brother.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. Tim saw a big orange swing. He wanted to play on it. His mom said, "Okay, let's go on the swing." At the swing, Tim saw a new friend named Sam. Tim's mom said, "Introduce yourself to Sam." Tim said, "Hi, I'm Tim." Sam said, "Hi, I'm Sam. Can we play on the swing?" Tim and Sam played on the orange swing. They went up and down, and had lots of fun. They laughed and played until it was time to go home. Tim and Sam were happy they met each other and became friends.

Once upon a time there was a wizard called Malerious. Malerious was very kind and always loved to collect jewels. One day, Malerious went to the magical forest to find new treasures. He walked and walked until he finally reached the forest. When he arrived he was really surprised to see all the beautiful jewels. He started to pick up the jewels and collect them in his bag. Suddenly, he heard a voice. "What are you doing?" asked the voice. Malerious was so scared he nearly dropped his bag! He looked around and saw a fairy smiling at him. "I'm collecting these jewels," he said. "Oh well, I can help you. I am ready to collect the jewels too," said the fairy. So they started to collect the jewels together. After some time they had collected all of the jewels in the forest. Malerious was so happy with the help of the fairy. He thanked her and they both went back home.

Once upon a time, there was a lady. She liked to bring pretty things, so she brought a delicate flower for a party. The flower sparkled and shined! Everyone was so excited, it was no surprise that they wanted to dance. The lady took the flower and started to spin it around the party. Everyone was so happy! But, then one of the guests made a mistake - they held the flower a bit too tight and it broke. Everybody was sad. The lady said, "Oh no, what happened? Who made the mistake?" But nobody answered. The lady sadly went home without her delicate flower. Everyone was very quiet. The party had ended with a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a happy family. Mama and Papa wanted to have a special day together. Mama brought home a special bottle of wine and Papa set out two cups. He filled the cups with a thick, purple liquid. Mama said to Papa, "Let's make a toast!" They hugged each other and clinked their cups together. Papa said, "Let's drink this yummy wine and be happy!" He took a big sip of the thick liquid. Mama smiled. She said, "Let's hug each other and then drink the wine together." They hugged tightly and laughed. Then they each took another sip of the special wine. Papa said, "This wine is delicious! Let's do this again soon." They hugged once more and finished their cups of wine. The happy family smiled, grateful that they could be together and have such a special moment. They agreed to do this again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She loved to cook with her mom. They cooked yummy things like cookies, pies, and cakes. Sue was very happy when she cooked. One day, Sue saw a glass on the table. It was very pretty. She wanted to use it to drink her milk. But she was too small to reach it. Sue tried to get the glass, but it fell and broke. Sue was sad and felt bad. Her mom saw what happened and hugged Sue. She said, "It's okay, we can clean it up. Next time, ask for help when you want the glass." Sue learned it's better to ask for help than to do something bad. They cleaned up the broken glass and later cooked a yummy dinner together. Sue was happy again.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a favorite blue shirt that he loved to wear every day. He also had a big cupboard in his room where he kept all his toys and clothes. One day, Tim could not find his blue shirt. He looked everywhere but could not find it. He started to complain to his mom. "Mom, I can't find my blue shirt!" he said. Mom told him to look in the cupboard. Tim looked in the cupboard, but he still could not find his blue shirt. Tim's mom told him to clean up his cupboard and maybe he would find his blue shirt. Tim did not want to clean up, but he really wanted his blue shirt. So, he cleaned up his cupboard and found his blue shirt at the very back. Tim was very happy and learned that if he keeps his things neat and tidy, he will not lose them and will not need to complain.

Once upon a time, there was a humble cat named Tom. Tom had a big head and loved to play with his friends. One day, Tom went to the park to play with his friend, Sam the dog. Tom saw Sam and said, "Hi Sam! Let's play ball!" Sam wagged his tail and said, "Yes, let's play!" They took turns throwing the ball and running after it. They laughed and had lots of fun. As they played, a big wind came and blew the ball away. Tom and Sam chased after the ball, but it was too fast. The ball struck a tree and bounced back. Tom jumped high and caught the ball with his head. Tom and Sam laughed and went back to playing. They had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted to join the colour parade with everyone else in her town. So, Lucy asked her mom for a flag. Her mom smiled and said, "A flag? Yes, I can make you a flag." The next day, mom gave Lucy a soft pink flag. It had white stars around the edges. Lucy was so happy! She waved her flag in the air and ran off to join the parade. However, when she got there, the other children were all carrying different colours of flags. Some had blue flags, some had green flags, but none of them had a pink flag like Lucy's. Mom was standing by the side watching. She ran up to Lucy and said, "Lucy, listen to me! Everyone has their own special flag to carry in the parade. You can still join the parade with your pink flag. Don't worry about being different." Lucy smiled and ran back to join the other kids. She waved her pink flag and enjoyed the parade. The moral of the story is that it's ok to be different and it's never too late to join in something new. Everyone should be proud of who they are and not be afraid to show it!

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a lucky coin on the floor. She was very happy and showed it to her friend, Tom. "Look, Tom! I found a lucky coin!" said Lucy. Tom was very excited too. Lucy and Tom wanted to prevent anyone from taking their lucky coin. So, they decided to hide it behind the curtain in Lucy's room. They knew it would be safe there. Later, Lucy's mom came into the room and saw the curtain moving. "What's behind the curtain?" she asked. Lucy and Tom looked at each other and smiled. "It's our lucky coin!" they said. Lucy's mom smiled too and knew their secret was safe.

Once upon a time there lived a girl named Anna who loved to explore. Every day, Anna would take her watch and follow a different path to discover new places. One day, Anna followed an unfamiliar street and came across an open field. The field was so wide that Anna could not see its end. Overjoyed, she sat in the field and started playing with the wildflowers growing all around. Suddenly, Anna heard the sound of clapping. She looked up to find an old man smiling at her. He said in a kindly voice, "Hello, little one! If you are willing to explore, make sure you understand the importance of hard work too!" Anna was surprised but she nodded to show that she understood. Anna thanked the old man and went home, but the man's words stayed with her. Every time Anna wanted to go exploring, she remembered what he said and worked hard in her studies first. The moral of the story is that it is important to always stay curious, but it is also important to work hard and be responsible.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old owl. The owl lived in a big tree in the forest. The owl was very smart and knew many things. One day, the owl saw a little boy walking in the forest. The boy was looking for something to eat. The wise owl saw that the boy was about to eat a berry. The owl knew that the berry had poison inside. The owl told the boy, "Do not eat that berry! It has poison inside and will make you sick!" The boy listened to the wise owl and did not eat the berry. As the boy and the owl talked, more and more animals came to listen. The number of animals listening to the wise owl increased. But then, something unexpected happened. The wise owl said, "I will show you a better berry to eat!" The owl flew down and picked up a berry that was not poison. The animals were so happy that they all started to eat the good berries. And they all became friends with the wise owl.

One day, a boy named Tim went outside to play. He saw two paths to choose from. One path was full of dust and the other was clean. Tim was glad because he liked to make choices. Tim chose the dusty path. He walked and walked. He found a big tree with a swing. Tim played on the swing and had lots of fun. He was very happy. After playing, Tim went home. His mom saw the dust on his clothes. She was not mad, but glad. She said, "You had fun today, and that's what matters." Tim smiled and hugged his mom. They both were happy.

One day, a little boy went for a walk. He saw a big, hairy dog. The dog was nice and liked to play. The boy and the dog became friends. The boy and the dog went to the park. They gazed at the sky and saw pretty birds. They played with a ball and had fun. The dog liked to run and catch the ball. Then, they found a little twig on the ground. The boy threw the twig and the dog ran to get it. They played with the twig for a long time. The boy and the dog were very happy.

Tommy was excited because he was going to read for the first time. He went to the living room and saw a huge, ugly cabinet in the corner. He opened the cabinet door and found lots of books inside. He chose one and eagerly opened it up. It was full of funny pictures and big, easy words. He read every single word with a big smile on his face. When he finished the book, he put it back in the cabinet and closed the door. He went around the house telling everyone that he had just read a book. His mom was so proud of him and gave him a nice hug. Tommy loved to read! Every day he went to the ugly cabinet and opened it up, looking for new books to read. From then on, Tommy was always seen with a book in his hand.

One day, a big boat was in the water. The boat had a clean, shiny anchor. A little fish saw the anchor and wanted to play with it. The fish swam and swam around the anchor, but it could not reach it. The fish asked the boat, "Can you please let your anchor down? I want to play with it." The boat said, "Okay, little fish. I will let my anchor down so you can play." The boat let the anchor down into the water. The fish was so happy and played with the anchor all day long. But then, something unexpected happened. The anchor got stuck in the rocks. The boat could not move. The little fish knew it had to save the boat. It asked all its fish friends to help. The fish friends worked together to free the anchor from the rocks. The boat was so thankful to the little fish and its friends. The boat said, "Thank you, little fish, for saving me. I will always remember to be careful with my anchor." The little fish learned that helping others is a good thing to do. And the boat learned to be more careful with its anchor. Everyone was happy and safe.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the zoo with his mom. They saw many animals like big elephants, tall giraffes, and funny monkeys. Tim was very happy. In the zoo, there was a smelly skunk. The skunk liked to hide from the people who came to see him. He would hide behind the trees and under the rocks. Tim saw the smelly skunk hide and wanted to find him. He looked around and found the skunk behind a tree. Tim and his mom laughed and had a fun day at the zoo.

Lily and Ben like to create things with their equipment. They have blocks, crayons, paper, scissors and glue. They can make houses, cars, animals and anything they want. One day, they decide to create a big rocket. They use a big cardboard box, some paint, some foil and some tape. They cut out windows, doors and wings. They paint the box red and blue. They stick foil on the wings and tape on the windows. They are very proud of their rocket. "Wow, our rocket is so cool!" Ben says. "We can go to the moon and see the stars!" "Yes, and we can meet aliens and have fun!" Lily says. "Let's go inside and pretend to fly!" They go inside the rocket and make noises like a real rocket. They count down from ten to one and blast off. They imagine they see planets, comets and asteroids. They have a lot of fun. After a while, they hear their mom calling them. "Lily, Ben, it's time to clean up your equipment and have a snack!" They come out of the rocket and see their mom smiling. She likes their rocket too, but she also wants them to keep their room clean. "OK, mom, we will clean up," Lily says. "But can we keep our rocket for tomorrow?" "Sure, you can keep your rocket, but you have to put away your other equipment," mom says. "And be careful with the scissors and the glue. They can be dangerous." Lily and Ben nod and start to clean up their equipment. They put their blocks, crayons, paper, scissors and glue in their boxes and drawers. They make sure their room is clean and tidy. They are happy to have a snack and tell their mom about their rocket adventure. They can't wait to play with their rocket again.

Once upon a time, there was a fierce lion named Leo. He was the king of the jungle. All the animals were scared of him. One day, Leo hurt his paw while playing. He was sad and in pain. A little bird named Chirpy saw Leo and wanted to help. Chirpy knew about a magic plant that could heal Leo's paw. So, he flew to the plant, picked some leaves and brought them back to Leo. Chirpy said, "Leo, let me put these leaves on your paw. They will make you feel better." At first, Leo did not trust Chirpy. He thought, "Why would a little bird want to help me?" But he let Chirpy put the leaves on his paw anyway. In no time, the magic plant healed Leo's paw. Leo was so happy, and he thanked Chirpy. To celebrate, Leo and Chirpy played a game of chess. They had so much fun. From that day on, the fierce lion and the little bird were best friends. They played chess every day, and the jungle was a happy place.

Once upon a time, there was a rhinoceros. He wanted to use something, but he didn't know what. He looked around and saw a big, clear pond. He climbed in and was surprised by how cool and refreshing the water felt. He dipped his head in the pond and drank some of the clear water. It was so delicious! He stayed in the pond for the rest of the day, splashing around and having fun. He laughed out loud when the water hit his big, gray skin. When it was time to go home, the rhinoceros said goodbye to the clear pond. He was very happy that he had found something to use. He hop-hopped away with a smile on his face. The end!

One day, a sleepy cat and a sleepy dog were sitting by a tree. They were friends and liked to talk. Today, they wanted to discuss a big thing in their house. It was a toilet. They did not know what it was for. The cat said, "I think it is a big water bowl." The dog said, "No, I think it is a big bed." They talked and talked, but they did not know what the toilet was for. Then, a little bird came by. The bird heard the cat and the dog talking. The bird said, "I know what the toilet is for. It is for people to go potty." The cat and the dog were happy to know what the toilet was for. They thanked the bird and went back to their house. They were not sleepy anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He had a pet bird. The bird was not dangerous. Tim and the bird played every day. They were very happy. One day, while they were playing, something unexpected happened. A big, dangerous bird came to their house. The big bird wanted to own Tim's bird. Tim was scared, but his bird was brave. The brave bird talked to the big, dangerous bird. They became friends. The big bird did not want to own Tim's bird anymore. They all played together and had fun. The big, dangerous bird was not dangerous anymore. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a calm little bunny named Pink. Pink loved to hop and play with her friends in the forest. They would laugh and have fun all day long. One day, Pink and her friends found a big pile of leaves. They wanted to play in the leaves, but there were many different colors mixed together. They decided to separate the leaves by color. Pink worked on the pink leaves, Blue worked on the blue leaves, and Green worked on the green leaves. When they finished separating the leaves, the friends jumped and played in their own piles. Pink felt happy and calm as she hopped in her pink leaf pile. At the end of the day, they all went home, excited to play together again tomorrow.

Once there was a pilot who had a dream to win a race. He was honest and worked very hard to make his dream come true. Every morning he would practice and practice until he had it just right. He believed he could win the race. The day of the race finally arrived and the pilot was feeling very excited. He climbed into his plane and flew off. Unfortunately, he was not honest enough. He cheated by cutting corners which he should not have. The race started and it looked like the pilot was going to win. But then, disaster struck. The pilot broke the rules of the race and the judges disqualified him. He had lost the race and his dream was crushed. The pilot had made a big mistake by not being honest. His dream had been dashed and all he could do was to fly back home sadly.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sarah had a very special dishwasher. It was very old, but it still worked very well. One day, Sarah's dishwasher stopped working! She didn't know what to do. She asked her dad for help. "Dad, the dishwasher is broken!" Sarah said. "Oh, don't worry sweetheart," her dad said. "We will get it fixed. But you need to be careful, because it can be very dangerous if you try to fix it yourself." Sarah nodded and decided to try to fix it anyway. She thought she knew how to do it. She began to try to open up the dishwasher, but it was hard to do. She kept pushing and pulling, but it wouldn't open. Suddenly, her dad came in and saw what she was doing. He was very angry and scolded her. "That was very stupid!" her dad said. "Don't ever try to fix something like a dishwasher without getting help. You could have broken it and it would have been impossible to save!" Sarah apologised and promised to never try to fix something without help again. And the dishwasher was saved in the end, thanks to Sarah's dad!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom liked to run and play with his friends. One day, Tom and his friends had a race to see who was the fastest. Tom wanted to win. Before the race, Tom saw a big dog. The dog was a threat. Tom was scared, but he knew he had to be brave. He ran away from the dog and went to the race. Tom and his friends started the race. They ran and ran. Tom was tired, but he did not stop. He ran faster and faster. In the end, Tom won the race. He was very happy and his friends cheered for him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toys and keep them clean. One day, Tim found a big, long tube in his toy box. He did not know what it was for, but he knew he would find out soon. Tim took the tube outside to play. He saw his friend, Sue, and they decided to meet at the park. They took the tube with them and started to think of fun games to play. They put the tube on the slide and tried to roll it down, but it would not go. They were sad but knew they would find the right game. Finally, Tim and Sue found a big hill. They put the tube at the top and watched it roll down, fast and smooth. They laughed and clapped as it went all the way down. They played with the tube all day and had so much fun. At the end of the day, they took the tube back to Tim's house and made sure it was clean. Now, they knew the tube was perfect for rolling down hills, and they couldn't wait to play again.

Jill and Ben were playing with their ball on the porch. They liked to bounce it and catch it and throw it to each other. They were having fun. "Look, Jill, I can bounce it really high!" Ben said. He threw the ball up in the air and watched it come down. "Wow, Ben, you are good!" Jill said. She clapped her hands and smiled. But then the ball bounced too high and went over the porch railing. It landed on the street, where a big car was coming fast. "Ben, the ball!" Jill shouted. She ran to the railing and pointed at the street. Ben saw the ball and the car. He was scared. He wanted his ball back. He thought the car was harmless. He did not know it could hurt him. He ran after the ball. He did not look both ways. He did not hear Jill scream. He did not see the car hit him. He only felt a big pain and then nothing. Jill saw Ben drop to the ground. She saw blood and tears. She saw the car stop and the driver get out. She saw people run and shout and call for help. She saw her brother and her ball and she cried. She wished she could go back and play on the porch. She wished she could make it all go away. But she could not.

Once upon a time, there was a parrot. The parrot liked to play hide and seek with his friend, a little boy. One day, the parrot was upset. He did not want to play hide and seek. The little boy was sad too. The little boy thought of a plan to make the parrot happy. He found a big, red ball. He showed the ball to the parrot. The parrot looked at the ball and started to laugh. The little boy was happy to see the parrot laugh. Then, something unexpected happened. The big, red ball started to bounce away. The parrot and the little boy ran after the ball. They laughed and played as they chased the ball. In the end, the parrot was not upset anymore. They played hide and seek with the big, red ball, and they had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there lived a 3 year old boy. He was very brave, and often went on adventures with his friends. One day, the boy and his friends thought it would be fun to go on a picinic in the park. The boy was so excited when he saw an amazing orange trophy across the park! He wanted to touch it, so he went to pick it up. But, when he reached for the trophy, it began to bounce and roll away from him. The boy's friends began laughing, and he felt embarrassed. He wanted to prove he was brave, so he chased after the trophy. Around and around the park he ran, and he wouldn't give up trying to reach it. Finally, he caught it and held it close to his chest. His friends were so impressed, they cheered and gave him a huge hug. The boy was very proud of himself for catching the orange trophy, and for not giving up his chase. He had shown his bravery, and would never forget that day!

Once upon a time, there was a big tree with many fruits. The fruits were called picks. In the tree, there were two birds named Tom and Jerry. Tom and Jerry were always trying to get the most picks. They were very competitive. One day, Tom and Jerry had a race to see who could get the most picks. They both flew very fast, picking as many picks as they could carry. They wanted to weigh their picks to see who had more. When they were done, they put their picks on a big leaf to weigh them. Tom's pile was bigger, but Jerry's pile was heavier. They both did a good job and were happy. In the end, they shared the picks with all their friends.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom lived in a little house in the west. He liked to sleep all day and play all night. One sunny day, Tom saw a pretty cat named Sue. Tom wanted to marry Sue. But Sue said, "I will not marry a lazy cat like you." Tom was sad but he wanted to show Sue that he was not lazy. The next day, Tom woke up early and worked hard. He caught a big fish for Sue. But when he gave the fish to Sue, something unexpected happened. A big dog came and took the fish away. Tom and Sue were both surprised. They ran after the dog and got the fish back. After that, Tom was not lazy anymore. He worked hard every day. Sue saw this and she was happy. In the end, Sue said yes to marry Tom. They lived happily ever after.

Tom was a cheerful boy who liked to play with his toys. He had a red car, a blue ball, a yellow duck and a green coin. He liked the coin because it was shiny and made a nice sound when he shook it. One day, Tom was playing with his coin on the floor. He tossed it up and down and caught it in his hand. He smiled and laughed. He wanted to see how the coin tasted, so he put it in his mouth and chewed on it. But the coin was hard and bitter. It hurt Tom's teeth and tongue. He made a face and spat it out. He did not like the coin anymore. He started to cry. His mom heard him cry and came to see what was wrong. She saw the coin on the floor and Tom's mouth. She was worried and angry. She picked up Tom and hugged him. She said, "Tom, you should not chew on coins. They are not food. They are dirty and can make you sick. You could also choke on them. You are a good boy, but you have to be careful." Tom felt sorry and scared. He said, "I'm sorry, mom. I won't chew on coins again. I love you." He gave his mom a kiss and a hug. His mom smiled and said, "I love you too, Tom. Let's go wash your mouth and find something yummy to eat." She took Tom to the bathroom and then to the kitchen. She gave him a glass of milk and a cookie. Tom felt better and happy. He thanked his mom and ate his cookie. He decided to play with his other toys and leave the coin alone. He learned his lesson.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man who liked to gaze at the sky. He had a game called chess that he loved to play with his friends. They would sit outside, play chess, and look at the sky together. One day, while the elderly man was gazing at the sky, he saw something strange. It was a big, shiny thing in the sky. He called his friends to come and see. They all stopped playing chess and looked at the sky too. They didn't know what the shiny thing was. Then, the shiny thing came down from the sky. It was a big, friendly bird who could talk! The bird said it liked to play chess too. The elderly man and his friends were very surprised. They played chess with the bird and had a lot of fun. From that day on, the bird would come to visit and play chess with them.

Once upon a time, there was a charming little bear. He lived in the woods and liked poking around to find adventure. One day, he found a big shock. He thought it might be dangerous, so he poked it carefully. Suddenly, it made a loud noise. He was so scared that he almost ran away, but then he heard a voice. It said, "Don't worry, little bear. I won't hurt you. I'm just a little shock looking for a friend." The bear was so surprised, but he was also curious. So he asked the shock, "What is a friend?" The shock said "A friend is someone who is always there for you when you need them, even if it's just to give you a little surprise." The bear was so happy to have a new friend. He knew he could always rely on the surprise that the shock gave. And he was full of joy to have found a charming new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom liked to play hide and seek with his friends. One day, they found a hidden place behind a big tree. In the hidden place, they saw a broken toy car. Tom wanted to repair the toy car. He went to his dad and asked for help. His dad said, "I will help you if you eat all your beef at dinner tonight." Tom loved beef, so he agreed. That night, Tom ate all his beef. His dad helped him repair the toy car. They made it look like new. Tom and his friends played with the toy car in their hidden place. They had lots of fun and lived happily ever after.

One day, Tom went to the park with his mom. They saw a big, old oak tree. Tom's mom said, "Tom, can you count how many leaves are on the oak tree?" Tom started to count. While Tom was counting, a clean, white cat jumped out of the tree. "Wow!" said Tom. "I did not see you up there!" The cat said, "Hello, Tom! I live in the oak tree. Can you help me find my toy?" Tom and the cat looked under the oak tree. They found the toy! It was a small, red ball. The cat was very happy. "Thank you, Tom!" said the cat. Tom and the cat played together under the oak tree.

Once upon a time, there was a white leopard. The white leopard lived in a big forest. The white leopard had many friends. But, the white leopard was not nice. One day, a little bird saw the white leopard near a small house. The little bird knew the white leopard was not nice. The little bird wanted to warn the people in the house. The little bird flew to the house and said, "White leopard is coming!" The people in the house did not listen to the little bird. They did not believe the little bird. They thought the white leopard was nice because it was white. They did not know the white leopard was not nice. The white leopard came to the house. The people opened the door for the white leopard. The white leopard went inside the house. The people were very scared when they saw the white leopard was not nice. The little bird was sad because the people did not listen to the warning. The white leopard was not nice to the people, and they all had a bad day.

One day, a little girl named Sara was playing in her room. She could hear a noise outside. It was the mailman with a big package. Sara was very excited to see what was inside. She thought it was a toy for her. Sara ran to the door and opened the package. But it was not a toy. It was a silly hat! Sara felt foolish for thinking it was a toy. She decided to wear the hat and show her mom. As Sara walked into the kitchen, her mom started to laugh. "Sara, that is not a hat!" her mom said. "It's a cover for our big pot!" Sara and her mom laughed together. The package was not for Sara, but it still made her day fun and unexpected.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty girl who owned a toy. She loved to play with it all the time. One day, she pressed a button on the toy and she got a big shock! She was so surprised that she dropped the toy on the ground. But then, she felt a tingly feeling in her tummy and laughed. She picked up the toy and hugged it. She had learnt an important lesson - never press a button without knowing what it does!

Once upon a time, there was a thin ant named Tim. Tim loved to march with his ant friends. They marched all day long, up and down the hill. One day, Tim saw a rope. He thought it would be fun to play with. So he called his friend Sam. "Sam, come play with me and the rope!" said Tim. Sam came running and they started to play. But, as they played, they did not see a big bird in the sky. The bird saw the ants and their rope. The bird wanted to play too. The bird came down fast and grabbed the rope. Tim and Sam tried to hold on, but they were too small. The bird flew away with the rope and the ants. And that was the end of Tim and Sam's playtime.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to go to her grandma's house. At grandma's house, they would have tea together. Sue liked to wear her tight dress when she went to grandma's house. One day, Sue went to grandma's house for tea. They sat down and poured the tea. Sue was very happy. But then, Sue spilled the tea on her tight dress. Sue was sad, and grandma tried to help clean the dress. They tried to wash the tight dress, but the stain would not go away. Sue cried, and grandma hugged her. They could not fix the tight dress. Sue went home without her tight dress, and she was very sad.

Lily was a busy bee who liked to fly around the flowers and make honey. She had yellow and black stripes and a big wing on each side of her body. She was happy and friendly and liked to talk to other bees and animals. One day, she saw a bright red thing in the sky. It looked like a big flower, but it was very hot and had smoke coming out of it. Lily was curious and wanted to see it closer. She flew towards the red thing, but did not notice that it was a fire balloon. "Be careful, Lily!" shouted her friend Max, another bee who was flying nearby. "That is not a flower, that is a fire balloon! It can burn you and hurt you!" But Lily did not hear him. She was too busy looking at the fire balloon. She thought it was pretty and shiny and wanted to touch it. She flew closer and closer, until she was very near the fire balloon. Suddenly, she felt a sharp pain in her wing. The fire balloon had burned her wing and made a hole in it. Lily cried out loud and fell down from the sky. She was scared and hurt and did not know what to do. Max saw what happened and flew quickly to help her. He caught her in his arms and carried her to a safe place. He found some leaves and wrapped them around her wing. He tried to make her feel better. "I'm sorry, Lily," he said. "You should have listened to me. The fire balloon is dangerous. It is not a flower, it is a thing that people make. It can burn you and make you fall." Lily looked at him with tears in her eyes. She felt sorry too. She had been silly and not careful. She had hurt her wing and her friend. "I'm sorry, Max," she said. "You were right. I should have listened to you. The fire balloon is not pretty, it is bad. It burned me and made me fall. Thank you for helping me. You are a good friend." Max smiled and hugged her. He was glad that she was okay. He was a good friend. They stayed together until Lily's wing felt better. Then they flew back to their hive and told their friends what happened. They learned a lesson and never went near the fire balloon again. They were happy and friendly and liked to talk to other bees and animals.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a boy named Tom. Tom had a big axe. He used it to cut wood for his family. One day, Tom walked into the woods to find some wood. Tom saw a big tree with clear, blue sky behind it. He wanted to cut the tree with his axe. But, a little bird was sitting on a branch. The bird said, "Please don't cut my tree. This is where I live." Tom felt sad for the bird. He said, "Okay, I won't cut your tree." Then, Tom walked to another tree. He looked around and saw a nice spot to lie down. He lay on the soft grass and looked at the sky. He felt happy and took a nap.

Once upon a time, in a big, big forest, there lived a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to play outside, and one day, she found an unknown tent. It was a pretty tent, with many colors. Mia wanted to see what was inside. Mia went into the tent and found a big, big cake. She was very hungry, so she started to eat the cake. Mia wanted to finish the whole cake. But when she was almost done, she heard a sound. She was scared. The sound was a small, friendly dog. The dog was looking for the cake too. Mia was happy to share the cake with the dog. They both finished the cake together. Mia and the dog became best friends and played in the tent all day.

One day, Pippa was walking through the woods. She really wanted to find a hippo. Suddenly, she heard some strange sounds coming from nearby. "What was that?" Pippa asked herself. Pippa cautiously crept forward and pushed aside a bush. She couldn't believe her eyes. There was a weird hippo there! He was eating apples and singing to himself. Pippa thought that the hippo was really strange, but she still wanted to be his friend. She waved to him, but he just looked away. Frustrated, Pippa started to walk away. Then, the hippo called out, "Wait! I think I lost my job." Pippa turned around and the hippo told her the whole sad story. It turned out he used to be a park ranger, but he got fired. That's why he was so lonely. Feeling sorry for the hippo, Pippa decided to help him out. She found him a job at the zoo to take care of the other animals. The weird hippo was so grateful. From then on, he and Pippa were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small ant named Tim. Tim lived in a hole in a big garden. Tim had many friends, but his best friend was a big bee named Bob. They played together every day. One sunny day, Tim and Bob found a box. They did not know what was inside. Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's send the box down the hole and see what happens." Bob agreed. They pushed the box into the hole and waited. Suddenly, the box opened, and out came many small, colorful balls. Tim and Bob did not expect this! They laughed and played with the balls all day. From that day on, their hole was the most fun place in the garden.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a kind lady who gave massages. She was very patient and loved to make people feel good. One day, a funny man came to her shop. He loved to joke and make people laugh. The funny man said, "I need a massage, but I want to joke too!" The kind lady smiled and said, "Okay, we can do both!" So, they started the massage and the funny man told many jokes. They laughed and laughed together. But then, something unexpected happened. A little bird flew in through the window and started to joke with them too! The bird told the funniest jokes they had ever heard. The kind lady, the funny man, and the little bird laughed and laughed until the sun went down. And from that day on, they became the best of friends, always sharing jokes and massages together.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jane. Jane was always very comfortbale in her class at school. All the other kids really liked Jane because she was so nice. One day, Jane was feeling so happy that she decided to act silly in her classroom. She began singing and dancing around the room, making silly noises. Jane thought it was so much fun! But suddenly, the teacher walked into the classroom and saw what Jane was doing. The teacher didn't think it was so much fun. She yelled at Jane and told her to stop acting silly. Jane was scared and felt so sad. The teacher told her she was not allowed to be comfortable in her class ever again. Jane was so upset she ran out the door and never went back again. That was the bad ending for Jane.

One day, a big cat with an impressive long tail went for a walk. The cat liked to step on the soft grass. As he walked, he saw a small dog. "Hi, cat!" said the dog. "I like your long tail. Can we be friends?" The cat looked at the dog and said, "Yes, we can be friends." They played together all day. They ran, they jumped, and they had fun. The cat's long tail moved in the air as they played. The dog was happy to have a new friend with an impressive tail. They were the best of friends from that day on.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big tree and decided to sit under it. Tim felt lucky because it was a sunny day and the tree gave them shade. Tim's mom said, "Guess what I have in my bag, Tim?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "Is it a toy?" "No, it's not a toy," his mom replied. "Guess again." Tim thought harder and said, "Is it a snack?" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, it's a snack! You guessed it right!" Tim felt so happy. After eating their snacks, Tim needed to go to the bathroom. They looked around and saw a small bathroom near the park. Tim and his mom went to the bathroom. When they were done, they went back to the tree and played more games. Tim felt lucky to have such a fun day at the park with his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lilly. Lilly loved to play by the bridge near her house. One day, while she was playing, she saw a small boy sitting on the bridge. The boy was weeping. Lilly felt sad for the boy and asked, "Why are you weeping?" The boy looked up and said, "I lost my toy and I am embarrassed to go home without it." Lilly wanted to help the boy find his toy. They looked around the bridge together. After a while, they found the toy under a bush. The boy was so happy, he stopped weeping. He said, "Thank you, Lilly!" They both smiled and played together near the bridge for the rest of the day.

Once, there was a big red barn. In the barn, there was a black cat and a brown dog. They were friends. The black cat liked to joke with the brown dog. They played and laughed all day. One day, the black cat said, "I have a joke for you, brown dog. Why did the chicken cross the road?" The brown dog thought and thought. He did not know the answer. The black cat laughed and said, "To get to the other side!" Just then, a little yellow chick walked into the barn. The black cat and the brown dog were very surprised. They had never seen a chick before. The chick said, "I crossed the road to find new friends. Can I play with you?" The black cat and the brown dog were happy to have a new friend. They all played and joked together in the big red barn. And they laughed and laughed, all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She lived in a small home with her mom, dad, and her furry cat, Tom. One day, Amy and Tom went outside to play in the warm sun. While they were playing, Tom saw a big red ball. "Amy, let's put the ball in the home!" Tom said. Amy agreed, and they rolled the big red ball towards their home. But as they got closer, they saw something unexpected. A tiny green frog was sitting on top of the ball! The frog looked at Amy and Tom and said, "Thank you for bringing my ball back to me!" Amy and Tom were surprised, but they were happy to help their new friend. From that day on, Amy, Tom, and the little green frog played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little monkey named Momo. Momo loved to hang from the trees in the jungle. One day, Momo saw all his animal friends going to a meeting near the big tree. Momo was very excited and wanted to go to the meeting too. He went to the big tree and saw all his friends talking and laughing. They were planning a big, fun party for everyone in the jungle. At the party, Momo and his friends had a crazy good time. They played games, ate yummy fruits, and danced all day long. Momo was so happy that he hung from the trees even more than usual. And all the animals lived happily ever after.

Mummy was very excited, she had a calendar in her hands. She said, "Today is a special day, because it's Grandma's birthday!" Mummy and the little girl went to Grandma's house.
