The people in the town were worried. In the town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was brave and wanted to help the town. He thought the fog was coming from a big hill. So, he walked to the hill to find out what was making the fog increase. When Tim got to the top of the hill, he saw a big, friendly dragon. The dragon was just taking a nap, and his breath was making the fog. Tim asked the dragon if he could stop making the fog. The dragon said he was sorry and flew away. The fog went away, and the town was happy again.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was an enormous bird. The bird liked to soar high in the sky. One day, the bird saw a little boy named Tim. Tim was sad because he saw a lot of waste in the forest. The waste made the forest look bad. The bird flew down to Tim and said, "Why are you sad?" Tim looked up and said, "There is too much waste in the forest. It makes me sad." The enormous bird wanted to help Tim. It used its big wings to soar through the sky and pick up the waste. Tim was happy to see the bird help clean the forest. Together, Tim and the bird cleaned the forest. They became good friends and played together every day. The forest was clean and everyone was happy.

One day, a little girl named Ann was playing outside. She saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. The colors were so pretty, she wanted to touch it. She asked her mom, "Can I touch the rainbow?" Her mom smiled and said, "No, dear. Rainbows are too far away. But you can look at it and enjoy its colors." Ann was sad, but she kept looking at the rainbow. Then, something unexpected happened. A little bird flew down from the sky and landed next to Ann. The bird said, "I can help you touch the rainbow. Just hop on my back." Ann was so excited! She climbed on the bird's back, and they flew up to the rainbow. When they got close, the rainbow turned into a big slide made of colors! Ann and the bird slid down the rainbow, laughing and having fun. They landed back on the ground, and Ann thanked the bird for the magical adventure.

Once upon a time, a little dog named Spot lived in a small house. Spot was a troubled dog because he liked to bite things. One day, he went for a walk to find something to bite. As Spot walked, he saw a big box. Inside the box, there was salt. Spot thought, "I want to bite the salt!" So, he opened the box and took a big bite. The salt tasted bad, and Spot made a funny face. Spot's friend, Cat, saw him and asked, "What did you bite, Spot?" Spot said, "I bit the salt, and it was yucky!" Cat laughed and said, "Next time, let's find something better to bite!" They both smiled and went to play together.

One day, a thoughtful boy named Tim found a toy missile. He wanted to move it to a safe place to play. Tim took the missile to his room and put it on the floor. Next, Tim asked his friend Sam to come over and play with the missile. They took turns moving the missile across the room. It was so much fun! After playing, Tim and Sam put the missile away. They were thoughtful and cleaned up the room. They knew it was important to put toys away when they were done.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to play golf. One day, Tim went to play golf with his friend, Sam. They were happy and excited to play together. While playing, Sam hit the ball too hard. The ball flew far away and broke a window. Tim and Sam were very scared. They knew they needed to tell the truth, but they felt ashamed. Tim said, "We must tell the owner of the house." Sam agreed and they went to the house together. They knocked on the door and the owner came out. They told the owner about the broken window and said sorry. The owner was mad and did not support them. He told their parents. In the end, Tim and Sam were punished by their parents. They felt sad and learned a lesson. They promised to be more careful when playing golf next time.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty library. It had a lot of books and it stretched across the whole town. Everyone went there to read and find stories. One day, a little girl came to the library. She was a very curious girl and she was always smiling. She said hello to all the people in the library and then headed to the shelves. The girl found lots of books and she was so happy. She smiled and looked at the titles and suddenly she found a very special book that was full of magical stories. The girl was so happy, she couldn't help but smile. She took the book outside and hugged it tight. She smiled at the sky and began to read it. She was so filled with joy that she smiled for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time there was a very clever little rabbit. The rabbit wanted to know how much he weighed, so he went to look for a bow that might help him. After searching for a while, the rabbit found a very special bow. The rabbit was very excited and picked it up. He asked the bow: "Can you help me weigh myself?" The bow replied: "Of course I can! All you have to do is stand on me, and I will tell you how much you weigh." The rabbit was so delighted. He hopped up and stood on top of the bow. The bow sang out: "You weigh 7 ounces!" The rabbit was thrilled to know how much he weighed and he thanked the bow for being so clever. He used the bow every day to check his weight and made sure he always stayed healthy and fit. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a hop-hop-hopping bunny. She hopped so high, she hopped up to the sky. As she hopped, she felt so free and so happy. Everywhere she hopped, the world was so sunny. The bunny hopped around the meadow and saw a new place she had never seen before. It was a big underground tunnel. She hopped closer, but was very shy. She didn't know if it was okay to go inside. Just then, she heard a loud and strong voice. It said, "Come on in, little bunny! Don't be shy, you are welcome here!" The bunny hopped hesitantly inside the tunnel and was surprised to find a warm and cozy den filled with lots of other bunnies. They welcomed her with open arms and introduced her to their underground home. The bunny was so happy. She had found a place to call home. From then on, she hopped around the underground with all her new friends, never feeling shy or lonely again.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. It was cold and windy, but they did not care. They liked to run and slide and swing. They had fun. But then, Lily saw a big dog. The dog was not friendly. It barked and growled and ran towards them. Lily was scared. She ran to Tom and hugged him. "Help, Tom! The dog is bad!" she cried. Tom was brave. He saw a stick on the ground. He picked it up and waved it at the dog. He shouted, "Go away, dog! Leave us alone!" The dog did not listen. It jumped at Tom and tried to bite him. Tom hit the dog with the stick. The dog yelped and ran away. Tom and Lily were safe. They hugged each other and smiled. "Thank you, Tom! You saved me!" Lily said. "You're welcome, Lily! You are my friend!" Tom said. They heard a voice behind them. It was their big sister, Anna. She was bossy. She wore a red coat and a hat. She had been looking for them. "Tom! Lily! What are you doing? You should not play with bad dogs! You could get hurt! Come here, now!" she said. Tom and Lily rolled their eyes. They did not like Anna's voice. They walked to her slowly. "Sorry, Anna. We were just playing. We did not see the dog until it was too late. But Tom saved me. He is brave!" Lily said. Anna looked at Tom. She saw the stick in his hand and the scratch on his arm. She felt sorry for him. She gave him a hug and a kiss. "Wow, Tom. You are brave. You saved Lily. I am proud of you. But you should be careful. Here, take my coat. It will keep you warm." she said. Tom smiled. He took Anna's coat and put it on. It was big and soft and red. He felt warm and happy. "Thank you, Anna. You are nice. You are my sister!" he said. Anna smiled. She took Tom and Lily by the hand. She led them to their home. They had hot chocolate and cookies. They told their mom and dad what happened. They were proud of Tom. They hugged him and Lily. They were a family. They loved each other.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and trucks. One day, they find a big print on the ground. It looks like a paw of a big animal. "Wow, what is this?" Tom asks. "Maybe it is a bear or a lion," Sam says. They are scared, but also curious. They want to see the animal that made the print. "Let's race to the end of the path and see if we can find it," Tom says. "OK, but be careful," Sam says. They run as fast as they can. They pass by trees and flowers and rocks. They do not see any other prints. They do not see any animals. They reach the end of the path. They see a big fence. Behind the fence, they see a zoo. They see many animals. They see bears and lions and monkeys and elephants. They also see a big sign. The sign says: "Welcome to the zoo. Please do not touch the animals. They are not regular pets. They are wild and can hurt you." They realize that the print they saw was from one of the zoo animals. They feel silly, but also happy. They laugh and hug. "Let's go and see the animals," Tom says. "Yes, let's go. But from far away," Sam says. They walk to the fence and watch the animals. They have fun and learn new things. They are glad they raced to the end of the path.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He was feeling restless and wanted to find something fun to do. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. Tim was very happy to be outside. As Tim walked, he saw a big cat. The cat was ignoring Tim and just sat there. Tim wanted to play with the cat, but the cat did not want to play. Then, something unexpected happened. The cat jumped up and started to dance! Tim was very surprised. Tim and the dancing cat became friends. They danced and played all day long. Tim was not restless anymore. From that day on, Tim and the cat went for a walk and danced together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big garden in her yard. She wanted to plant something original in her garden. Lily thought and thought. She had an idea! She would plant a special bulb. Lily went to the store with her mom to buy the bulb. She was very excited. She picked a pretty bulb that would grow into a beautiful flower. When they got home, Lily planted the bulb in her garden. She watered it every day and waited for it to grow. One day, Lily saw a tiny green shoot coming out of the ground. She was so happy! The shoot grew and grew. Finally, the flower bloomed. It was the most original flower in the whole garden. Lily's friends came to see the flower, and they all wanted to plant bulbs too. Lily was proud of her flower and happy she could share it with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to visit her grandma's house. Grandma lived near the big park. Lily loved to play there. She felt peace when she was in the park. One day, Lily saw a serious-looking cat in the park. The cat was big and grey. Lily wanted to be friends with the cat. She gave the cat some food. The cat liked the food and started to play with Lily. From that day on, Lily and the serious cat became good friends. They played in the park every time Lily visited her grandma. They had lots of fun together. And they always felt peace in the big park.

Once upon a time, in a small pond, there lived a little frog. This frog loved to play hide and seek with his friends. One day, the frog and his friends decided to play in the icy cold snow. Frog said to his friends, "Let's hide and see who can find us!" His friends all agreed and started to hide. Frog hopped and hopped until he found a big snow pile to hide behind. As Frog hid behind the snow pile, he heard his friend Duck call out, "I found you, Frog!" Frog laughed and said, "You are good at this game!" Then, they both went to find their other friends. In the end, all the friends were found and they all laughed and played together in the icy snow. Frog and his friends had so much fun that they couldn't wait to play hide and seek again.

One day, a little girl named Lily was in her room. She was very tired, so she lay on her bed. Her bed was big and soft. Lily felt her eyes get heavy and she fell asleep. Her face was pale because she was not feeling well. In her dream, she saw a big talking bear. The bear said, "Hello, Lily! I am here to help you feel better." Lily was surprised but happy to see the bear. The bear gave her a big hug and they played together. They laughed and had fun. Then, the bear said, "Lily, it's time for me to go. But, I have a surprise for you." The bear clapped his hands and a big plate of cookies appeared. Lily woke up and found the cookies on her bed. She was so happy and felt much better. She knew her new friend, the bear, had helped her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to eat cookies, but her mom kept them on a high shelf. Mia was too small to reach the cookies. She felt sad and weak because she could not get the thing she loved most. One day, Mia had an idea. She found a big box to stand on, so she could reach the cookies. Mia was very happy and ate all the cookies she could fit in her stomach. But then, her stomach began to hurt. Mia felt bad and weak. Mia's mom came into the room and saw Mia with the cookies. She told Mia that eating too many cookies can make her stomach hurt. Mia's mom gave her a big hug and told her that they could share the cookies from now on. Mia learned that sharing made her feel strong, not weak.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat cereal. Every morning, he would eat a big bowl of cereal before going to school. Tim was also very good at games. He liked to win and was very competitive. One sunny day, Tim's mom said, "Tim, we are going on a trip. Please pack your bag." Tim was so excited. He packed his clothes, his toys, and his favorite cereal in his bag. He couldn't wait to play games with his friends during the trip. On the trip, Tim met a new friend named Sam. Sam also liked to play games and eat cereal. They decided to have a game to see who could eat the most cereal. Tim said, "Ready, set, go!" They both ate and ate, trying to be the fastest. In the end, they both ate the same amount of cereal and laughed. They were both winners and became best friends.

Once upon a time, in a tidy little house, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside, even when it rained. One day, it rained very hard, and Lily put on her boots to go outside and play. As Lily played, she jumped in a big puddle. Her boots got very wet. They started to soak. Lily did not care. She kept jumping and splashing in the puddle with her soaked boots. When Lily came back to her tidy little house, she took off her soaked boots. She put them by the door to dry. Lily was happy she had her boots to play in the rain. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little mouse named Max. Max lived in a field with tall wheat. Max loved to play in the wheat and eat the seeds. One day, Max saw a big bird in the sky. Max was scared of the bird and ran to hide in the wheat. Max met a new friend in the wheat, a small bug named Ben. Ben said, "Hi Max, do you want to play with me?" Max said, "Yes, but we need to hide from the big bird!" Ben had an idea to surprise the big bird. They would make a funny noise and scare the bird away. Max and Ben hid in the wheat and made a loud noise. The big bird was surprised and flew away. Max and Ben were happy they scared the bird away. They played together in the wheat all day long. Max and Ben were best friends and had many fun days in the wheat field.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. She loved to play with her toys in her room. One day, Emma saw her mom's makeup on the table. She thought the makeup looked pretty and wanted to try it on. Emma put the makeup on her face. She put on red lipstick, pink blush, and blue eyeshadow. She looked in the mirror and felt like a grown-up. She was so happy to discover how makeup can change how she looks. But then, Emma's mom came into the room and saw her with the makeup on. Emma's mom was not happy. She told Emma that she was too young to wear makeup. Emma felt sad, but her mom gave her a sweet hug and said, "You are beautiful just the way you are." Emma learned that she did not need makeup to be pretty. She learned that being herself is the best way to be.

Once upon a time, there was an object. It was very pale. It sat all by itself, looking out of place. "Where do I belong?" it asked. But nobody answered. The object kept searching. It looked around and around, but it seemed like it didn't belong anywhere. At last, he saw a kind face. It was a young girl. She smiled at him and said: "You belong here! I can help you find your place!" The object felt so happy. The girl showed it its new home, where it belonged. The object fit perfectly, just like it was meant to be. The object smiled and was finally at peace. It belonged.

Once there was a little plant. Every day it grew a little bit. It's leaves started to form a pattern. Soon its stem grew strong, and it was able to stand on it own. One day, a strong wind came and blew the plant away. It flew far away, feeling helpless and alone. Later, the plant found itself in a warm and happy garden. The sun shone brightly and the soil was rich with nutrients. It drank in the Water, and the happy soil, and began to grow happily. Soon the little plant was even stronger than before! The moral of the story is that no matter how helpless you feel, you can always find the right place to grow if you keep trying. With the right environment, you can become strong, beautiful, and happy.

Once upon a time, there was an adventurous little dove. He flew around the sky like no other dove ever could. One day he flew up to a village by a lake. He saw a little girl sitting by the lake, sad and alone. He flew around her, wondering why she was so sad. The little girl said "I miss my mommy". The dove wanted to help, so he flapped his wings and flew around the village, looking for her mommy. Finally, he flew up to a cottage on a hill. He saw the girl's mommy inside. He fluffed his wings and flew back down to tell the little girl the good news. The little girl was so happy to see her mommy she ran to give her a big hug. The dove flew away, proud of his accomplishment, and happy to help. The adventurous little dove and the little girl continued to be good friends from then on.

Once upon a time, there was a little seal named Sam. Sam lived in the sea with his family. One day, Sam was swimming and saw a big rock. He wanted to stand on the rock and see the world. Sam swam to the rock and tried to stand on it. But he slipped and fell. "Ouch!" Sam cried. "I hurt my fin!" His mom heard him and swam over. "What happened, Sam?" she asked. "I tried to stand on the rock, but I fell and hurt my fin," Sam said sadly. Mom looked at Sam's fin and said, "Let me help you." She took care of his hurt fin and told him, "Sam, it's okay to try new things, but always be careful. And if you get hurt, remember that your family is here to help you." Sam nodded, and from that day on, he always tried to be more careful. And whenever he felt hurt, he knew his family was there to help him.

Once upon a time there was a small bunny. He was very polite and always listened to his mommy. One day the bunny wanted to try something new. So, he went and got a wrap from the kitchen cupboard. He was excited to try it, but when he bit into it, he was surprised. It didn't taste like he thought it would. So he decided to chew it. But his teeth were too weak. He tried and tried but he couldn't chew it. He felt sad and frustrated. He wanted what his mommy had. He wanted to be able to chew it. He started to cry. Just then his mommy came running into the room. She had seen the bunny crying. She asked him what was wrong. The bunny told her that he wanted to chew the wrap but his teeth were too weak. His mommy smiled and said, "It's ok, little one. I can help you with that." She quickly cut the wrap into small pieces and put it on the bunny's plate. She said, "Now you try again." The bunny was so happy! He picked up a piece and put it in his mouth. This time, with the help of his mommy, he was able to chew it. He smiled and thanked his mommy for being so polite and helping him. The bunny enjoyed the wrap and learned a valuable lesson that sometimes

Once upon a time, there was a cool jug. It was very big and used to hold a lot of liquid. One day, the jug started to have some surprises inside. First, it had a little toy boat with a sail inside it. Then, a colourful bird appeared. Last, there was a sparkly diamond inside the jug! The Jug was so excited. It wanted to tell everyone about its surprises. So it rolled down the street, spilling its liquid as it went. Everywhere it went, it stopped to show off its surprises. Everyone it met was so amazed. They said, "Wow look at that cool jug, it has so many surprises". The Jug was so proud. From then on, everywhere it rolled it shouted, "Look at my surprises!" and everyone smiled. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was eager to choose what he wanted to be when he grew up. He thought and thought, and then he knew! He wanted to be a fireman. One day, Tim's mom took him to visit the fire station. They met a big fireman named Jack. Jack showed Tim the big red fire truck and all the tools they used to put out fires. Tim was so happy! "Can I be a fireman like you one day?" Tim asked Jack. Jack smiled and said, "Of course you can, Tim! You just need to be brave and help people when they need it." Tim was excited and knew that he would be the best fireman ever.

Once upon a time, there was a giant. The giant was very hungry. He wanted to find food to eat. He walked and walked, looking for something to fill his big belly. One day, the giant found a big wall. The wall had many colors on it. The giant saw a little girl. The little girl was painting the wall. She was using red, blue, and yellow paint. The giant was curious. He wanted to paint too. The little girl said, "No, you are too big. You will make a mess." The giant was sad. But he was also still hungry. The giant had an idea. He picked up a big tree and used it like a paint brush. The giant painted the wall with the tree. The little girl laughed. They painted the wall together. The giant was not hungry anymore. He was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little orange cat named Tip. Tip lived in a big green house with a nice family. They all loved to play together in the backyard. One sunny day, Tip was playing outside when he saw a little bird stuck in a tree. The bird was scared and could not fly away. Tip knew he had to help and save the bird. So, he climbed up the tree, using his sharp claws. When Tip reached the bird, he gently pushed the bird out of the stuck branches. The bird was free and could fly again! The little bird was very happy and thanked Tip for saving him. After that, Tip and the bird became best friends, and they played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. Sam wanted to buy a toy from the store. He asked his mom if he could go to the store with her. His mom said yes, and they walked to the store together. At the store, Sam saw a harmless bug on the stair. The bug was small and green. Sam liked the bug and wanted to play with it. But he remembered that he came to the store to buy a toy, so he said goodbye to the bug and went inside. Sam found a toy he liked and his mom helped him buy it. They walked back home, and Sam played with his new toy on the stairs. He was happy and had a fun day with his mom.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was always fascinated by flags, especially celebrated ones. One day, on a bright, sunny morning, Sally and her family went out for a walk. Sally spotted a large flag in the distance and asked her mom, "What's that?". Her mom replied, "That is the famous flag of our country". Sally was so excited that she started jumping! She pointed to the flag and said, "Look, look Mommy, the flag!". Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, Sally. That is our country's flag. Do you recognize it?". Sally nodded with delight, and said, "Yes Mommy, I recognize it! It's so big and beautiful!" After that moment, Sally was eager to learn more about flags, and she spent much of her time outside, admiring flags of all shapes and sizes.

One sunny day, a nosy little rabbit named Remy hopped through the woods. He saw a big tree with lots of shade. Remy thought it was a good place to rest. He hopped under the tree and laid down. Soon, a tiny bird named Bella flew by. She saw Remy in the shade and said, "Hi, Remy! Can I sit with you?" Remy looked up and smiled. "Of course, Bella! Come sit in the shade with me," he said. As they sat in the shade, a squirrel named Sam ran up to them. He was holding a big nut. "Hi, Remy and Bella! I found this nut. Do you want some?" Sam offered. Remy and Bella said yes, and they all shared the nut. They had a fun day in the shade, eating the nut and talking to each other.

One day, there was an old post. It was standing alone in the middle of a field. A girl walked up to the post and looked at it. She wanted to do something special with the post, so she decided to tie a string around it. She found some string nearby and looped it around the post, knotting it tightly. Next, she noticed some birds nearby. She wanted to make the birds happy, so she tied some colourful, bright ribbons on the string. The ribbons blew in the wind and sparkled in the sun. The birds flew down to the post. They chirped and sang, happy to see their beautiful new decorations. The girl beamed with joy. The post, the string and the ribbons stayed there forevermore, a reminder of a special day.

Once upon a time, there was a modest dog named Spot. Spot had a blue collar. He loved to play with his ball in the park. One day, Spot met a new friend named Max. Max had a red collar. They played with the ball together. Max said, "Let's tie our collars together and be best friends." So, Spot and Max tied their collars together. They played and ran all day. They shared their toys and had lots of fun. At the end of the day, Spot and Max untied their collars. They said, "We are best friends forever." They went home to rest and looked forward to playing together again.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was three years old and she loved to explore the world around her. One day, Daisy went outside with her dad to the garden. Her dad pointed at some lovely flowers and said, "Look, Daisy! Those flowers are blooming!" Daisy was fascinated, she asked her dad, "What does that mean?" Her dad explained that when flowers bloom, it means that they are opening up and showing their beautiful colours. That day, Daisy went off exploring all the blooming things in her garden, they were all so lovely! Then Daisy spotted something shiny on the ground, it was a magnet! She picked it up, and her dad said, "That's so cool, you can use the magnet to pick up other metal things around the garden". Daisy loved the magnet, it was so magical! They spent the rest of the day exploring and discovering the lovely things in the garden, and Daisy kept her magnet close by. Daisy had so much fun during her garden adventures, and she learned that when flowers bloom, it is a sign of love and joy!

John was envious of his neighbor's new bike. He asked his mom, "Mommy, why don't I have a bike like the neighbor's?" His mom smiled and said, "John, that bike is very expensive. We don't have enough money." John had an idea. He said, "If we send some money to Grandma she'll know what to do!" His mom replied, "You're so smart! That's great idea. Let's do it!" So they sent money to grandma and the next day, a big box arrived! John was so excited to open it. When he did, he saw his very own shiny, new bike! He cheered and said, "Thank you Grandma!" His mom said, "Yes, thank you Grandma for sending us the money for the bike!"

Once there was a little boy named Tim. He had a pair of pants that did not fit. They were too big for him. Tim wanted to wear the pants, but he could not. So, he asked his mom for help. Mom said, "Let's welcome your friend, Sue, to help us." Sue came over and had an idea. She found a belt to put on Tim's pants. The belt made the pants fit just right. Tim, Sue, and Mom were happy. They played together all day. Tim's pants now fit, and he was very happy. Tim said, "Thank you, Sue, for helping me." Sue was glad she could help her friend.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little furry cat. The cat loved to crawl under the bed and play with a ball. One day, the cat found a new ball under the bed. The ball had a label on it, but the cat did not know what the label said. The cat played with the new ball all day. The label fell off the ball and the cat put it in its mouth. The cat did not know that the label was not for eating. The cat felt funny in its tummy, but it kept playing with the ball. Later, the cat's tummy started to hurt very bad. The cat did not want to play with the ball anymore. The cat's owner found the label on the floor and saw that it said, "Not for pets." The owner knew the cat was in trouble. The cat felt very sick and the owner was sad. The cat should not have eaten the label from the ball.

Once upon a time, there were two little ducks, Jack and Jill. They were best friends and were always together. One day, they went for a walk in the forest. Jack said to Jill, "Let's look for some blueberries!" So they went looking for blueberries. They came across a beautiful field of blueberries and their eyes lit up. The field was bursting with plump, juicy blueberries, some white, some red, and many gray. Jack said, "Let's pick some of the gray ones - they look yummy!" But Jill said, "No, no, it's better not to take things that don't belong to us." Jack didn't listen, he just picked many of the gray blueberries and ate them. Jill said, "We better go now - or someone might meet us!" But it was too late. A big, mean man came running towards them. He shouted, "What are you doing?! You're stealing my blueberries!" Jill tried to explain, but the man wouldn't listen. He punished them for stealing, and they never saw each other again. Moral of the story: Don't take things that don't belong to you.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a restless bird named Tim. Tim loved to soar high up in the sky. One day, he saw a long wire near his nest. Tim wanted to sit on the wire, but his friend Ben, the wise owl, said, "Be careful, Tim. The wire might not be safe." Tim did not listen to Ben and went to sit on the wire anyway. As he sat on the wire, it began to shake. Tim was scared and called for help. Ben came to save him. They both flew back to their nests. Tim learned to listen to his friends and to be careful. The moral of the story is to always listen to good advice from friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a good boy, but sometimes he did not believe what his mom told him. One day, Tim's mom said, "If you are good today, you will get a reward." Tim did not know what the word "reward" meant, but he thought it sounded nice. Later that day, Tim saw a big dog in the yard. The dog looked friendly, but Tim's mom had told him not to go near dogs he did not know. Tim thought his mom was just being silly, so he went up to the dog anyway. The dog barked and scared Tim. He ran back to his mom and said, "Mom, I was wrong to not believe you." Tim's mom hugged him and said, "It's okay, Tim. Now you know to be careful around dogs you don't know." She then gave Tim a reward for learning his lesson. The reward was a big, tasty ice cream cone. Tim was happy he learned not to be ignorant and to believe his mom. And he loved his ice cream reward!

Once upon a time, there was a great big flower. This flower loved to bloom. It had many bright colors. One day, a little bird came to visit the flower. The bird said, "Hello, great flower! You are so pretty when you bloom. Can you help me? My friend is in jail. We need to find a key to open the door." The flower thought for a moment. It wanted to help the little bird. So, the flower bloomed even bigger and brighter. The flower's bright colors made a key appear. The little bird was so happy. It took the key and flew to the jail. The bird opened the door and set its friend free. The two birds came back to thank the great flower. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a tall tree. In the tree, there was a pretty butterfly. The butterfly liked to fly and play with her friends. One day, a big wind came, and the butterfly's friends were scared. The butterfly said, "Stay with me, friends. We can be safe in the tall tree." But her friends did not listen. They flew far away to find a safer place. The butterfly was sad, but she stayed in the tall tree. The wind got stronger and stronger. The tall tree shook and shook. The butterfly tried to hold on tight, but the wind was too strong. The tall tree fell down, and the butterfly was hurt. She wished she had gone with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a jolly day in her backyard, playing with her dolls. The sun was shining brightly and Daisy was so happy. Suddenly, her mom came out of the house and called her. 'Daisy, come here! I have a surprise for you,' her mom said. Daisy was filled with excitement and quickly ran to her mom. 'Here you go, darling. I bought this for you,' her mom said holding out a toy. Daisy was so excited, she thanked her mom for the surprise. After that, every day Daisy would ask her mom to supply her with new toys. And every day her mom would fulfill her wish. But one day, her mom told Daisy 'No' when Daisy asked her for a new toy. Daisy was so disappointed, she started crying and begging her mom. Her mom shook her head and said, 'I can't always supply you with everything you want, Daisy. You should learn to be content.' This made Daisy understand that she shouldn't always expect to be given things. It was a bad ending, but it was good to learn a moral lesson. Excessive wanting is not always a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a huge refrigerator. It was so big that it could hold many yummy things. One day, a boy named Tim went to the refrigerator to find a snack. "Wow, this refrigerator is so big!" said Tim. He opened the door and saw a strange machine inside. The machine could print pictures. Tim thought it was fun and wanted to try it. He pressed a button and the machine printed a picture of a big apple. Tim showed it to his mom. "Look, Mom! The refrigerator printed a picture for me!" Mom smiled and said, "That's amazing, Tim! Let's put it on the fridge for everyone to see." And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a pigeon. The pigeon liked to fly and whistle. One day, the pigeon found a big tree. The tree had many branches to sit on. In the tree, the pigeon saw something disgusting. It was a big, dirty sock! The pigeon did not like the dirty sock. The pigeon wanted the tree to be clean and pretty. So, the pigeon picked up the dirty sock with its beak. It flew far away and dropped the sock in a trash can. Then, the pigeon flew back to the tree. It whistled a happy song, and the tree was clean and pretty again.

Once upon a time, there was a strong boy named Tom. He had a mask that he liked to wear. One day, he went to play with his friend, Sam. They played and laughed all day. But then, they started to quarrel about who was the strongest. Tom said, "I am strong because I have this mask." Sam said, "No, I am strong because I can run fast." They argued and argued until they were very tired. They decided to have a race to see who was the strongest. The race started and Tom and Sam ran as fast as they could. But then, something unexpected happened. A little girl named Lily, who was watching them, ran even faster and won the race! Tom and Sam were surprised. They learned that it is not just masks or running fast that makes someone strong. They became friends with Lily and they all played happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn boy named Tim. He loved to play outside and look at the clouds in the sky. One day, he saw a big, fluffy cloud and he wanted to hold it. Tim asked his mom if he could hold the cloud. His mom said, "No, clouds are up in the sky. You can't hold them." But Tim was stubborn and didn't listen. He tried to reach the cloud by standing on his tiptoes, but it was too high. Tim had a big idea. He found a tall chair and climbed on it. He reached up high, but he still couldn't hold the cloud. Tim was sad, but he learned that some things, like clouds, can't be held. From that day on, Tim enjoyed looking at the clouds, but he didn't try to hold them anymore.

One day, a little girl named Mia was playing with her toys. Her mommy told her not to disturb her because she was on the phone. Mia was a good girl and listened to her mommy. She played quietly and did not make any noise. Suddenly, Mia heard a loud sound outside. She became very alert and wanted to see what it was. She looked out the window and saw a big, colorful bird! The bird was singing a beautiful song. Mia was so excited and wanted to show her mommy the bird. Mia forgot not to disturb her mommy. She ran to her mommy and said, "Look, look! A big bird!" Her mommy was not happy at first, but when she saw the bird, she smiled. The bird was not a real bird, it was a big balloon! It was a surprise for Mia's birthday party. Mia and her mommy laughed and enjoyed the special day.

Lily and Max were twins who liked to travel. They had a big map on their wall with many colors and shapes. Sometimes they pretended to go to different places on the map. They packed their bags with toys and snacks and put on their hats and coats. One day, they decided to travel to the wide porch of their grandma's house. They said goodbye to their mom and dad and walked down the street. They saw many things on the way: cars and buses, birds and dogs, flowers and trees. They waved and smiled at the people they met. When they reached their grandma's house, they climbed up the steps to the wide porch. They knocked on the door and waited. Soon, they heard their grandma's voice. "Who is it?" she asked. "It's us, Lily and Max!" they shouted. "Come in, come in, my dear ones!" she said. She opened the door and hugged them. "What a nice surprise! Did you travel far?" "We traveled from our house to your porch!" they said. "We saw many things on the way!" "Wow, you are very brave and curious!" she said. "Come, let me show you some more things inside. I have cookies and milk for you, and some stories and games. I'm so happy you came to visit me!" Lily and Max followed their grandma inside. They were happy too. They loved to travel, but they also loved to be with their grandma. She always made them feel warm and welcome. They knew they would have a lot of fun on the wide porch and beyond.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally lived in a small house with her mom and dad. One day, her mom asked Sally to go to the attic and find her old toys. Sally said, "Please, can I go to the attic later? I want to play outside now." Sally went outside to play with her friends. They played a fun game of catch. But then, a rude boy came and took their ball. Sally and her friends were sad. Sally said, "Please, give us our ball back. It's not nice to take things that are not yours." The rude boy felt bad and gave them their ball back. Sally and her friends said, "Thank you!" and went back to playing their game. Later, Sally remembered she had to go to the attic. She went inside and found her old toys. Sally was happy to share her toys with her friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a big dog named Sam. Sam was a good dog, but he was miserable. He did not like to do exercise. He liked to sleep all day. One day, Sam's mom said, "Sam, you need to go outside and play. You need exercise to be happy." Sam did not want to go, but he went outside. He saw a small ball and started to play with it. It seemed like a normal ball, but something was different. As Sam played with the ball, it started to bounce higher and higher. Suddenly, the ball bounced so high that it touched the sky! Sam was very surprised. He jumped and tried to catch the ball. As he jumped, he felt happy. The more he played, the less miserable he was. From that day on, Sam loved to exercise and play with his magic ball.

One day, a little lion named Leo went for a walk. He saw a big, bright star in the sky. The star was shiny and harmless. Leo wanted to tell his friend, a little bird named Bella, about the star. Leo found Bella and said, "Bella, I saw a big star in the sky! It was shiny and harmless. Let's go see it tonight!" Bella was excited and said, "Yes, let's go look at the star when the sun goes down." That night, Leo and Bella went to look at the star. As they looked up at the sky, they heard a loud roar. It scared Bella, but Leo knew it was just his dad, who was also a lion. Leo's dad came to see the star too. Leo said, "Dad, we found a big, shiny star in the sky!" Leo's dad smiled and said, "That's great, Leo! I heard your roar and wanted to see the star too." They all looked at the star together, happy and safe, under the harmless, shiny star.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow piece. It was quite big, so it couldn't fit in the toy box. The piece was boring by itself, so the baby wanted to play with it. "How can I play?", the baby asked. Suddenly, the baby had an idea. She started to separate the piece in two. She divided the yellow piece into two halves. Now, the baby had two new pieces to play with. The baby was so happy to separate the yellow piece. She was very excited to try new games. She stacked the pieces like a tower, and pretended they were two castles. Then, she put them back together and the piece became yellow again. The baby was so proud of her new game. She was even more proud of herself for finding a way to make two pieces out of one. She had a lot of fun playing with her yellow piece.

One day, a boy named Tim had a cake. It was a big, yummy cake. Tim wanted to eat the cake all by himself. But his friend, Sue, wanted some cake too. Tim did not want to share the cake with Sue. Sue was sad and angry. She wanted to eat the cake too. So, Sue had a plan. She went to the kitchen and found a cup of water. Sue made the cake wet with the water. The cake was not yummy anymore. Tim saw the wet cake and was very sad. He could not eat the cake now. Sue was sad too because she could not eat the cake either. In the end, no one could eat the cake. Tim and Sue learned that being selfish and mean made both of them unhappy.

Lily liked to play with her toys in her room. She had dolls, cars, books and blocks. She made up stories and songs with them. She was happy and quiet. But one day, she heard a loud noise from outside. It was a musician. He had a big drum and a shiny horn. He played them very loud and fast. Lily did not like the noise. It hurt her ears and made her toys fall. She wanted him to stop. She ran to the window and looked out. She saw the musician on the street. He had a hat with money in it. He smiled at the people who walked by. He did not see Lily. Lily opened the window and shouted. "Stop! Stop! You disturb me! Go away!" She was angry and loud. The musician heard Lily. He looked up and saw her. He was surprised and sad. He liked to play his music. He did not want to disturb anyone. He stopped playing and said. "I'm sorry, little girl. I did not know you were here. I will play softer. Do you like music?" Lily felt bad. She did not want to make the musician sad. She liked music, but not so loud. She said. "I'm sorry, too. I like music, but I was playing with my toys. Can you play softer?" The musician nodded. He played his drum and horn softer. He played a nice song. Lily listened. She liked the song. She smiled and clapped. The musician smiled and waved. He was happy and quiet.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tom wanted to travel far away. He put on his hat, took a gift for his friend, and started to walk. Tom was very happy because he had never traveled before. As he walked, Tom saw a dead tree. It looked very old and had no leaves. Tom felt sad for the tree. He thought of his gift and had an idea. He put the gift near the tree and walked away. The next day, Tom came back to see the tree. To his surprise, the tree was not dead anymore! It had many green leaves and looked very happy. The gift Tom left had made the tree alive again. Tom was so happy that his gift could help the tree. From that day on, Tom and the tree became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a king who wanted to move his kingdom to a far away land. He wanted more land and thought his kingdom could be bigger. The king was very powerful and had many followers. So the king and his followers set forth, ready to move to the new land. However, they were not prepared for what they found. The new land was barren and weak. The soil wasn't good for growing crops and there was not enough food or water. The king was angry and demanded to know what was happening, so he spoke to his followers. "What is this?" he said. "This land is weak!" One of the followers stepped forward and said, "Your Majesty, this land is too weak for us to live here. We must go back from where we came from." The king was sad and displeased. He ordered his followers to go back and the kingdom was never moved. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a mule named Max. Max lived on a farm with many animals. Max was a very easy-going mule. He liked to help his friends on the farm. One day, Max's friend, the farmer, said, "Max, I need your help. Please permit me to put this big bag on your back." Max said, "Okay!" Max thought he was helping the farmer, but he did not know what was in the bag. As Max walked, he felt the bag move. Max was scared. Then, something unexpected happened! A little kitten jumped out of the bag! Max was happy. The kitten was not scary. The kitten was lost, and Max helped her find her way back home. Max and the kitten became best friends.

Once upon a time there was a square. He was very impatient. He wanted to do lots of things, but he had to wait. He waited for hours and hours and he got tired. But still he waited. Then, one day, something exciting happened. A door opened. The impatient square was so excited. He quickly ran through the door. Now he could do all the things he had been waiting for. He was happy. The end.

One day, a black octopus named Ollie lived in the sea. He had many friends who liked to play with him. They swam and played all day in the water. One day, while they were playing, Ollie saw a big fish coming near them. He was scared and wanted to tell his friends. So, Ollie yelled, "Big fish! Swim away!" All his friends heard him and swam fast to hide. The big fish went away and Ollie's friends came back. They were happy that Ollie warned them. They all said, "Thank you, Ollie!" From that day on, they played together and always looked out for each other.

Once upon a time, there was a mule. The mule liked to stretch. Every day, he stretched in the bright sun. He stretched his long legs and neck. The mule was very happy. One day, the mule saw a big ball. The ball was very bright. The mule wanted to play with the ball. He stretched his neck to reach the ball. He pushed the ball with his nose. The ball rolled away. The mule ran after the ball. He stretched his legs to run fast. The mule caught the ball. He played with the ball all day in the bright sun. The mule was very happy.

One day, a funny snowman wanted to dance. He was very happy and excited. He danced and danced all day long. The sun was shining bright, and the funny snowman did not know what would happen next. As the funny snowman danced, he started to feel different. He did not know why. He looked down and saw that his body was getting smaller. The snowman was melting because of the sun's warm rays. He felt sad and stopped dancing. Just then, a big cloud came and covered the sun. The snowman stopped melting and felt cold again. He was very happy because he could dance once more. The funny snowman danced and danced, and the cloud stayed with him. It was a big surprise, and the snowman was happy to keep dancing all day long.

Tim and Liz are twins. They like to play together. One day, they find a big box in the basement. The box has many clothes inside. Tim and Liz want to try them on. Tim picks a red sweater. He puts it on. He says, "Look at me, Liz. I am a fireman. I can put out fires." He acts like he has a hose and sprays water. Liz picks a blue sweater. She puts it on. She says, "Look at me, Tim. I am a teacher. I can teach you things." She acts like she has a book and points at words. They have fun with the sweaters. They act like different people. They do not hear Mom calling them for lunch. Mom comes to the basement. She sees Tim and Liz in the sweaters. She is angry. She says, "What are you doing with these sweaters? They are not yours. They are for the poor kids. We are going to give them away. You should not take things that are not yours. You should be ashamed." Tim and Liz are scared. They take off the sweaters. They say, "We are sorry, Mom. We did not know. We just wanted to play. We will not do it again." Mom hugs them. She says, "I forgive you, Tim and Liz. But you have to learn to respect other people's things. And you have to share what you have. Now, come on. Let's go have lunch. And then we will take the sweaters to the charity."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big test at school. Lily was scared and felt a little ashamed because she did not know if she could do it. Her mom saw that Lily was sad and wanted to help her. Mom had an idea. She took a soft, warm blanket and helped Lily wrap it around herself. Lily felt safe and loved in the blanket. The blanket gave her a big hug, and she felt better. The next day, Lily went to school with the blanket. She took the test and did her best. After the test, Lily was not ashamed anymore. She knew that with the help of her mom and the warm blanket, she could do anything.

Once upon a time there was a tall tree. But no one wanted to play with it. They all just ignored the poor tree. Except for one little girl. She loved to give the tree a big hug and look up and admire its big leaves. One day, the girl spotted an itch on the trunk of the tree. She scratched it gently and said, "There, that's better." She kept playing with the tree, completely unaware of what she had done. But little did she know, the tree was growing much faster than before. The water and the air were making it increasingly bigger and bigger. The more it grew, the less the little girl could hug it. Despite her best efforts, the girl had to eventually ignore the now tall tree and look for something else to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy boy named Tim. He lived in a small house with his mom and dad. His bedroom was very messy, with toys all over the floor. One day, Tim found a strange fruit under his bed. It was round and green. He didn't know where it came from, but it was starting to rot. Tim felt sad because he didn't want his bedroom to smell bad. Tim decided to show the fruit to his mom. When she saw it, she smiled and said, "This is not a fruit, it's a ball!" Tim was surprised and happy. He played with the ball all day and forgot about being grumpy. And from that day on, he made sure to keep his bedroom clean.

Once upon a time there was a puppy called Poochy. He just loved to soak and run in the sunshine with his family. One day, Poochy was rolling around in the mud and he came across a big package. Poochy opened the package and found a luxury toy inside. He was so happy and he thought it was yummy. Poochy: "I can keep this all to myself and play with it every day!" But his mom didn't agree. She said it was too expensive and not meant for him. Mom: "No, Poochy. It's not yours, this is for someone else. You have to give it back!" But Poochy was really excited about the toy and he did not want to give it back. So he thought of a plan. He took the toy to the pond and soaked it, thinking his mom would not be able to tell that it was the same one. Mom: "Oh no, Poochy! Why did you soak the toy?" Poochy thought he'd get away with it, but his mom knew what he had done. She was very upset, and since Poochy had taken something that didn't belong to him, he had to give his toy to his mom. The moral of the story is that honesty is the best policy. It's never right to try to get away with something you know is wrong.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little youth named Timmy. Timmy loved to walk and play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy saw a big, shiny red ball in the park. He wanted to play with it, but it was too far away. Timmy's mom said, "Timmy, be careful when you walk to get the ball." Timmy started to walk very carefully to get the ball. On his way, he met a nice girl named Lily. Lily said, "Hi Timmy, I want to play with the red ball too!" Timmy and Lily walked together to get the ball. They were so excited to play with it. As they walked closer to the ball, they saw a big puddle of water. They remembered what Timmy's mom said about being careful. So, Timmy and Lily held hands and walked slowly around the puddle. They got the red ball and played happily together all day long. And Timmy's mom was very proud of him for being careful.

Lily and Ben were very happy. They were going on a holiday with Mum and Dad. They packed their bags with toys and clothes. They got in the car and drove to the airport. At the airport, they saw many people and planes. They had to wait in a line to show their tickets. Lily saw a big teddy bear in a shop. She wanted it very much. She ran to the shop and grabbed the teddy bear. She hugged it and said, "Mine!" A lady who worked in the shop saw Lily. She was not happy. She said, "That is not yours. You have to pay for it." She took the teddy bear from Lily. Lily cried and screamed. She kicked and hit the lady. Mum and Dad heard Lily. They ran to the shop. They were very angry. They said, "Lily, what are you doing? You are being very naughty. You can't grab things that are not yours. You have to say sorry to the lady." Lily did not want to say sorry. She wanted the teddy bear. She said, "No! I want it! It is mine!" Mum and Dad said, "No, it is not. You are being very spoiled. You have to learn to share and be polite. You have to say sorry or we will not go on the holiday." Lily did not like that. She did not want to miss the holiday. She wanted to see the beach and the sea and the sand. She wanted to play with Ben and have fun. She looked at the lady and the teddy bear. She felt sorry. She said, "Sorry, lady. I was bad. I will not grab things again." The lady smiled and said, "That's okay. I forgive you. You can have the teddy bear as a gift. It is on sale today. Have a nice holiday." She gave the teddy bear to Lily. Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, lady. You are very kind. I like the teddy bear. I will share it with Ben." Mum and Dad hugged Lily and said, "We are proud of you, Lily. You said sorry and you learned your lesson. You are a good girl. Now let's go on the holiday." They took their bags and went to the plane. Lily and Ben were very happy. They held their teddy bears and looked out the window. They saw the sky and the clouds. They were excited for their holiday.

One day, a little girl named Sue found an orange camera. She was very happy. Sue wanted to take a picture of her cat, Fluffy. She ran to find Fluffy and saw her sleeping on the bed. "Fluffy, wake up! I want to take a picture of you with my new camera!" said Sue. Fluffy opened her eyes and looked at Sue. Sue held the camera and rubbed it to make it shiny. She wanted the camera to look nice for the picture. Just as Sue was about to take the picture, something unexpected happened. Fluffy jumped off the bed and ran away! Sue was sad, but then she saw a big, orange butterfly. The butterfly landed on the camera. Sue smiled and took a picture of the beautiful butterfly instead.

One day, a big spider made a cobweb in a small house. The spider loved her cobweb very much. She worked hard all day to make it look nice. A little girl named Lucy lived in the house. Lucy did not like the cobweb. She said, "Mom, I want to clean the cobweb." Mom said, "Wait, we may lose something in it." Lucy did not understand, but she listened to her mom. One day, a fly came into the house. The fly was very loud and bothered Lucy. The fly went right into the cobweb! The big spider caught the fly and the house was quiet again. Lucy smiled and said, "Thank you, big spider. I am glad we did not lose the cobweb."

Tom and Jen are friends. They like to play in the park. They have a ball and a kite. They take turns to kick the ball and fly the kite. One day, they see a big dog in the park. The dog is brown and fluffy. It has a long tail and a wet nose. The dog runs to them and barks. "Wow, look at the dog!" Tom says. "He is so cute. I want to pet him." "No, don't!" Jen says. "He is too big. He might bite you. He is crazy." Tom and Jen disagree. Tom thinks the dog is friendly. Jen thinks the dog is scary. They argue. "Come on, Jen. He just wants to play. He won't hurt us. He is a good dog." Tom says. "No, Tom. He is a bad dog. He is loud and wild. He might chase us. He is a crazy dog." Jen says. The dog hears them and wags his tail. He likes to hear people talk. He jumps on Tom and licks his face. Tom laughs and hugs the dog. "See, Jen. He is nice. He likes me. He is a fun dog." Tom says. Jen is not happy. She is afraid of the dog. She thinks the dog is too rough. She runs away from the dog. "Stop, Jen. Don't be scared. He is not mean. He is a silly dog." Tom says. Jen does not listen. She runs to the bench and sits down. She is angry and sad. She does not want to play with Tom and the dog. The dog follows Jen and barks. He wants to play with her too. He does not understand why she is mad. He is a curious dog. "Go away, dog. Leave me alone. You are a crazy dog." Jen says. The dog does not go away. He jumps on Jen and licks her face. Jen screams and pushes the dog. She is scared and mad. She does not like the dog. "Help, Tom. Help me. He is a crazy dog." Jen says. Tom runs to Jen and the dog. He tries to calm them down. He is sorry and confused. He does not know why Jen and the dog disagree. He is a kind boy. "Jen, don't be mad. He is just a dog. He does not know better. He is a playful dog." Tom says. "Tom, don't be silly. He is not a dog. He is a monster. He is a crazy dog." Jen says. Tom and Jen disagree. They do not understand each other. They do not understand the dog. They are sad and frustrated. They are not friends. The dog does not care. He is happy and excited. He has a ball and a kite. He has a lung and a tongue. He is a crazy dog. He is a happy dog.

One day, a little bird was in a hedge. The bird was dizzy because it flew around too much. The bird wanted to find a friend to play with. The bird saw a big tree and flew to it. In the tree, there was a squirrel. The squirrel was trying to shut a box. The bird asked, "Can I help you?" The squirrel said, "Yes, please!" The bird used its beak to help shut the box. The squirrel was happy. They became good friends and played all day. The dizzy bird felt better and they had a lot of fun together.

Lily and Ben were going to the park with Mom. They put on their coats and hats and shoes. Mom helped them with their zips. "Zips are fun," Lily said. "They make a funny sound. Zip, zip, zip!" At the park, they saw a big slide. Lily and Ben ran to the slide. They took turns to go down. "Whee!" they shouted. They had a lot of fun. Then they saw a boy with a big ice cream cone. It looked yummy. It had chocolate and vanilla and sprinkles. Lily and Ben wanted some ice cream too. They asked Mom if they could have some. Mom said yes and gave them some money. They went to the ice cream truck. The boy with the big ice cream cone was there too. He saw Lily and Ben and smiled. "Hi, I'm Sam," he said. "Do you want to be my friends?" Lily and Ben nodded. They liked Sam. He seemed nice. They told him their names and what kind of ice cream they wanted. Sam said he liked chocolate and vanilla and sprinkles too. They got their ice cream and sat on a bench. They licked their ice cream and talked. They talked about the slide and the park and their favorite toys. They had a lot in common. But then something bad happened. Sam's ice cream cone broke. His ice cream fell on the ground. He was very sad. He started to cry. He felt embarrass. Lily and Ben felt sorry for Sam. They wanted to help him. They had an idea. They gave him some of their ice cream. They said, "Don't cry, Sam. You can have some of ours. We can share." Sam stopped crying. He smiled. He said, "Thank you, Lily and Ben. You are very kind. You are good friends." They gave him a hug. They ate their ice cream together. They felt happy. They had a yummy treat and a new friend.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a holiday. Everyone was happy and excited. They had a big party with balloons and cake. The kids played fun games, and the grown-ups talked and laughed. In this town, there was a man who liked to steal. He saw the holiday party and wanted to take something. He saw a big, shiny, expensive toy that a little boy was playing with. The man thought it would be fun to have the toy for himself. The man tried to steal the expensive toy, but the little boy saw him. The boy told his mom, and she called the police. The police came and took the man away. The town was safe again, and everyone continued to enjoy their holiday party. The little boy was happy that he could keep his toy, and he learned that stealing is wrong.

Sara loves to read books with her mom. She likes to look at the pictures and hear the stories. One day, she finds a book on the shelf that she has never seen before. It has a big dragon on the cover. She wants to read it with her mom. She takes the book to the couch and opens it. But she sees that some of the pages are torn and ripped. She feels sad and anxious. She does not want to ruin the book. She does not know what to do. She calls her mom and shows her the book. "Mom, look! The pages are broken! Can we fix them?" she asks. Her mom smiles and hugs her. "Don't worry, Sara. We can repair the pages. We just need some tape and scissors. Do you want to help me?" she says. Sara nods and smiles. She likes to help her mom. They go to the kitchen and get the tape and scissors. They go back to the couch and start to repair the pages. They cut the tape and stick it on the tears. They make the pages look whole again. Sara feels happy and proud. She has helped her mom repair the book. She thanks her mom and gives her a kiss. They cuddle on the couch and start to read the book. Sara likes the book. She likes the dragon. She likes to read with her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. He had a small camera that he loved to play with. Tom wanted to learn how to take good pictures. One day, he went to the park to try and take pictures of the icy pond. Tom saw a big duck near the pond. He said, "Hello, duck! Can I take your picture?" The duck said, "Yes, you can." Tom was happy and took a picture of the duck. The duck looked at the picture and said, "I like it. Thank you, Tom!" Then, Tom wanted to take a picture of the icy pond. He walked closer to the edge. But the ice was very slippery. Tom slipped and fell into the icy water. He was very cold and scared. The duck tried to help Tom, but it was too late. Tom's camera was lost in the pond, and he was very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a slow snail named Sam. He lived in a small garden with his friends. Sam liked to fix things for his friends when they had a wreck. One day, a little bird named Billy had a wreck. Billy's nest fell from the tree. Sam saw this and wanted to help. He went to the tree where the nest fell. Sam was slow, but he was a good friend. Sam and his friends worked together to fix Billy's nest. They picked up sticks and leaves to make it strong again. When the nest was fixed, they put it back in the tree. Billy was happy, and Sam felt good for helping his friend.

One day, a little girl named Lucy wanted to help her mom with the laundry. She knew it was difficult, but she wanted to try. She asked her mom, "Can I take the laundry to the washing machine?" Her mom said, "Yes, Lucy. Be careful, it's heavy." Lucy took the laundry basket and slowly walked to the washing machine. It was difficult, but she did it! After the laundry was clean, they hung it outside to dry. Lucy felt happy she could help her mom. They both smiled and said, "We did it together!"

Once upon a time, there was a little star named Shiny. Shiny lived up high in the sky, right at the top. Every night, Shiny would shine bright and light up the whole sky. One night, Shiny met another star named Serious. Serious was always very serious and didn't like to play. Shiny asked, "Why don't you like to play with the other stars?" Serious replied, "I want to be the best at shining, so I must practice all the time." Shiny thought about it and said, "We can still be the best and have fun too. Let's play and shine together!" So, Shiny and Serious played and shined together. They learned that they could shine even brighter when they were having fun. The whole sky was filled with their bright light. All the other stars saw Shiny and Serious having fun and shining so bright. They wanted to join in too. Soon, all the stars were playing and shining together, making the sky the brightest it had ever been. The moral of the story is that we can do our best and still have fun. When we work together and enjoy what we do, we can shine even brighter.

One day, a girl named Sue was in the kitchen with her mom. Sue saw her mom's apron and thought it was pretty. Sue wanted to help her mom cook, so she asked, "Mom, can I wear an apron too?" Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Sue!" She found a small apron that would fit Sue just right. Sue put on the apron and felt very happy. She helped her mom mix and cook the food. As they were cooking, they heard a noise. They turned around and saw a big, friendly dog in the kitchen! The dog had an apron on too! Sue and her mom did not think a dog could wear an apron. They laughed and said, "Now we can all cook together!"

One day, a little dog named Buddy was playing in the park. He wore a nice collar with his name on it. Buddy liked to run, jump, and blink his eyes when he was happy. Suddenly, Buddy saw a big cat. The cat looked at Buddy and said, "Why do you blink so much?" Buddy was frightened because the cat was so big. He said, "I blink because I am happy when I play." The big cat thought about it and said, "I want to be happy too. Can I play with you?" Buddy smiled and said, "Yes, we can play together!" So, Buddy and the big cat played in the park. They ran, jumped, and even blinked their eyes together. They were both very happy and not frightened anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to ride his red bike every day. He was a very obedient boy and always listened to his mom. One sunny day, Tom found a big, shiny coin on the street. He knew the coin had value, so he picked it up and put it in his pocket. He was excited to show his mom when he got home. But when Tom got home, he found out that the coin was not real! It was just a shiny toy. Tom was sad, but his mom said it was okay. They laughed together and Tom learned that real value is in the fun and love they share.

One day, a little girl named Sue went to the park. She saw a hidden ice-cream truck behind some trees. Sue was so happy! She ran to the truck and asked for her favorite ice-cream. The next morning, Sue had a dream about the ice-cream truck. She did not want to wake up because she was having so much fun in her dream. But her mom came into her room and said, "Sue, it's time to wake up for school!" Sue woke up and got ready for school. At school, Sue told her friends about the hidden ice-cream truck. After school, they all went to the park to find it. They were so excited when they found the truck and ate ice-cream together. Sue was happy she shared her secret with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a foolish little boy named Tim. Tim had a favorite glove that he wore every day. One day, he lost his glove while playing outside. Tim started to weep because he could not find his glove. He looked behind the tree and under the rocks, but it was not there. His friend, Sam, saw him crying and asked, "Why are you weeping, Tim?" Tim told his friend about his lost glove. Sam wanted to help Tim find his glove, but Tim was too foolish to listen. He thought he could find it all by himself. So, Sam went away, and Tim kept looking for his glove. But he never found it. In the end, Tim was very sad and still without his glove. He learned that it is better to accept help from friends instead of being foolish and trying to do everything alone.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a restless little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her favorite pink dress. One day, she made a wish to find a new friend to play with her. Lily went outside to look for a friend. She saw a big tree and thought it would be fun to climb. As she climbed higher, she found a small bird. Lily was excited and asked the bird to be her friend. The bird agreed, and they played together all day long. But then, something unexpected happened. The bird flew away, leaving Lily alone in the tree. Lily was sad and didn't know how to get down. She cried for help, but no one heard her. As night came, Lily was still stuck in the tree with no way to get down. She wished she had never climbed the tree and missed her warm bed at home.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man named Tom. He had a big house near a cliff. Tom liked to sort his many toys into different boxes. One sunny day, Tom went outside to play with his toys. He took them all out of their boxes and spread them on the ground. He had fun playing with his cars, dolls, and balls. When it was time to go home, Tom sorted his toys back into their boxes. He was happy to live in his big house near the cliff. And every day, he played with his toys and sorted them again and again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Belle. Belle loved exploring the sea, and one day she decided to go on an adventure. Before she left, her mum said, ‘Don’t worry, Belle. I’ll be watching you!’ Belle sailed away in her boat, and as she went further across the open sea, she heard a loud noise - it was a pirate! ‘Who are you?’ Belle shouted. The pirate said, ‘I’m here to take your boat away!’ Belle was not afraid. She knew that her mum would protect her, so she resisted the pirate. ‘No! You cannot take my boat’ she shouted. ‘Go away!’ The noisy pirate tried to take the boat, but Belle resisted and eventually the pirate gave up and sailed away. Belle was so proud of herself for standing up to the pirate. She sailed home and proudly told her mum about her adventure. Belle’s mum smiled and said, ‘I knew you could do it, Belle!’

Once upon a time there was a boy named Joe. He was very brave and always liked to explore. One day he was walking through a big field. It was filled with wildflowers and he had fun picking them. Suddenly, a big gust of wind blew through the field. Joe watched in amazement as a skirt flew through the air and vanished. He couldn’t believe that it was gone! Joe was frightened and started to call for help. A loud voice suddenly boomed from the sky. It said: "Joe, don't be frightened. That skirt will come back if it finds its way back. You have to believe that it will come back." Joe was filled with hope. He was determined to find the skirt, so he searched the field every day until it was dark. On the seventh day, Joe saw something colourful far away and he ran towards it. It was the skirt. Joe was so happy that he had found it. He quickly picked it up and waved the skirt in the air. The wind started to blow again and Joe watched as the skirt vanished in the sky. Suddenly, he knew that the skirt would always find its way back to him.

Lily and Ben love to play in the park. They run, jump, slide and swing. They excite when they see the big pond with the ducks and fish. They want to feed them bread and watch them swim. They ask their mom for some bread. Mom is reliable. She always has bread in her bag. She gives them some and tells them to be careful near the water. Lily and Ben say thank you and run to the pond. They break the bread into small pieces and throw them to the ducks and fish. The ducks quack and the fish splash. Lily and Ben laugh and clap. They breathe oxygen from the fresh air. They feel happy and warm. But then, a big goose comes. It is greedy and mean. It wants all the bread for itself. It chases the ducks and fish away. It hisses and snaps at Lily and Ben. They feel scared and sad. They run back to their mom. Mom hugs them and tells them it is okay. She says the goose is not nice, but it cannot hurt them. She says they can play somewhere else in the park. Lily and Ben nod and smile. They still have some bread left. They decide to share it with the squirrels and birds. They hope they are friendly and polite.

One day, Lily and her dad went to the zoo. They saw many animals, like monkeys, lions, and giraffes. Lily liked the animals, but she wanted to see something special. She asked her dad, "Can we see the rhinoceros?" "Sure, honey," her dad said. "The rhinoceros is very big and strong. He has a horn on his nose. He is reliable. He protects his friends from danger." They walked to the rhinoceros enclosure. There was a big rhinoceros lying on the grass. He looked sleepy. Lily was disappointed. She wanted to see him do something. She said, "Dad, the rhinoceros is boring. He is not doing anything." Her dad smiled. He said, "Wait a minute, Lily. The rhinoceros has a surprise for you. Look at his horn. It is starting to glow." Lily looked at the rhinoceros's horn. It was true. It was glowing with different colors. It was like a rainbow. Lily was amazed. She said, "Wow, dad, the rhinoceros is glowing. He is so cool. How does he do that?" Her dad said, "The rhinoceros is glowing because he is happy. He likes to show off his horn. He is proud of it. He is saying hello to you." Lily waved at the rhinoceros. She said, "Hello, rhinoceros. You are very pretty. Thank you for glowing for me." The rhinoceros nodded his head. He was happy too. He liked to make new friends. He was a reliable rhinoceros.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big pond. Tim had a toy boat. He wanted to sail it on the pond. So, his mom let him put the boat in the water. The boat sailed away, and Tim was happy. As they watched the boat, a brilliant angel came down from the sky. The angel smiled at Tim and his mom. "Hello, I am here to help you," said the angel. Tim and his mom were very surprised. The angel touched the boat with her magic. Suddenly, the boat grew big enough for Tim and his mom to get in. "Come sail with me," said the angel. Tim and his mom got in the boat and sailed across the pond with the angel. They had a fun day, and then the angel took them back home.

Once upon a time, there was a big mystery in the little town. All the happy toys were now miserable because they were separate from their friends. They did not know why this had happened, but they wanted to be together again. One day, a nice girl named Lily decided to help the toys. She looked around and found a big box. Lily put all the toys in the box and gave them a big hug. The toys felt happy again and the mystery was solved. From that day on, the toys were never separate again. They played together and had fun every day. Lily was happy too because she had helped the toys and made them smile again. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day a young girl named Sarah was playing with her favourite toy, a soft teddy bear. She hugged it tight as it always made her feel happy and safe. Suddenly her Dad appeared in the room. He smiled and said to Sarah, "I have a surprise for you." Sarah looked at him with excitement. "What is it?" she asked. "I need you to trust me," he said. Sarah looked even more curious. "Why?" she asked. "Just trust me and close your eyes," said Dad. Sarah closed her eyes and when she opened them again, there was a shiny new toy car in front of her! Sarah gasped and said, "Thank you!" She raced around the room with the toy car, smiling from ear to ear. Dad had given her the surprise to show her how much he trusted her, and in turn Sarah trusted him one hundred percent. Sarah was feeling very lucky to have such a wonderful Dad — even at her young age.

Once upon a time, there was a famous boy named Tim. He had many blocks to play with. One day, he met a girl named Sue. Tim said, "Let's play with my blocks!" Sue was happy and said, "Yes, let's do that!" They started to build a big tower with the blocks. But then, a big wind came and blew the tower down. Tim and Sue were sad. They tried to build the tower again, but it fell down again. The wind was too strong. In the end, they could not play with the blocks. The wind did not stop, and the tower stayed down. Tim and Sue were very sad.

Tom and Lily liked to play with blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes. They could create anything they wanted with their blocks. One day, they decided to create a nation with their blocks. They used purple blocks to make a big castle. The castle was the home of the king and the queen of their nation. They used yellow blocks to make a wall around the castle. The wall was to keep the nation safe from bad people. They used green blocks to make fields and trees. The fields and trees were for the animals and the food of their nation. They used blue blocks to make a river and a lake. The river and the lake were for the water and the fish of their nation. Tom and Lily were very proud of their nation. They gave their nation a name. They called it Purple Land. They made a flag with a purple star on it. They put the flag on top of the castle. They pretended to be the king and the queen of Purple Land. They made rules and laws for their nation. They had fun and played with their blocks. They loved their nation. They loved Purple Land.

Sara and Ben were having lunch with Mom and Dad. They liked to eat sandwiches and apples and drink juice. Sara was very careful not to spill anything on her pink dress. Ben was not so careful. He liked to make funny noises and play with his food. "Ben, stop that!" Mom said. "You are making a mess. Use your napkin, please." Ben did not listen. He took his napkin and threw it at Sara. It landed on her head. Sara was very angry. She reached for her napkin and tried to throw it back at Ben. But she missed. The napkin flew across the table and hit Dad's face. "Dad, I'm sorry!" Sara said. She was anxious. She did not want to make Dad mad. Dad was not mad. He was surprised. He took the napkin off his face and smiled. He looked at Sara and Ben and said, "You two are very silly. But you are also very cute. How about we finish our lunch and then have a story time?" Sara and Ben liked that idea.
