They said sorry to each other and to Mom and Dad. They ate their sandwiches and apples and drank their juice. They wiped their mouths and hands with their napkins. Then they followed Dad to the couch. He picked a book and read them a story. Sara and Ben listened and cuddled with Dad. They felt happy and sleepy. They closed their eyes and had a nice nap.

Once upon a time, there was a charming little dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball and run around the park. One sunny day, Max went to the park with his owner, Tom. At the park, Max saw a cart. The cart had many colorful things hanging on it. Max was very curious and wanted to see what was on the cart. He asked Tom, "Can we go see the cart, please?" Tom smiled and said, "Of course, Max. Let's go!" They walked to the cart together. Max saw many pretty things hanging on the cart. There were shiny bells, soft scarves, and yummy treats. Max and Tom picked a shiny bell and a soft scarf from the cart. Tom put the scarf on Max and hung the bell on Max's collar. Now, Max looked even more charming than before. They both went home, happy with their new things.

One day, a little squirrel named Sam found a big acorn. He felt very lucky. The acorn was shiny and round. Sam wanted to keep the acorn and feed on it later. Sam took the acorn to his home in the tree. He showed the acorn to his mom and dad. They were happy for Sam. They knew he was lucky to find such a big acorn. That night, Sam and his family ate the acorn. They all felt lucky and full. They thanked the big tree for giving them the acorn. Sam was happy he could feed his family with the big acorn he found.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with clay. He had a big box of clay in many colors. Tim was very happy when he played with his clay. One day, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue saw Tim's clay and said, "I want to play with your clay too!" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, let's play together!" They played with the clay and made many fun things. They made a rich, big cake with the clay. The cake had many layers and colors. Tim and Sue were very happy. After playing with the clay, Tim and Sue became good friends. They played with the clay every day. They made many things like animals, houses, and cars. Tim and Sue were very happy to have each other and their clay.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy was very independent. She liked to do things all by herself. One day, Amy saw a big tree with a green lime on it. She wanted to get the lime, but it was too high up. Amy thought of a way to get the lime. She found a long stick and leaned it on the tree. She thought the stick would help her reach the lime. But the stick was not strong enough, and it fell down. Amy was sad, but she did not give up. She looked around and saw a tall ladder. She leaned the ladder on the tree and climbed up. Finally, she reached the lime and picked it. Amy was very happy. She learned that sometimes, it's okay to need help to reach your goals.

Once upon a time, there was a nice cat named Tom. Tom liked to play with a bulb. One day, Tom saw a big dog. The big dog said, "I want to play with the bulb too." Tom did not want to share the bulb with the big dog. So, Tom tried to escape from the big dog. He ran and ran. The big dog ran after Tom. They both wanted the bulb. Then, something unexpected happened. The bulb fell into a hole. Tom and the big dog looked into the hole. They could not get the bulb. They were both sad. The bulb was gone forever.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely girl named Amy. Amy had a pretty veil that she loved to wear. One day, she went for a walk in the forest. In the forest, Amy met a big, strong tree. The tree wanted to support and help Amy. They became good friends. Amy liked to sit under the tree with her veil. One day, when Amy was under the tree, it began to rain very hard. The tree tried to support and protect Amy from the rain. But the rain was too heavy, and the tree fell down. Amy's pretty veil got wet and dirty, and she was very sad.

Lily and Sam are friends. They like to play with toys. Lily has a colorful ball. Sam has a big truck. They want to trade toys for a day. "Can I have your ball, Lily?" Sam asks. "It is so colorful and round. I want to roll it and bounce it." "OK, Sam. You can have my ball. But can I have your truck, Sam?" Lily says. "It is so big and strong. I want to push it and load it." "Sure, Lily. You can have my truck. But we have to trade back tomorrow, OK?" Sam says. "These are our favorite toys." "OK, Sam. We have to trade back tomorrow. Let's send our toys to each other now." Lily says. They give each other a hug and a smile. Then they send their toys to each other. Lily takes the truck and Sam takes the ball. They have fun playing with their new toys. They make noises and stories. They are happy. They are good friends. They like to trade.

Once upon a time, a little bird named Timmy lived in a tree. Timmy loved to sing all day long. One day, Timmy felt bored. He did not want to sing the same songs again. Timmy saw his friend, Benny the bunny, hopping by. Timmy said, "Benny, I am bored. Can you help me find a new song to sing?" Benny thought for a moment, and then he said, "Yes, Timmy! Let's go find a new song." Timmy and Benny went on a walk. They listened to the wind, the leaves, and the other animals. They heard many new sounds. Timmy tried to sing them, but they were not the right song. Then, they heard a beautiful sound. It was a little girl singing a new song. Timmy and Benny listened and learned the song. Timmy and Benny went back to the tree. Timmy sang the new song. All the animals came to listen. They all loved the new song. Timmy was happy, and he was not bored anymore. From that day on, Timmy sang the new song every time he felt bored.

Once upon a time, there was a big planet. On this planet, there lived a boy named Tom and a girl named Sue. Tom and Sue were friends. They liked to play and have fun together. One day, Tom and Sue saw something in the sky. It was very big and bright. Tom said, "What is that?" Sue said, "I don't know." They both stared at the big thing in the sky. They were scared. Tom and Sue ran to their mom and dad. They told them about the big thing in the sky. Mom and Dad stared at it too. Dad said, "It's just a big star. It won't hurt us." Tom and Sue felt better. They went back to playing and having fun.

One day, a wise cat named Lucy found a sock. It was a big, red sock. Lucy thought it was a fun toy. She played with the sock all day. She tossed it up and down. She chased it around the house. She loved her new sock toy. Lucy's friend, a little bird named Tim, saw her playing with the sock. "What is that?" he asked. "It's my new toy, a sock!" Lucy said. "Want to play with me?" Tim said, "Yes, I want to play too!" So, they played with the sock together. They made the sock zoom through the air. Tim would fly up and catch it in his beak. Then, he would drop it down for Lucy to catch. They played until they were tired. At the end of the day, they were happy they had played together. The wise cat and the little bird became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a high structure. It was very big and tall. It was in the middle of a park. The park had many trees and flowers. Kids liked to play near the high structure. One day, two friends, Tom and Sue, went to the park. They wanted to play together. They saw the high structure and thought it was fun. But they had to separate to play on different sides of the structure. Tom went to one side, and Sue went to the other side. They played and had fun, even though they were separate. They could still see each other and talk. They played until the sun went down. Then, they went home together, happy and tired from their fun day at the park with the high structure.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was 3 years old and loved to play with his friends. One day, Tim was playing outside when he heard a terrible noise. It was coming from a nearby temple. He ran to the temple to see what was happening. When he got there, he realized that the temple was on fire! The flames were reaching high into the sky and the smoke was making it hard to breathe. Tim was scared, but he knew he had to do something. He ran back to his house and got a bucket of water. He ran back to the temple and tackled the flames with the water. Everyone was so surprised that this little 3 year old boy was able to put out the fire. In the end, the temple was saved and everyone was happy. This taught everyone an important lesson that even the smallest person can make a big difference. Even though things seem terrible, with courage and a bit of help, the situation can be improved.

One day, a girl named Lucy was excited. She wanted to spread her toys all over the floor. So, she took her toy police car, toy bear, and toy blocks out of her toy box. Lucy spread the toys on the floor and played with them. She made the toy police car drive around and chase the toy bear. The toy blocks were buildings in her little town. After playing, Lucy felt tired. She put her toys back in the toy box. She was happy that she had so much fun with her toy police car, toy bear, and toy blocks.

Once upon a time, there was a soft, little cat. The cat lived with a nice human family. They loved the cat and played with it every day. One day, the cat saw a big cake on the table. It looked so tasty. The cat jumped up and ate some of the cake. The human family came into the room and saw the cat eating the cake. They were sad. The cat felt regret for eating the cake. It was sorry for making the human family sad. The cat gave them soft hugs and they forgave the cat. They all played together and were happy again.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He wanted to find something fun to do. He saw a big tree with a sign. The sign said, "Find my lost toy and get a reward." Tim was excited and wanted to help. He looked and looked for the toy. Tim asked a girl, "Did you see a lost toy?" The girl said, "Yes, I saw it by the slide." Tim went to the slide and found the toy. It was a cute, small car. Tim took the toy to the big tree. A generous old man was there. He said, "Thank you for finding my toy. Here is your reward." The old man gave Tim a big bag of candy. Tim was happy and shared the candy with his friends. The moral of the story is to always help others, and good things will come to you.

One day, a little girl named Sally went to the store with her mom. They were looking for a gift for Sally's grandma. Sally saw a bottle of perfume and thought it would be a great gift. She asked her mom, "Can we buy this for grandma?" Her mom said, "Yes, that's a good choice." They bought the perfume and went home. Sally was very excited to give the gift to her grandma. When they got home, Sally's noisy dog, Max, was playing in the living room. Sally put the perfume on the table and went to play with Max. While they were playing, Max knocked over the perfume bottle. It broke and the perfume spilled all over the floor. Sally realized that the gift for her grandma was ruined. Sally started to cry and told her mom what happened. Her mom was sad too, but she said, "It's okay, we can buy another gift for grandma." But when they went back to the store, they found out that the perfume was the last one. They had to buy a different gift for grandma, but Sally knew it was not as good as the perfume. Sally felt sad that she could not give her grandma the perfect gift.

One day, a weak dog named Spot went for a walk. He saw a big tree with a cut on it. Spot wondered what could have made the cut. He kept walking and saw his friend, a cat named Luna. "Hi Luna!" Spot said. "Did you see the cut on the tree?" Luna nodded and said, "Yes, I saw it. I think something big did it. Be careful, Spot." Spot and Luna walked and played. They heard a loud noise. They saw a big truck that made the cut on the tree. The truck was fixing the tree to make it strong again. Spot and Luna were happy the tree would be strong and safe.

One day, a little cat named Kitty went for a walk. She saw a distant house and wanted to see what was there. So, she walked and walked until she got to the house. In the house, there was a dog named Doggy. Doggy saw Kitty and said, "Hi Kitty! Do you want to play with me?" Kitty said, "Yes, I want to play! But I also want some meat. Do you have any meat?" Doggy looked around and found some meat in the kitchen. He gave it to Kitty, and they both ate together. After they ate, they played and played. But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird came into the house! The bird said, "I want some meat, too!" Kitty and Doggy were scared, but they decided to share their meat with the bird. The bird was happy, and they all became friends. From that day on, they played and shared their food together.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly girl named Lily. Lily loved to bring her toys to the park. Her favorite toy was a big, red ball. One sunny day, Lily went to the park with her ball. At the park, Lily met a boy named Tom. Tom said, "Can I play with your ball?" Lily said, "Yes, let's play together!" They had lots of fun playing with the ball. They were tired and sat under a tree. While they were resting, a big wind came. The wind took the ball high up in the sky. Lily and Tom were sad. But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird came and caught the ball in its beak. The bird brought the ball back to Lily and Tom. They were so happy! They said, "Thank you, bird!" And they played with the ball until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Amy. She had a big box in her room. One day, she wanted to unpack the box. Inside the box, she found a picture. The picture was modern and had many colors. Amy put the picture on her wall. She looked at it every day. One day, something unexpected happened. The picture started to move! A cat jumped out of the picture and into her room. Amy was very surprised. The cat was friendly and played with Amy. They had a lot of fun together. At the end of the day, the cat went back into the picture. Amy knew that the picture was magical. From that day on, she had a new friend to play with every day.

Once upon a time, there was a noisy bird named Chirpy. Chirpy loved to sing all day long. He lived in a pretty landscape with many trees and flowers. One day, Chirpy met a quiet mouse named Squeaky. Squeaky did not like Chirpy's loud singing. Squeaky said, "Chirpy, please stop singing. It is too noisy for me." Chirpy did not want to stop singing. He loved to sing. But Chirpy also wanted to be friends with Squeaky. So, Chirpy tried to sing more softly. Squeaky was happy that Chirpy tried to sing softly. He said, "Thank you, Chirpy. I accept your singing now." Chirpy and Squeaky became good friends and played together in the pretty landscape. From that day on, Chirpy sang softly and Squeaky learned to enjoy Chirpy's singing. They both learned to accept each other's differences and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a small orange frog. He was hopping around and enjoying the sunshine, when suddenly he heard a loud croak! He paused, wondering what had cause the noise. He saw a large mud puddle ahead and noticed a tiny green frog sitting in the middle. The small orange frog hopped towards the mud and asked: "Excuse me, what are you doing sitting in this mud puddle?". The tiny green frog replied, "I am trying to make a mud pie, and I need some more mud". The small orange frog paused to think, and then offered the tiny green frog a hand in gathering the mud. The two frogs gathered more mud and the small orange frog watches as the tiny green frog form a mud pie and decorate it with bits and pieces of coloured flower petals. He was impressed with the outcome, for the mud pie looked marvellous. The two frogs smiled and the small orange frog said, "That is a very beautiful mud pie, it is my pleasure to have helped you." The tiny green frog thanked him and they said their goodbyes. The small orange frog smiled and hopped away.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was a very lucky boy. One day, Tim found a big maze in his backyard. He was very excited to play in the maze. Tim went into the maze and started to walk around. He saw a long string on the ground. Tim thought it was a good idea to attach the string to his shirt. This way, he could find his way back out of the maze. As Tim walked deeper into the maze, something unexpected happened. The string led him to a hidden door. Behind the door, there was a room full of toys and treats! Tim was so happy and surprised. He played with the toys and ate some treats. Then, he used the string to find his way back home. Tim knew he was a very lucky boy.

Once upon a time, there was a little seed. The seed wanted to grow big and strong. One sunny day, the seed said, "I am ready to grow now!" A driver in a big car heard the seed. The driver stopped the car and got out. He said, "Hello, little seed! I can help you grow. I will put you in the ground and give you water." The driver put the seed in the ground and gave it water. The seed was so happy! It started to grow. It grew a little bit every day. The driver came to see the seed every day and gave it more water. One day, the seed had grown into a big, strong tree. The driver and the tree were both very happy. They talked and laughed together. The tree said, "Thank you, driver, for helping me grow. I am big and strong now!" And they lived happily ever after. The driver and the tree were best friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a clever girl named Lucy. She loved to design clothes for her dolls. One day, she found a big, shiny button on the floor. Lucy thought it would look nice on her doll's dress. Lucy showed her friend Tom the button. Tom said, "Wow, that's a big button! Can I have it?" Lucy said, "No, I found it first. I want to use it on my doll's dress." Tom was sad, but he understood. Later, Lucy was playing with her doll when the button started to glow. It turned her doll into a real princess! The princess said, "Thank you, Lucy, for putting the button on my dress. It was magical and turned me back into a real person." Lucy and Tom learned that sharing and being kind can lead to amazing things.

One day, Mommy was in the kitchen cooking. She had to make dinner for her family. Mommy was feeling very tired and sad, but she kept cooking for her family. Suddenly, Mommy heard a noise. She looked around the kitchen and saw a big chest! She opened the chest and found lots of yummy food inside. Mommy was so surprised and grateful. She was so happy to have all the food for her family. She kept cooking with all the food from the chest. Mommy made a delicious dinner for her family. Everyone was so happy and grateful. They all thanked Mommy for cooking such a wonderful dinner.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play in the garden. But they are not allowed to go near the big shed. The big shed has steel tools and machines. Mom and Dad say they are dangerous. One day, Anna and Ben are bored. They see the big shed. They want to see what is inside. They are naughty. They sneak to the shed when Mom and Dad are not looking. They open the door and go in. The shed is dark and noisy. There are many things they do not know. They see a big red button. Ben wants to press it. Anna says no. Ben says yes. He presses the button. The machine makes a loud sound. It shakes and sparks. Anna and Ben are scared. They run out of the shed. Mom and Dad hear the sound. They come to the garden. They see the shed. They see Anna and Ben. Mom and Dad are angry. They ask Anna and Ben what they did. Anna and Ben are sorry. They nod. They tell the truth. They say they were naughty. They say they pressed the button. Mom and Dad are glad they are safe. But they are still angry. They say they have to fix the machine. They say Anna and Ben have to go to their room. They say they have to think about what they did. They say they have to be good. Anna and Ben nod. They go to their room. They think about what they did. They say they will not be naughty again.

Once upon a time, there was a small bug named Tim. Tim was very good at making motion. He could run, jump, and fly. Tim lived in a big green field with his friends. They played all day long. One day, Tim saw a bright light. It was a fire! The fire started to burn the grass. Tim was scared. He knew that he and his friends needed to get away from the fire. So, Tim started to move very fast. Tim told his friends about the fire. They all moved together, away from the burn. They ran, jumped, and flew until they were far away. The small bugs were safe now. They found a new home in a different green field. They were happy and played all day long again.

One day, a friendly cat went to the beach. The cat liked to watch the water and play in the sand. The sun was warm, and the cat was happy. As the cat played, it saw a big fish in the water. The fish jumped out and said, "Hi, friendly cat!" The cat was surprised but said, "Hi, big fish!" They played together in the sand and had lots of fun. Then, the big fish said, "I have a secret. I am not just a fish, I am a magic fish!" The friendly cat was very surprised. The magic fish told the cat to make a wish. The cat wished for more friends to play with on the beach. The magic fish made the wish come true, and now the friendly cat had many friends to watch the water and play in the sand with.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Mark. Mark had a big sack. In the sack, he kept lots of toys. Mark liked to play with his toys every day. One day, Mark met a deaf dog. The dog could not hear anything. Mark wanted to be friends with the dog. He said, "Hello, dog! My name is Mark. Do you want to play with me and my toys from my sack?" The deaf dog could not hear Mark, but he saw the sack. The dog wagged his tail and barked. Mark knew the dog wanted to play, so he opened his sack and took out his toys. They played together all day long. Mark and the deaf dog became best friends. They played with the toys from the sack every day. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a calm little town, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to bake. She would bake cakes, cookies, and bread for her friends and family. One day, Lily decided to have a big baking party. At the party, Lily and her friends put on fun masks. They had masks that looked like cats, dogs, and even birds. They laughed and played while they baked yummy treats. The masks made everyone feel happy and silly. Lily and her friends baked a big cake, some cookies, and a loaf of bread. They all had a great time at the party. When they were done, they shared their treats with everyone in the calm little town. The town's people loved the treats and thanked Lily and her friends for their hard work.

Once upon a time there was a bird. It was very creative, which meant it did things differently to other birds. Every day it would pass over a big lake. It was always so fun to fly! As it passed over the lake, the bird loved to look at the fish swimming around. One day it had an idea. It flapped its wings and flew high up into the sky. Then it started to dive. It passed through the air like a daring stunt! The fish were very surprised. They watched and cheered as the bird whizzed by. The bird was so proud of itself. It had thought of something memorable and special that no other bird had ever done. The bird flew away happy and proud. Everyone in the lake remembered the creative bird and the special pass it had done!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a troubled child because he could not find his toy car. He looked for it everywhere. He was very sad. One day, Tim asked his mom, "Mom, where is my toy car?" His mom thought for a moment and said, "Maybe it is in the kitchen." Tim went to the kitchen and looked around. In the kitchen, he saw a faucet. The faucet was dripping water. Tim turned the faucet off and found his toy car under it. He was so happy and said, "Thank you, faucet!" Tim played with his toy car all day and was not troubled anymore.

One day, a girl named Sue was playing with her toys. She had many toys, but her favorite was a pretty dish. The dish was shiny and attractive. Sue liked to pretend it was a magic dish that could talk. Sue was sorting her toys when she heard a voice. "Hello, Sue!" said the voice. Sue looked around and saw that the pretty dish was talking to her! "Wow, you can talk!" said Sue. The dish smiled and said, "Yes, I can! I am a magic dish, and I can do many things." Sue and the dish played all day. They had fun playing with the other toys. But then, something unexpected happened. The dish said, "Sue, I have a secret. I can change into any toy you want!" Sue was very surprised and happy. She asked the dish to change into a big, soft teddy bear. The dish turned into the teddy bear, and Sue hugged it tight. They played together and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play in her backyard. One day, she found an interesting patch of dirt. It was a small round spot with no grass. Lily wanted to know what was under the dirt. Lily asked her mom, "Can I disturb the dirt? I want to see what's under it." Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful." Lily took a small shovel and started to dig. She was very excited to see what she would find. As Lily dug, she found a small, shiny rock. She showed it to her mom and said, "Look what I found!" Her mom smiled and said, "That's a very special rock. You should keep it." Lily was very happy with her new rock and put it in her pocket. From then on, she always remembered the interesting patch in her backyard where she found her special rock.

Once upon a time, there was a smart cat named Tom. Tom lived in a house with many furniture. His favorite furniture was a big seat. Every day, Tom would sit on the seat and look out the window. One day, Tom saw a little bird outside. He wanted to play with the bird, but the bird was scared. Tom thought, "How can I make the bird like me?" So, he decided to share his seat with the bird. Tom opened the window and the bird flew in. They sat on the seat together and played. They became very good friends. Soon, other animals heard about Tom and the bird. They all wanted to be friends too. So, Tom shared his seat with all of them. The animals learned that sharing is good. They all became friends and lived happily together. The moral of the story is to always share and be kind to others.

Lily and Tom were playing hide and seek in the park. Lily was the seeker and Tom was the hider. Lily counted to ten and then opened her eyes. She looked around for Tom, but she could not see him. She walked around the trees and the swings, but she could not find him. "Tom, where are you?" she called out. "I give up, you can come out now!" She heard a giggle behind a bush. She ran to the bush and pulled the branches apart. She saw Tom lying on the ground, with a big smile on his face. "Boo!" he shouted, and wrapped his arms around her neck. Lily was frightened and screamed. She pushed Tom away and ran to her mom, who was sitting on a bench. "Mommy, Tom scared me!" she cried. "He jumped on me and grabbed my neck!" Mommy hugged Lily and kissed her cheek. She looked at Tom, who was still laughing. "Tom, that was not nice," she said. "You should not scare your sister like that. Say sorry to Lily." Tom stopped laughing and looked at Lily. He saw that she was still crying and felt bad. "I'm sorry, Lily," he said. "I was just playing. I didn't mean to scare you." Lily looked at Tom and saw that he was sorry. She wiped her tears and smiled. "It's okay, Tom," she said. "I forgive you. But don't do that again, okay?" "Okay," Tom said. "Do you want to play again?" Lily nodded and hugged Tom. They ran back to the park and played hide and seek again. But this time, Tom did not scare Lily. He found a better hiding spot and waited for Lily to find him. They had fun and laughed together.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his red ball. One day, he took his ball to the park to have some fun. At the park, Spot saw a big turn. He was very alert and careful. He didn't want to lose his red ball. Spot rolled his ball around the turn, but then it got stuck in a bush. Spot was sad. Spot tried to remove the ball from the bush. He pushed and pulled, and finally, the ball came out. Spot was so happy! He played with his ball all day and went home tired but smiling.

Once there was a careless goat. He liked to wander around and explore. One day he left the farm and went off into the forest. He had a lot of fun in the forest but he started to get tired and hungry. Suddenly he saw a cottage. He went closer to take a look. The door of the cottage opened and out came a little boy. He had some carrots in his hand and he gave them to the goat. The goat was so happy and he thanked the boy by licking his face. The goat ate the carrots and felt full. The little boy was happy to see the goat happy. He put a collar around the goat's neck and took him back to the farm. The goat thanked the little boy again and the little boy said goodbye. The goat understood that the boy was kind and careful. From that day onwards the goat never wandered off and always stayed near the farm.

Once upon a time, there was a big, loud dog named Max. Max liked to play in the yard. One day, Max saw a new cat in the yard. The cat was very small and scared. Max wanted to welcome the cat to play with him. Max said, "Hi, cat! Do you want to play with me?" The cat looked scared and said, "No, thank you. I am scared of big, loud dogs." Max was sad, but he still wanted to welcome the cat. So, Max had an idea. He went to the closet and found a big, soft blanket. Max thought the blanket would make the cat feel safe. Max put the blanket on the ground and said, "Come, cat. You can sit on the blanket and feel safe." The cat looked at the blanket and slowly came closer. But then, Max barked very loud. The cat got scared and ran away. Max was sad because he scared the cat away. The next day, Max saw the cat again, but the cat would not come near him. Max learned that he should be more careful with his loud voice. The moral of the story is to be kind and gentle to others, even when you are excited.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was very lazy and never wanted to do anything. One day, his mother opened the wardrobe and asked him to come and take his clothes out. Tom just looked at her and refused. His mother said, "Come on, Tom! Don't be so lazy!" Tom refused again. Then Tom's father stepped in. He pointed at the wardrobe and said, "Tom, put your clothes inside the wardrobe, now!" Tom slowly walked up to the wardrobe and opened the door. He took out his clothes and put them neatly inside the wardrobe. Tom's mother smiled and said. "Well done, Tom! You did it!" Tom smiled back and said, "It was easy!" His mother laughed and said, "See, it wasn't that hard after all!" Tom was proud of himself for not being too lazy. And he was very happy.

One day, a bald man named Tom went for a walk. He wore a big hat on his head. Tom had a dog. The dog's name was Max. Max had a hurt heel, so he walked slow. Tom and Max saw a cat. The cat was up in a tree. The cat said, "Help, I am stuck!" Tom wanted to help the cat. He tried to call for help, but no one heard him. Max looked at Tom and wanted to help too. Then, something unexpected happened. Max jumped high and got the cat down from the tree. The cat said, "Thank you, Max!" Tom was very proud of Max. They all went home happy, and Max's heel felt better.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big smile on his face. Today, he was going on a trip with his family. He was very happy. Tim's mom said, "Get your luggage, Tim!" Tim ran fast to his room and got his luggage. It was a small bag with his clothes and toys inside. He put it near the door. Tim, his mom, and his dad got in the car. They drove fast to the beach. Tim played in the sand and water. He smiled and laughed all day long. It was a fun day for Tim and his family.

Once upon a time, there was a pen that could soar. The pen was dry, but it wanted to write. It had a friend named Bird. Bird could also soar high in the sky. One day, the pen asked Bird, "How can I write again?" Bird thought for a moment and said, "We need to find water to make you wet. Then you can write again." So, they both went on a journey to find water. They soared together and finally found a small puddle. The pen dipped itself in the water and became wet. Now, it could write again! The pen and Bird were so happy. They soared back home and wrote many stories together.

Sara and Tom were having lunch with their mom. They liked to eat pasta with cheese and tomato sauce. Mom gave them each a fork and a plate. Sara and Tom said thank you and started to eat. But Tom was not very hungry. He played with his fork and made funny noises. He poked his pasta and threw some on the floor. He did not listen to mom when she told him to stop. Sara was annoyed. She wanted to eat her pasta in peace. She had an idea. She saw a brilliant red pepper on the counter. She knew Tom did not like peppers. They were too spicy for him. She asked mom if she could have some pepper on her pasta. Mom nodded and cut a small piece for her. Sara smiled and put it on her fork. She pretended to eat it and said, "Mmm, this pepper is so yummy. It makes the pasta taste even better. Do you want some, Tom?" She held out her fork to him. Tom was curious. He liked to try new things. He nodded and took the fork from Sara. He put the pepper in his mouth and bit it. He felt a burning sensation on his tongue. He spit out the pepper and screamed. He ran to the sink and drank some water. He cried and said, "That pepper is bad! It hurts my mouth! Why did you give it to me, Sara?" Sara laughed and said, "That's what you get for being naughty and wasting your food. Maybe next time you will eat your pasta nicely." Mom came over and hugged Tom. She said, "I'm sorry, Tom. Sara was not very nice to you. Peppers are not for little kids. They are too hot. Here, have some milk. It will make you feel better." She gave him a glass of milk and a kiss. Tom drank the milk and calmed down. He said, "I'm sorry, mom. I won't play with my fork anymore. I will eat my pasta." Mom nodded and said, "That's good, Tom. I'm proud of you." She looked at Sara and said, "And you, Sara. You should not trick your brother like that. It was not kind. You should apologize to him." Sara nodded and said, "I'm sorry, Tom. I was just joking. I won't do it again." She gave him a hug and said, "Do you want to share my pasta?" Tom nodded and said, "OK, Sara. Thank you. You are a good sister." They smiled and ate their pasta together. Mom smiled and said, "That's better. I love you both." She joined them at the table and they had a nice lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet little bird named Blue. Blue loved to fly high in the sky. One sunny day, Blue saw a big stage in the park. Blue flew down to the stage and saw a funny clown. The clown said, "Hello, Blue! Do you want to play with me on the stage?" Blue nodded and they played together, laughing and having fun. After they played, Blue said, "Thank you, funny clown! I had fun on the stage." The clown smiled and said, "You're welcome, sweet Blue! Come back and play again soon!" Blue flew away, happy and excited to tell his friends about the stage and the funny clown.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy and a girl. The little boy and girl were so excited for a summer day. They decided to go to the lake. They ran to the lake carrying their kayaks, and they were looking forward to splashing around in the lake. When they reached the lake, they started getting ready and they put their kayaks into the lake. Suddenly, they saw a very high hill. The little boy said to the little girl, "Let's paddle our kayaks up the hill!" The little girl said, "Yes!" The little boy and girl paddled their kayaks and climbed up the hill. It was very high, but they reached the top eventually. At the top, they were excited to see a big, beautiful rainbow in the sky. They were so happy, and the little girl said, "We made it, let's go down now!" The little boy and girl decided to take their kayaks careful down the hill. At the bottom, they were proud of themselves for completing their kayak adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a bald man. He lived in a small house with a big garden. In the garden, there were many pretty flowers and green trees. The bald man loved his garden very much. Every day, he would water the plants and play with his pet dog. One sunny day, the bald man saw a big box in his garden. He did not know where it came from. He blinked his eyes and looked again. The box was still there. He felt very surprised. The bald man opened the box. Inside, there were many colorful hats! He tried one on his head. It fit very well. The bald man was happy. From that day on, he wore a new hat every day while he played in his garden. And he never knew where the box came from, but he was very thankful.

One day, a little girl named Sue saw a harmless bug in the yard. The bug liked to dance. Sue wanted to be friends with the bug. She said, "Hi bug! I like your dance. Can we play together?" The bug said, "Yes, we can dance and play together!" So, Sue and the bug danced and played in the yard all day. They were very happy. After a while, Sue's friend Tom came and saw them playing. He wanted to join them, but he was scared of the bug. Sue said, "Don't worry, Tom. This bug is harmless and friendly. We can all play together." Tom joined Sue and the bug, and they all danced and played in the yard. They learned that being kind to others, even if they are different, can bring lots of fun and new friends.

The class was busy trying to paint. Some of them used red, some green and others blue. It was so much fun! One of the students, Anna, was a bit nosy. She kept peeking over to see what everyone else was painting. She liked to be able to see everyone’s painting. Suddenly the teacher noticed something. She asked Anna, “What are you doing Anna?” Anna answered timidly, “I wanted to see everyone’s painting.” The teacher smiled and said, “That’s very nice of you Anna, but you have to keep your own painting private!” So Anna went back to her painting and stayed very focused. painting beautiful pictures was so much fun! She made sure to be careful and keep her own painting a secret.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot was an obedient dog. He always did what his owner, a little boy named Tim, told him to do. One day, Tim and Spot went to the park. Tim put a chain on Spot so he would not run away. They played all day and had lots of fun. While they were playing, they saw a big pumpkin that had started to rot. "Ew!" said Tim. "That pumpkin is old and yucky." Spot barked at the pumpkin. They left the pumpkin and went home, happy after their fun day at the park.

One day, a little rabbit named Ben went out to play. He saw a big ball in the grass. Ben wanted to catch the ball. He ran quick to get it. Ben met a small bird named Tim. Tim was ignorant about how to catch the ball. Ben said, "I will show you how to catch the ball, Tim." Tim was happy. Together, they played catch with the ball. They ran quick and laughed. Ben taught Tim how to catch the ball. They had fun and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy named Robo. Robo had one arm. Tim loved to play with Robo every day. One day, Tim could not find Robo. He looked and looked, but Robo was not there. Tim felt sad and helpless. He missed Robo very much. He asked his mom for help, but she did not know where Robo was. Then, Tim saw his baby sister, Lily, in her room. Lily had Robo! She was playing with him. Tim was so happy to see Robo. But guess what? Robo now had two arms! Lily found the missing arm and put it on Robo. Now, Robo was not helpless anymore. Tim and Lily played with Robo together, and they all had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a unique bird named Bob. Bob loved to race with his friends. One day, he asked his friend, Sam the squirrel, "Do you want to race with me?" Sam said, "Yes! Let's race to the big tree!" So, they started the race. Bob flew fast and Sam ran fast. They were both happy and having fun. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew Bob off track. He was so surprised! Sam saw Bob and stopped running. He helped Bob get back on track, and they finished the race together. In the end, they both won and became even better friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy. This puppy was not ordinary. He could do something special. He could organize things very well. One day, the puppy went to a big park. He saw many toys on the ground. The puppy thought, "I will organize these toys!" He worked hard and put all the toys in neat piles. But then, something unexpected happened. The wind blew very hard. The wind messed up all the toys! The puppy was sad, but he did not give up. He organized the toys again, but this time, he put them in a big box. The wind could not mess up the toys now. The puppy was happy, and so were the kids at the park.

Anna likes to read books with her mom. They sit on the sofa and mom picks a book from the shelf. Anna picks a page she wants to read. She points to the pictures and says what they are. "Look, mom, a dog!" Anna says. "Yes, a dog. What does the dog say?" mom asks. "Woof, woof!" Anna says. They read more pages and see more animals. Anna likes the cat, the cow, the duck and the pig. She makes the sounds they make. Mom smiles and hugs her. "Anna, you are very smart and honest. You know the animals and their sounds. You don't lie or pretend. I am proud of you," mom says. "Thank you, mom. I love you. You are honest too. You read the words and tell me the story. You don't skip or change. You are the best mom," Anna says. They hug and kiss and read more pages. They are happy and honest. They love books and each other.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little soldier. He liked to look at things and ask questions. He lived in a small house with his mom and dad. One day, the curious soldier went for a walk. He saw a big red ball in the park. He wanted to play with it, so he used his hands to push the ball. The ball rolled and rolled, and the little soldier laughed. As the curious soldier pushed the ball, he met a new friend. The friend was a small dog with a wagging tail. They played together, pushing the ball and running in the park. The little soldier was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a regular kite. Tim loved to play with his kite in the park. He would run and laugh as the kite flew high in the sky. Tim had a lot of fun with his kite. One sunny day, Tim saw a girl crying in the park. Her kite was stuck in a tree. Tim wanted to help the girl. He tried to get her kite out of the tree. The girl stopped crying and smiled. Tim felt happy that he could help her. After that day, Tim and the girl became good friends. They played with their kites together and laughed a lot. Tim learned that helping others can make you feel happy too. The moral of the story is to be kind and help others when you can.

Once upon a time, there was a powerful hurricane. It was so big and strong that it could blow away houses. People were scared of the hurricane, so they stayed inside. One day, a little boy named Tim was searching for his favorite toy, a small red car. He looked under the bed, in the closet, and behind the sofa. Tim could not find his car anywhere. He was very sad. Tim's mom said, "Maybe the powerful hurricane took your car away. Let's go outside and search for it together." Tim and his mom went outside, and they saw something unexpected. The hurricane had stopped, and it was talking to them! The hurricane said, "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to play with your car. Here it is." The hurricane gave Tim his car back, and they all played together. From that day on, the powerful hurricane became their friend.

One day, a pigeon was walking around a park. He was looking for food, when suddenly he heard a loud noise. He panicked and hurried over to a nearby bush. He crouched down and stayed very still. As the noise got louder, the pigeon started to get worried. He wanted to fly away, but he didn’t know where to go. He stayed hidden until the noise stopped. But after the noise stopped, the pigeon noticed something strange. The park was filled with people, but they were all behaving in the same way. They were all running around, screaming and shouting. The pigeon was so scared, he couldn’t move. Then he realised; this was normal! This was how people behaved when they were having fun! The pigeon was relieved. He flew away, happy to be back to his normal life.

Once upon a time, there was a big stadium where people went to play games. One day, a little boy named Tim went with his mom to watch a game. Tim felt very safe and happy at the stadium because his mom was with him. While they were watching the game, Tim's mom said, "Guess what, Tim? I have a surprise for you." Tim was excited and tried to guess the surprise. "Is it ice cream?" he asked. His mom smiled and said, "You'll see." At the end of the game, Tim's mom took him to a special place in the stadium. There, he saw a big table with lots of ice cream! Tim was so happy and couldn't believe his guess was right. They had a fun day at the stadium and went home feeling safe and loved.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her toys and have fun with her friends. One day, she found an enormous book in her room. The book was about math. Lucy was very curious about what was inside the book. Lucy decided to start learning math. She opened the book and saw many pictures and numbers. She tried to count the numbers and match the pictures with the numbers. Lucy was very happy to learn something new and exciting. As she learned more math, Lucy became very good at counting. She could count her toys, her friends, and even the stars in the sky. Her friends were amazed by her new skill. Lucy was proud of herself for learning math from the enormous book. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big orange parrot. The parrot lived in a tree. The tree was in a park. The parrot liked to talk to people. One day, a boy came to the park. The boy saw the orange parrot. The boy said, "Hi, parrot!" The parrot said, "Hi, boy!" The boy and the parrot became friends. They played and talked every day. One day, the boy did not come to the park. The parrot was sad. The parrot wanted to send a letter to the boy. But the parrot did not know how. The parrot asked a dog for help. The dog said, "I can help you, parrot!" The dog took the letter to the boy. The boy was happy. The boy came back to the park. The parrot was happy too. The boy said, "Thank you, parrot, for sending the letter." The parrot said, "Thank you, dog, for helping me." The boy, the parrot, and the dog became best friends. They played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a high tree in the forest. It was so high that no one could reach the top of it. At the bottom of this high tree, was a little child. She was feeling very brave and wanted to climb the tree. She grabbed a branch and started to climb, higher and higher. As she got closer and closer to the top, she started to tremble. She was afraid that she wouldn't make it. But she kept going just the same. Finally, she reached the top of the tree and started to look around. Suddenly, the branch broke and she started to fall. She screamed, but no one could help her. She fell all the way down to the ground, and the child was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a unique cat named Spot. Spot loved to play hide and seek with his best friend, a little boy named Tim. One sunny day, they were playing their favorite game in the park. "Ready or not, here I come!" shouted Tim, as he looked for Spot. He searched near the big tree, behind the green bush, and even by the wet pond. But Spot was very good at hiding, and Tim could not find him. Just then, a big dog came running up to Tim. "Woof woof!" barked the dog. Tim was surprised and a little scared. But the dog wagged its tail and licked Tim's hand, making him laugh. "You're not so scary after all!" said Tim. The big dog helped Tim find Spot, who was hiding behind a small rock. From that day on, the unique cat, the little boy, and the big dog became best friends and played hide and seek together every day.

Lily and Tom are playing in their room. They have a big scale that can weigh things. They like to put different toys on the scale and see how heavy they are. "Look, Tom, this bear is very heavy!" Lily says, holding a big, fluffy bear. "It makes the scale go down a lot!" "Let me see!" Tom says, taking the bear from Lily. He puts it on the scale and watches the needle move. "Wow, you are right! The bear is heavier than the car and the ball!" They take turns weighing different toys and comparing them. They have fun seeing how the scale changes. Then, Lily has an idea. She opens a drawer in their dresser and takes out a black hat. It is their dad's hat. He wears it when he goes to work. "Tom, look at this!" Lily says, holding the hat. "Do you think it is heavy or light?" Tom shrugs. "I don't know. Maybe light?" "Let's find out!" Lily says, running to the scale. She puts the hat on the scale and waits. But nothing happens. The scale does not move at all. The hat is too light to weigh. Lily and Tom are confused. They look at the hat and the scale. "Why is the hat not heavy?" Lily asks. "I don't know," Tom says. "Maybe it is magic?" They giggle and try to weigh the hat again. But it still does not work. They hear their mom calling them for lunch. They put the hat back in the drawer and run to the kitchen. They forget about the hat and the scale. But they do not know that the hat is not really magic. It is just very old and has a hole in it. And inside the hole, there is a feather. A very light feather that makes the hat weigh nothing.

Sara was miserable. She had a big ouch on her knee from falling down. It was red and wet and hurt a lot. She cried and cried and wanted her mommy. But her mommy was busy. She had to work on her computer and talk on the phone. She told Sara to be quiet and play with her toys. She gave Sara a band-aid and a kiss and said it would heal soon. Sara did not want to play with her toys. She wanted her mommy to hug her and make the ouch go away. She looked around her room and saw a spider on the wall. She was scared of spiders. She screamed and ran to her mommy. Her mommy was angry. She said Sara was being silly and loud. She said spiders were not bad. They were small and harmless and helped to catch flies. She said Sara should not be afraid of them. She said Sara should go back to her room and leave her alone. Sara felt sad and lonely. She went back to her room and sat on her bed. She looked at the spider again. It was still on the wall. It had eight legs and two eyes and a round body. It did not look scary. It looked lonely too. Sara decided to be brave. She got up and walked slowly to the wall. She said hello to the spider. The spider did not say anything. It just moved a little. Sara smiled and said her name. She said she had a big ouch on her knee and it hurt a lot. She asked the spider if it ever had an ouch. The spider nodded. It pointed to a small cut on its leg. It said it got it from a mean cat. It said it hurt a lot too. But it said it would heal soon. It said it had a band-aid and a kiss from its mommy. Sara felt sorry for the spider. She said she had a band-aid and a kiss from her mommy too. But she said her mommy was busy and did not have time for her. She said she was miserable and wanted a friend. The spider said it was miserable too. It said it did not have any friends. It said it was scared and lonely. It said it wanted a friend too. Sara and the spider looked at each other. They saw that they were not so different. They both had ouches and band-aids and kisses. They both wanted friends. They both wanted to be happy. Sara reached out her hand and touched the spider gently. The spider crawled onto her palm and tickled her fingers. Sara giggled and said it felt funny. The spider smiled and said it felt nice. Sara and the spider became friends. They played and talked and laughed. They forgot about their ouches and their mommies. They felt happy and not miserable. They healed each other.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play outside in the yard. One day, they see a big ladder next to the house. They decide to climb the ladder and see what is on the roof. They are very careful and go up the ladder one by one. When they reach the top, they see many things on the roof. They see a bird's nest, a ball, a kite, and a chimney. They also see the sky and the trees and the cars. "Wow, this is fun!" Tom says. "We can see everything from here!" "Yes, it is!" Sam agrees. "But we have to be quiet. Mom and Dad don't know we are here. They will be angry if they find out." They play with the ball and the kite for a while. They also look at the bird's nest, but they don't touch it. They don't want to scare the birds. Suddenly, they hear a loud bark. They look down and see their dog, Rex, in the yard. Rex is alert. He sees them on the roof and he wants to join them. He jumps and runs and barks. "Oh no, Rex!" Tom says. "You are making too much noise! Mom and Dad will hear you!" "Shh, Rex, shh!" Sam says. "We are coming down. Stay there!" They quickly pack their things and go down the ladder. They hope Mom and Dad don't see them. They hug Rex and tell him to be quiet. They are happy they had fun on the roof, but they also know they were naughty. They decide not to do it again.

Once upon a time, there was a barber. The barber was a good man. He cut hair for people in the town. The people liked the barber and they trust him to make them look nice. One day, a boy came to the barber. The boy felt dizzy. The boy said, "I need a haircut, but I feel dizzy." The barber said, "Do not worry, I will help you." The barber gave the boy a haircut. The boy did not feel dizzy anymore. The boy was happy. The people in the town were happy too. They trust the barber to help them. And they all lived happily ever after.

Lily and Tom were hungry. They wanted to eat spaghetti for dinner. Mom said she would make spaghetti for them. She went to the kitchen and started to boil water. Lily and Tom played in the living room. They had a lot of toys. They liked to pretend they were animals. Lily was a lion and Tom was a monkey. They made loud noises and jumped around. Mom heard them and smiled. She wanted to have some fun too. She put some spaghetti on a plate and sneaked into the living room. She hid behind the couch and waited. Lily and Tom did not see her. They kept playing. Lily roared like a lion and Tom chattered like a monkey. They ran towards the couch. Mom jumped out and shouted, "Boo!" She held the plate of spaghetti in front of her face. She made a funny noise. Lily and Tom were scared. They screamed and ran away. They thought Mom was a spaghetti monster. Mom laughed and said, "It's me, it's me! I was just joking. Come here, my little animals. It's time for dinner." Lily and Tom stopped and looked at Mom. They saw her face and the spaghetti. They realized it was a prank. They felt silly and laughed too. They hugged Mom and said, "You scared us, Mom. But we love you. And we love spaghetti." Mom said, "I love you too. And I'm glad you love spaghetti. Let's go to the kitchen and eat. Maybe we can have some ice cream later." Lily and Tom were happy. They followed Mom to the kitchen. They ate spaghetti and ice cream. They had a good time. They were not scared anymore. They were glad.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived in a big house with his mom and dad. The house had many stairs. One day, Tim's mom told him to go up the stairs and find the original toy she had set on the top stair. Tim started to climb the stairs, excited to find the toy. He went up and up, wondering what the original toy would look like. As he climbed, he saw many toys on the stairs, but he knew none of them were the original toy. Finally, Tim reached the top stair and saw the original toy. It was a beautiful red car, just like the one his dad had. Tim was so happy that he found the toy his mom had set for him. He played with the car all day and knew that it was his favorite toy.

One day, a boy named Tim went to play outside. He saw his neighbor, a girl named Sue. Sue was very flexible. She could bend and twist in many ways. Tim and Sue liked to play together. "Let's play catch," said Tim. Sue agreed, and they started to throw a ball back and forth. But Tim forgot to tie his shoe. He tripped and fell on the ground. Sue ran to help him. "Oh no, are you okay?" Sue asked. Tim nodded, but he felt sad. Then, something unexpected happened. Sue showed Tim a new way to tie his shoes. She used her flexible fingers to make a special knot. "Now you won't forget and trip again," said Sue. Tim smiled and thanked Sue. They played catch all day long, and Tim never tripped again.

Once upon a time, in a big town, there was a famous gate. The gate was big and pretty. Many people came to see the gate and take pictures. The gate was happy to be famous. One day, a little girl named Lucy came to the famous gate. She looked at the gate and thought it was very nice. Lucy wanted to show the gate that she liked it, so she gave the gate a little kiss. The gate felt very happy that Lucy had kissed it. From that day on, more and more people came to see the famous gate and give it a little kiss too. The gate and the people in the town lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. Tim lived on a big earth with many trees and flowers. One day, Tim saw a big door. He wanted to know what was behind the door. He tried to open it, but it was closed very tight. Tim was sad because he couldn't open the door. He wanted to find a way to open it. He asked his friend, a small bird, to help him. The bird was very smart and knew how to open the door. The bird told Tim to push the door very hard. Tim listened to the bird and pushed the door with all his strength. The door opened, and Tim was very happy. Behind the door, he found a beautiful garden with many colorful flowers. Tim and the bird played in the garden all day. At the end of the day, they closed the door and went home, knowing they could always come back to play again.

Tom and Sue are friends. They like to play with toys. One day, they find a big box in the garage. The box has a picture of a spaceship on it. Tom and Sue open the box and see a toy spaceship inside. The spaceship has buttons and lights and a laser. "Wow, this is a cool spaceship!" Tom says. "Let's play with it!" "OK, but be careful with the laser. It can hurt your eyes," Sue says. Tom and Sue put the spaceship on the floor and pretend to travel to different planets. They make sounds like zoom and beep and whoosh. They have fun. But then, Tom gets curious. He wants to see what the laser does. He points the laser at the wall and presses a button. A red beam comes out of the spaceship and hits the wall. The wall makes a hole. "Oops!" Tom says. "Tom, what did you do?" Sue says. "You broke the wall!" "I'm sorry, I didn't know the laser was so strong," Tom says. They hear footsteps. It is Tom's mom. She comes to the garage and sees the hole in the wall. She is angry. "Tom, Sue, what happened here?" she says. "Did you use the laser?" Tom and Sue look at each other. They are scared. They don't know what to say. They wish they had not played with the modern toy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue liked to help her mom in the house. One day, Sue found a broken toy in her room. She wanted to fix it, so she went to the chamber to find glue. In the chamber, Sue found a big box. She opened the box and saw many toys inside. The toys were not broken. Sue was very happy. She took the toys to her room and played with them. One day, Sue's mom saw the toys and asked where they came from. Sue told her mom about the big box in the chamber. Her mom said the toys were for the kids who needed help. Sue felt bad for taking the toys, so she put them back in the box. Sue and her mom took the box to the kids who needed help. They all played with the toys and had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a harmless thief. His name was Tom. Tom liked to take things from others, but he never hurt anyone. One day, he saw a shiny toy car in a shop. He wanted it very much. Tom went into the shop and said to the shopkeeper, "I want that shiny toy car, please." The shopkeeper said, "You need to give me two coins for it." Tom did not have any coins. He was sad. That night, Tom went to the shop and took the shiny toy car. The next day, the shopkeeper saw the toy car was gone. He knew Tom took it. The shopkeeper went to Tom's house and said, "Tom, you took my shiny toy car. That is not nice." Tom felt bad and gave the toy car back. From that day on, Tom never took things from others again.

John played in the park. He ran around and had lots of fun. He went to the slide and kicked the toy car that his mom had given him. His mom watched him and said, "John, that car is useful. You can use it to go down the slide." John thought for a minute and then said back, "Okay mom, I'll use the car to slide down." John put the car on the slide and pushed it down with his feet. It went faster than he expected and he went flying in the air, screaming with joy! He loved sliding down the slide just as much as he loved kicking the car.

Once upon a time, there was a big room. In the room, there were many beds. Each bed had a staff next to it. The staff was for people who were ready to sleep. When they were ready, they would hold the staff and go to sleep. One day, a little girl named Amy came into the room. She was very tired and ready to sleep. She picked up a staff, held it tight, and lay down on a bed. But something unexpected happened. Instead of going to sleep, she began to float in the air! Amy was surprised and a little scared. She held the staff tighter and thought about sleep. Suddenly, she was back on the bed, ready to sleep again. This time, when she closed her eyes, she slept and did not float. The next morning, Amy told everyone about her adventure. They all laughed and said it was a funny dream. But Amy knew it was not a dream. She knew the staff had a secret power. From that day on, Amy always used the special staff when she was ready to sleep. And sometimes, she would float and have fun in the air.

Once upon a time, there was a busy town. In the town, there was a big castle. In the castle lived a king. The king had a shiny crown on his head. He seemed very important. One day, the king lost his crown. He looked everywhere for it. He looked under the bed, he looked behind the door, but he could not find it. The king seemed very sad. A little girl in the town found the crown. She knew it was the king's crown. She took it to the king. The king was so happy. He thanked the little girl. The town seemed happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a cute dog named Spot. Spot was very white and loved to play outside. One day, Spot saw a big truck near his home. The truck was full of toys and balls. Spot wanted to help, so he started to load the toys and balls into the truck. Spot worked hard to load the truck. He picked up each toy and ball with his mouth and put them inside the truck. The truck driver saw Spot and smiled. He knew that Spot was a good helper. The driver said, "Thank you, Spot!" and gave him a pat on the head. After the truck was full, it was time for the driver to go. Spot waved goodbye with his tail and the truck drove away. Spot felt happy that he helped load the truck. He ran back to his home and took a long nap, dreaming of all the fun he had with the cute toys and the big white truck.

Once upon a time, there was a little sheep. It had a lot of wool. The wool was very soft, but it was also filthy. The sheep did not like its filthy wool. One day, the sheep met a bird. The bird liked to sing. The sheep asked the bird, "Can you help me make my wool clean?" The bird said, "Yes, I can help you." The bird sang a happy song. As it sang, it picked up water from a nearby river. The bird splashed the water on the sheep's wool. The filthy wool became clean and shiny. The sheep was very happy and thanked the bird. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to peek into things. One day, she saw a big pan in the kitchen. The pan was shiny and new. Kitty wanted to know what was inside. Kitty jumped up on the table and looked into the pan. She saw a yummy cake! She wanted to eat it all by herself. Just then, her friend, Doggy, came into the kitchen. Doggy saw Kitty with the cake and said, "Kitty, we should share the cake with our friends!" But Kitty was feeling nosy and wanted the cake all to herself. She told Doggy, "No, I found it first, so it's mine!" Doggy felt sad and left the kitchen. Later, Kitty felt bad for not sharing the cake. She went to find Doggy and said, "I'm sorry, Doggy. You're right, we should share the cake with our friends." So Kitty and Doggy shared the cake with all their friends, and everyone was happy. The moral of the story is that sharing with friends makes everyone happy.

One day, a youth named Tim went to the park. He had a big sack with him. In the sack, there were many brilliant toys. Tim loved to play with his toys under the sun. At the park, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue saw the sack and asked, "What is in the sack?" Tim smiled and said, "I have toys in the sack. Do you want to play with me?" Sue was happy and said, "Yes, I want to play with you!" Tim and Sue played with the brilliant toys all day. They had lots of fun. They laughed and played until the sun went down. Then, they put the toys back in the sack and went home. They were now good friends.

Anna and Ben were adventurous kids. They liked to play in their room and pretend they were on a big ship. They used a sheet to make a sail and tied it to their bed. They also had a toy chest that they used as a treasure box. One day, they decided to hop from their bed to the toy chest and back. They thought it was fun and exciting. They said, "Ahoy, matey! We are the best pirates in the world!" But they did not see that the sheet was loose. When Anna hopped back to the bed, the sheet came off and wrapped around her. She fell to the floor and hit her head. She cried out loud and felt a lot of pain. Ben was scared and ran to get their mom. Mom came quickly and saw Anna on the floor. She was angry and worried. She said, "What were you doing? You could have hurt yourself badly! This is not a game, this is dangerous!" She picked up Anna and took her to the doctor. The doctor said Anna had a bump on her head and needed to rest. He gave her a band-aid and a lollipop. Anna felt sorry and sad. She said, "I'm sorry, mom. I won't hop on the bed anymore." Mom hugged her and said, "I love you, Anna. But you have to be careful and listen to me. You can play, but not with the sheet. It is not a sail, it is for sleeping." Anna and Ben learned their lesson. They did not play with the sheet anymore. They found other ways to be adventurous and have fun. But they always checked if it was safe first.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to visit her friend, Tom. Tom had a big, furry cat named Fluffy. Lucy loved to play with Fluffy because she was so soft and cuddly. Tom wanted to show Lucy something special. He said, "Look, Lucy! I have a trophy!" The trophy was shiny and big. Tom had won it in a race. Lucy clapped her hands and said, "Wow, Tom! That's great!" Lucy, Tom, and Fluffy played together all day. They had lots of fun. When it was time for Lucy to go home, she said, "Bye, Tom! Bye, Fluffy! I had a great time!" Tom and Fluffy waved goodbye, and Lucy went home with a big smile on her face.

Once upon a time, there was a little bug named Tim. Tim loved to glow at night. One day, Tim was very upset. He could not find his friend, Sam the snail. Tim looked and looked, but Sam was not there. Tim felt very tired, so he took a short nap. When he woke up, he saw a big bird flying above him. Tim had an idea. Maybe the bird could help him find Sam. So, Tim asked the bird to help him look for his friend. The big bird agreed to help Tim. They looked everywhere for Sam. But then, the big bird saw Sam and quickly ate him. Tim was very sad. He learned that he should not trust everyone he meets.

Tom and Mia are young. They like to play with toys. They have a big box of toys in their room. One day, they find a new toy in the box. It is a rocket. It is red and shiny. It has a button on it. "Wow, look at this!" Tom says. He picks up the rocket. "It is a rocket. It can fly to the moon." "Can I see?" Mia asks. She wants to play with the rocket too. "OK, but be careful. It is not a toy for babies." Tom says. He gives the rocket to Mia. She holds it in her hands. She feels the button. "What does this button do?" Mia asks. She is curious. She wants to press the button. "I don't know. Maybe it makes a sound. Or maybe it makes the rocket fly." Tom says. He is curious too. He leans closer to the rocket. Mia presses the button. The rocket makes a loud noise. It shoots out a flame. It flies out of Mia's hands. It zooms across the room. It hits the wall. It makes a hole in the wall. "Uh-oh!" Tom and Mia say. They are scared. They drop to the floor. They hide behind the bed. They peek out from the bed. They see the rocket on the floor. It is broken. They see the hole in the wall. It is big. "Mommy! Daddy!" Tom and Mia shout. They hope their parents are not angry. They hope they can fix the rocket. They hope they can fix the wall. They hope they can still play with toys. They are young. They like to play with toys. But they learn a lesson. They learn to be careful with new toys. They learn to ask before they press buttons. They learn to share and take turns. They are young. But they are growing up.

Once upon a time, there was a big, warm fireplace in a little house. A boy named Tim and his sister, Sue, lived there. They loved to sit near the fireplace on cold days. The fireplace made them feel happy and safe. One day, Tim and Sue were playing near the fireplace. Tim said, "Let's be fair and take turns playing with the toy car." Sue agreed and they both played happily. They knew that sharing was important. As they played, their mom came in and said, "I love how you share and play together. It's nice to see you being fair and kind." Tim and Sue smiled, knowing that being fair and kind was the right thing to do. And they continued to play together, feeling warm and happy by the fireplace. The moral of the story is: sharing and being fair to others makes everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big purple dog. The dog loved to play with a small copper ball. He would run and jump with the ball all day long. One day, the purple dog got very dirty. He had mud all over his fur. His copper ball was dirty too. The dog's friend, a little girl, saw him and said, "Oh no! You're so dirty! Let's clean you up." The little girl got a soft cloth and wiped the purple dog's fur. She wiped and wiped until the dog was clean again. Then, she wiped the copper ball until it was shiny. The purple dog was so happy to be clean and to have his shiny copper ball back. They played together all day long, and the purple dog promised to stay clean.

One day, a little girl named Mia wanted to bake a cake. She felt gloomy because it was raining outside. Mia put on her apron and started to mix the cake batter. She was excited to bake the cake, but she needed help. Mia's mom came into the kitchen and said, "I can help you, Mia!" They both worked together to bake the cake. They mixed and stirred the batter. Then, they put the cake in the oven to bake. While they waited, Mia found a horn. She blew the horn to make a loud noise. Her little brother, Tom, heard the noise and started to cry. Mia felt bad for making Tom cry. She gave him a big hug and said, "I'm sorry, Tom." Mia's mom took the cake out of the oven. It smelled very good. Mia, her mom, and Tom all sat down to eat the cake. They were happy, and the gloomy day felt much better with cake and family.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a pet dog named Max. Max was an obedient dog and always listened to Tim. They loved to play together. One sunny day, Tim wanted to play outside. "Max, come!" said Tim. Max came running to him. Tim put on his pants and went outside with Max. They played in the park and had lots of fun. After a while, Tim's mom called them. "Tim, Max, come home!" she said. Tim and Max went home. They were tired but happy. They had a great day playing together.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a kite. The kite was red and blue. Tim wanted to make the kite fly high in the sky. He ran to the park with the kite. The wind blew and the kite went up, up, up. Tim was very happy. In the park, Tim saw a girl named Sue. Sue liked to dance. She was dancing to fun music. Tim felt uncomfortable because he did not know how to dance. But Sue said, "Don't worry, I can teach you how to dance!" Tim and Sue danced together in the park. They laughed and had fun. The kite flew high in the sky. It was a great day for Tim and Sue. They were happy and the kite danced with them in the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max had a big, red bow on his neck. He loved to play with his friend, a cat named Lily. One day, Max and Lily were playing in the park. Max said, "Lily, let's play a game. You lead, and I will follow." Lily was very patient and waited for Max to catch up as they ran around the park. But then, they saw a big, mean dog. The mean dog wanted Max's red bow. Max and Lily tried to run away, but the mean dog was faster. He took Max's bow and ran away. Max and Lily were very sad, and they never saw the red bow again.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous fish named Fin. Fin loved to swim all day long. He swam in a big pond near a place called University. One day, while Fin was swimming, he saw a big shiny thing. It was a key! The key was very special. Fin took the key in his mouth and swam to his fish friends. They all looked at the key and wondered what it could open. As they swam around, they found a big door under the water. Fin put the key in the door and turned it. The door opened, and they found a secret room full of toys! The fish were so happy to play with the toys. They never knew there was a secret room under the water. And from that day on, the fish had even more fun swimming and playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a man with a big mustache. He was very rich. He lived in a big house. The man liked to gaze at the sky. One day, a little boy came to the man's house. The boy said, "Hello, mustache man! I like your big house." The man said, "Thank you, little boy." The boy and the man became friends. They played and gazed at the sky together. But one day, the man wanted more. He wanted to be the richest man in the world. The man stopped playing with the boy. He only cared about his money. The boy was sad. The man became the richest man, but he was not happy. He had no friends. The man with the big mustache was all alone.

One day, Sam and Lily went to the park with their mom. They saw a big slide, a swing, and a sandbox. They wanted to play with everything. "Can we go on the slide, mom?" Sam asked. "Sure, but be careful," mom said. Sam and Lily ran to the slide and climbed up the ladder. They took turns sliding down and laughing. They had a lot of fun. Then they noticed a boy sitting on a bench. He had an enormous club in his hand. It was bigger than him. He looked sad and lonely. "Who is he?" Lily wondered. "I don't know. Maybe he wants to play with us," Sam said. They walked over to the boy and said hello. "Hi, I'm Sam and this is Lily. What's your name?" Sam asked. The boy looked up and smiled. "I'm Max. This is my club. It's my favorite toy," he said. "Wow, that's a cool club. Can we see it?" Lily asked. "Sure, but be careful. It's heavy," Max said. He handed the club to Sam and Lily. They tried to lift it, but it was too heavy for them. "Wow, you're strong. How did you get this club?" Sam asked. "My dad made it for me. He's a carpenter. He said it's a special club for a special boy," Max said. "That's awesome. Your dad is very nice," Lily said. "Thanks. Do you want to play with me?" Max asked. "Yes, we do. What do you like to play?" Sam asked. "I like to pretend I'm a giant and I smash things with my club. But I don't have anyone to play with. Everyone is scared of me and my club," Max said. "That's not fair. We're not scared of you. We want to be your friends. Can we be giants too?" Lily asked. "Really? You do? That would be great. Yes, you can be giants too. Here, you can use these sticks as your clubs," Max said. He gave Sam and Lily two sticks from the ground. They were happy. "Yay, thank you. Let's go and smash things," Sam said. They ran to the sandbox and pretended to be giants. They smashed the sand castles, the rocks, and the flowers. They made loud noises and laughed. Mom watched them from the bench. She was glad they made a new friend. She smiled and said to herself, "They're having a blast."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy had a delicate toy bunny. She loved her bunny very much. Every day, Lucy would keep her bunny close and play with it. One day, Lucy and her bunny went to the park. While playing, Lucy saw a big bird fly by. The bird had a shiny thing in its beak. Lucy wanted to see what it was, so she followed the bird. She told her bunny, "Keep an eye on me, so we don't get lost!" As Lucy followed the bird, she found a big tree. The bird dropped the shiny thing into a hole in the tree. Lucy reached in and pulled out the shiny thing. It was a key! She wondered what the key could open. Lucy looked around and saw a little door at the base of the tree. She put the key in the door and turned it. The door opened, and inside was a room full of toys! Lucy was so happy. She knew that she and her bunny would have lots of fun playing with all the new toys. And from that day on, Lucy and her bunny had many more adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable dog named Spot. Spot liked to sit on the porch and watch the kids play. He was always there to make sure they were safe. One day, a little girl named Sue fell down and hurt her knee. Spot ran to her side to make sure she was okay. Sue's mom came out and saw her hurt knee. She knew what to do to heal it. Sue's mom put a band-aid on the hurt knee and gave Sue a big hug. Spot stayed by Sue's side until she felt better. Sue was happy to have such a dependable friend like Spot. They went back to the porch and played happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to learn new things. Her mother would teach her every day. They had a lot of fun together. One day, Amy and her mother went for a walk.
