Once upon a time, there was a big tree. The tree had a branch that liked to lean. The branch was very high up. A little bird lived on the branch. The little bird was not happy. The little bird wanted to fly away. One day, the little bird saw a cross on the ground. The cross was very big. The little bird was angry. The little bird wanted to know who put the cross there. The little bird flew down to the cross. The angry little bird sat on the cross. The little bird looked around. The little bird could not find who put the cross there. The little bird was very sad. The little bird never found out who put the cross there. The little bird did not have a happy ending.

Jack and Janie were walking in the park together when they both saw an apple tree. Jack took an apple and said, "Let's taste it, Janie".Janie took a bite and exclaimed, “Yummy! It tastes so sweet”. Then, they heard an unfamiliar sound. They noticed a bird in the tree and the bird said, “Tweet, tweet”. Janie was surprised and said, “What kind of language is that?” Jack said, “That’s a special language. It's called bird language, and birds all around the world use it. It's unique”. Janie thought the language was cool and wanted to learn it. She asked, “Can we learn the language too?” Jack smiled and said, “Well, birds learn their language from their parents, so it won’t be easy. But it will be fun to try!” Janie was excited and they both began learning the language. It took some time, but soon they became fluent in bird language and enjoyed talking to the bird.

Once upon a time, there was a blue boat. A boy and his dog liked to play near the boat. One day, the boy said, "Let's go in the boat, dog!" So, the boy and the dog went in the boat. While they were in the boat, the boy saw a lock. He turned the lock and, surprise! The boat started to move. The boy and the dog were happy. They laughed as the boat went faster and faster. Then, they saw a big fish jump out of the water. The big fish said, "Hello, boy and dog! I made the boat go fast when you turned the lock. Do you want to go back to land?" The boy and the dog said, "Yes, please!" So, the big fish helped them go back to land. The boy and the dog thanked the fish and played by the blue boat every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was a curious three year old who wanted to explore the world. One day, she wanted to taste the sky. She thought, “If I can get to the top of the highest mountain, I can look up and taste the sky”. So, she asked her brother, “Can I taste the sky?”. Her brother smiled, then said, “No Daisy, the sky is too far away”. But Daisy wouldn't give up easily. She asked her mum, “Can I taste the sky?” Her mum chuckled and said ,“No, it's too uncomfortable. You shouldn't even try”. But Daisy was determined. She asked her dad, “Can I taste the sky?” Her dad picked her up and said, “No, Daisy, but I can show you a much better way to explore the sky”. So dad took Daisy to the highest hill nearby. From the summit, she could look up at the sky in amazement. Although she couldn't taste the sky, it was still an incredible experience for little Daisy.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a snake on the ground. Tim was very careful. He did not want to scare the snake. He said, "Hi, snake! Can I lift you?" The snake said, "Yes, Tim. You can lift me. But be careful, please." Tim was very happy. He carefully lifted the snake with both hands. The snake felt soft and smooth. Tim and the snake became good friends. They played together every day. Tim always remembered to be careful with his new friend. And the snake liked being with Tim too. They had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there lived an adventurous panda named Pandy. Pandy loved to play with his friends, the little birds and the happy bunnies. Every day, they would come together near the tall trees and have fun. One sunny day, Pandy met a new friend, a tiny squirrel named Squeaky. Pandy said, "Hi, I am Pandy. Come play with us!" Squeaky was shy, but he liked Pandy's big smile. So, he said, "Okay, I will come and play too!" Pandy, Squeaky, and all their friends played hide and seek, jumped in the soft grass, and laughed together. They had so much fun that they played until the sun went down. Then, they all said goodnight and went to their cozy homes to sleep. And from that day on, Squeaky was part of their happy group of friends.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk. He wore his red jacket because it was cold outside. Tim wanted to improve at running so he could be healthy and strong. As Tim ran, he saw his friend Sue. Sue said, "Hi Tim, I like your red jacket! Do you want to run with me?" Tim said, "Yes, let's run together to be healthy." So, Tim and Sue ran and ran. But then, they saw a big hole in the ground. Tim and Sue did not see the hole and they fell in. They were stuck and could not get out. Their jackets got dirty and they did not improve at running. Tim and Sue were sad because they had a bad day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys. He had many toys in his room. Tim's room was very organized. He had a special place for each toy. One day, Tim noticed something new in his room. It was a spoon! The spoon was shiny and pretty. Tim picked up the spoon and started to play with it. He used the spoon to dig in his toy box and found more fun things to play with. Tim played with the spoon all day. He used the spoon to eat his lunch, and he used it to help his toys eat their pretend food. At the end of the day, Tim put the spoon in its special place in his organized room. Tim was very happy with his new spoon and loved playing with it every day.

Once upon a time, there lived a silly little girl called Grace. Grace was a very adventurous girl who loved to explore the world. Every morning, she would rise early to go to the nearby mill and watch the people deliver the wheat. One day, as Grace was watching, she noticed a man delivering something different. What could it be? She decided to follow him and find out. After a while, the man stopped at an old, dark house. He knocked on the door, and out popped an old lady. “Hello there! I recently bought this flour, and I’m here to deliver it to you,” the man said. Grace was so excited that the old lady asked, “Why don’t you come in and play?” Grace ran inside and played with the old lady’s silly toys all afternoon. Before she knew it, the sun had already gone down. When it was time for Grace to go home, the old lady gave her a bag of flour from the mill. “Thank you for delivering the flour to me,” she said to Grace with a smile. Grace thanked the old lady and took the flour home. From that day on, she promised to never forget the silly old lady at the mill.

Once upon a time, there was a loud mill. It was big and noisy. The mill would split wood all day long. The people who worked there were not happy. One day, a small cat came to the mill. The cat was lost and scared. The workers liked the cat, and the cat made them happy. They wanted to keep the cat at the mill. But the mill was very loud. The cat did not like the noise. It tried to run away, but it could not find the way out. It was too loud for the cat, and it was scared. The workers tried to help the cat, but they could not stop the mill. The mill kept splitting wood, and it was too loud. The cat was very sad and scared. In the end, the cat could not stay at the mill. It was too loud, and the cat was too scared. The workers were sad, and the mill kept being loud and scary.

Once upon a time, there lived a boy named Jack. He was a healthy boy who loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, Jack's mum asked him to clean his room. He was a bit scared at first but he knew it was something he had to do. So, he set to work collecting all his toys and putting them away. His mum was so proud of him for doing such a good job that she decided to give him a special gift. It was a healthy snack of apples and oranges. Jack was so happy and ate every last bit. Jack was so pleased that he had done such a good job cleaning that he ran and hugged his mum. They both laughed as they celebrated his hard work. Jack would never forget the gift he got and he knew that if he continued to work hard and stay healthy, he would be rewarded with more surprises!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Kelly. She was very troubled, always constantly worrying and feeling sad. One day, Kelly decided to take a hop to try and make herself feel better. She hopped and hopped until she reached what looked like a shiny white phone. She was curious as to what it was, and before she could hop away, someone called out to her. "Why, hello there. Go ahead and pick me up," said the voice on the phone. Kelly was a bit troubled, but she decided to pick up the phone. "Hello? Who is this?" asked Kelly. "I'm your guardian angel, Sayid. I'm here to help you. Why don't you tell me what's troubling you," said Sayid. Kelly explained to Sayid how sad and worried she was. "Well Kelly, I'm here to help you. You just have to remember to hop towards happiness," said Sayid. Kelly understood. She thanked Sayid and hopped away, feeling much better.

Harry was a happy three-year-old boy. He loved playing in the park. One day, Harry was playing with his ball near a glass window. Suddenly, the ball rolled straight into the window and broke it. Harry started to cry. His mom heard the noise and came running to him. "Oh, Harry, why are you crying?" she asked. "My ball broke the glass," he sobbed. His mom was helpful. "Don't worry, Harry. I can fix it," She said. With her help, Harry looked on as his mom took out some tools, put it all together and soon, the window was as good as new. "See, Harry. Everything is OK," she said and hugged him. "Thank you, Mommy," Harry said, being relieved. A smile came on his face after he saw the glass was back in one piece. He hugged his mom and said, "You are the best." Harry was so glad his helpful mom fixed it all.

Jimmy was looking out the window, watching the birds fly around. His mom walked into the room and asked him what he was doing. Jimmy said he was just trying to pick out his favourite bird. His mom smiled and said, "That's nice Jimmy. What's your opinion?" Jimmy thought for a second and said, "I like the one with the red wings." His mom said, "That's a flexible opinion." Then they heard a noise outside. Jimmy and his mom looked out the window, and they saw a squirrel carrying a nut. Jimmy asked his mom if he could go outside and play with the squirrel. She said, "I don't know, Jimmy. What do you think?" Jimmy said he thought it would be a great idea. His mom said, "That sounds like a good plan. I will allow you to go outside and play." Jimmy was so excited and thanked his mom. He rushed out the door, scrambling to catch up with the squirrel. He ended up spending the whole afternoon playing with the squirrel, and when it was time to come back inside, he felt so happy and thankful.

Ben and Lily were playing in the kitchen. They liked to pretend they were chefs and make yummy food. They had pots and pans and spoons and bowls. They also had some fruits and vegetables that mom gave them. Ben wanted to make a salad. He picked a big red tomato and cut it with a plastic knife. He picked a green cucumber and cut it too. He put them in a bowl and mixed them with some salt and oil. He was very proud of his salad. Lily wanted to make a cake. She picked a chubby banana and peeled it. She picked a brown egg and cracked it. She put them in a bowl and mashed them with a fork. She added some flour and sugar and milk. She was very happy with her cake. She looked for a pan to bake her cake. She saw one on the stove. It had a shiny knob. She reached for it, but Ben stopped her. "No, Lily, that's my pan!" he said. "I need it for my salad. Go find another one." "But I want this one!" Lily said. "It's the best one. It has a knob. Let me have it!" They both pulled on the pan. They started to fight. They shouted and pushed and kicked. The pan fell on the floor. The salad and the cake spilled everywhere. They made a big mess. Mom heard the noise and came to the kitchen. She saw the mess and the pan and the kids. She was very angry. "Ben and Lily, what have you done?" she said. "You ruined your food and my kitchen. You are very naughty. Go to your rooms, now!" Ben and Lily felt very sorry. They dropped the pan and ran to their rooms. They wished they had shared the pan and played nicely. They learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a big, friendly dog named Spot. Spot loved to play and have fun with his friends. One day, he met a new friend named Tim. Tim was a small, original bird who liked to sing. Spot wanted to teach Tim how to play fetch, so they went to the park. Spot showed Tim how to throw a ball and then go get it. Tim tried, but it was hard for him to hold the ball in his beak. They both laughed and had fun trying. In the end, Tim taught Spot how to sing a pretty song. They both learned something new and had a lot of fun. Spot and Tim became the best of friends and played together every day. And that is the story of Spot and Tim.

Once upon a time, there was a wild pony named Spot. Spot lived in a big field with other ponies. One day, Spot saw a little girl named Sue come near the field. Sue liked to stare at the ponies and watch them play. One day, Sue said to her mom, "I want to be friends with the wild pony, Spot." Her mom said, "If you give Spot a big red apple, he might come to you." Sue was very happy and went to find a big red apple. The next day, Sue came back to the field with the big red apple. She showed it to Spot and said, "Here, Spot. This is for you." Spot slowly walked to Sue and took the apple. They both smiled at each other. From that day on, Sue and Spot were best friends.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl. She loved to explore and went to the cabin in the woods. There, she noticed that everything was very dirty. She was concerned and decided to do something about it. She asked her mom for help. Her mom agreed and they set off to the cabin. When they arrived, the girl was ready to strike. She took the broom and started sweeping the dirt. The girl was so determined. She worked and worked until all the dirt was gone. After she was finished, the cabin was sparkling clean. The girl was delighted and thanked her mom for helping. Her mom just smiled and said: "It's what moms do for their kids. You did a good job." The girl was filled with pride. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a pig. The pig lived on a farm. The pig thought the farm was boring. Every day, the pig would walk around and look for fun things to do. One day, as the pig walked, he saw a big box. The pig was very curious. He kneeled down to look inside the box. Inside the box, there were many colorful balls. The pig was so happy! He had never seen anything like it before. The pig played with the colorful balls all day. He rolled them, he threw them, and he even tried to eat them. But then, something unexpected happened. The balls started to bounce on their own! The pig was surprised, but he wasn't scared. He laughed and played with the bouncing balls. The farm wasn't boring anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a fair little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with big windows. Lily loved to look out the window and watch the birds play in the sun. One day, it rained and rained. Lily could not go out to play. She felt sad. She looked out the window and saw the rain falling on the trees and flowers. The rain made the window wet. When the rain stopped, Lily wanted to help her mom. She took a soft cloth and began to dry the window. She wiped and wiped until the window was dry and clear. Now, she could see the bright sun and the happy birds again. Lily felt happy and proud that she helped her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to watch movies with her family. Her favorite movie was about a big, friendly dog who went on fun adventures. Amy would always laugh and clap when she watched this movie. One day, Amy's mom wanted to watch a new movie. She asked Amy to help her find the movie. They went to the room where all the movies were kept. But, oh no! The movies were not organized. They were all mixed up and hard to find. Amy had an idea. She decided to attach a picture of each movie to the shelf, so they could see which movie was where. Amy and her mom worked together to make the pictures and put them on the shelves. Now, the movies were organized and easy to find. Amy and her mom found the new movie and enjoyed watching it together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a red radio. He loved to listen to the songs on the radio. One day, Tim heard a rich man on the radio. The rich man was talking about how he supports people who need help. Tim wanted to be like the rich man. He wanted to support others too. So, Tim asked his mom how he could help people. His mom said, "You can share your toys with your friends, and be nice to everyone you meet." Tim was happy to help others. He shared his toys with his friends and was always nice. And every time he listened to his red radio, he remembered the rich man who supports others. Tim knew that he was making a difference, just like the rich man.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a green frog near a broken toy. Tim went to the frog and said, "Hi, frog! Why are you near this broken toy?" The frog looked at Tim and said, "I want to help fix the toy, but I am too small. Can you help me?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, I can help you, frog!" Tim and the frog worked together to fix the broken toy. Tim would grab the parts, and the frog would tell him where to put them. They had a lot of fun fixing the toy. When they were done, the frog said, "Thank you, Tim! Now I can play with the toy!" Tim and the frog played together at the park all day.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a toy car. The toy car was red and reliable. Every day, Tim played with his car. One day, Tim's car was lost. Tim was sad. He looked for the car but could not find it. Tim asked his mom to help him get the car. His mom said, "Tim, don't worry. We will find your car." They looked and looked. Then, Tim saw his car under the bed. He was happy. He gave his mom a big smile. Tim played with his car again. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a king. The king was big and strong, but he was also very ugly. He lived in a big castle with many people. The king was sad because people would tease him about his ugly face. One day, a little girl named Lily came to the castle. She saw the king and said, "Why are you so sad, Mr. King?" The king told her about how people tease him. Lily felt bad for the king and wanted to help him. Lily had an idea. She went to find a big, pretty hat for the king to wear. When the king put on the hat, he was very happy. The people stopped teasing him, and the king was not sad anymore. The king and Lily became good friends, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim had a vest that he loved very much. It was a crazy vest with lots of colors and shapes. He wore it every day. One day, Tim saw a girl named Sue who was sad. Sue did not have a vest like Tim's. She felt cold and wanted a vest to keep her warm. Tim wanted to help Sue. He tried to explain how to get a vest like his, but Sue did not know where to find one. Tim thought for a moment and then decided to give his crazy vest to Sue. Sue was very happy and thanked Tim. She felt warm and loved her new vest. Tim felt good because he had helped Sue. The moral of the story is that it is important to help others when they need it. Sharing and caring can make everyone happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim got a new toy. It was a big, red ball. He was so happy! He wanted to play with it outside. The sky was dark, but Tim did not care. He just wanted to play with his new ball. Tim went outside and started to bounce the ball. He was having so much fun. But then, he heard a loud sound. It was thunder! Tim was scared. He did not want to be outside with the thunder. He wanted his mom to make it go away. Tim ran inside to find his mom. She was in the kitchen. "Mom, there is thunder outside!" he said. His mom smiled and said, "Do not worry, Tim. Thunder can be a surprise, but it will not hurt you." Tim felt better. He went back outside and played with his ball. The thunder did not scare him anymore.

One day, a boy named Tim found a cone in the park. He picked it up and saw a small sack next to it. Tim was very happy and wanted to play with them. He went to his friend Sue's house and showed her the cone and sack. "Look, Sue! I found a cone and sack. Let's play with them!" Tim said. Sue was excited and they started to play a game. They took turns throwing the sack into the cone. While they were playing, the sack accidentally hit a little bird. The bird was hurt and looked sorry. Tim and Sue felt bad for the bird. They stopped playing and went to help the bird. Tim gently picked up the bird and said, "We are sorry, little bird. We didn't mean to hurt you." Sue found some food and water for the bird. They took care of the bird until it felt better. The bird thanked Tim and Sue and flew away. Tim and Sue were happy that they could help the bird and continued to play with the cone and sack, but more carefully this time.

Once upon a time, there was an old man. He had a tie that he loved a lot. The tie was very old too. The old man wore the tie every day. One day, the old man's friend asked him to wear a new tie. The old man refused. He loved his old tie too much. He did not want a new tie. The next day, the old man put on his old tie. But, something unexpected happened. The tie broke! The old man was very sad. He wished he had tried the new tie. Now, he had no tie to wear.

One day, a wide frog named Bob met a small ant named Ann. They were friends and liked to play together. Bob told Ann, "I can vanish! Do you want to see?" Ann was excited and said, "Yes, please show me!" Bob closed his eyes and thought hard. Then, with a big "poof", he vanished! Ann was so surprised that she dropped her food. She looked around but could not see Bob. She called out, "Bob, where are you? I miss you!" But there was no answer. Ann was sad and sat down on a big rock. She looked down and saw a tiny toe. It was Bob's toe! She touched it and Bob appeared again with a big smile. "You found me!" he said. Ann was happy to have her friend back. They laughed and played together for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable little girl who loved to eat waffles. Every morning, a generous waffle man would come to the girl's home to give her a big and delicious waffle. One day, the waffle man was running late, and the little girl flew into a temper. She crossed her arms and refused to surrender to the waiting. Fortunately, a wise old man could see the little girl's frustration, and he came up to her. He said to her, "My little friend, it is okay to be upset sometimes. But remember, surrendering to patience will bring you more good things than throwing a temper." The wise man's words touched the little girl's heart, and she decided to listen. The waffle man soon arrived, and the little girl shared her waffle with the old man as a thank you. Ever since then, the little girl always remembered to surrender to patience and be grateful for what she had. And this story reminds us that although tempers can be easy to express, surrendering to patience will always bring its own rewards.

Lila and Tom are playing in the park. They like to swing, slide and run. They see a big hill with grass and flowers. They want to climb it and see what is on the other side. "Come on, Tom, let's go!" Lila says. She grabs Tom's hand and they rush to the hill. They are fast and happy. They reach the top of the hill and look around. They see a pond with ducks and frogs. They see a tree with a nest and eggs. They see a fence with a sign that says "Do not enter". "What is behind the fence?" Tom asks. He is curious and brave. "I don't know, let's find out!" Lila says. She is adventurous and bold. They crawl under the fence and enter a new place. They see a lot of strange things. They see a pile of metal and wires. They see a box with buttons and lights. They see a tube with water and bubbles. They see a spike that is shiny and sharp. "Wow, this is cool!" Lila says. She touches the spike and feels a pain. She cries out loud. "Ouch, ouch, ouch! The spike hurt me!" Lila says. She holds her finger and bleeds. "Are you okay, Lila?" Tom says. He is worried and scared. "No, I'm not okay, Tom. The spike is bad. We need to go back!" Lila says. She is hurt and sad. They run back to the fence and crawl under it. They see a man with a coat and glasses. He is angry and stern. "Hey, you two, what are you doing here? This is a dangerous place. You are not allowed here. You could have been hurt badly. You are very naughty!" The man says. He shouts and points. "We are sorry, sir. We were just playing. We didn't know. We won't come back. Please don't be mad." Tom says. He is sorry and polite. Lila says nothing. She is still crying and bleeding. She needs a band-aid and a hug. They leave the fence and the man. They go back to the hill and the park. They find their mom and dad. They tell them what happened. They get a band-aid and a hug. They learn a lesson. They never go near the fence and the spike again. They play with other things that are safe and fun. They are flexible and smart. They are still fast and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly cat. The cat liked to walk all around the house. It walked on the floor, on the walls, and even on the ceiling! One day, the cat saw a big, red ball. It wanted to play with the ball. The cat walked on the ceiling to get closer to the ball. It was very fun for the cat to walk upside down. The cat played with the ball all day. It was very happy. At the end of the day, the cat walked back to its bed. It was tired but had a fun day playing with the ball.

Ben and Lily liked to play in the park. They liked to slide, swing, and run. But they did not like the big dog that sometimes came. The big dog was mean. He barked and chased them. He was a threat. One day, Ben and Lily saw the big dog again. He was not on a leash. He ran towards them. Ben and Lily were scared. They ran to the slide. They hoped the big dog would not follow them. But the big dog was fast. He jumped on the slide. He tried to bite Ben and Lily. Ben and Lily screamed. They slid down the slide. They looked for a place to hide. They saw a tent. The tent was near the slide. The tent was blue and yellow. It had a zip. Ben and Lily ran to the tent. They opened the zip. They went inside. They closed the zip. They waited. They heard the big dog outside. He sniffed and scratched. He wanted to get in. Ben and Lily hugged each other. They wished the big dog would go away. Then they heard a voice. The voice was kind. The voice said, "Hey, what are you doing in my tent?" Ben and Lily looked up. They saw a man. The man was tall and strong. He had a hat and a badge. He was a park ranger. The park ranger smiled. He said, "Don't be afraid. I'm here to help. I know the big dog. He is not mean. He is just playful. He likes to zip around the park. He does not know how to be gentle. I will teach him. Come on, let's go out and meet him." Ben and Lily were not sure. They were still scared. But they trusted the park ranger. He seemed kind. They opened the zip. They went out of the tent. The park ranger held the big dog. He said, "This is Rex. He is my friend. He is sorry for scaring you. He wants to say hello. Can you give him a pat?" He showed Ben and Lily how to pat the big dog. Ben and Lily were brave. They patted the big dog. The big dog licked their faces. He wagged his tail. He was not a threat. He was a friend. Ben and Lily smiled. They said, "Hello, Rex. We are Ben and Lily. We like to play in the park. Do you want to play with us?" Rex barked. He nodded. He wanted to play. The park ranger said, "That's great. I'm glad you made a new friend. But remember, always be careful around dogs you don't know. And always ask their owners before you touch them. OK?" Ben and Lily nodded. They said, "OK." They thanked the park ranger. They said goodbye to Rex. They went back to the slide. They had fun. They zipped down the slide. They laughed. They were happy.

One day, a big dog named Max went to the park. He saw an enormous ball and wanted to play with it. Max ran to the ball and started to play. He was very happy. Soon, a girl named Sue arrived at the park. Sue was carrying a bag. Inside the bag was a knife. Sue saw Max playing with the enormous ball and wanted to play too. She took out the knife to cut the ball into two pieces. Max saw Sue with the knife and got scared. He tried to stop her, but it was too late. Sue cut the ball with the knife. The enormous ball popped and was gone. Max was very sad and went home.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They had a lot of fun. But then Tom fell down and hurt his knee. He cried and cried. It was red and bleeding. Lily ran to him and said, "Don't cry, Tom. I will help you." She took a tissue from her pocket and wiped his knee. She said, "Look, it's not so bad. It will get better soon. You are very brave." Tom stopped crying and smiled. He said, "Thank you, Lily. You are very kind. Can we still play?" Lily nodded and said, "Yes, we can. But we have to be careful. We don't want to hurt ourselves again." They got up and walked to the swings. They saw a big dog running towards them. It was barking and wagging its tail. It looked very happy. Lily said, "Wow, look at that dog. It's so big and fluffy. Can we pet it?" Tom said, "I don't know. Maybe it's crazy. Maybe it will bite us." They were scared and hid behind the swings. The dog came closer and closer. It sniffed them and licked their faces. It was very friendly. Lily said, "Oh, it's not crazy. It's nice. It likes us." Tom said, "You're right. It's not crazy. It's cute. It wants to play." They came out from behind the swings and petted the dog. They threw a stick and the dog fetched it. They laughed and laughed. They had a lot of fun. They forgot about Tom's knee. They made a new friend. They learned that things can change. Sometimes they can be bad, but sometimes they can be good.

Once upon a time, there was a happy hunter named Tom. Tom liked to find and catch animals in the big woods. Every day, he would go out with his big dog, Spot, to look for animals to take home. One day, Tom and Spot saw a big rabbit. It was running very fast. Tom said, "Let's catch the rabbit, Spot!" They started to run after the rabbit. The rabbit saw them and began to run faster. Spot barked, and Tom laughed as they tried to catch it. As they ran, the rabbit's speed seemed to increase. Tom and Spot kept trying to catch up, but the rabbit was too fast. At last, Tom said, "Good try, Spot. Let's go home now." They walked back to their house, still happy because they had a fun day in the woods.

Once upon a time, there was a little brown dog named Max. Max loved to run and play outside. One day, Max saw a big white ball in the grass. He wanted to play with the ball. Max ran fast to the ball. But as he got close, he did not see a small rock. Max did stumble on the rock and fell down. He was sad and his leg hurt a little. Max's friend, a girl named Lily, saw him fall. She came over to help Max. She gave him a hug and helped him stand up. Max and Lily played with the white ball together. They had lots of fun and Max was happy again.

Once there was a poppy who wanted to study. The poppy was very brave and wanted to learn new things. So, every day the poppy studied hard. One day, while the poppy was studying, he saw something enormous! The enormous thing was so scary that the poppy decided to run away. He was scared and ran as fast as he could. But the enormous thing followed him, chasing him away. The poppy was running so fast that he didn't see an enormous cliff in front of him. He was too scared to stop and couldn't go around it. The cliff was so high and the poppy fell. The poppy's fall was so hard that he died. The end.

One day, a little girl named Mia was playing in her room. She liked to act and pretend she was someone else. Today, she wanted to act like a ghost. She found a white sheet and put it on her head. Mia said "Boo!" and laughed. Mia's little brother, Ben, saw her and thought it was interesting. He wanted to be a ghost too! So, Mia helped him find a white sheet and put it on his head. Now, they were both ghosts. They went around the house saying "Boo!" and scaring their toys. Mia and Ben had lots of fun acting like ghosts. Their mom and dad thought it was cute. They took pictures of their little ghosts and gave them hugs. Mia and Ben were happy they could be interesting ghosts together.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big tunnel and wanted to look inside. Tim walked to the tunnel and looked in. It was very dark, but he was not scared. As Tim walked in the tunnel, he heard a small cry. He looked around and saw a little cat. The cat looked sorry and sad. Tim wanted to help the cat, so he picked it up and walked out of the tunnel. When they got out of the tunnel, the cat started to glow! Tim was very surprised. The cat was not a normal cat, but a magic cat! The magic cat thanked Tim for helping and gave him a big hug. They became best friends and had lots of fun together.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to play in the park. She saw a small box on the ground. She picked it up and felt that it was very heavy. Mia thought, "I want to find out what is inside this box." Mia asked her friend Tom to help her open the box. Tom said, "This is a tough box to open. Let's find a big rock to break it." They looked around and found a big rock. They put the box on the ground and Tom hit it with the rock. The box broke open and they saw a lot of toys inside. Mia and Tom were very happy to find the toys. They played with them all day long. The heavy weight of the box had been a clue that there were many toys inside. Mia and Tom had a great day at the park with their new toys.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. He liked to sleep all day in his room. He did not like to play or run. Tom was not a happy cat. One day, a little girl named Sue came to visit Tom. Sue wanted to play with Tom, but he was too lazy. Sue tried to make Tom play by shouting, "Tom, come play with me!" But Tom did not want to play. Sue was sad and went outside to play by herself. Tom stayed in his room, still lazy. Sue found a big ball and started to play. The ball rolled into the street, and Sue ran after it. She did not see the big car coming. The car hit Sue, and she did not get up. Tom heard the noise and looked out the window. He saw Sue on the ground and knew he should have played with her. Now, Tom was a very sad cat.

Once upon a time, there was a strong bear named Ben. Ben lived in a big forest with his friends. They liked to play together every day. One day, Ben got sick. He felt hot and did not want to play. Ben's friend, a wise owl, had a thermometer. Owl put the thermometer in Ben's mouth to check if he was too hot. All the friends stared at the thermometer, waiting to see what it would say. They hoped Ben would be okay. The thermometer showed that Ben was very hot. Owl knew just what to do. He gave Ben some cold water to drink and a cool cloth to put on his head. Soon, Ben felt better. He was strong enough to play with his friends again. They all had a great time, and Ben was happy to be healthy and strong.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to watch videos on the big TV. His favorite video was about a big, strong dog who could protect everyone in the town. The dog's name was Max. One day, it was a mild and sunny day outside, so Tim went to play in the park. He wished that he could have a dog like Max to play with and protect him. While he was playing, he saw a small puppy all alone. The puppy looked sad and lost. Tim decided to take the puppy home and protect it, just like Max in the video. He named the puppy Max, too. Tim and little Max became best friends, and they watched the big, strong Max video together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big event in the park. Many kids and moms and dads were there. They played games, ate food, and had fun. The sun was shining, and everyone felt comfortable and happy. There was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted to play a game with a big ball. But Lucy was too small to play with the big kids. Her mom said, "Let's find a game just for you." Lucy felt sad, but she knew her mom would find something fun for her. Then, Lucy and her mom found a game with small balls. Lucy was so happy! She played the game and won a prize. She knew that being small was okay because she found a game just for her. And the big event in the park was fun for everyone.

Once upon a time, in a small village, a boy named Tim found a cold potato on the ground. He did not know where the potato came from, but he decided to take it home. He showed his mom the potato, and she told him that they could cook it for dinner. That night, Tim's family ate the potato for dinner. While they were eating, they discovered that there was something special about this cold potato. It made them feel very happy and warm inside. They all smiled and laughed together, and their hearts felt full of joy. The next day, Tim and his family decided to share their happiness with the other people in the village. They gave each person a small piece of the special potato. Soon, the whole village was filled with happiness and laughter. The people learned that sharing can bring joy to everyone. And in that small village, they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim went outside to play. The sky was dark and the wind was strong. Tim saw a big tornado coming. He was scared and started to scream, "Mommy, help!" His mommy heard him and ran outside. She saw the tornado too. "Tim, come inside now!" she yelled. They both went inside their house. The house was safe and strong. After the tornado passed, they went outside again. The yard was empty and messy. They started to clean up together. Tim was happy to be safe with his mommy. They hugged each other and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a creative otter named Ollie. Ollie loved to play and make things. One day, Ollie found a big stick near the water. He had an idea to make something fun with the stick. Ollie worked all day with the stick. He put small rocks and leaves on it. He was very happy with his work. Ollie showed his friends what he made. They all liked it and wanted to play with Ollie's stick too. In the end, Ollie and his friends played a fun game with the stick. They threw the stick and tried to catch it with their mouths. They all had a great time. Ollie was happy he could make something fun for his friends to play with.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack who loved flowers. He spent his days picking them from his garden and putting them in a jar by his window. One day Jack's sister saw the flowers and wanted to play with them, but Jack said no. He wanted to keep them safe. His sister was sad and said she wanted to help. So Jack let her come into the garden and pick one flower to make into a necklace. She was so happy! The next day, Jack's sister wanted to go back into the garden and pick more flowers. Jack said no, because he wanted to keep his flowers safe. But his sister was stubborn and kept teasing him to let her pick more. Jack finally said yes, but he said she must be careful and not pick any of the important flowers. So she agreed. She picked lots of flowers and made a beautiful necklace. From then on, Jack and his sister visited the garden together to pick flowers. No matter how much his sister teased him, Jack always made sure to keep the important flowers safe.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Amy. Amy wanted to help her Mommy, but she couldn't do anything too big. One day, Mommy said, “Amy, will you help me cut the lawn?” Amy was so excited. She ran outside to the lawn and grabbed the cutting tool. She tried to be strong and moved it up and down. But it was too hard for Amy. Mommy came over and said, “Amy, do not worry. I will help you.” Amy smiled. Mommy showed Amy how to use the tool in a normal way. And then, Amy tried again. Finally, after some time, the lawn was cut. Amy was very proud of herself and hugged Mommy. “Good job, Amy!” said Mommy. The End.

One day, a flea named Tim hopped on a big dog. The dog's name was Max. Tim and Max were friends. Tim liked to make Max laugh. Max liked to run and play with Tim. One day, Max jumped into a deep puddle. Splash! Tim was wet, but he still wanted to make Max laugh. So, Tim said, "Max, look at me! I can swim too!" Max laughed and laughed. Just then, a big fish jumped out of the deep puddle! The fish said, "Hello, I am Finn. I heard you laugh and I want to play too!" Tim, Max, and Finn played all day. They had fun and made new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old dog named Spot. Spot was very good at helping his friends. One day, a big party was happening in the park. All the animals were there to play games and eat yummy food. Spot wanted to help his friends have fun, so he decided to serve them drinks. "Here, have some juice," Spot said to his friend, Bunny. Bunny was very happy and said, "Thank you, Spot! You are very wise and kind." At the party, there was a big race. All the animals wanted to win the race because there was a prize for the winner. The prize was a big, shiny gold bone. Spot and Bunny both wanted to win the prize, so they ran very fast. But then, something unexpected happened! A little bird flew down and took the prize away. All the animals were shocked and didn't know what to do. Spot, being wise, said, "Don't worry, friends. We can still have fun without the prize. Let's all dance and play together!" All the animals agreed and had lots of fun at the party. They learned that the best prize was being together and having a good time.

Once upon a time, there was a little radish. The radish lived in a big garden with many other plants. The radish was worried because it was not yet big enough to bloom. One day, the sun came out and the rain fell down. The radish felt happy because it knew that sun and rain would help it grow. It wanted to bloom and be as pretty as the other plants in the garden. After many days of sun and rain, the little radish finally started to grow. It grew bigger and bigger until one day, it bloomed! The radish was so happy and not worried anymore. It was now a beautiful part of the big garden, just like all the other plants.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved strawberries. One day, she saw a big, red strawberry in her garden. She was very happy. Lily wanted more strawberries, so she asked her reliable friend, the big brown bear, to help her. The big brown bear said, "We can work together to grow more strawberries." They both worked hard every day. They dug the ground, planted seeds, and gave water to the plants. Soon, the garden was full of sweet, red strawberries. Lily and the big brown bear were so happy. They shared the strawberries with their friends. Everyone loved the strawberries. The moral of the story is that when we work together with reliable friends, we can make good things happen.

Once upon a time, there was a raven who liked to hop. Every day, he'd hop from tree to tree, from one side of the forest to the other. One day, he saw a group of strange birds, who didn't hop. Curious, he flew over and spoke to them. “What are you doing?” the raven asked. “We’re walking, this is the normal way to move,” the birds replied. So the raven joined them, walking alongside them, but he found it difficult and difficult to keep up. Finally, he stopped and spoke again. “I think I like hopping better,” he said. The birds laughed. “But hopping isn’t normal!” they said. The raven smiled and said, “Maybe not, but just because it isn’t normal, doesn’t mean it isn’t right. We should all find our own way to do things, even if it’s different to what everyone else does.” And so the raven returned to hopping happily through the forest, knowing that it was ok to be different. The moral of the story is that it is ok to be different and we should be brave enough to choose our own paths, even if they go against the norm.

Sylvia was a very glad little girl. She loved to go to the store. Every day, her parents bought her nice things, like ice cream and toys. One day, Sylvia went to the store with her family. But then she got lost and couldn't find them. Sylvia was scared and started to cry. She looked around but her parents were nowhere. Just then she saw a nice lady. "Where are your parents?" asked the lady. "I don't know. I can't find them," answered Sylvia. The lady smiled and told her, "It's okay, I will help you find them." The lady and Sylvia looked everywhere, but her parents seemed to have vanished. Finally, they found them at the back of the store. Sylvia's parents were so glad to see her safe. But then they got mad - they had called and called for her, but Sylvia had ignored them! Sylvia felt a bit scared, but the lady said, "It's okay, everyone makes mistakes sometimes." Sylvia was so glad to be with her family again! From then on, she always listened to them and never ignored them again.

Lily had a big dog named Rex. Rex was very strong and liked to run and play. Lily loved Rex, but Rex was bad sometimes. He would bark at people and cats and chase them. He would dig holes in the garden and make a mess. He would pull on his leash and make Lily fall. One day, Lily's mom said, "Rex is too bad. We need to get him a chain. A chain will keep him in the yard and stop him from being bad." Lily did not like this idea. She did not want Rex to have a chain. She wanted Rex to be free and happy. She said, "No, mom, please don't get Rex a chain. Rex is not bad, he is just playful. He needs to run and play and have fun. A chain will make him sad and angry. Please let Rex be free." Lily's mom said, "I'm sorry, Lily, but Rex is too big and too strong for you. He could hurt someone or get hurt himself. A chain is for his own good. He will still have food and water and toys and love. He will just have to stay in the yard." Lily was very sad. She did not want to own Rex with a chain. She wanted to own Rex with love. She hugged Rex and said, "I'm sorry, Rex. I love you very much. I wish you could be free. Maybe someday you will learn to be good and not need a chain." Rex licked her face and wagged his tail. He did not understand what a chain was, but he understood that Lily loved him. He loved her too.

Once upon a time, there was a bear called Barry. One day, Barry decided he wanted to go for a walk, but as soon as he stepped outside, he couldn't go any further. A wall had been built in his path and he was so small, he just couldn't fit through. Barry was feeling very uncomfortable, he didn't understand why this wall was blocking his way. He remembered seeing a rabbit nearby earlier, so he called out to her, “Rabbit, do you know why there’s a wall here?” The rabbit hopped up to him and said, “Barry, sometimes people build walls to separate us, but it's important to be kind to one another and keep an open mind. Otherwise, no one will be able to fit through.” Barry thought about the rabbit’s words and the moral of her story. He was determined to find a way to make everyone fit. He worked together with his friends and they managed to build a bridge. Now everyone could cross over and on the other side, everyone could fit and be happy. The end.

One day, a large dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a small house with a blue door. Max was very curious and wanted to see what was inside. Max knocked on the door. A kind lady opened it and said, "Hello, Max! I am making a big order of toys for the kids. Do you want to help me?" Max was very happy and said, "Yes, I would love to help!" So, Max and the lady started to put toys in a big box. While they were working, Max needed to use the toilet. He asked the lady, "Can I use your toilet, please?" The lady said, "Of course, it's right there." Max went inside the toilet and saw something very strange. There was a big, shiny button on the wall. Max was curious and pressed the button. Suddenly, the toilet turned into a big slide! Max slid down and landed in a room full of toys! The lady came in and said, "Wow, Max! You found my secret toy room! Now we can add more toys to our order!" Max was very happy and they both had a fun day playing with the toys.

Once upon a time, in a normal town, there lived a dragon. The dragon was very big and liked to play with the kids. One day, the dragon went to the park to play ball with his friend, Tim. As they played, the dragon saw a big box. The dragon said, "Tim, let's open the box!" Tim nodded and they both opened the box together. Inside the box, they found many colorful balls. Just then, the balls started to jump and dance! The dragon and Tim were so surprised. They played with the dancing balls and had lots of fun. All the other kids came to see the magic balls and joined in the fun. At the end of the day, the dragon and Tim learned that sharing is good. They shared the magic balls with everyone and made many new friends. The whole town was very happy, and they all played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little caterpillar named Bounce. Bounce was very scared because he had to climb the tallest tree in the forest. He was sure he could never do it. But then a brave bird came by and said to Bounce, "Let me help you fly up the tree!" Bounce took a deep breath and said yes. With the help of the brave bird, Bounce soared to the very top of the tree. Once at the top, Bounce felt a great sense of victory! He had done what he thought was impossible. He shouted for joy and flew back down to the ground. The other caterpillars were so happy for Bounce. They were not scared anymore, knowing that Bounce could do it, they could too! And they all flew up the tree, ready to find their own victory.

One day, a little bird was in its nest in a tree. It started to rain. The bird felt helpless because it could not fly yet. It wanted to find a place to stay dry. The bird noticed a big leaf nearby. "Can I stay under your leaf to stay dry?" the bird asked the leaf. The leaf said, "Yes, come under me. You will stay dry here." The rain stopped after a while. The bird said, "Thank you, leaf, for keeping me dry." The leaf was happy to help the little bird. They became friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. He was excited to go on a trip. The boy asked his mom to let him go. She agreed and said yes. The boy was so happy that he started packing for the trip. He couldn't wait to go. When he was almost ready to leave, he realised that the trip was something unusual. He was a little bit scared, but he knew he wanted to go. He took a deep breath, waved goodbye to his mom, and let himself go. But unfortunately, the trip was not what the boy expected. Instead of a fun adventure, he found himself in danger. In the end, the boy sadly never came back.

Once upon a time there was a small bird. He liked to fly across the sky and was always happy. One day he saw a big towel lying on the ground. He thought it looked nice and flew down to take a closer look. When he got close he saw the towel was covering something. He moved the towel and was shocked to see a cat lying there. The bird said to the cat, "Why are you so tired?" The cat replied, "I was chasing a mouse but it was too fast!" The bird said, "Let me help you!" and grabbed the towel and started to fly up into the sky. But the cat was too heavy and the bird couldn't fly high enough. The bird grew tired and the food started to come down lower and lower until finally, they both crashed to the ground and the bird was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a jeep. The jeep was unusual. It drove really fast and it made loud sounds. One day, a boy wanted to play with the jeep. He climbed inside and he saw a big, shiny button. When he pressed the button, the jeep began to change. It made all kinds of new, exciting sounds. Big things popped out of the sides and the windows flipped open. Then the boy noticed that the jeep was getting bigger. Soon the boy was sitting inside a big machine. It had huge tires and was much bigger than the jeep! The machine had replaced the jeep. The boy smiled and he drove away in the new machine. He couldn't believe how unusual it was! He had the best day ever.

One day, a sweet little boy named Tom found a helmet. It was big and shiny. Tom was very happy. He took the helmet and ran to show his friend, Sue. "Look, Sue! I found a helmet!" Tom said. Sue looked at the helmet and smiled. "Wow, Tom! That's a big helmet!" Sue said. They both laughed and played with the helmet all day long. As the sun began to set, Tom and Sue were very tired. They lay down on the grass to rest. They put the helmet on the ground next to them. Soon, they fell asleep. While they were sleeping, a mean man saw the helmet. He wanted it for himself. He took the helmet and ran away. When Tom and Sue woke up, the helmet was gone. They were very sad. They looked for the helmet, but they could not find it. The mean man had taken their helmet, and they never saw it again.

Once there was a little toddler called Emma. She loved to paint and make things bright and full of colour. One day Emma went to the store to buy some paint. She pointed to the different colours, but she was getting very weak from standing for too long. So Emma's mom scooped her up in her arms and said "Don't worry princess, we will get the paint later". Emma wasn't sure what to do, so she started to cry. But her mom told her "Don't worry, sweetheart. We will get some paint soon and make lovely pictures together." Emma brightened up right away. She knew that soon she would have lots of lovely bright colours to paint with.

Once upon a time, there was a little kitten named Fluffy. Fluffy lived in a big house with a kind family. Fluffy was very excited to play with the family every day. One day, Fluffy found a toy. It was a ball with a string. Fluffy liked to shake the toy with her paw. The ball would jump and bounce. Fluffy was so happy to play with the toy. Fluffy's family saw her play with the toy. They laughed and clapped. They loved to see Fluffy so excited. They played with Fluffy and the toy all day. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. Anna loved to play with her toy cars. One day, she got a new toy car. She was very happy. Anna wanted to complete a stage with her new toy car. She asked her friend, Tom, to play with her. "Tom, can you help me finish this stage?" Anna said. Tom said, "Yes, I can help you!" But, there was a problem. A big cat was in the way of their stage. The cat would not move. Anna and Tom tried to make the cat go away, but the cat did not listen. They were sad. Then, Anna had an idea. She gave the cat a toy to play with. The cat liked the toy and moved away. Anna and Tom were happy. They completed the stage with their toy cars and had lots of fun.

One day, a boy named Tim and his friend, a talking frog named Fred, went to the river to play. They saw a big raft. The raft was broken. Tim and Fred wanted to fix the raft so they could float on the river. Tim said, "Let's speak to my dad. He can help us fix the raft." They went to Tim's dad and asked for help. Tim's dad gave them some wood and glue. They took the wood and glue to the raft and fixed it. Tim and Fred were happy. They jumped on the raft and started to float down the river. Suddenly, the raft started to speak! It said, "Thank you for fixing me! I am a magic raft." Tim and Fred were very surprised, but they made a new friend that day. They all floated down the river together, laughing and having fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a pretty brown dress that she loved to wear. She wore it every day and it made her very happy. One day, while playing outside, Lily's brown dress got a big tear. She was very sad and didn't know what to do. Her mom saw her crying and asked her what was wrong. Lily showed her the tear in her pretty brown dress. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. I can restore your dress and make it like new again." Lily smiled and gave her mom the dress. Her mom fixed the tear and gave the dress back to Lily. Lily put on her restored brown dress and danced around, happy once again.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat named Tom. Tom loved to step and jump in the sun. One day, he found a pair of sunglasses on the ground. He put them on and thought he looked very cool. Tom walked to his friend, a little dog named Tim. Tim saw Tom and said, "Wow, your sunglasses are nice!" Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, I like them too!" Later, Tom and Tim went to a party. At the party, they ate delicious cake and danced together. They had so much fun with their friends. At the end of the day, Tom and Tim went home, tired but happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Bob. Bob loved to eat carrots. One day, he found a big carrot in the garden. "Wow, this is the biggest carrot I have ever seen!" said Bob. Bob wanted to show his friends the important carrot. But when he turned around, he saw a big hole. Bob's friend, Tim the turtle, had fallen in. Tim was scared and said, "Help me, Bob! I can't get out!" Bob knew he had to rescue Tim. Bob put the important carrot down and thought hard. Then, he had a great idea. He put the big carrot over the hole, so Tim could climb out. Tim was so happy and said, "Thank you, Bob! You saved me!" The friends hugged and shared the big carrot together. And from that day on, they knew that helping a friend was more important than any carrot.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a pretty dress with flowers on it. Lucy loved her dress very much. One day, Lucy went to a party with her mommy and daddy. At the party, Lucy saw a big table with lots of food. She noticed a plate full of yummy cookies. Lucy loved cookies, so she asked her mommy if she could have one. Her mommy said yes, and Lucy took a cookie from the plate. Lucy ate the cookie and it was very tasty. She smiled and said thank you to her mommy. Then, Lucy played with her friends at the party. They all had a fun time, and Lucy was happy she got to eat a cookie from the pretty plate.

One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to make a yummy pastry. She put flour, sugar, and butter in a big bowl. She started to stir them all together. Lily was so excited to taste the yummy pastry when it was done. Lily put the pastry in the oven to bake. She waited and waited. Then, something unexpected happened! The oven started to shake and make loud noises. Lily was scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, the oven door opened and out came a talking pastry! The pastry said, "Hi, I'm Patty the Pastry! I'm here to be your friend!" Lily was surprised but happy. She and Patty the Pastry played all day and had lots of fun. In the end, Lily didn't eat the yummy pastry, but she made a new friend.

Jen and Sam were bored. They did not like the gloomy day. The sky was gray and the rain was loud. They wanted to go outside and play, but Mom said no. "Can we do something fun?" Jen asked Mom. Mom smiled and said, "How about we go to a restaurant? We can have pizza and ice cream. Does that sound good?" Jen and Sam cheered. They loved pizza and ice cream. They put on their coats and shoes and followed Mom to the car. At the restaurant, they saw a big menu with pictures of food. Mom let them choose what they wanted. "I want cheese pizza and chocolate ice cream," Jen said. "I want pepperoni pizza and vanilla ice cream," Sam said. Mom said, "I want salad and coffee. And I want to include some breadsticks for us to share." The waiter brought their food and drinks. Jen and Sam ate their pizza and ice cream. They were happy and full. They thanked Mom for the treat. Mom said, "You're welcome, my sweeties. I'm glad you enjoyed it. Sometimes a gloomy day can turn into a fun day."

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there was a wise old owl. The owl loved to sit in a circle of trees and chew on leaves. One sunny day, the owl was chewing on a leaf when he saw a small mouse. The mouse was running and playing near the circle of trees. The wise old owl watched the mouse and thought, "I can catch the mouse and eat it." So, the owl flew down to the ground and tried to catch the mouse. But the mouse was too fast! The owl could not catch the mouse. The mouse stopped running and looked at the owl. "Why are you trying to catch me?" the mouse asked. The wise old owl thought for a moment, and then said, "I wanted to eat you, but you are too fast. Let's be friends instead." And so, the owl and the mouse became the best of friends, and they played together in the circle of trees every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little white dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his toy hammer. One sunny day, he went outside to play with his hammer. Spot saw his friend, a big cat named Fluffy. Fluffy had a toy hammer too! Spot said, "Hey Fluffy, let's match our hammers and play together!" Fluffy agreed, and they started to play. As they were playing, a big bird flew down and took Spot's hammer. Spot and Fluffy were so surprised! They looked at each other and said, "Let's get our hammers back!" They chased the bird together and got both hammers back. Spot and Fluffy were happy and continued to play with their matching hammers.

Tom and Lily are twins. They like to play in the garden. They see a big green plant with red fruits. They are strawberries. Tom and Lily love strawberries. They run to the plant. Tom picks a big red strawberry. He bites it. It is sweet and juicy. He smiles. He picks another one. He gives it to Lily. Lily looks at the strawberry. She sees a green spot on it. She does not like green spots. She thinks they are yucky. She shakes her head. She disagrees with Tom. She does not want the strawberry. Tom does not understand. He thinks the green spot is okay. He tries to make Lily take the strawberry. He says it is good. He pushes it to her mouth. Lily does not like that. She pushes Tom away. She says it is bad. She runs to the other side of the plant. She looks for a strawberry without a green spot. Tom is angry. He thinks Lily is silly. He follows her. He wants to show her that all the strawberries are good. He picks another one. He does not see the green spot on it. He bites it. It is sour and bitter. He makes a face. He spits it out. He feels something on his tongue. He looks at the strawberry. He sees a green worm on it. He screams. He drops the strawberry. Lily hears Tom scream. She turns around. She sees the green worm on the ground. She feels sorry for Tom. She runs to him. She hugs him. She says she is sorry. She says she will share her strawberry with him. She picks a big red strawberry without a green spot. She breaks it in half. She gives one half to Tom. Tom smiles. He says thank you. He says he is sorry too. He says he will not disagree with Lily again. They eat the strawberry. It is sweet and juicy. They are happy. They pick more strawberries. They do not see any more green worms. They are careful. They have fun.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw an enormous slide that looked like a rainbow. They wanted to try it, but there was a long line of children waiting for their turn. "Let's hurry and get in line," Lily said. "Maybe we can go twice before we have to go home." Ben nodded and they ran to the end of the line. They waited and waited, but the line moved very slowly. Some children took a long time to slide down, and some wanted to go again and again. Lily and Ben started to feel bored and angry. They wished the other children would hurry up and let them have a turn. They began to complain and whine. "Why are they so slow?" Lily said. "They are not fair. They should let us go first." "Yeah, they are mean," Ben said. "We should push them and make them move." They were about to do that, when they heard a voice behind them. "Excuse me, can I please join the line?" the voice said. They turned around and saw a little girl in a wheelchair. She had a big smile on her face and a wonder in her eyes. She looked at the slide with excitement and hope. Lily and Ben felt ashamed. They realized how selfish and rude they had been. They saw that the little girl had a harder life than them, but she was still happy and polite. They felt sorry for her and wanted to help her. "Of course you can," Lily said. "Here, you can go in front of us. We don't mind." "Thank you, that's very kind of you," the little girl said. "You are very nice." Lily and Ben smiled and moved aside. They watched as the little girl was lifted by her dad and slid down the slide. She laughed and cheered and had a lot of fun. Lily and Ben felt happy for her. They learned that sharing and caring was more important than hurrying and getting. They decided to be more patient and respectful to the other children. They also decided to be more grateful and joyful for what they had. They finally got their turn to slide down the rainbow. They enjoyed it, but they also enjoyed seeing the little girl's happiness. They made a new friend that day, and they learned a valuable lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a little oyster. The oyster lived in the sea, but it wanted to build a home on the dry land. So, the oyster went to the beach to find a nice place to build its home. The oyster found a spot near the water and started to build. It used sand and little rocks to make a small house. The house was dry and cozy. The oyster was very happy with its new home. One day, a big wave came and washed the oyster's house away. The oyster was sad, but it knew it could build a new home. So, it went back to the sea and started to build again. This time, the oyster built a stronger house, and it was happy again.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play in the garden. One day, they saw a big orange pumpkin growing on a vine. They ran to it and touched it with their hands. "Wow, look at this pumpkin!" Lily said. "It is so big and round!" "Yes, it is!" Tom agreed. "But it is also ugly. It has bumps and spots on it. And look at its stem. It is brown and dry." Lily frowned. She did not think the pumpkin was ugly. She thought it was beautiful and special. She wanted to keep it and make it into a lantern for Halloween. "No, it is not ugly," she said. "It is different and nice. I like it. I want to take it home and carve it." Tom shook his head. He did not want to take the ugly pumpkin home. He wanted to find a better one. He looked around the garden and saw another pumpkin on the other side. It was smaller and smoother than the first one. It had no bumps or spots. And its stem was green and fresh. "Look, Lily, there is another pumpkin!" he said. "It is much prettier than this one. Let's take that one instead." He ran to the other pumpkin and tried to pull it off the vine. But it was too hard. He could not move it. "Help me, Lily!" he called. "This pumpkin is stuck!" Lily did not move. She stayed with the first pumpkin and hugged it. She did not want to help Tom. She did not want the other pumpkin. She only wanted the one she had. "No, Tom," she said. "I do not want that pumpkin. I want this one. It is my pumpkin. I know it is the best pumpkin in the world."

One day, a little dog named Tim went to a music store. He wanted to find a new music to dance to. Tim was very impatient. He looked at all the CDs on the shelf. A nice lady worked at the store. She saw Tim looking at the CDs. She asked, "Can I help you find something?" Tim said, "I want to dance to new music. What do you recommend?" The nice lady thought for a moment and said, "I recommend jazz. It is fun to dance to." Tim got a jazz CD and went home. He put the CD in the player and started to dance. He was so happy! The jazz music made him feel excited. From that day on, Tim loved to dance to jazz music.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful bird named Lily. Lily loved to fly high in the sky and play with her friends. One day, while playing, she saw something shiny on the ground. It was a bar of soap! Lily flew down to the soap and called her friend, Max the squirrel. "Max, look at this!" she said. Max came running and looked at the soap. "What is it?" he asked. Lily didn't know, but she thought it was special. Max had an idea. "Let's leave the soap by the big tree and see if someone knows what it is," he said. Lily agreed, and they both took the soap to the big tree. Soon, their friend Bella the bunny hopped by and saw the soap. "That's soap!" she said. "We can use it to clean our hands and faces!" Lily and Max were happy to learn about the soap, and they all took turns using it. From that day on, they always felt clean and fresh after playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck. He was the happiest duck in the whole pond. He was always in a good mood and saw the best in everything. One day, the little duck heard a loud noise. He looked around and saw a newspaper. It was lying on the ground and not moving. The little duck thought it might be asleep, so he gently held it with his wings. But as soon as he touched it, he knew something was wrong. The paper was dead! The little duck felt sad. He thought about things like kindness and caring and he realized that his happiness doesn't come from things like newspapers, but from the good feelings inside him. This is the moral of the story: it's better to share kindness and caring than to hold onto dead things.

Once upon a time, there was a large tree. It was so big, everyone could see it. The tree had a lovely view of the whole town. Many birds lived in the tree. They felt like they belong there. One day, a big wind came. It blew very hard. The birds were scared. They flew away to find a safe place. The wind was so strong that it did something unexpected. It pushed the large tree over. The next day, the birds came back. They saw the large tree on the ground. They were sad. But then, they saw something special. Where the tree fell, there was a new view. The birds could see the beautiful river. They felt happy again. They knew they still belong here, even with the new view.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a big, fluffy cat named Tom. One day, Sue and Tom went to the park to play. While they were playing, they saw a big man with a harsh face. The man walked over and said, "Hello, little girl. Can I sit with you and your cat?" Sue looked at Tom and said, "Yes, you can sit with us." After sitting down, the man's face became less harsh. He smiled and said, "Thank you for letting me sit with you. I am not used to playing with little girls and cats." Sue and Tom smiled back at the man. They all played together and became good friends. And the man's face was never harsh again.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to play with her mom's jewelry. One day, she asked her mom, "Can I borrow your jewelry, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful." Amy put on the pretty jewelry and went to play outside. While playing, she met a dog. The dog looked bad and angry. The bad dog saw the shiny jewelry and wanted it. Amy got scared and ran back to her house. She told her mom about the bad dog. Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm glad you're safe. Let's put the jewelry away now." Amy learned to be careful when she borrowed things and to stay away from bad dogs.

Lila and Sam were playing in the park. They liked to run, jump and slide on the grass and the swings. But it was very hot and sunny. They felt thirsty and tired. "Let's find some water and shade," Sam said. "I'm so hot and thirsty." "Me too," Lila said. "But where can we find water and shade?" They looked around and saw a big fountain in the middle of the park. It had water that sprayed up and down. It also had some trees and benches around it. "Look, Sam, a fountain!" Lila said. "Maybe we can drink some water and sit under the trees." "Good idea, Lila," Sam said. "Let's go to the fountain." They ran to the fountain and drank some water from the tap. It was cool and refreshing. They felt better. Then they found a bench under a big tree. It was shady and breezy. They felt relaxed. "Ah, this is nice," Sam said. "This is like an oasis in the park." "An oasis?" Lila asked. "What is that?" "An oasis is a place with water and plants in the desert," Sam explained. "It is a good place to rest and relax when you are hot and tired." "I like that word, oasis," Lila said. "It sounds pretty and calm." They smiled at each other and lay down on the bench. They closed their eyes and listened to the water and the birds. They were not nervous anymore. They were happy and relaxed. They had found their oasis in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Pup. Pup lived in a big, rich house with a nice family. They loved Pup very much and played with him all day. One sunny day, Pup went to the park with his family. They played catch with a small, red ball. Pup loved to run and catch the ball in his mouth. He was very good at it. After a fun day at the park, Pup and his family went back to their rich house. They were all very happy. Pup knew he was a lucky puppy to have such a loving family. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a big, hairy bull was in a field. He was very happy. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. The bull liked to play with his friends. A little boy named Tim came to the field. He saw the bull and said, "Hello, Mr. Bull! Do you want to play with me?" The bull nodded his head and said, "Yes, I would like to play." Tim picked up a stick and began to play with the bull. They played a game where Tim would strike the stick on the ground, and the bull would run to it. They had so much fun together. As the sun began to set, Tim said, "I have to go home now, Mr. Bull. But I will come back to play with you again." The bull was sad to see his new friend go, but he knew they would play again soon. And so, Tim and the hairy bull became best friends. They played together every day, and they were always happy when they were together.

One day, a little girl named Mia found a weird triangle toy in her room. She didn't know where it came from, but she liked it. The triangle had a big smile and two big eyes. Mia played with the triangle all day long. At night, when Mia went to bed, she put the triangle next to her pillow. She closed her eyes and went to sleep. In the middle of the night, she heard a noise. Mia woke up and saw the triangle was moving. It was dancing and jumping on her bed. Mia was happy and laughed. She played with the triangle for a little while. Then, they both went back to sleep. The next morning, when Mia woke up, the triangle was still next to her. She smiled and knew they would have more fun days together.

Once upon a time, there was a sheep. The sheep had lots of wool. The wool was white and soft. But one day, the sheep got very dirty. It rolled in the mud. Its wool became filthy. The sheep wanted to be clean again. It tried to wash its wool. It went to the water. The sheep tried and tried. It did not succeed at first. The sheep was sad. Then, a friend came. The friend was a duck. The duck helped the sheep. They worked together. The sheep and the duck tried hard. At last, they succeed. The sheep's wool was clean again. The sheep was happy.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sally found a magic jelly in her kitchen. The jelly was clean and shiny. Sally's mom said, "Be careful, that jelly can make things shrink!" One day, Sally's big brother Tom was being mean. He took her toy bear and put it on a high shelf. Sally was sad and couldn't reach her toy. Then, she remembered the magic jelly. Sally put some jelly on her toy bear. The bear began to shrink! It became so small that it fell off the high shelf. Sally picked up her tiny bear and said, "Now, you are small like me!" Tom saw what happened and said, "I'm sorry, Sally. I didn't mean to be mean." Sally forgave Tom, and they played together with the tiny bear. From that day on, they were always kind to each other. And the magic jelly helped them remember to be nice.

Sara and Ben are playing in the living room. They have many toys and books on the floor. Sara likes to read the books and Ben likes to build with the blocks. They are having fun. "Look, Sara, I made a tower!" Ben says. He shows Sara his tower of blocks. It is very tall and colorful. "Wow, Ben, that is a great tower!" Sara says. She claps her hands. She wants to show Ben her book. It is a book about animals. She likes animals. She looks for her book on the floor, but she cannot find it. She thinks maybe it is on the shelf. The shelf is high on the wall. She cannot reach it. She needs a chair. She sees a chair near the shelf. She is careless. She does not ask Ben or Mommy for help. She moves the chair to the shelf. She climbs on the chair. She tries to get her book. But the shelf is not strong. It is old and broken. When Sara touches the shelf, it falls down. It makes a loud noise. It makes a big mess. Books and toys and dust are everywhere. Sara and Ben are scared. They notice Mommy running to the living room. She sees the shelf and the chair and the mess. She is angry and worried. "Sara, Ben, what happened?" Mommy says. "Are you okay? Why did you do this?" Sara and Ben are sorry. They did not mean to break the shelf. They did not know it was broken. They just wanted to play. "We are sorry, Mommy," Sara and Ben say. "We were playing. Sara wanted her book. She was careless. She climbed on the chair. The shelf fell down." Mommy hugs Sara and Ben. She is glad they are not hurt. She tells them to be careful next time. She tells them to ask for help when they need it. She tells them to clean up the mess. Sara and Ben nod. They help Mommy clean up the mess. They put the books and toys back in their places. They say sorry to the shelf. They hope it can be fixed. They learn their lesson.

David and his mommy were at the airport. David liked to slide at the airport, and he thought it was very fun. He was very creative and he liked to make up games as he slid around. Mommy said to David, "It is time to slide, let's go!" David said excitedly, "Yay!" and he started to slide. He went very quickly and he laughed the whole time. He went around and around until he was very tired. Mommy said, "Time to go home, David!" and he said, "OK!" David was very happy. He had had a very creative day sliding around the airport.

Tim liked his hat very much. It was red and had a big star on it. He wore it every day when he went to play outside. He felt happy and proud with his hat. One day, he met a big boy who was mean. The big boy saw Tim's hat and wanted it. He ran to Tim and grabbed his hat. He said, "This is my hat now. You have a baby hat. Go away!" Tim was scared and sad.
