The hens were shocked. The baby duck said, "Quack, quack!" The big hen was sad at first. But then, she decided to raise the baby duck as her own. The other hens were not jealous anymore. They all loved the baby duck and played together.

Billy was sitting outside looking at the view. The sky was a dull gray color. He noticed a strange shape in the distance. He squinted his eyes and furrowed his brow. He leaned forward and was surprised to see a squirrel. Billy jumped up and said, "Hello, Mr. Squirrel! What are you doing here?" The squirrel looked up and frowned. He said, "I am looking for some tasty nuts, but it looks like they are not here. I am so sad." Billy felt sad too. He wanted to help the squirrel. "Come with me," he said. "I know where you can find some nuts!" He grabbed the squirrel by the tail and led him away. After searching for a while, they found a tree with a big pile of gray nuts at the bottom. Billy smiled and said, "Here you go, Mr. Squirrel!" The squirrel smiled back and said, "Thank you very much, Billy! You are a true friend!" Billy beamed with joy as he watched the squirrel start eating the nuts.

One day, a little girl named Amy wanted to bake a cake. She put on her apron and went to the kitchen. Amy opened the refrigerator and took out eggs, milk, and butter. She was very alert, making sure she had everything she needed. Amy mixed all the ingredients in a big bowl. She asked her mom, "Can you help me put the cake in the oven?" Her mom said, "Of course, Amy! Let's bake the cake together." After the cake was baked, Amy took it out of the oven with her mom's help. They let the cake cool down and then put it in the refrigerator. Amy was so excited to share the cake with her family. They all enjoyed the yummy cake and were very proud of her.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a friendly dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his ball and run in the park. He had many friends in the town who liked to play with him too. One day, while Spot was playing in the park, he saw something shiny on the ground. It was a big diamond! Spot picked it up with his mouth and started to look for someone who could help him find where it came from. As Spot walked through the town, he saw a little girl crying. She had lost her diamond and didn't know where to find it. Spot knew he had to rescue the girl's diamond. So, he walked up to her and dropped the diamond at her feet. The little girl was so happy that she hugged Spot and thanked him. From that day on, Spot and the little girl became best friends and played together every day.

One day, a little girl named Amy was very tired. She woke up late and missed her breakfast. Her tummy was making noises because she was hungry. She went to the kitchen and saw her mom making toast. "Mom, can I have some toast, please?" asked Amy. Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, my dear. I know you missed breakfast, so I am making toast just for you." Amy was so happy. She sat at the table and waited for her toast. Her mom gave her a plate with two yummy pieces of toast. They were warm and smelled so good. Amy ate her toast and felt better. She was not tired anymore. After eating, Amy and her mom went outside to play. They had lots of fun together in the sun. Amy was glad she had the toast and that she didn't miss any more fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named True. She had a big heart and always took care to help others. One day, she found a small, lost dog in her yard. The dog was very sad and hungry. True wanted to make the dog happy, so she gave it some food and water. This was an easy thing for her to do. The next day, True's friend, Sam, saw the dog and wanted to take it home. But True did not want to give the dog away. She cared for the dog and wanted to keep it safe. Sam got mad and they both started to cry. True's mom heard the crying and came to see what was wrong. She listened to both True and Sam. Then she said, "Why don't we all care for the dog together?" True and Sam liked this idea. It was an easy way to solve the problem. They all took care of the dog and became the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a small girl called Annie. She was only three years old and full of joy. Every day she would take out her black scooter and perform amazing tricks with it. One day, as she rode around her neighbourhood, something strange happened. Annie spotted a giant black bird with a shiny silver beak. It was perched atop an old can. Annie wanted badly to talk to the bird, so she stopped her scooter and went over to it. The bird said: “If you perform a dangerous trick on your scooter, I will grant you the greatest wish of your life.” Annie decided to take the bird up on its offer and started to practice. She was getting closer and closer to completing her dangerous trick. But just as Annie was about to finish, the can that the bird was perched on started to wobble. The bird flew away and Annie crashed her scooter. She was terribly hurt and had to go to the hospital. The moral of the story is: Never take risks with your safety because they can come with very bad consequences. Think before you act.

Once upon a time, there was a pig. His name was Oink and he was looking for something special. One regular day, Oink heard a sound, “Mmmm! What’s that smell?” Oink began to follow the smell until he arrived at a big house. He knocked on the door and heard an old voice say, “Who’s there?” Oink replied, “It’s me, Oink!” The door opened, and there stood an old man and an old lady. They said, “Come in Oink! Have some of our special snacks!” Oink was so excited that he ate all of the snacks, and then the old man said, “Follow me. I'm going to show you something.” The old man and Oink arrived at the barn, and inside was a giant pig-sty. The old man said, “This is for you Oink! You can stay here and have regular meals each day. You are now part of our family!” Oink smiled and jumped for joy. He snuggled into the hay and was so happy that he finally found a place to call home.

One day, a boy named Tim saw that the toilet was broken. He wanted to repair it. He asked his dad, "Dad, can you help me fix the toilet?" His dad said, "Yes, Tim. Let's repair the toilet together." So, they went to the toilet and started to fix it. They used tools like a big wrench and a small screwdriver. Tim felt warm and happy because he was helping his dad. After they repaired the toilet, Tim's mom came in and said, "Wow! Good job, Tim and Dad! The toilet looks like new!" Tim smiled and said, "Thanks, Mom! I learned how to repair a toilet today!" And they all lived happily in their warm home with their fixed toilet.

Billy was a gifted boy. He was smart and always believed in himself. One day, his teacher decided to give the class a quiz. Everyone was excited, except for Billy. He was afraid that he wouldn't do well. He asked his friends to help him. They offered to support him and they even gave him the answers. Billy felt better and began to answer the quiz. Unfortunately, Billy got all the answers wrong. His friends couldn't believe it. Billy was embarrassed and ashamed. He realized that he had relied too much on his friends to support him. When the teacher saw the result, she was very disappointed. She knew that Billy was very talented but he didn't trust in himself. Billy had failed in the quiz and it was a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a wild bird who lived in a tree. The bird had a neighbor, a small squirrel. They were good friends and played together every day. One day, the bird saw some big, red berries on a bush. The bird wanted to eat the berries to become big and strong. The bird told the squirrel about the berries. The squirrel said, "No, don't eat them! They will make you increase too much!" But the bird did not listen. The bird ate the berries and started to increase in size. The bird grew bigger and bigger until it could no longer fit in the tree. The squirrel was sad and scared for its friend. Then, something unexpected happened! The bird's big wings began to shrink back to their normal size. The bird realized that the squirrel was right, and it should not have eaten the berries. The bird and the squirrel learned a lesson and promised to always listen to each other. And they lived happily ever after, playing together in their tree.

Once upon a time there was a red crane. He was standing in a pond and wanted to take a bath. He said to the bunny who was hopping nearby, "Can you help me take a bath?" The bunny replied, "I can help you with bathing, but I won't be able to reach in the pond with you." The crane thought for a while and then said, "Ok, I will climb onto your back, then you can hop around in the pond." The bunny nodded and the crane hopped onto his back. They slowly hopped around the pond. The water splashed all around them as the bunny hopped and the crane enjoyed his bath. After a while, the bunny stopped and said, "Ok, you can get off now, you are all clean." The crane thanked the bunny and hopped off. He was thankful for the bunny's help and was feeling refreshed after his bath. He took off, flying away as red as a ruby.

Lily and Sam were twins who liked to play with their toys. They had many toys, but their favorite ones were the modern trains that could move by themselves. They had a big track that they could set up in different ways. One day, they wanted to play with the trains, but they had a problem. They both wanted the same train, the red one that made a loud sound. They started to fight over it, pulling and pushing and shouting. "Give me the train, it's mine!" Lily said. "No, it's mine, I saw it first!" Sam said. Their mom heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. She saw the twins fighting and the track broken. She was not happy. "Stop it, both of you!" she said. "Why are you fighting over one train? You have many other trains to play with. And look, you ruined the track. Now you can't play at all." Lily and Sam felt ashamed. They knew their mom was right. They had been selfish and mean. They said sorry to each other and to their mom. They decided to share the red train and take turns. They also fixed the track and made it even better than before. They played nicely with the trains for the rest of the day. They had more fun when they were kind and fair. They learned that sharing is caring and that fighting is not good. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a princess named Lily. She lived in a big castle with her family. She had a friend named Tom. Tom was foolish, but he was always around to help. One day, Princess Lily lost her toy. She was very sad. Tom wanted to help her find it. They looked everywhere together. They looked under the bed, behind the chair, and in the garden. But they could not find the toy. Finally, Tom found the toy in the kitchen. "Look, Lily! I found your toy!" he said. Princess Lily was so happy. She said, "Thank you, Tom!" But foolish Tom dropped the toy into a big pot of soup by accident. The toy was gone forever. Princess Lily was sad again, and Tom felt very bad for what he did.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot was a very smart dog. He lived in a big lab with his friend, a kind scientist named Dr. Tim. One day, Dr. Tim needed to complete a special project. He asked Spot for help. "Spot, can you help me complete my work?" Spot barked happily and wagged his tail. He wanted to help his friend. Dr. Tim and Spot worked hard in the lab. When they finished, Dr. Tim gave Spot a delicious treat. Spot gobbled it up and licked his lips. They were both happy and proud of their work.

Once upon a time, there was a bee called Buzz. Buzz had a pot of honey. People thought the honey was very sweet and tasty. But Buzz did not want to share the honey. He would only have it for himself. People felt sad for Buzz and wanted him to be happy. One day, Buzz met a little girl. The girl began to weep. Buzz asked why she was crying. She said that she was sad because she had nothing sweet to eat. Buzz felt so sorry for the girl. He decided to share the honey with her. The girl was so pleased and impressed. She thanked Buzz and shared the tasty honey together. Buzz learned how good it felt to share with others. He found out that being generous and kind is much more impressive than keeping things for himself.

Once there was a town with a river running through it. The river was fragile and glittered in the sun. One day, the towns people found a little girl sitting by the river. She was smiling and looking around with curiosity. They asked her what she was doing and she said, "I'm looking for my mommy." The towns people were very sad and asked her what her mother looked like. The little girl showed them a picture of her mom and asked if they had seen her. Just then, the wind blew and the little girl's hair fluttered in the breeze. Suddenly, a woman appeared across the river and called out, "That's my daughter!" The towns people smiled and said, "It looks like you've found each other!" The little girl smiled and ran over the fragile bridge to give her mommy the biggest hug. They were so happy to be together again. The towns people were filled with joy to see them reunited. From then on, they hugged each other every day under the bridge and everyone in the town smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little blue bird. The blue bird had a tiny egg in her nest. She loved her egg very much. One day, the blue bird saw her egg start to change. She was so happy! Her egg was going to be a baby bird soon. She watched the egg change more and more each day. At last, the egg changed into a cute baby bird. The baby bird was blue, just like her mom. They were so happy together. They sang and played in their nest every day. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a pet dog named Max. Max was very intelligent. Tim and Max loved to play together every day. One day, Tim found a big box. He wanted Max to fit inside the box. He said, "Max, can you fit in this box?" Max looked at the box and wagged his tail. He tried to fit in the box, but he was too big. Tim was sad because Max could not fit. Just then, Max had an idea. He ran away and came back with a smaller box. Max put the smaller box inside the big box. Then, Max fit inside the smaller box! Tim was so happy and said, "Max, you are so intelligent!" They both laughed and played all day with their new boxes.

One day, a boy and his mom went to the park. The boy saw a big, hairy dog. The dog was playing with a ball. The boy wanted to play with the dog, so he asked his mom. Mom said yes. The boy and the hairy dog played for a long time. They had so much fun. Then, the boy's mom told him it was time to go home. The boy was sad, but he said bye to the hairy dog. As they walked home, the boy's mom told him a secret. She said, "That hairy dog is yours now!" The boy was so happy. The hairy dog was his new friend. Now they can play at the park every day.

Once, there were two friends, Jenny and Tony. They lived in the same big house, but in different rooms. Neither of them had any other friends and they were feeling very lonely. One day, Jenny and Tony decided to unite. They thought it would be fun to be together. So they decided to meet in the kitchen. When they got to the kitchen, they couldn't believe their eyes. It was full of fun things - toys, games, and treats! They both smiled and hugged each other. Jenny and Tony had so much fun in the kitchen together. They laughed, played games, and shared snacks. They were both so happy - they weren't lonely anymore! They stayed in the kitchen until it was dark outside, and then they said goodbye until next time. Every day, they would come back to the kitchen and unite. They were never lonely again!

Once upon a time, there was a little player named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy truck. One day, he wanted to see how much his toy truck could carry. So, he decided to weigh it with some rocks. "Let's see how useful my truck is," Tim said to his friend, Sue. They put one rock on the truck, then two rocks, then three rocks. The truck was carrying the rocks just fine. But then, something unexpected happened. A tiny mouse came and jumped on the truck too! The truck started to move on its own, carrying the rocks and the mouse. Tim and Sue were so surprised and laughed. The little mouse had made their truck even more useful than they thought.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Max and Jack. They were jolly and always excited to go on adventures together. One day, Max and Jack decided to explore outside. As they searched, Max suddenly realized he had lost his will for traveling. He stopped to think and sadly told Jack, “I don’t have my will to go on.” But Jack was confident. He smiled and said, “Don’t worry, Max. I know you can find it again.” Max thought. He thought hard and soon he realized something - he had his will inside him all along! He cheered and called out, “Jack! I found my will again!” Jack was so jolly to see Max so happy. He clapped his hands and shouted, “Let’s keep exploring!” And so, the two friends went on with their travels, full of will and joy.

Once upon a time, there was a baby named Tim. Tim was a confused baby. He didn't know where his toy was. He looked around the room, but he couldn't find it. Tim was sad. One day, Tim's mom said they had to go to the store. Tim didn't want to go. He wanted to find his toy. Tim tried to delay going to the store. He cried and cried, but his mom said they had to go now. At the store, Tim saw a big box. His mom opened the box, and guess what? Tim's toy was inside! Tim was so happy. He didn't know how his toy got there, but he didn't care. Now Tim and his toy could play together again.

Lily and Tom were playing with their toy boats in the pond. They liked to sail them and watch them go fast. Lily had a red boat and Tom had a blue boat. "Look, my boat is faster than yours!" Tom said to Lily. "No, it's not! My boat is faster and prettier!" Lily said back. They raced their boats across the pond, but then they saw a big duck. The duck was ugly and mean. It had a long neck and a big beak. It saw the boats and wanted to bite them. "Quack, quack, quack!" The duck said. It swam towards the boats and tried to catch them. "Oh no, the duck is going to eat our boats!" Lily cried. "What can we do?" Tom asked. Lily had an idea. She saw some bread on the bench. She ran to get it and threw it to the other side of the pond. "Hey, duck, look! There is some bread for you!" Lily shouted. The duck heard Lily and saw the bread. It forgot about the boats and swam to get the bread. "Quack, quack, quack!" The duck said happily. It ate the bread and left the boats alone. Lily and Tom were glad. They got their boats back and sailed them again. "Good idea, Lily! You saved our boats!" Tom said. "Thank you, Tom! You are a good friend!" Lily said. They smiled and hugged. They had fun playing with their boats and the pond.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a box. The box was little and blue. Sue liked to play with her box. One day, Sue saw a crab. The crab was by the box. Sue wanted to play with the crab. But the crab was scared. The crab pinched Sue's finger. Sue was sad. Sue's mom came and gave her a hug. She told Sue to be careful. The crab did not want to hurt Sue. Sue said sorry to the crab. The crab went away. Sue played with her box and was happy again.

One day, a little girl named Sue wanted to bake a cake for her friend Tom. She was so excited! She went to the kitchen and put all the things she needed on the table. But she was ignorant about how to bake a cake. She had never done it before. Sue went to her big sister, Amy, and asked, "Can you help me bake a cake for Tom?" Amy smiled and said, "Of course, Sue. Let's do it together!" They went to the kitchen and started baking the cake. They mixed flour, sugar, eggs, and milk in a big bowl. While the cake was baking in the oven, they went outside to play. They saw a lumber truck drive by. The lumber was big and long. Sue and Amy watched the truck go down the street. When they went back inside, the cake was ready. They took it out of the oven and let it cool. Then, they put icing on the cake and wrote "Happy day, Tom!" on it. Sue was so happy she got to bake a cake for her friend!

Once upon a time, there was a big, huge tree. In the tree, there was a little bird. The bird could speak. It spoke to all the animals in the forest. The bird was very happy. One day, the little bird wanted to have a big party. It told all the animals to come. The animals were happy and excited. The little bird wanted the party to be a big success. The day of the party came. All the animals were there, but something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew the huge tree down. All the animals were scared. But then, a big, strong elephant came. The elephant put the huge tree back up. The little bird and all the animals were very happy. The party was a big success, and they all danced and played together.

Once upon a time, there was a popular girl named Jane. Jane liked to design things. She loved to draw and make new things. One day, she went for a walk in the woods. She saw many trees, flowers, and mushrooms. Jane saw a big mushroom. It was red and white. She thought it was pretty. She wanted to design a picture of the mushroom. So, she sat down and started to draw the mushroom on her paper. As Jane was drawing, something unexpected happened. The mushroom began to grow bigger and bigger! Jane was so surprised. Then, the mushroom started to talk! It said, "Thank you for drawing me. I am now a magic mushroom!" Jane and the magic mushroom became good friends, and they had many fun adventures together.

Once upon a time there were two teams, a red team and a blue team. Tom, who was part of the red team, wanted to show how kind he was. So he asked the blue team if he could help them to mark their papers. The blue team were very happy and accepted his help. Tom smiled, he was so happy to be able to help them. Tom said “I’m so glad to be part of a kind team.” The blue team smiled and thanked him. Tom then happily marked the papers for the blue team. The blue team were so glad to have help and they were so happy to be part of a kind and helpful team. The red and blue teams were happy and had never felt so united.

One day, a boy named Tim found a pen on the floor. He was very proud of his new pen. He showed it to his mom and dad. They were happy for Tim. Tim went to the park to play with his friends. He saw a girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her pen. Tim felt bad for Sue. He thought about what to do. Tim decided to give Sue the pen he found. He knelt down and gave it to her. Sue was very happy and said thank you. Tim felt good about helping his friend. The twist is that Tim made a new friend and learned that sharing is good.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. Tom liked to go for walks in the park. One day, the wind was blowing strong. Tom felt cold on his head. Tom met a friend, Sue. Sue said, "I recommend you wear a hat. It will keep your head warm." Tom thought that was a good idea. He said, "Thank you, Sue. I will get a hat." The next day, Tom got a hat. He wore it to the park. The wind blew again, but Tom's head was warm. Tom was happy. He thanked Sue again for her help. And they played in the park together, warm and happy.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his friends. They played with the toys available to them, like balls and dolls. The village was a happy place for all the children. One day, a new boy, Sam, came to the village. Sam was shy and didn't have many friends. Tim saw Sam and wanted to be his friend. But some other kids started to tease Sam. They laughed and pointed at him because he was new. Tim did not like that the other kids were teasing Sam. He wanted to help Sam feel better. So, Tim went to Sam and asked him to play with him. Together, they played with the available toys and had lots of fun. Soon, the other kids saw how much fun Tim and Sam were having and they stopped teasing Sam. They all became friends and played happily in the village.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One day, he saw a big piece of ice on the ground. He felt the ice and said, "Wow, this is very cold!" Tim had a friend named Sam. Sam was a little ignorant and did not know what ice was. Tim wanted to help Sam learn about ice. Tim said, "Sam, come feel this ice. It is very cold!" Sam touched the ice and said, "Wow, you are right! It is very cold!" From that day on, Sam learned that ice is cold and he should be careful when playing with it. Tim was happy that he could help his friend. The moral of the story is that we should always help our friends learn new things, even if they are ignorant.

Once upon a time, in a peaceful little town, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to decorate her room with pretty things. One sunny day, Lily found a big box of colors and paper. She was so happy and excited to make her room even more beautiful. Lily started to cut and glue the paper on her walls. She made flowers, stars, and even a big sun. Her room looked so bright and fun. Lily saw her shadow on the wall, and she had an idea. She wanted to decorate her shadow too. Lily took a blue color and drew a big hat on her shadow's head. Then, she took a red color and drew a big smile on her shadow's face. Her shadow looked so funny and happy. Lily laughed and danced with her new friend. They played together all day long in her pretty, peaceful room.

One day, a gifted boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He loved to play on the swings and slide down the big slide. Tim was very good at running and jumping, so he liked to exercise every day. While at the park, Tim saw a girl named Sue who was sad. He asked Sue, "Why are you sad?" Sue said, "I can't run and jump like you. I wish I could." Tim thought for a moment and said, "Let's pray together. Maybe it will help you run and jump too." So, Tim and Sue prayed together at the park. Suddenly, Sue started to run and jump just like Tim! They were both so happy and played together all day. The unexpected thing was that Sue was not only able to run and jump, but she became even better than Tim! The moral of the story is that when we pray and help others, good things can happen.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a grumpy cat named Tom. Tom did not like to play with other animals. He wanted peace and quiet all the time. One day, a little bird named Sally came to the town. She saw Tom sitting alone and wanted to be his friend. Sally went to Tom and said, "Let's play together!" Tom got mad and said, "No! Go away!" Sally felt sad but she made a promise to herself that she would make Tom her friend. The next day, Sally tried again. This time, she brought a toy for Tom. Tom saw the toy and started playing with it. Soon, he was not grumpy anymore. Tom and Sally played together and became good friends. Tom learned that having friends was fun, and he promised to be nice to others. From that day on, there was peace and happiness in the small town.

Once upon a time, in a land full of colors, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to wear her yellow dress. One day, Lily saw a clean, white bunny hopping in her backyard. She wanted to play with the bunny, so she decided to follow it. As Lily followed the bunny, they came across a big, dirty puddle. The bunny hopped over it, but Lily was scared to jump. She did not want to make her yellow dress dirty. Then, a helpful bird flew down and told Lily, "If you help clean the puddle, your dress will stay clean, and you can keep following the bunny." Lily thought it was a great idea. She found a big stick and moved the dirt away from the puddle. The water became clean, and she could walk around it without getting her yellow dress dirty. Lily thanked the bird and continued to follow the bunny. They played together all day long. In the end, Lily learned that by helping to clean the world around her, she could keep her things clean and enjoy her time with her new bunny friend. And that was the day Lily learned the importance of keeping the world clean and taking care of the environment.

Once upon a time, there was a unique duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to splash in the water. One day, Ducky saw a stage near the pond. The stage was big and had many colors. Ducky went to the stage and saw other animals there. A big dog named Doggy was on stage. Doggy said, "I can jump high!" Ducky wanted to be on stage too. Ducky thought, "I can splash big!" So, Ducky went on stage and said, "I can splash big!" Doggy did not like that. Doggy said, "No, I am the best!" Ducky was sad but did not give up. Ducky knew a big splash was coming. The next day, Ducky went to the stage again. This time, Ducky made a big splash. All the animals saw the big splash and clapped. Doggy saw the big splash too. Doggy said, "Wow, you are good too!" Ducky and Doggy became friends and played together on the stage. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a big pie on a table. Tim was very hungry. He wanted to eat the pie, but it was not his. Tim felt impatient. He saw a girl named Sue near the table. Tim asked, "Can I have some pie?" Sue smiled and said, "Yes, you can have a small piece." Tim and Sue ate the pie together. They were happy and full. After eating, they continued to walk and play. They became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a big toy box filled with many toys. One day, she found a small, fragile doll in her toy box. The doll was made of cloth and had a tiny iron heart inside. Mia loved her new doll very much. She played with it all day and all night. One day, while playing, Mia accidentally tore the doll's arm. She was very sad and didn't know what to do. Mia's mommy saw her crying and asked her what was wrong. Mia showed her mommy the torn doll. Her mommy smiled and said, "Don't worry, Mia. I can fix it." She took the doll and sewed its arm back on. Mia was so happy! She hugged her mommy and thanked her. From that day on, Mia took extra care of her fragile doll and they lived happily ever after.

One day, a friendly dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a little girl with a cone. The cone had ice cream on top. Max wanted some ice cream too. Max walked up to the girl and said, "Can I have some ice cream, please?" The girl was happy to share her ice cream with Max. But as she gave him a lick, a big wind came and blew the cone out of her hand. The cone went slap on the ground. Max and the girl were sad. They did not know what to do. Then, a nice man came by with more cones. He said, "Don't be sad, I have more ice cream for you both!" Max and the girl were so happy. They thanked the man and enjoyed their new ice cream cones together. The day turned out to be a great day after all.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys. He had many toys, but his most popular toy was a big red ball. Tim liked to play with his ball all day long. He would throw it, kick it, and even bounce it on the furniture. One day, Tim was playing with his red ball inside the house. He was not allowed to play with it near the furniture, but he did it anyway. While playing, he accidentally broke a chair. Tim was very sad and scared that his mom would be angry. Just then, something unexpected happened. The chair started to talk! The chair said, "Don't worry, Tim. I know you didn't mean to break me. Let's play together and fix me." Tim and the chair worked together to fix the broken leg. After that, they played with the red ball and had lots of fun. Tim learned the importance of being careful, and he made a new friend in the talking chair.

Once upon a time, there was a unique cat named Bob. Bob was not like other cats. He liked to help his friends get better when they were sick. Bob was a patient cat who wanted to improve the lives of his friends. One day, Bob's friend, a little bird named Sue, was not feeling well. Sue said, "Bob, I don't feel good. Can you help me improve?" Bob thought for a moment and said, "Yes, Sue. I will be patient and help you feel better." Bob and Sue tried many things to help Sue feel better. They tried resting, eating yummy food, and drinking water. But nothing seemed to work. Sue was still not feeling well. Bob started to feel sad because he could not help his friend. But then, he had an idea. "Sue, let's try singing a happy song. Maybe that will help you feel better." Sue and Bob sang the happy song together. Slowly, Sue started to feel better. The happy song had worked! Bob was so happy that he could help his friend improve. From that day on, Bob and Sue knew that their unique friendship could help them face any problem.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Amy had a violin. She loved to play it every day. One day, she saw a fair in her town. She wanted to play her violin at the fair. Amy went to the fair and asked a man, "Can I play my violin here?" The man said, "Yes, you can play on the stage." Amy was so happy. She went on the stage and played her violin. Everyone clapped and cheered for her. But then, something unexpected happened. The sky turned dark and it started to rain. Amy was sad because she couldn't play her violin in the rain. She went home and prayed, "Please, let the rain stop so I can play my violin at the fair again." The next day, the rain stopped and the sun came out. Amy went back to the fair and played her violin. Everyone was so happy to hear her play again.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He had a big, open bag to take his toys with him. In the bag, he had a red plastic ball and a small plastic car. When they got to the park, Tim was very excited to play. As Tim was playing, a little girl named Sue came over. She said, "Can I play with your red ball?" Tim said, "Yes, you can play with my ball." So, Tim and Sue played with the red plastic ball and had lots of fun. Suddenly, a big dog came running over. The dog took the red plastic ball in its mouth and ran away! Tim and Sue were very surprised. They looked at each other and then ran after the dog. They chased the dog all around the park until the dog dropped the ball. Tim and Sue picked up the ball, laughed, and went back to playing together.

Frank was at the park with his parents. His dad was pushing a swing and his mom was talking to a neighbour. Frank was so happy and started to dance. He was twirling around and singing. Suddenly, Frank heard a snap. He stopped dancing and looked around. He saw an ugly creature standing next to him. "Boo!" it shouted. Frank screamed and ran away. The creature ran after him. Frank's parents called out his name, but Frank didn't stop. He ran and ran until he couldn't run anymore. He tripped and fell. When he looked back, the ugly creature was right behind him. "Boo!" it shouted again. Frank was so scared that he flew up into the sky and flew away. His parents never saw him again.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat bread with thick butter. One day, she went to the kitchen to get some butter. But oh no! The butter was all gone. Lily asked her mom, "Mom, where is the butter?" Her mom said, "Lily, we need to save money, so we didn't buy more butter." Lily was sad, but she had an idea. Lily went to her friend, Tim, who lived on a farm. She said, "Tim, can you help me save some butter?" Tim said, "Yes, Lily! We can make butter from our cow's milk." They worked together to make thick butter. Lily was happy, and she shared the butter with her family. From that day on, Lily and Tim saved butter together.

Once upon a time, there was a brave cow. He lived on a farm. One day the farmer said to the cow "I want you to raise your head". The cow was scared, but he was brave so he raised his head. The farmer smiled and said "Good job, you are so helpful". He brought out a bucket full of yummy food and said "It's all for you, brave cow". The cow ate it all up and was very happy. The next day, the same thing happened. The farmer said "Raise your head" and so the brave cow did. But this time the farmer had a big surprise. He had made a special shelter for the cow, so he could stay safe and warm. The brave cow was so happy. He thanked the farmer for being so kind. From then on, the brave cow and the farmer were good friends. Every day the cow would raise his head in anticipation, ready for whatever surprise the farmer had for him.

Ben loves to look at the stars at night. He wonders what is out there, far away. He asks his mom to tell him stories about the planets. Mom says there are many planets, and some are big and some are small, and some are hot and some are cold. One night, Ben has a dream. He is in a big rocket with his mom and dad. They are going to visit a planet. The rocket goes up, up, up, and Ben feels excited. He looks out the window and sees the Earth. It is blue and green and white, and it looks like a ball. He waves goodbye to the Earth. The rocket flies for a long time, and then it lands on a planet. The planet is red and dusty, and it has big mountains and rocks. Ben puts on a special suit and a helmet, and he goes out with his mom and dad. They walk around and explore. Ben sees a small rock that looks shiny. He wants to take it home. He tries to lift it, but it is very heavy. He asks his dad to help him. Dad says the planet has more pull than the Earth, so things are harder to lift. He helps Ben lift the rock and put it in a bag. Ben is happy. He has a souvenir from the planet. He thinks the planet is cool, but he misses the Earth. He likes the Earth better, because it is warm and has water and plants and animals. He tells his mom and dad he is ready to go back. They agree. They get in the rocket and blast off. They fly back to the Earth, and Ben sees it again. It looks bigger and brighter than before. He smiles and hugs his mom and dad. He can't wait to tell his friends about his dream.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his shiny, clean coin. One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his coin. The sun was shining bright in the sky. Tim liked how the sun made his coin shine even more. At the park, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue saw Tim's shiny coin and said, "Wow, your coin is so shiny and clean! Can I play with it too?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, you can play with my coin. Let's play together!" Tim and Sue played with the shiny, clean coin all day. They took turns tossing the coin and watching it shine in the sun. They had so much fun playing together. When it was time to go home, Tim and Sue said goodbye. Tim was happy that he made a new friend and shared his shiny, clean coin with her.

One day, two friends, Benny and Max, were walking in the woods. It was already dark, so Benny felt a bit scared. Then Max said, “Let me introduce you to something that can help.” He showed Benny his chubby little flashlight. “What’s this?” Asked Benny. “This is a flashlight. It helps you see when it's dark,” Max said. Benny felt much better with the flashlight, and Max showed Benny how to switch it on and off. Later that night, Benny took his flashlight and went for a walk in the woods. Everything seemed so much less scary in the light. Max and Benny became good friends, and Benny was thankful for Max introducing him to the flashlight. Benny learned that, no matter how scary it is, it’s always good to get help and to be brave.

Once upon a time, there was a big ranch. On the ranch, there were many animals. They all liked to work together. One day, a new animal came to the ranch. It was a big, original bird. The bird was not like the other animals. The bird said, "Hi, I want to work with you." The other animals looked at the bird. They did not know what to do. They had never seen a bird like this before. The bird tried to help the animals work. But, the bird was not good at the work. The other animals were sad. Then, something unexpected happened. The bird started to sing. The music made the animals happy. The animals learned that everyone can help in their own way.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy prince named Tim. He never wanted to do anything. He just liked to lay in bed all day. One day, a bird came to Tim's window. The bird said, "Prince Tim, come with me! Let's soar high in the sky together!" Tim looked at the bird and thought, "Maybe I should try something new." Tim went outside and the bird helped him soar high in the sky. They flew over the trees and the houses. Tim felt so happy and free! When they came back down, Tim said, "Thank you, bird! I had so much fun!" The bird smiled and said, "You're welcome, Prince Tim. Remember, life is more fun when you try new things!" From that day on, Prince Tim was not lazy anymore. He learned that trying new things can be fun and exciting. And he lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim was eager to play outside. He put on his big coat, hat, and gloves. He opened the door and saw a beautiful sight. The sun was shining, and the snow was sparkling. Tim saw a big snowman in his yard. He ran to it and started to play. He threw snowballs and danced around. Then, he decided to play a game. He would freeze like a statue and then jump and shout. His mom came outside to watch. She laughed as Tim played his game. He would freeze and then jump high in the air. Tim was having so much fun in the cold snow. And the sight of his happy face made his mom smile too.

Once upon a time, in a normal house, a little girl named Mia loved to eat dinner. Every day, her mom made yummy food for her. Mia's favorite dinner was spaghetti. She loved it so much! One day, Mia came home and saw her mom was not there. Her dad said, "I will make dinner today." Mia was a little bit worried because her dad never made dinner before. But she thought it would be fun to try something new. When dinner was ready, Mia saw something strange on her plate. It was not spaghetti. It was something green! Mia was scared, but she tried the green food. To her surprise, it was very yummy! She loved it! Mia learned that trying new things can be fun and yummy too.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly pot. It lived in a big kitchen with other pots and pans. The smelly pot was sad because it was dirty and no one wanted to use it. One day, a little girl named Lily came into the kitchen. She saw the smelly pot and said, "Why are you so smelly, pot?" The pot replied, "I am smelly because I am dirty and no one wants to use me." Lily felt sad for the pot and decided to help it. Lily got some soap and water and started to clean the smelly pot. After she was done, the pot was shiny and clean. Lily said, "Now you are not smelly anymore!" The pot was very happy. Lily then organized all the pots and pans in the kitchen. The smelly pot was now a clean and happy pot, and it became Lily's favorite pot to use when she cooked.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and loved playing outside. Every day, Lucy would take her trail-walking around her neighborhood. She was always so excited to explore the trails and find new things. One day, while Lucy was out on her trail-walking, she stopped to admire a perfect rainbow. She had never seen one so bright and vivid before. She was mesmerized by it and wanted to stay there to enjoy it for as long as she could. Then, her mom called out to her. “Lucy,” she said. “It's time to go home now.” Lucy didn't want to leave, so she asked her mom, “Why do I have to go home? I love the rainbow! I think it is the most valuable thing in the whole world.” Her mom smiled and said, “That may be true, but you need to remember to value yourself too. You're just as valuable as the rainbow.” So, Lucy and her mom went home, but Lucy never forgot what her mom said. She was happy to learn that she too was perfect and valuable. And she promised herself to always remember that.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He lived in a small house with a modest yard. Tim loved to play with his red ball in the yard every day. One sunny day, Tim went outside to play with his ball. He threw the ball high up in the air and it came down, striking the ground with a soft thud. Tim laughed and clapped his hands. Just then, his friend Sue came over. She saw Tim playing and asked, "Can I play too?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, let's play together!" They took turns striking the ball and had lots of fun in the modest yard.

John likes to go outside and explore. One day, John wandered far from home and spotted a big, modern house. He was curious, and peeked inside. Inside he saw a cozy room with a big chair in the middle. He then heard a voice. It was coming from the chair and he saw a lady sitting there. She said, "Hello, little one. What brings you here?" John was shy, so he didn't answer out loud. He just smiled and pointed to the window. He wanted to show her the puddle outside. The lady smiled. She said, "I don't mind if you sit in my chair and watch the puddle. Here, you can have a seat." John happily climbed up into the chair and watched the puddle. He loved all the shiny, colorful pieces of it. The lady smiled and watched him. Soon, John's mom came and found him. She said, "John, there you are! Come on home now." John waved goodbye as he followed his mom home. He had a great adventure that day!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was an ordinary square. The square was very plain and had nothing on it. One day, a little boy named Timmy walked by the square with his mom. "Mom, can we decorate the square?" asked Timmy. His mom smiled and said, "Yes, let's make it pretty and fun!" So, Timmy and his mom went to their home and got some colorful paint, brushes, and paper. They went back to the square and started to decorate it. They painted pretty flowers, trees, and animals on the ground. They also hung up the paper on the trees around the square. Soon, other kids and their moms and dads came to help. They all worked together to make the ordinary square look special and happy. Everyone in the town loved the new, decorated square. It became a fun place for kids to play and for families to have picnics. From that day on, the square was not ordinary anymore. It was a beautiful and happy place for everyone to enjoy. And Timmy was very proud of what he and his mom started.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it. Sometimes the ball went too far and they had to look for it in the grass or behind the trees. One time, the ball went over the fence and into the road. Lily and Tom ran to the fence and saw a big car coming. They were scared and wanted their ball back. They did not see the sign that said "Stop". "Tom, we have to get the ball!" Lily said. "No, Lily, it is too dangerous!" Tom said. But Lily did not listen. She climbed over the fence and ran to the road. She did not look left or right. She only saw the ball. The man in the car saw Lily and tried to stop. He pushed the brake hard and honked the horn loud. But it was too late. The car was too fast and Lily was too small. The car hit Lily and made a loud noise. Tom saw what happened and started to cry. He panicked and did not know what to do. He wanted to help Lily but he was afraid of the car and the road. He shouted for help but no one heard him. The man in the car got out and saw Lily on the ground. He was very sad and sorry. He called for help too but it was too late. Lily was not moving or breathing. She was gone. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She lived with her mom, dad, and her aunt. Mia loved her aunt very much. She was grateful for her aunt because she always played with her and made her laugh. One sunny day, Mia's aunt took her to the park. They played on the swings and the slide. Mia asked her aunt if she could play in the sand. Her aunt said, "I permit you to play in the sand, but be careful." Mia was very happy and started to build a big sandcastle. While Mia was playing, a little dog came to the park. The dog saw Mia's sandcastle and wanted to play too. Suddenly, the dog jumped on the sandcastle and it fell down. Mia was sad at first, but then she saw the dog's wagging tail and happy face. Mia decided to be friends with the dog and they played together all day. At the end of the day, Mia, her aunt, and the new dog friend went home, feeling very happy and grateful for the unexpected fun they had at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a white cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to play games with his friends. One day, Fluffy and his friends decided to play a game to see who could find the biggest number. As they started to look for numbers, Fluffy found a number one. His friend, a little dog named Spot, found a number two. They both were very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird flew down and showed them a number three. Fluffy and Spot were very surprised! They did not know that the bird wanted to play too. The bird won the game because three is bigger than one and two. Fluffy and Spot laughed and clapped for the bird. They all became good friends and played more games together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toy cars. One day, he was playing with his toy ambulance. He went "vroom, vroom" as he pushed it around the room. Suddenly, Tim's toy ambulance hit his big sister's doll. The doll fell down with a "thud". Tim felt ashamed for knocking down the doll. He knew he should be more careful when playing. Tim picked up the doll and said sorry to his sister. Then, he played with his ambulance more carefully. He did not want to strike anything else. Tim learned a good lesson and they all played happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a kind lawyer named Tom. Tom liked to help people who were in trouble. He was a very good lawyer. One day, Tom met a helpless lady named Sue. Sue was very sad because she lost her toy. Tom wanted to help Sue find her toy. He asked, "Sue, where did you last see your toy?" Sue thought for a moment and said, "I think I left it at the park." So, Tom and Sue went to the park to look for the toy. After some time, they found the toy under a big tree. Tom was happy to help Sue. He gave the toy back to Sue. Sue was so happy that she hugged Tom and said, "Thank you, Tom, for helping me!" From that day on, Tom and Sue became very good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big bull. The bull was very good and nice. He lived on a farm with his friends. The farm was a fun place to play and run around. One day, the farmer wanted to test the bull. He wanted to see how fast the bull could run. The farmer called the bull and said, "Let's race!" The bull was excited and ready to run. The bull ran very fast. The farmer was happy to see that the bull was good at running. The bull won the race and got a big hug from the farmer. They both laughed and played together. The bull was proud of himself and had a great day.

One day, a group of friendly kids went to the park together. They were all very excited. One of the kids started to whistle, and it was so beautiful that everyone else had to join in! The group of kids whistled together for a long time. Suddenly, the kids heard a faint noise, coming from the trees. They stopped their whistling and wondered what the sound was, when they noticed a friendly squirrel standing on a branch. The squirrel looked at all of the kids and whistled to them. The kids jumped with excitement, and the squirrel hopped down from the tree. The kids said, "Hi squirrel! What's your name?" The squirrel smiled and whistled at them. He pointed to his chest, and the kids could just make out the word 'Nutty' in his deep, gentle whistle. The kids laughed, excited to have a new friend called Nutty. They all spent the afternoon playing together in the park, and Nutty the squirrel got to join the group. The kids waved goodbye to Nutty as he ran up the tree, and they went home with big smiles, happy to have made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Jane. Jane was smart and she wanted to grow corn. She planted lots of corn in her garden. But one day, it started to rain. Jane was sad and could not stop the rain from coming. Just then, she had an idea. Jane lied on the ground and wished for the rain to go away. It worked! The rain disappeared and the sun came out. Jane was so happy. With the sun shining, Jane's corn started to grow. It grew tall and looked very green. Jane was proud of her corn and she smiled at it. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived with her mom, dad, and her dog, Max. It was a cold, icy day outside. Lily wanted to play with Max, but she had to stay inside because it was too cold. Lily's mom gave her a piece of paper with a message on it. The message said, "Be kind and share with others." Lily liked the message, but she was not careful and she accidentally made a tear in the paper. She felt sad and showed it to her mom. Her mom smiled and said, "It's okay, Lily. The message is still there. The important thing is to remember to be kind and share with others." Lily hugged her mom and promised to always be kind and share. She learned that even when things are not perfect, we can still learn and grow from them.

Once upon a time, in a lively town, there was a big chest. It was a very special chest. All the kids liked to play with it. They put their toys in it and then took them out. It was a lot of fun. One day, a new kid came to the town. He saw the chest and wanted to play with it too. The other kids were kind and said, "We can lend you the chest to play with." The new kid was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. When the new kid opened the chest, all the toys were gone. The kids were very sad. They looked for the toys, but they could not find them. The lively town was not so lively anymore. And the kids learned that sometimes, things can go wrong when you least expect it.

Amy was a little girl who loved to play outside. One nice sunny day she went outside with her stick. She saw her friend, John, with a kite in the sky and felt very envious of him. "John," she said, "I want to play with you. Let me join you!" John smiled and said, "Of course you can join. Let's play together." So they played together, running and waving their sticks in the air. After a while, they got tired and both lay in the grass. "Let's take a nap" Amy said. "Yes, let's nap," John agreed. So they both closed their eyes and fell asleep in the grass. When they woke up, they were well rested and the sun was setting. They said goodbye and went home. Amy was so happy that she had shared an envious day with John.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with toys. One day, Tom has a new toy. It is a tap. The tap can make water come out. Tom is happy with his tap. Sam sees Tom's tap. He wants to play with it too. He asks Tom, "Can I have your tap?" Tom says, "No, this is my tap. I like it very much." Sam says, "Please, let me have your tap. I will give you something else." Tom thinks for a while. He says, "What will you give me?" Sam looks around. He sees a ball. He says, "I will give you this ball. It is big and red. You can throw it and catch it." Tom likes the ball. He says, "OK, I will sell you my tap for your ball. Give me your ball first." Sam gives Tom his ball. Tom gives Sam his tap. They are both happy. They say, "Thank you." But there is a problem. Sam does not know how to use the tap. He tries to turn it, but nothing happens. He tries to shake it, but nothing happens. He tries to hit it, but nothing happens. He is sad and angry. He goes to Tom. He says, "Your tap is bad. It does not work. Give me back my ball." Tom says, "No, you bought my tap. It is yours now. My ball is mine now. Go away." Sam says, "You cheated me. You sold me a broken tap. You are a bad friend." Tom says, "No, I did not cheat you. My tap is not broken. It works fine. You are a bad friend." They start to shout at each other. They do not listen to each other. They are deaf to each other. They are not friends anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, soft cushion that she loved very much. Lily took her cushion with her everywhere she went. She liked to sit on it, hug it, and even sleep on it at night. One day, Lily went to the park with her cushion. She was playing with her friends when she noticed that her cushion was empty. She was very sad and didn't know what to do. She looked around and saw her dog, Max, running in the park. Lily thought maybe Max could help her find what she needed to fill her cushion. Lily and Max looked all around the park. They saw a big pile of leaves and thought that maybe the leaves could fill her cushion. They put the leaves inside the cushion, but it was still empty. Then, they saw a big pile of sand and thought that maybe the sand could fill her cushion. They put the sand inside the cushion, but it was still empty. Finally, they saw a big pile of soft, fluffy clouds in the sky. Lily and Max didn't know how to get the clouds down, but they knew they needed them to fill the cushion. Then, something unexpected happened. A friendly bird saw Lily and Max looking at the clouds and decided to help them. The bird flew up, grabbed a big cloud, and brought it down to Lily. Lily filled her cushion with the soft, fluffy cloud, and it was not empty anymore. She was so happy, and she gave Max and the bird a big hug. From that day on, Lily's cushion was the softest and most comfortable cushion in the whole world, and she shared it with her friends, Max, and the bird.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a nervous boy. He did not like the night. When it was dark, he felt scared. One day, his mom told him a story. The story was about a big, friendly bear. The bear would warn people when it was time for bed. The bear was not scared of the night. It loved the dark. Tim wanted to be like the bear. So, every night, he would pretend to be the bear. He would warn his mom and dad that it was time for bed. He would say, "It's night time. Time for bed!" And just like the bear, Tim was not scared of the night anymore.

One day, a thin shark named Fin swam in the sea. He saw a little fish and wanted to talk to him. Fin said, "Hi, little fish. Let's be friends and play together." The little fish was scared at first, but then he said, "Okay, Fin. We can be friends and play." They swam and played all day long. They were so happy to have a new friend. After playing, Fin and the little fish were tired. They sat on a big rock and talked. They talked about the sea, their families, and their favorite games. They became best friends and played together every day.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play with toys in Sara's room. Sara has many toys. She has dolls, cars, blocks and books. Tom has few toys. He has a ball, a bear and a train. One day, Tom sees a shiny toy on Sara's shelf. It is a fairy with wings and a wand. Tom likes the fairy. He wants to play with it. He asks Sara, "Can I have the fairy?" Sara looks at Tom. She feels jealous. She likes the fairy too. She says, "No, you can't. The fairy is mine. My grandma gave it to me. It is special. You can play with other toys." Tom feels sad. He says, "But I don't have a fairy. I only have a ball, a bear and a train. They are old and boring. Please, can I have the fairy for a little while?" Sara shakes her head. She says, "No, you can't. The fairy is not for sharing. Go away." Tom goes away. He sits on the floor. He sees a lot of dust under Sara's bed. He thinks, "Sara has so many toys, but she does not take care of them. She lets them get dirty and dusty. She is not a good friend. She is selfish and mean." He picks up his ball, his bear and his train. He says, "I don't want to play with Sara anymore. I will go home and play with my toys. They are not shiny, but they are clean and nice. They are my friends. They make me happy." He leaves Sara's room. Sara sees Tom leave. She feels lonely. She looks at the fairy. She thinks, "The fairy is pretty, but it does not talk or laugh or hug. It is just a toy. It does not make me happy. Tom is my friend. He talks and laughs and hugs. He makes me happy. I was wrong. I should have shared the fairy with him. I miss him." She picks up the fairy. She says, "I'm sorry, fairy. You are not special. You are just dust. I don't want you anymore. I want Tom." She runs after Tom. She says, "Tom, wait. I'm sorry. You can have the fairy. You can play with it. You can keep it. Please, come back. Let's be friends again." Tom hears Sara. He turns around. He sees Sara with the fairy. He smiles. He says, "Thank you, Sara. You are very kind. I like the fairy. But I like you more. You are special. You are my friend. Let's play together." Sara smiles. She says, "You're welcome, Tom. You are very nice. I like you too. You are my friend. Let's play together." They hug. They go back to Sara's room. They play with the fairy and other toys. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big cake. It was a very special day, and the cake needed to be pretty. So, a little girl named Lucy wanted to decorate the cake. She was a bit nervous because she had never done it before. But she was excited too. Lucy put on her apron and got her colorful icing. She started to decorate the cake. She made flowers, stars, and hearts on the cake. The cake looked so pretty! Lucy was very happy with her work. Soon, it was time for the party. All of Lucy's friends came and saw the cake. They loved it! They told Lucy that she did a great job. Lucy was not nervous anymore. She knew that she could decorate cakes very well. Everyone enjoyed the cake and had a fun time at the party.

Lily and Max were going on a trip with Mom and Dad. They had to wake up very early in the morning. Lily was sleepy and did not want to get out of bed. Max was excited and ran to the door with his toy car. "Come on, Lily, we have to go!" Max said. "The plane will leave soon!" Lily rubbed her eyes and yawned. She put on her pink dress and her shoes. She grabbed her teddy bear and followed Max. Mom and Dad were waiting in the car with the luggage. The luggage was big and heavy. Mom and Dad had to throw it in the trunk. "Are you ready, kids?" Dad asked. "We are going to have a lot of fun!" Lily nodded and climbed into the car. She buckled her seat belt and hugged her teddy bear. Max sat next to her and held his toy car. He made zooming noises and pretended to drive. The car drove to the airport. It was a long ride. Lily felt more and more sleepy. She rested her head on her teddy bear and closed her eyes. She dreamed of the trip. She wanted to see the beach, the sun, and the sand. She wanted to play with Max and make sand castles. Max saw Lily sleeping and smiled. He was happy to have his sister with him. He stopped making noises and looked out the window. He saw the planes flying in the sky. He wondered how it would feel to be in one. He could not wait to find out. He hoped Lily would wake up soon and share his adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little wild cat. He liked to play in the big green woods. One day, he saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. He climbed up and up, but he could not see what would happen next. The little wild cat heard a loud sound. He looked around and saw a big bird. The big bird said, "You are in my tree. I will help you get down." The little wild cat was scared, but he let the big bird help him. The big bird took the little wild cat to the ground. The little wild cat said, "Thank you, big bird. I did not know this was your tree." The big bird said, "That is okay. Now we can be friends." And from that day on, the little wild cat and the big bird were best friends. They played together in the big green woods, and nothing bad happened again.

One day, a sunflower was in a big field. It was a big and pretty sunflower. The sunflower saw a little girl walking by. The little girl was sad. The sunflower wanted to help the girl. It said, "Why are you sad, little girl?" The girl said, "I lost my toy. I am very sad." The sunflower was compassionate and wanted to make the girl happy. The sunflower thought of a plan. It said, "I will strike the ground with my roots. Maybe your toy will come out." The sunflower struck the ground, and the toy came out! The girl was happy and said, "Thank you, sunflower!" The moral of the story is to be kind and help others when they are sad.

One summer day, Benjamin was walking outside looking for something to do. He heard a whistle coming from the sky and looked up. He saw a yellow bird flying high up in the clouds. He thought it was beautiful and began to whistle himself. As he whistled, the bird flew towards him and landed on the windowsill of his house. Benjamin smiled and the bird smiled back. He was so excited that he ran inside to tell his mom. "Mommy, there is a pretty yellow bird outside!" "That is great, Benjamin" replied his mom. "Maybe we can give it a nice bath in the sink!" Benjamin liked the idea and ran outside to find the bird. Sure enough, the bird was still there and Benjamin grabbed it carefully. He carried it to the kitchen and placed it in the sink. He filled the sink with water and began to sing a happy song. The bird seemed to enjoy the bath and soon its feathers were sparkling yellow. After a while, Benjamin took the bird back to the windowsill and it sang a beautiful song of thanks. Benjamin enjoyed spending time with the bird and knew that it wouldn’t be the last time. He had a feeling that this was only the beginning of his friendship with the special yellow bird.

Once there was a small boy who wanted to climb a tall tree in the park. His mum saw him and said, "Be careful! That's a big tree and it's too high for you!" But the boy was determined and said, "I'll try!" So the boy climbed the tree and he almost reached the top. But then the branch he was standing on broke and he began to fall. Suddenly, he was grabbed by a strong hand and pulled to safety. "You were really trying, but climbing the tree was too hard for you” said the man who had caught him. The small boy thanked the man. Then the man said, "Competition is good, but if something is too hard, you should stop and try something easier. That's what real courage is." The small boy nodded and decided to do more things that he knew were safe. He still wanted to try hard, but he was happy to learn that it was much smarter to not do something that was beyond his limits.

One day, a bald man named Tom went for a walk. He saw a little girl named Sally. Sally was sad. She lost her toy in a tall tree. "Can you help me?" asked Sally. Tom wanted to help, so he tried to get the toy. But the tree was too tall. Tom could not reach it with his hands. Tom had an idea. He took off his belt from his waist. He swung the belt to catch the toy. After a few tries, the belt caught the toy. Tom pulled it down and gave it to Sally. "Thank you!" said Sally with a big smile. They both were happy in the end. And they became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a cop named Bob. Bob was a very good cop. He liked to help people and keep them safe. One day, Bob was driving his cop car down the street. He saw a big truck that was going the wrong way. The truck was going to hit a little cat. Bob knew he had to do something. Bob turned on his cop car lights and drove very fast. He got in front of the truck and stopped it. Then, he told the truck driver to reverse. The truck driver did what Bob said and moved the truck away from the little cat. The cat was safe now. Bob was happy that the cat was not dead. The little cat was happy too. The cat jumped into Bob's cop car and sat on his lap. From that day on, Bob and the little cat were best friends. They went everywhere together and helped people stay safe.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big ancient tree. Under the tree, he found a long stick. He picked up the stick and played with it. He ran around the park and had a lot of fun. Soon, Tim met a girl named Sue. She saw Tim's stick and said, "Wow, that's a cool stick! Can I play with it too?" Tim said, "Yes, let's play together!" They played with the stick all day. They swung it and threw it in the air. The sun was hot, and the stick became dry. At the end of the day, Tim and Sue were tired. They put the stick under the ancient tree and said goodbye. But when they left, they forgot the stick. The next day, it rained, and the stick got wet and broke. Tim and Sue were sad because their fun day with the stick was over.

Once upon a time, in a beautiful garden, there was an attractive hive. Many bees lived in the hive. They were very busy making honey. The hive was near a big tree that had pretty flowers. One morning, the sun started to rise. The bees woke up and saw the sun. They were very happy because it was a new day. They flew out of the hive to find more flowers. As the bees flew around the garden, they saw many attractive flowers. They worked hard to collect the sweet nectar. The bees brought the nectar back to the hive. They made more and more honey. The bees were very proud of their hive.

Once upon a time, there was a popular boy named Tim. He had many friends and liked to play with them. One day, he found a big sack in his yard. Tim wanted to show the sack to his friends. So he went to his friend's house and said, "Look at my big sack! Let's play with it!" His friends were excited and they all started to play with the sack. They put toys in it, jumped on it, and even used it as a big pillow. But one day, the sack broke. All the toys fell out and the sack could not be fixed. Tim started to cry. His friends felt sad too. They all learned that they should be careful with things and not play too rough.

Once upon a time, in a big yellow house, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat prunes. One day, he could not find his prunes. So, Tim started to search the house for his yummy snack. Tim looked in the kitchen and asked his mom, "Mom, where are my prunes?" His mom said, "I don't know, Tim. Keep searching." Tim looked in his room, but he could not find the prunes there either. As Tim was searching, he saw his dog, Spot, in the yard. Spot had a big, purple smile on his face. Tim knew that Spot had eaten all his prunes! Tim was sad, but then he laughed. He said, "Silly dog, you like prunes too!" Tim and Spot played in the yard, and they were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a very famous barber. One day, he said to his customer, "I can bring you a brand new haircut!" The customer was excited. He asked the barber to bring him something special. So the barber brought something special – a big, sharp pair of scissors. When the customer saw the scissors, he was scared. He said, "No, no! I don't want that! Please bring me something else!" But the barber didn't listen. He didn't bring anything else. He grabbed the customer's hair and started to cut it with the scissors. The customer was so scared that he ran away! From that day on, the famous barber was never seen again.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Jack and Jake. They both wanted to play together at the playground, but Jack wanted to play on the swings while Jake wanted to go down the slide. Jack said to Jake, "Let's both go down the slide!" But Jake shook his head and said, "No, I want to go down the slide, and you want to go on the swings. Let's test it out, and see who is right!" Jack was getting angry and said, "No, it's not fair! I don't want to test it, because then I won't get what I want." Then a wise old man, who was sitting on a nearby desk, spoke to them. He said, "When you test something and you don't get what you want, it doesn't mean it's not fair. Sometimes it's just the way things are. Don't be angry, be kind to each other and you will have lots of fun." Jack and Jake listened to the old man and decided to go down the slide together. They both had lots of fun and learnt a valuable lesson - it's better to be kind than to be angry.

Sam and Mia were playing in the park. They saw a big board lying on the grass. Sam wanted to use it as a slide. "Look, Mia, a slide!" he said. "Let's go on it!" Mia was not sure. The board looked old and dirty. She thought it might break or hurt them. "Sam, I don't think that's a good idea," she said. "The board is not fit for sliding. It might have nails or splinters. And it's too high. We could fall and get hurt." Sam did not listen. He was too excited. He ran to the board and climbed on it. He tried to slide down, but the board was not smooth. It was rough and bumpy. Sam felt a sharp pain in his leg. He cried out loud. "Mia, help! I'm stuck! The board has a nail in it! It poked my leg!" Mia ran to Sam. She saw the blood on his leg. She felt scared and sorry. She wished they had not played with the board. "Sam, I'm sorry. I'll get help. Don't move. Stay calm," she said. She ran to the nearest adult. She told them what happened. They called an ambulance. They took Sam to the hospital. They fixed his leg. He had to wear a bandage for a while. Sam learned his lesson. He never played with boards again. He listened to Mia more. She was his best friend. She always looked out for him. They played with safer things. They had fun. They were happy.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a lamp. The lamp was amazing. It was blue and shiny. Lily loved her lamp very much. One day, Lily took her lamp outside to play. She wanted to show her friends how amazing it was. They played with the lamp all day long. Lily took good care of her lamp. She made sure it didn't get dirty or broken. When the sun went down, Lily took her lamp inside. She was very tired, but she still took care of her lamp. She put it on her table next to her bed. The lamp made her room bright and happy. Lily smiled and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a reliable mailman named Tom. He loved to deliver mail to all his friends in town. Every day, he would put on his blue hat and carry a big bag of letters and packages. One sunny day, Tom had a special job. He had to deliver a big, colorful flag to his friend, Sally. Sally was excited to get her new flag. When Tom arrived at Sally's house, he said, "Here is your flag, Sally!" "Thank you, Tom!" said Sally. She was very happy. She put the flag up in her yard, and it waved in the wind. All the kids in the neighborhood came to see the flag. They laughed, played, and had a fun day together. Tom was proud that he could help make his friends happy by delivering the flag.

One day, a brilliant cat named Tim went to play outside. He saw a big ball and wanted to catch it. Tim ran very fast and jumped high to catch the ball. He felt very happy when he got the ball. Tim's friend, a dog named Max, came to play with him. Max said, "Wow, Tim! You are so good at catch! Can I play with you?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, Max! Let's have fun together!" They played catch with the big ball. It was a luxury for them to play all day. They laughed and had a great time. Tim and Max were very happy and tired when the sun went down. They went home and slept well after their fun day of playing catch.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy ball. One day, while playing, he threw the ball too hard and it landed in a disgusting mud puddle. Tim's friend, Sam, saw the ball in the mud and said, "Ew, your ball is in the yucky mud! Don't touch it, or you'll get dirty too!" But Tim didn't listen. He wanted his ball back, so he reached into the mud to get it. As Tim grabbed the ball, he felt something else in the mud. He pulled it out, and it was a small, shiny cell. Tim and Sam were so surprised! They cleaned the cell, and it started to glow. They knew it was special. Tim and Sam took the cell to their teacher, who told them it was a magic cell. The teacher said, "You can make one wish with this cell, but be careful what you wish for!" Tim and Sam thought hard about what they wanted. Finally, they wished to never miss playing with their ball again. The magic cell granted their wish, and from that day on, Tim and Sam never missed a throw or a catch. They were so happy that they found the magic cell in the disgusting mud puddle.

One day, a parrot flew up high into the sky. He was so happy to be flying, and he felt the warm sunshine on his wings. He tried to do some amazing tricks, but he was so full of energy, he was unable to stay in one place for too long. Eventually, he flew so high that he didn't even know how to get back down. He tried to fly lower but he only flew higher and higher. Soon he was so tired and frightened that he started to cry. He was lost, alone, and far away from home. Despite his best efforts, he could not find his way back down and soon he fell from the sky and hit the ground with a loud thump. The parrot was never seen again, and his owners were so sad. They remembered how happy he was when he left, and they wished he had been able to fly home safely.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved her calendar. It had pictures of cute animals on it. She liked to look at the animals and count the days. One day, Sue's little brother, Tim, ripped her calendar. Sue was very sad and impatient. She wanted to fix it right away. She asked her mom, "Can you help me restore my calendar?" Her mom said, "Yes, I can help you." They used tape to put the pieces back together. Sue was happy to see her calendar looking good again. She and her mom talked about the animals and counted the days together. From that day on, Sue and Tim learned to be careful with each other's things. They played together and shared their toys. Sue showed Tim her calendar, and they both enjoyed looking at the cute animals.

Ben and Lily were playing knights and dragons in the garden. Ben had a stick for a weapon and Lily had a plastic sword. They pretended to fight the evil dragon that lived in the bush. "Roar!" Lily said, waving her sword. "I am the dragon and I will eat you!" "No, you won't!" Ben said, swinging his stick. "I am the brave knight and I have a sharp weapon!" They ran around the garden, making noises and having fun. But then Ben tripped over a rock and fell down. He hurt his knee and it started to bleed. "Ow, ow, ow!" Ben cried, holding his knee. "It hurts so much!" Lily stopped playing and ran to him. She saw the blood and felt sorry for him. "Oh, Ben, I'm sorry!" she said, dropping her sword. "Are you okay?" She hugged him and tried to make him feel better. She looked at his stick and saw that it had a pointy end. "Ben, your weapon is too sharp!" she said. "It can hurt you or me. We should not play with it." She threw the stick away and picked up her sword. "Look, my weapon is not sharp," she said. "It is only plastic. It is better for playing. And it is fancy, too. See, it has a shiny handle and a red ribbon." She gave her sword to Ben and smiled. "Here, you can have my weapon," she said. "You can be the knight and I can be the dragon. But we have to be careful and not hurt each other. Okay?" Ben nodded and took the sword. He felt a little better and smiled back. "Okay," he said. "Thank you, Lily.
