You are a nice dragon and a good friend." They hugged again and then continued to play, but more gently and safely. They had fun and forgot about the pain.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play outside in the sun. The sun was very hot, but Lily did not mind. She liked to run and jump with her friends all day long. One day, Lily found a pretty rock. The rock was shiny and smooth. Lily liked the rock and wanted to show it to her friends. She ran to find her friends, but when she looked for the rock, it was gone! The rock had vanished! Lily felt sad and looked everywhere for the rock. Lily looked under a big tree, and there she found the rock! The tree had been hiding it from the harsh sun. Lily was so happy to find her rock. She showed it to her friends, and they all played with the rock together. From that day on, Lily and her friends took turns taking care of the rock, making sure it never vanished again.

Tommy was a boy who liked to play with his toys. He had many toys, but his favorite was a doctor kit. He liked to pretend he was a doctor and use his tools to check his stuffed animals. He had a stethoscope, a thermometer, a bandage, and a syringe. One day, he decided to play doctor with his sister, Lily. Lily was younger than Tommy and did not like to play doctor. She was scared of the syringe and did not want Tommy to use it on her. She said, "No, Tommy, no! I don't want to play doctor. Leave me alone!" But Tommy did not listen to Lily. He thought he knew better and he wanted to use his syringe. He said, "Don't be silly, Lily. It's just a toy. It won't hurt you. I'm a doctor and I need to give you a shot." He grabbed Lily's arm and tried to poke her with the syringe. Lily cried and screamed. She kicked and pushed Tommy away. She ran to their mom and told her what Tommy did. Mom was very angry with Tommy. She said, "Tommy, that was very rude and mean of you. You should not use your toys to hurt your sister. You should respect her feelings and ask her before you play with her. How would you like it if she used your toys to hurt you?" Tommy felt ashamed and sorry. He realized he was wrong and he hurt Lily. He said, "I'm sorry, mom. I'm sorry, Lily. I was not a good doctor. I was a bad brother. I won't use my syringe on you again. Can you forgive me?" Lily was still upset, but she saw that Tommy was sorry. She said, "I forgive you, Tommy. But don't do that again. It's not fun. It's scary." Tommy hugged Lily and said, "Thank you, Lily. I love you. Can we play something else?" Lily nodded and said, "I love you too, Tommy. How about we play tea party?" Tommy agreed and they went to play tea party with their stuffed animals. They had fun and they were nice to each other. Mom was happy to see them get along. She said, "That's better, Tommy and Lily. You are good children. You should always use your toys to have fun and not to hurt. And you should always use your words to ask and to say sorry." The moral of the story is: You should not use your toys to hurt others. You should respect their feelings and ask before you play with them. And you should always use your words to ask and to say sorry.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was very scared of exams. His teacher used to tell him not to worry, because the exams were very easy. One day, Tom's teacher came over to his house and said, "Tom, I'm here to help you with the exam. Don't be scared, it's easy." Tom replied, "No, it's too scary. I don't want to do it!" Tom's teacher smiled and said, "It's ok, Tom. I'll help you and make it easier for you. I promise it won't be so scary anymore." Tom took a deep breath and said, "Ok, let's do it!" Tom and his teacher worked together and soon Tom was feeling much less scared. When exam time came around, Tom was ready. He took the exam and passed with flying colors. He was relieved and happy that his teacher had helped him overcome his fear. From then on, Tom was no longer scared of exams.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy board. He would draw on it, and it made him very happy. The board was big and harmless, so his mom and dad let him play with it all the time. One day, Tim found a long string. He thought it would be fun to tie the string to his board. He tied the string tight and strong. Now, he could pull the board around the room like a train. Tim showed his mom and dad his new toy train. They smiled and clapped their hands. They were proud of Tim for being so creative. Tim played with his board and string all day, having lots of fun. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, Tim and his mom went to the park. They saw a big box with unusual things inside. Tim said, "Mom, what is that?" Mom said, "That is equipment for a game." They took the equipment out and tried to play. It was hard to use, but they had fun. They played until it was time to go home. Before they left, they had to wrap the equipment and put it back in the box. Tim helped his mom wrap the unusual things. They put them in the box and said goodbye to the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy had a cat named Mr. Whiskers. They lived a happy life in a small house. One day, Amy found a spicy pepper in the kitchen. She thought it would be fun to tease Mr. Whiskers with it. She waved the spicy pepper in front of Mr. Whiskers and said, "Look, Mr. Whiskers! Do you want to try this spicy thing?" Mr. Whiskers sniffed the pepper and sneezed. Amy laughed and said, "I'm sorry, Mr. Whiskers. I didn't mean to make you sneeze." Mr. Whiskers looked at her and meowed, as if to say, "It's okay, Amy." From that day on, Amy and Mr. Whiskers continued to have fun and play together. They learned not to tease each other with spicy things. And they lived a happy life, full of love and laughter.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy ant named Andy. He lived in a big ant hill with his friends. They all worked hard to find food and make their home nice. One day, Andy saw his friends trying to move a big leaf. They wanted to take it to their home. But the leaf was too big. Andy had an idea. He said, "Let's measure the leaf and make it smaller." So, they all measured the leaf and cut it into smaller parts. They worked together to carry the leaf pieces back to their home. When they got there, they had reached their goal. They were all very happy. Andy was not grumpy anymore. He learned that working together with friends can make hard things easier.

One day, Tom and Sam went to the park. Tom was eager to whistle a happy song. Sam saw a sign near a big tree. The sign said, "No whistling near the tree." "Why no whistling?" asked Tom. Sam did not know. Tom wanted to whistle, but he did not want to break the rule. The next day, Tom and Sam went to the park again. Tom forgot about the sign and started to whistle. Suddenly, the big tree shook, and a lot of birds flew out. The birds were scared of the whistling! Now, Tom and Sam knew why the sign was there. They laughed and played, but Tom did not whistle near the tree anymore. The birds were happy, and so were Tom and Sam.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who was very sick. He was very weak and all he wanted was to be healed. He was a bit scared. One day, a special doctor came to visit him. The doctor brought a big plate with some healthy food. The boy was very excited and started to eat. The doctor watched the boy and smiled. He said some special words and the boy started to feel better. He had been healed. The doctor told the boy to eat lots of healthy food from the plate, and to get lots of rest. The boy smiled and did as he was told. In no time at all, the boy was feeling much better. He was healed and back to his old self again. He was so happy and grateful to have been healed.

One day, a boy named Tim and his mom went on a picnic. They took a huge basket full of food. They walked to a big park and found a nice spot under a tree. As they were eating, a little bird flew down and said, "Hello, can I have some food?" Tim and his mom shared their food with the bird. They all talked and laughed together. Suddenly, the little bird started to grow bigger and bigger. Tim and his mom were very surprised. The bird was now huge! The bird said, "Thank you for sharing your food. Now, I will make your picnic disappear!" And with a wave of its wing, the picnic was gone. Tim and his mom looked at each other and smiled. They knew they had made a new friend.

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot was a good dog, but he always lost his way. One day, his friend, a wise old owl, gave him a special collar. The owl said, "Spot, trust this collar to help you find your way home." One hot day, Spot went for a walk in the forest. He played with his friends, the squirrels and the rabbits. They ran and jumped and had so much fun. But soon, Spot realized he was far from home and didn't know how to get back. Spot remembered the collar the owl gave him. He trusted the collar and started to walk. The collar guided him through the forest. He passed by tall trees and pretty flowers. He heard the birds singing and felt the warm sun on his fur. Finally, Spot saw his little house. He was so happy to be home! His friend, the wise old owl, was waiting for him. Spot said, "Thank you, Owl, for the magic collar. I trusted it, and it helped me find my way home." From that day on, Spot always wore his special collar. He knew he could trust it to help him find his way home, no matter how far he went. And Spot, the wise old owl, and all their friends lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a man who had a big, long stick called a staff. He used it to walk and help people in his town. One day, he lost his staff. He was sad because it was very special and expensive. The man looked everywhere for his staff. He asked his friends if they saw his staff. They all looked together, but they could not find it. The man was very sad. He thought he would never find his expensive staff again. Then, a little girl saw the man and asked him why he was sad. The man told the little girl that he lost his expensive staff. The little girl wanted to help, so she looked around the town with the man. They found the staff under a big tree. The man was very happy, and he thanked the little girl for helping him. They went home, and the man could help people again with his special staff.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to play in the park. She wore her favorite blouse, which was blue with pretty flowers. Lucy thought her blouse was very important because her mom gave it to her on her birthday. In the park, Lucy met a boy named Tom. Tom was sad because he lost his ball. Lucy wanted to help Tom find his ball. They decided to unite and look for the ball together. As they searched, they talked and became good friends. Suddenly, they saw a dog running towards them. The dog had Tom's ball in its mouth! The dog dropped the ball at their feet and wagged its tail. Tom and Lucy were so happy and surprised. They played with the dog and had lots of fun. In the end, they found out that the dog belonged to Tom's neighbor. The day was full of unexpected fun, and Lucy and Tom became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to polish his shoes. He would polish them every day. One day, Tim found a big box in his room. The box had the word "space" on it. Tim felt a bit guilty because he did not know if he should open the box or not. He thought maybe it was not his. Tim decided to open the box. Inside the box, there was a shiny space toy. The toy was so cool! Tim played with the toy all day. He knew that he would have to find out who the toy belonged to, but he could not stop playing with it. The next day, Tim's mom came into his room. She saw the space toy and smiled. "Tim, I see you found the surprise I left for you," she said. Tim felt so happy! He was not guilty anymore because the toy was his all along.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a pair of light pants that he loved to wear. One day, Tim had a big dream. In his dream, he saw a talking cat. The cat was wearing pants just like Tim's light pants. The cat said, "Hi, Tim! Let's play together!" Tim was so happy to play with the talking cat. They ran and jumped and laughed all day long. Tim's light pants were just like the cat's pants, so they felt very special. When Tim woke up from his dream, he told his mom about it. His mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a fun dream, Tim!" Tim was happy that he had the dream and even happier that he could share it with his mom. From that day on, whenever he wore his light pants, he remembered the talking cat and their fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, intelligent dog named Max. Max lived in a small house with his friend, a little boy named Tim. They loved to play together all day long. One day, Max found a strange thing in the yard. It was a skull. Max thought it would be fun to play with, so he attached a string to the skull. He ran to show Tim his new toy. Tim and Max played with the skull all day, but then it started to get dark. They did not want to stop playing, so they kept going. But as they played, the skull began to glow. Suddenly, a scary ghost appeared from the skull. It chased Tim and Max into the house, and they were never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom had a cold, so he had to stay in bed all day. He was very sad because he wanted to go out and play with his friends. One day, Tom found a big board in his room. He decided to draw on the board with his crayons. He drew a big sun, some trees, and flowers. Tom felt a little better when he looked at his pretty drawing. Tom's mom saw his drawing and had an idea. She said, "Let's leave your cold behind and go out to play." Tom was so happy! He put on his coat and went outside to play with his friends. The cold was gone, and Tom had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a big bird named Bob. Bob liked to soar high in the sky. He loved to feel the wind on his face as he flew up and down. One day, Bob found a bottle of ink. The ink was colorful and pretty. He had an idea. He dipped his wings in the ink and started to paint the sky. The sky looked so beautiful with all the colors. Bob got hungry after painting. He saw a tree with delicious red apples. He flew down and ate some. They were so yummy! Bob was happy. He went back to soaring in the sky, with a full belly and a colorful world around him.

Once upon a time, there was a humble uncle named Tom. He lived in a small house with a big tree. Uncle Tom loved to play with his little niece, Lily. One sunny day, Uncle Tom and Lily decided to play hide and seek. Uncle Tom said, "I will count to ten, and you go hide!" Lily ran to find a good hiding spot. Uncle Tom counted, "One, two, three..." Lily found a big box near the tree. She thought, "This is a great hiding spot!" Lily got inside the box and waited for Uncle Tom to find her. Uncle Tom looked and looked, but he could not find Lily. Finally, he saw the big box near the tree. He smiled and thought, "I bet Lily is hiding in there!" Uncle Tom opened the box, and there was Lily! They both laughed and played hide and seek all day long.

Max and Mommy were getting ready to go on a picnic. They were very excited. They packed the car with the food and drinks and drove to the park. When they got to the park, Max saw his good friend Will. They said hello and went exploring around the park. Unfortunatly, Will had accidently left his invitation to the picnic at home. Will was sad and asked Max to help him. Max came up with a plan. With a flexible attitude, Max decided to sneak into the picnic area and steal an invitation. Max snuck over to the picnic blanket and grabbed an invitation card. Then, they ran back over to Will and gave him the invitation. Will was very excited and thank Max for helping him. They could now join the picnic. Max was a good friend and was so proud he had been able to help Will. He was glad he had been flexible and had a great idea to steal the invitation.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a red knob on the door. He did not know what it was for. He wanted to see what would happen if he turned it. He thought maybe a toy would come out. Tim went to eat lunch. He had a big sandwich and some milk. He forgot about the red knob for a little while. After lunch, Tim went back to the door. He saw the red knob again and remembered he wanted to twist it. He turned the red knob and waited. Nothing happened at first. Then, a big cat jumped out of the door! Tim was so surprised. He did not think a cat would come out. The cat was nice and wanted to play. Tim and the cat had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Yesterday, he went to a shop with his mom. Tim saw a big, red ball. He wanted it so much. He asked his mom, "Can I have the ball, please?" His mom said, "Yes, you can have it." Tim was so happy. He played with the ball all day. But then, he kicked the ball too hard. The ball flew away and hit a tree. The tree was hurt. The tree said, "Ouch! That hurt! Please be careful next time." Tim felt sorry for the tree. He said, "I'm sorry, tree. I will be more careful." He picked up the ball and took it home. Tim's mom ordered a new, soft ball for the tree. The tree was happy, and Tim learned to play more carefully. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable dog named Spot. Spot had a friend named Lily. Lily was a little girl who loved to play with her dog. One day, Lily found a shiny crystal in her backyard. "Spot, look at this!" Lily said, showing the crystal to her dog. Spot wagged his tail and barked, as if he knew it was special. Lily and Spot decided to show the crystal to their friends. As they walked, Lily started to feel tired. Spot saw this and it reminded him to help his friend. "Woof, woof!" barked Spot, as he took the crystal in his mouth and carried it for Lily. "Thank you, Spot!" said Lily, smiling. They continued to walk and show their friends the beautiful crystal. Lily was happy to have such a dependable friend like Spot. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park. She saw a box on the ground. The box was very empty. Mia felt sad because she wanted to find stuff inside the box. She looked around to see if there was anything near the box. Then, a little boy named Tim came to the park too. He saw Mia and the empty box. Tim said, "Hi Mia, what are you doing?" Mia said, "I found this empty box, but there is no stuff inside." Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's go find some stuff to put in the box!" Mia and Tim looked all around the park. They found pretty rocks, leaves, and even a toy car. They put all the stuff they found inside the box. Suddenly, the box started to shake and make noise. Mia and Tim were surprised. The box opened, and out came a friendly talking bird! The bird said, "Thank you for filling my box with stuff. Now I have a cozy home!" Mia and Tim felt happy because they made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a polite dog named Spot. Spot loved to play in the dirt. One day, he found a flashlight. It was shiny and bright. Spot had an idea. Spot wanted to bury the flashlight in the dirt. He dug a deep hole with his paws. He put the flashlight inside the hole. Then, he covered it with dirt. Spot was proud of his work. Later, the sun went down and it was dark. Spot's friend, a little girl named Sue, needed help. She was scared of the dark. Spot remembered the flashlight he had buried. He dug it up and gave it to Sue. Sue was happy and not scared anymore. They played all night with the flashlight. Spot was a very good friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She liked to play in the kitchen with her toy pots and pans. One day, Sue wanted to remove a big plate from the cupboard. But she was too small to reach it. Her cat, Fluffy, saw that Sue was sorry she couldn't reach the plate. Fluffy had an idea! He jumped on the counter and pushed the plate off the edge. Sue was so happy and thanked Fluffy with a big hug. But, guess what? When the plate fell, it didn't break! It bounced like a ball! Sue and Fluffy laughed and played with the bouncy plate all day. They had lots of fun with their new toy, and Sue was not sorry anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big worry. Her mommy was going to have a birthday party and Lily wanted to help. She wanted to prepare a surprise for her mommy, but she didn't know how. One day, Lily saw a naughty cat take a cake from the table. The cat made a big mess. Lily had an idea. She could make a new cake for her mommy's birthday party. She thought it would make her mommy happy and fix the mess that the naughty cat made. Lily worked hard to prepare the cake. She mixed, poured, and baked it. When the cake was ready, she put it on the table. Her mommy came in and saw the cake. She was so happy and hugged Lily. Lily's worry was gone. The birthday party was a big success, and everyone had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a big man. He had a loud axe. One day, he went to the woods. He wanted to cut a tree. But he saw a little bird in the tree. The big man did not want to hurt the little bird. So, he did not cut the tree. He was sad. He wanted to cut a tree. But he did not want to hurt the little bird. Then, something unexpected happened. The little bird flew to the big man. The bird dropped a seed in his hand. The big man smiled. He planted the seed. Now, he had a new tree to cut. The big man and the little bird were both happy.

Once upon a time, there was a dragon. The dragon was dirty. He lived in a big cave. One day, a girl saw the dragon. The girl was not afraid. She wanted to help the dragon. The girl said, "Mr. Dragon, you are dirty. Let me help you." The dragon was happy. The girl and the dragon went to the river. The girl helped the dragon wash. The dragon was clean. Now, the dragon wanted to raise the girl. The girl and the dragon played and had fun. They became best friends. The girl's family was very surprised. They did not know that dragons could be kind. The girl and the dragon lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, a little bunny named Bobo loved to travel. He would hop, skip, and jump all day long. One day, Bobo wanted to go to a big hill he saw far away. He thought it would be fun to roll down the hill. Before he left, his mommy said, "Be careful, Bobo. The big hill can be fun, but it can also bring pain." Bobo just smiled and said, "Don't worry, mommy! I will be safe." Bobo hopped and skipped all the way to the big hill. When he got there, he felt so happy. He started to roll down the hill, but he went too fast! He hit a big rock and felt a lot of pain. Bobo was sorry he didn't listen to his mommy. Bobo slowly hopped back home, feeling very sorry. When he got home, his mommy hugged him and said, "I'm glad you're safe, Bobo. Remember to always be careful when you travel." Bobo nodded and promised he would be more careful next time.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Tom. Tom loved to watch the birds in the trees. He would sit by the window and watch them all day. One day, Tom saw a little bird on the ground. He wanted to play with the bird, so he asked, "Little bird, can I play with you?" The little bird looked at Tom and said, "Yes, we can play together." So, Tom and the little bird played all day. They ran and jumped and had lots of fun. When it was time to go home, Tom and the little bird said goodbye. They were happy to have a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, while they were playing, they found a huge box in the park. Lily and her friends decided to hide in the huge box. But when they got inside, they saw a big red button that said "emergency." They did not know what it meant, but it looked fun to press. Lily pressed the emergency button, and suddenly, the huge box started to shake! They all laughed and played inside the shaking box until it stopped. Then, they went back to playing hide and seek, happy to have found such a fun surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little brown dog. The dog loved to play in the yard. One day, he saw a bean on the ground. He gazed at it and thought it was a toy. The dog picked up the bean with his mouth and played with it all day. He rolled it, tossed it, and ran around with it. But then, something unexpected happened. The bean fell into a small hole in the yard. The next day, the dog went to find his bean. But instead of a bean, he found a big green plant! The plant had grown from the bean. The dog was very happy because now he had a new friend to play with. The brown dog and the green plant played together every day. They became the best of friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She wanted something special, so she went to the store. The girl saw a bracelet, and it was fit for her. She smiled and asked the shopkeeper if she could have it. The shopkeeper said yes, so the girl thanked him and put the bracelet on her wrist. She looked in the mirror and smiled. The bracelet was just what she wanted. The girl ran home and showed her bracelet to her mom. She said it was the best thing ever. Mom smiled and said she was happy. The bracelet made the girl so happy. She wore it all the time and never wanted to take it off. The girl and her bracelet were like good friends. Time went by and the girl grew up. It was finally time to end her time with the bracelet. The girl was sad, but knew it was time to move on and make new memories. She put the bracelet away and said goodbye. With that, the bracelet's journey with the girl came to an end.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a delicate bird named Blue. Blue loved to sing and play with her friends. She lived in a nest on a branch high up in a tall tree. One sunny day, Blue was playing with her friend, a squirrel named Squeaky. They were having fun running and jumping in the trees. Suddenly, they saw a big, scary cat named Whiskers. Whiskers wanted to fight with Blue and Squeaky. Blue said to Squeaky, "We must be brave and not let Whiskers hurt us." Squeaky nodded and they both stood up to Whiskers. They started to make loud noises to scare him away. Whiskers didn't like the noise, so he ran away. Blue and Squeaky were happy that they didn't have to fight Whiskers. They went back to playing on the branch, knowing they were safe. From that day on, Blue and Squeaky knew they could be brave together and protect each other. And so, Blue and Squeaky lived happily in the big forest, playing and singing every day. They knew they could face anything as long as they were together.

Sam and Lily were best friends. They liked to play with their scooters in the park. One day, it was very hot outside. Sam and Lily felt thirsty and tired. "Let's go to the fountain and drink some water," Sam said. "OK, but we have to remove our helmets first," Lily said. They parked their scooters near a bench and took off their helmets. They ran to the fountain and drank some water. It was cold and refreshing. "Ah, that feels good," Sam said. "Look, there are some ducks in the pond," Lily said. They walked to the pond and watched the ducks swim and quack. They threw some bread crumbs to them. The ducks came closer and ate the bread. "Hello, ducks," Sam said. "Quack, quack," the ducks said. Sam and Lily laughed and clapped their hands. They had fun with the ducks. They forgot about their scooters and helmets. But then, a big boy came to the bench. He saw the scooters and helmets. He liked them. He decided to take them. He grabbed Sam's scooter and helmet and ran away. He did the same with Lily's scooter and helmet. Sam and Lily heard the noise and turned around. They saw the big boy stealing their scooters and helmets. "Hey, stop!" Sam shouted. "Those are ours!" Lily cried. They ran after the big boy. They were angry and sad. They wanted their scooters and helmets back.

Once upon a time, there was a thoughtful little girl named Lily. She loved to listen and hear the sounds around her. One day, Lily was walking in the park when she saw a little bird hopping on the ground. The bird looked sad and was holding its toe. "Little bird, why are you sad?" Lily asked. The bird looked up and said, "I hurt my toe, and I can't fly to my family in the tree." Lily thought for a moment and said, "I can help you, little bird." Lily picked up the bird and carried it to the tree. She put the bird on a branch, and the bird's family was so happy to see it. They all sang a beautiful song that Lily could hear. The bird said, "Thank you, Lily, for being so thoughtful and helping me." From that day on, Lily and the bird became the best of friends.

One day, a boy named Tim and a girl named Sue were very busy. They had paint and big paper. They wanted to make a pretty picture together. Tim had blue paint, and Sue had red paint. Tim said, "Let's pour the paint on the paper!" Sue said, "Yes, let's do it!" They poured the paint on the paper. The blue and red paint mixed together. It was fun and messy! But something unexpected happened. A little dog ran into the room. He stepped in the paint and ran all over the paper. Tim and Sue were surprised! Now, their pretty picture had dog prints on it. They laughed and said, "Our picture is even better now!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy had a great big smile and loved to play. One day, she found a rag in her room. It was a pretty rag with many colors on it. Amy thought it would be fun to use the rag in a game. Amy took the rag outside to play. She found her friend Tom and showed him the rag. They decided to use the rag to play a game of catch. They threw the rag to each other, laughing and having fun. The rag was soft, so it was easy to catch. After playing catch for a while, Amy and Tom were tired. They sat under a big tree to rest. They used the rag as a blanket to sit on. They talked and shared stories while sitting on the rag. The great day ended with the sun setting, and the two friends went home, happy and tired.

Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a big machine. He wanted to study it. The machine was very dry. Tim asked his friend, Sam, to help him. "Sam, will you help me study the machine?" Tim said. Sam said, "Yes, I will help you." They both looked at the machine. It was big and dry. They pushed a button on the machine. The machine made a loud sound. It started to shake. Tim and Sam were scared. They tried to stop the machine. But the machine did not stop. It shook more and more. It made a big hole in the ground. Tim and Sam fell into the hole. They could not get out. The machine was still loud and dry. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog. He was restless and liked to run and play all day. One day, he saw a big box in the yard. He was very curious about it. The little dog went close to the box and started to sniff it. Suddenly, the box moved and the dog began to tremble. He did not know what was inside. He was scared, but he did not run away yet. Then, the box opened and out came a tiny kitten. The dog was surprised, but he was not scared anymore. They became best friends and played together all day. The little dog was not restless anymore.

One day, a bright sun was shining in the sky. A little bird named Tim was flying around. He saw his friend, the squirrel named Sam, sitting under a tree. Tim went to say hello. "Hi Sam," said Tim. "I have a message for you." Sam looked up and smiled. "What is the message?" he asked. Tim told him, "Our friend, the rabbit, needs help. He needs someone to supply him with food. Can you do it?" Sam thought for a moment and said, "Yes, I can help. I will supply food for our friend, the rabbit." So, Sam and Tim went to find food for the rabbit. They found some nuts and berries. They took the food to the rabbit's home. The rabbit was very happy and thanked them for their help. Sam and Tim felt good about helping their friend. From that day on, they always helped each other whenever they could.

Lily was very happy today. She was going to visit her grandma and grandpa. They lived in a big house with a garden and a dog. Lily loved to play with the dog and help grandma with the flowers. "Are you ready, Lily?" asked mom. "We have to go soon." "Yes, mom!" said Lily. She put on her shoes and her coat. She grabbed her backpack. Inside, she had a drawing for grandma and grandpa. She had made it with crayons and stickers. It was a picture of a rainbow and a sun. They got in the car and drove to grandma and grandpa's house. Lily looked out the window and saw the trees and the birds. She sang a song with mom. She was very excited. When they arrived, grandma and grandpa were waiting for them. They hugged and kissed Lily and mom. They said they were happy to see them. "Look what I made for you!" said Lily. She showed them her drawing. "It's a rainbow and a sun. Do you like it?" "Oh, Lily, it's beautiful!" said grandma. "Thank you so much. You are very talented." "We love it, Lily," said grandpa. "You are very kind. Can we hang it on the fridge?" "Yes, please!" said Lily. She smiled. She was proud of her drawing. They went inside and had some cookies and milk. They talked and laughed. Lily told them about her school and her friends. She asked them about their dog and their garden. She said she wanted to play with them. "Of course, Lily," said grandma. "We have a lot of fun things to do. You can help me feed the birds and water the plants. You can also play fetch with the dog. He likes you a lot." "And you can help me build a birdhouse," said grandpa. "I have some wood and some tools. You can paint it with your favorite colors. We can hang it on a tree." "Wow, that sounds awesome!" said Lily. She clapped her hands. She was very happy. She loved to visit her grandma and grandpa. They were very nice and fun. They always had something new to show her. They always made her feel special. She believed that they were the best grandma and grandpa in the world. And she was their regular visitor.

Peter was walking around the park. He saw a funny joke and began to laugh. He wanted to taste it so he reached out his hands. But as soon as he touched it, the joke went away! He was surprised and wondered where it had gone. Suddenly, an organized group of ants appeared. They had the joke in their hands. Peter asked the ants if he could have the joke, and they all agreed. He carefully reached out and took the joke. He slowly tasted it. It was sweet and crunchy at the same time! Peter smiled and thanked the ants. The ants were happy that Peter liked the joke and they said goodbye. Peter held the joke in his hands until he got home. He shared the sweet joke with his family, and they all laughed. The joke was a success!

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the zoo with his mom. They saw many animals, but Tim's favorite was the big, incredible tiger. The tiger had pretty stripes and a long tail. Tim liked to watch the tiger play with a big ball. When they got close to the tiger, Tim's mom told him to be quiet and whisper. She said the tiger might get scared if they were too loud. So, Tim whispered to his mom, "I want to be friends with the tiger." Tim's mom had an idea. She bought a toy tiger from the zoo shop for Tim. Tim was so happy. He whispered to the toy tiger, "You are my new friend." They played together all the way home.

Once upon a time, there was a round ball named Bally. Bally was an honest ball and loved to play with his friends. One day, Bally met a new friend named Tiny. Tiny was a small bug who wanted to play with Bally, but he was too small. Bally said to Tiny, "I wish I could shrink so we can play together!" Tiny smiled and said, "I know a magic word that can make you shrink. Say 'shrinky-dink' and you will become small like me!" Bally said the magic word, "shrinky-dink!" Suddenly, Bally began to shrink until he was the same size as Tiny. They were both very happy and played together all day long. At the end of the day, Bally said the magic word again and grew back to his normal size. Bally and Tiny became best friends and played together every day.

One day, a boy named Tim and his dog, Sam, went for a long walk. They liked to play a game. Tim would throw a ball and Sam would run to get it. They were very happy playing this game. As they played, they met a girl named Sue. Sue asked, "Can I play with you?" Tim said, "Yes, you can throw the ball for Sam." Sue threw the ball to the left, and Sam ran to get it. They all laughed and had fun. But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird came down and took the ball away! Tim, Sue, and Sam looked at each other, surprised. They decided to find the bird and get the ball back. Together, they went on a new adventure to find the big bird and their ball.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a toy spear. He loved to play with his spear all day long. One day, Tom felt uncomfortable. His tummy hurt a lot. He wondered what was wrong. Tom went to his mom and asked her a question. "Mom, why does my tummy hurt?" His mom thought for a moment and said, "Maybe you ate too much candy, Tom." Tom knew he ate a lot of candy, so he thought his mom was right. Tom's mom told him to rest and not play with his spear for a while. Tom listened to his mom and took a nap. When he woke up, he felt much better. Tom learned that eating too much candy can make him feel uncomfortable. He decided to eat less candy and play with his spear more.

Once upon a time, there was a big, important machine. It lived in a small house with a little girl named Lily. Lily loved her machine very much. Every day, they played and had fun together. One day, the machine stopped working. Lily was very sad. She wanted her machine to work again. She tried to fix it, but she did not know how. She asked her mom for help. Her mom looked at the machine and found a way to fix it. After a while, the machine started working again. Lily was so happy! She hugged the machine and said, "I love you, machine!" The machine was important to Lily because it was her best friend. From that day on, they played together all the time and had lots of fun.

One day, a little girl named Amy wanted to help her mom cook. Her mom said, "You can help me measure the sugar." Amy was happy to help. She took a spoon and put sugar in a cup. Amy saw that the sugar was wet. "Oh no," she thought, "I can't use wet sugar." She ran to her mom and said, "Mom, the sugar is wet. What do I do?" Her mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, we can dry it." Amy and her mom put the wet sugar in the sun. They waited and played. Soon, the sugar was dry. They measured it again with the spoon. Now they could cook together. Amy was proud to help her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a big cook named Tom. He loved to cook yummy food for everyone. One day, Tom was going to the store to buy food. He saw many cars and people. It was traffic. Tom thought it was boring. Tom walked and walked until he saw a big tree. He thought it would be fun to climb it. He climbed up and up. When he was at the top, he saw something strange. It was a big, red button. Tom wanted to see what the button did. He pushed it. Suddenly, all the cars and people in the traffic started to dance! The cars danced, the people danced, and even the dogs danced. The boring traffic was now fun! Everyone laughed and clapped. Tom climbed down the tree and went to the store. He bought food and cooked a big meal for all his new friends. And from that day, Tom and his friends would always remember the day the boring traffic turned into a dance party.

One day, a little boy named Tim was walking in the park. He saw a man with a troubled face. The man was looking at his shirt. Tim went to the man and said, "What's wrong?" The man said, "I spilled juice on my shirt. I don't know how to clean it." Tim thought for a moment and then said, "Let's go to the water and wash it." They went to the water and Tim helped the man clean his shirt. The man was very happy. He said, "Thank you, Tim. You are very kind." From that day, Tim learned that helping others can make them happy. And when we help others, we feel happy too.

Once upon a time there was a poor girl who lived in a small house. Every day she would step out of her house carrying a spoon. One day, she was walking down the street when she ran into her friend John. John asked her, "What are you doing with the spoon?" The girl smiled and said, "I am going to the park to feed the birds. I am very poor and can't afford much food for them, so I take this spoon to scoop some water for them." John smiled and said, "Let me come with you!" The girl smiled happily as she stepped closer to the park with John. They soon reached the spot where the birds were chirping, and John helped her to scoop some water with the spoon. The birds thanked them with many happy tweets. The girl and John grinned as they watched the birds enjoying the water. They both felt very happy that they had helped the poor birds in such a small way.

Alice was a little girl who loved going to the park to play. One day, she brought her friend Jack along with her to join all the fun. As they walked through the park, Alice spotted a large hairy animal. She ran up to it and asked Jack, "What's that?" He replied, "That's a golf. It's a funny animal!" Alice was delighted and started to applaud for the golf, who seemed very pleased. The golf started to follow Alice and Jack around, and Jack said, "It likes us!" Alice and Jack continued to play as the golf watched, and Alice said, "Let's give it a pet!" Jack said, "Yes, it's so hairy!" They both reached out and petted the golf, who enjoyed their attention and started purring. Alice and Jack laughed and applauded the golf again, before they left the park. The golf seemed to know they had to go and waved its paw goodbye, before settling down in the grass for a nap.

Once upon a time, there was a famous doctor. He could heal anyone. People liked him a lot. They came from far away to get better. The doctor was very happy to help them. One day, a man came to the doctor. The man had a bad lung. The doctor wanted to help him. He tried and tried but the lung did not heal. The doctor was sad. He did not know what to do. Then, something unexpected happened. A little bird came to the doctor. The bird sang a special song. The man with the bad lung started to feel better. His lung was healed! The doctor was very happy. The little bird was the one who healed the man. Now, they all were friends and helped people together.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man named Bob. He had a big house and many toys. One day, he saw a sack in his yard. He did not know what was in it. He wanted to find out. Bob opened the sack and found oil inside. "Oh no!" he said. "This oil will make my yard dirty!" He did not want the oil to spill. He needed help to move the sack. He asked his friend, Tom, to help. Tom came over and they both tried to lift the sack. But it was too heavy! They tried and tried, but they could not move it. They were sad and tired. Then, a strong man named Sam walked by. He saw Bob and Tom struggling. "I can help you," Sam said. He picked up the sack with one hand and took it away. Bob and Tom were happy and thanked Sam. From that day on, Bob, Tom, and Sam became best friends. They played together and had fun every day. And Bob's yard stayed clean and pretty.

One day, a hairy dog named Max went for a walk. He wore his favorite pants. Max loved his pants because they were red and fun. Max walked and walked, and then he saw a big tree. Max blinked his eyes and saw a squirrel. The squirrel blinked back at Max. Max wanted to play with the squirrel. He ran and ran, but the squirrel was fast. Max was sad. Then, something unexpected happened. Max's pants got caught on a branch. Max blinked and looked at his pants. The squirrel came back and helped Max. They both laughed and became friends. Max was happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He lived in a small hut with his mom and dad. The hut was near a big tree and a river. Tim loved to play outside with his friends. One sunny day, Tim saw an enormous frog near the river. The frog was green and shiny. Tim asked the frog, "Why are you so big?" The frog said, "I drank a lot of water from the river." Tim thought it was funny and wanted to be big too. Tim took a cup and went to the river. He poured water into the cup and drank it. But he didn't become big. He tried again and again, but nothing happened. Then, the frog laughed and said, "I was just joking! Drinking water won't make you big." Tim laughed too and they became friends. From that day on, Tim and the enormous frog played together near the river every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a favorite glass. The glass was red and shiny. Amy was proud of her glass. She used it every day. One day, Amy's friend, Ben, came to play. They played with dolls and cars. They had fun. Then, it was time for a drink. Amy showed Ben her proud glass. "Look, Ben! My glass is so pretty!" she said. Ben liked the glass too. But, when Amy went to get water, she dropped the glass. It broke. Amy was sad. Ben said, "Don't be sad, Amy. We can fix it." They tried to fix the glass, but it didn't work. Amy's mom came and said, "It's okay, Amy. We can get a new glass. Don't let it spoil your fun day." Amy smiled and played with Ben again. The broken glass didn't spoil their day.

Once upon a time there was a brave knight. He was going to fight a dragon! The dragon was big and strong and it made the brave knight scared. He knew the dragon was tough and he thought he was in trouble. The knight said to the dragon, "I surrender! Please don't be angry!" But the dragon was angry and said "No! You will not surrender!" The knight was so scared and he didn't know what to do! The knight started to cry. He was so sad and scared and he couldn't fight the dragon any more. He felt so bitter and helpless. Then suddenly, the dragon stopped and said "Okay, I will let you surrender!". The knight was so happy and relieved. He thanked the dragon and the dragon told the knight to go home. The brave knight went home and never fought a dragon again. He knew that he could never win a fight against a dragon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. One day, while he was playing in the park, he saw something shiny. It was a pretty gem! The gem was red and sparkly. Tim was very happy to find it. Tim wanted to show his friends the gem. He ran to find his friends, Tom and Lily. When they saw the gem, they were amazed. They thought it was beautiful too. They all wanted to play with the gem. But then, a foolish squirrel appeared. It ran up to Tim and took the gem from his hand! The squirrel ran away with the gem. Tim, Tom, and Lily chased the squirrel, but it was too fast. The gem was gone. They were sad, but they learned that it was just a thing. They still had fun playing together in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toy planes. One day, his mom said, "Let's go to the airport!" Tim was very excited. At the airport, Tim saw big planes and small planes. He felt dizzy from all the noise and running around. His mom suggested they sit down and watch the planes take off. Tim sat and watched the planes fly away. But then, he saw a plane that looked like it was in trouble. The plane tried to fly, but it fell down and went boom. Tim was sad and scared. The end.

One day, Sam and his mom were baking cookies in the kitchen. Sam liked to help his mom stir the dough and put it on the tray. He wore his blue bathrobe that was soft and warm. He felt very cheerful and happy. But then, Sam smelled something bad. He looked at the oven and saw smoke coming out. The cookies were burning! Sam and his mom ran to the oven and turned it off. They opened the door and saw the black and crispy cookies. They were sad and disappointed. Sam's mom said, "It's okay, Sam. We can make more cookies later. Let's go outside and play for a while." She took off her apron and put on her coat. She helped Sam take off his bathrobe and put on his jacket. They went outside and saw the sun shining and the birds singing. They felt cheerful and happy again. They played with Sam's ball and his bike. They saw their neighbor, Lily, and her dog, Spot. They said hello and joined them. They had fun and laughed a lot. They forgot about the burned cookies and enjoyed the day. They were glad and grateful.

One day, a little bird was sad. It had no friends to play with. It sat on a tree branch and cried. A boy named Tim saw the bird and wanted to help. Tim said, "Bird, why are you sad?" The bird said, "I have no friends to share my food with." Tim had an idea. He went to his house and got some bread. Tim and the bird shared the bread. They both were happy. The bird was not sad anymore. They became best friends and shared food every day. And the bird always had a friend to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom had a best friend named Max. They played together every day. One day, they found a big ball to play with. Tom wanted to play catch, but Max wanted to kick the ball. They did not agree. This made Tom angry. He threw the ball at Max's shoulder. Max said, "Ouch!" Max was sad, but Tom said sorry. They decided to take turns playing catch and kicking the ball. They played all day and were happy again.

Once there was an impatient skeleton. He wanted something to do, so he decided to provide a service. He started by delivering food to the hungry. Every day, he would take some food to them and put a big smile on his face. Next, the skeleton decided to take care of the animals. He would take the cows to the meadow and give the chickens their food. He was always gentle and kind with them. Finally, the skeleton was ready to provide a service for people. He offered to help little children cross the street safely. He made sure to always be there to guide them. The skeleton was very happy to be able to provide so much help to others. In the end, the skeleton was no longer impatient and he was content.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow bird. The bird liked to dress up. Every day, it put on a little hat. One day, the bird found a whistle. It blew the whistle. The sound was fun. The bird was happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The bird blew the whistle and a big dog came. The dog could dress up too! The bird and the dog became friends. They dressed up and played together. The end.

Lily and Max are twins. They like to play with their toys and watch television. But sometimes they do not agree on what to watch or play. Then they get angry and ignore each other. One day, Lily wants to watch a show about princesses and fairies. Max wants to watch a show about cars and trucks. They both grab the remote and try to change the channel. They shout and push each other. "Let me watch my show!" Lily says. "No, let me watch my show!" Max says. Mom hears the noise and comes to the living room. She sees Lily and Max fighting over the remote. She is not happy. "Stop it, you two!" Mom says. "You need to share and take turns. Or you can watch something else that you both like." But Lily and Max do not listen to Mom. They keep ignoring her and each other. They only care about their own show. Mom sighs and takes the remote from them. She turns off the television. "Enough!" Mom says. "You are both being rude and selfish. You need a time out. Go to your rooms and think about what you did." Lily and Max are shocked. They do not want to go to their rooms. They want to watch television. But they know Mom is serious. They go to their rooms and close the door. They sit on their beds and feel sad and bored. They wish they had listened to Mom. They wish they had not ignored her and each other. They realize they miss their twin and their show. They get up and go to the door. They knock and call each other. "Lily, I'm sorry. Can we watch your show?" Max says. "Max, I'm sorry. Can we watch your show?" Lily says. They open the door and hug each other. They say they are sorry to Mom too. Mom smiles and hugs them. She says they can watch television again, but they have to share and take turns. And they have to be nice and respectful. Lily and Max agree. They go to the living room and watch television together. They find a show that they both like. It is about animals and adventures. They laugh and talk and have fun. They are not angry and ignore each other anymore. They are happy and love each other. They are sleepy too. They cuddle on the couch and fall asleep. Mom covers them with a blanket and kisses them good night.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow cat named Sunny. Sunny loved to play with her friends in the park. One day, Sunny saw a big print on the ground. She did not know what it was. Sunny asked her friend, a little bird, "Do you know what this print is?" The bird said, "I think it is from a big animal. Be careful, Sunny!" Sunny was scared, but she wanted to find the big animal. Sunny followed the prints and found a big, friendly dog. The dog said, "I can make things disappear!" Sunny asked the dog to show her. The dog made a ball disappear and then brought it back. Sunny and the dog became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a smart dog named Max. Max could speak like people. He had many friends who liked to listen to him. They thought Max was very special. One day, Max's friend, a cat named Lily, had to go for an operation. Max and his friends were worried. They wanted to help Lily feel better. So, they planned a big surprise for her when she came back. After the operation, Lily came back and saw her friends. They all said, "Surprise!" Lily was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. Lily started to speak like Max! The operation had made her speak like people too. Now, Max and Lily could talk to each other and their friends. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in an ordinary big forest, there lived a big elephant. The elephant was very nice and loved to play with his friends. Every day, they would run, jump, and laugh together. One day, the elephant saw a little car. He thought, "I want to drive the car!" So, the elephant asked his friend, the bird, "Can you help me drive the car?" The bird said, "Yes, I can help you!" They were very happy. The elephant and the bird got in the car. The elephant tried to drive, but he was too big. The bird helped him by pushing the buttons. They drove around the forest, laughing and having fun. All the other animals watched and clapped. The elephant and the bird were very happy that they could drive the car together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was grumpy every morning because he didn't like to eat cereal for breakfast. One day, Tim's mom had an idea to make him happy. She told Tim that after he eats his cereal, he can ride his bike outside. Tim ate his cereal very fast and ran outside to ride his bike. He was so excited! As he rode his bike, he saw a little girl who was very sad. Tim stopped and asked her why she was sad. The little girl said that she had no food to eat in the morning. Tim felt bad for her. Tim decided to share his cereal with the little girl the next day. The next morning, Tim was not grumpy anymore. He ate his cereal and took some to the little girl. They ate together and played outside. Tim learned that sharing with others can make him happy too.

Once there was a puppy called Fleur. She was a small and fluffy black puppy. Every day, her family used to remind her to stay away from the street. They put a collar on her so she knew not to cross the line that was near the street. One day, Fleur was running in the garden when she saw something. It was a cat! She started to bark and quickly ran across the line without her collar. Her family heard her barking and quickly ran after her. When they found Fleur, they were very worried. But luckily, the cat was just walking around. It went away and Fleur was safe. They reminded her again that she must stay away from the street so she can stay healthy. Fleur nodded and they put the collar back on her. From then on, Fleur always remembered to stay away from the street and always listened to her family. She was a very healthy pup and she was loved by all.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old. One day, she wanted to do something special. Her mum said, “Let’s do a task. It will be fun!” The task was to build a tower with blocks. Lucy thought it would be a fair challenge. She and her mum worked together to improve their tower. Together, they put the blocks on top of each other carefully. “This looks great," said Lucy's mum. "Let's try to make it even better!" So, Lucy and her mum added some more blocks. Then, they added decorations. Lucy was so proud of the tower when they were done. "That looks amazing," said Lucy's mum. "We did a great job together! We improved the task, and we made it fair." Lucy smiled and was very proud of herself. She had learned that working together with her mum was a lot of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful hoop. It was very shiny and colorful. The hoop lived in a big park where many children played. One day, a little boy named Tim saw the hoop. He said, "Wow! What a pretty hoop!" He wanted to play with it. So, Tim picked up the hoop and started to spin it around. The hoop made a fun ringing sound as it spun. Tim laughed and clapped his hands. Tim's friend, Sue, came to the park and saw Tim playing with the hoop. She asked, "Can I play with the hoop too?" Tim said, "Yes, of course!" They took turns spinning the beautiful hoop and listened to the ringing sound it made. They played with the hoop all day long, and they both had lots of fun.

Mia and Tom went to the gym together. Mia grabbed the bags they were carrying. Tom was so happy. The gym was huge and long. Mia saw lots of things to do. She saw a big ball to grab, a big slide to go down, and a trampoline to jump on. Mia reached out and grabbed the ball. She tossed it to Tom who laughed as he caught it. They ran around the gym and had so much fun. They ran up and down the big slide and jumped high on the trampoline. They even grabbed a long rope and held on for a long time. They laughed and shouted until it was time to go home. They were so happy and tired that even the bags seemed much lighter when Mia grabbed them.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Jack was walking in the forest. He was feeling nice and calm, until he heard a sound coming from a nearby castle. He went to investigate and see what it was. When he got closer to the castle, he heard the sound getting louder. It was laughter! He opened the castle's door to see who or what was inside. He saw a beautiful princess inside, laughing away. The happy sight made Jack smile, and he decided he wanted to join in with her laughter. He started laughing and the princess quickly stopped. Jack said he was sorry for startling her, and the princess apologized for scaring him. The princess invited Jack to explore the castle with her. As they explored, their laughter only got louder and the princess taught Jack how to play different kinds of games. The two of them were so happy in the castle and the laughter they shared filled the castle with joy. The happiness they felt in this moment will stay in the castle forever.

Anna and Ben are playing in the garden. They have a big box of toys. Anna likes to display her toys on the grass. She makes a line of dolls, cars, balls and books. Ben likes to play with his axe. It is a toy axe, but it looks real. It is pink, because Ben likes pink. "Look at my axe!" Ben says to Anna. "It is so cool and strong. I can chop anything with it." Anna looks at Ben's axe. She does not like it. She thinks it is silly and ugly. She likes her toys better. She says to Ben, "Your axe is not cool. It is pink. Pink is for girls. And you cannot chop anything with it. It is a toy." Ben feels angry. He does not like what Anna says. He thinks pink is for everyone. And he likes his toy axe. He says to Anna, "You are wrong. Pink is not for girls. Pink is for everyone. And my axe can chop anything. It is a toy, but it is also real. Watch this!" Ben runs to Anna's line of toys. He raises his axe and swings it down. He chops Anna's dolls, cars, balls and books. He makes a big mess. Anna screams. She is very sad and mad. She runs to Ben and pushes him. She says, "Stop it! Stop it! You are mean and bad. You broke my toys. I hate you!" Ben and Anna start to fight. They hit and kick and bite each other. They cry and shout. Their mom hears them. She comes to the garden. She sees the mess and the fight. She is very shocked and angry. She says, "What are you doing? Why are you fighting? Why did you break the toys? You are naughty and rude. You have to say sorry and share. And you have to clean up this mess. Now!" Ben and Anna stop fighting. They feel sorry and ashamed. They say sorry to each other and to their mom. They hug and make up. They help each other to clean up the mess. They put the toys back in the box. They decide to play nicely and share. They say, "We are sorry, mom. We love you. We love each other. We will not fight again. We will play nicely and share. Can we have a snack now?" Their mom smiles. She is happy and proud. She says, "I am glad you are sorry and you love each other. You are good and kind. You can have a snack now. But no more axes, okay?" Ben and Anna nod. They agree. They say, "Okay, mom. No more axes. We will play with something else. How about a ball?" Their mom says, "A ball is fine. But be careful and gentle. And have fun." Ben and Anna take the ball and go to the garden. They play with the ball and have fun. They are happy and friendly. They forget about the axe and the mess. They are good and kind. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very fast runner. He loved to zip around the playground and race with his friends. One day, Tim's teacher wrote a game on the blackboard. The game was to see who could run the fastest. Tim was excited to play the game. He knew he was fast, but he wanted to be the fastest. So, Tim practiced running every day. He would run to the blackboard and back, zip, zip, zip! All the other kids wanted to be as fast as Tim, but they couldn't keep up. One day, Tim noticed that his friend Sam was sad. Sam was not fast like Tim. Tim decided to help Sam run faster. They practiced together, and Sam got faster too. In the end, Tim and Sam raced together and won the game. They learned that helping others is more important than being the fastest. And that is the moral of the story: always help your friends, and you will both be winners.

One day, a boy named Sam went to search for a fancy stamp. He looked in his toy box, under his bed, and in his closet. He wanted to find the fancy stamp to put on a letter to his grandma. Sam loved his grandma very much. While he was searching, Sam found a big box in the corner of his room. He opened the box and saw many fancy stamps! He was very happy. Sam picked the prettiest stamp and put it on the letter. Sam showed his mom the fancy stamp on the letter. His mom smiled and said, "Sam, those are not just fancy stamps. They are magic stamps!" Sam was surprised. He didn't know that the stamps were magic. Now, he was even more excited to send the letter to his grandma.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy goat. He liked to speak to everyone. One day, he saw a big box. The goat wanted to know what was inside. He went close to the box and tried to open it. But the box was too heavy for him. The nosy goat did not give up. He went to find his friend, a strong horse. The goat asked the horse to help him open the box. The horse was happy to help. They went back to the box and the horse used his strong legs to open it. When the box opened, they found many balls inside. The goat and the horse were happy and started to play with the balls. But then, something unexpected happened. The balls started to speak! The balls were magical and could talk. The goat and the horse were very surprised but they became friends with the talking balls. They all played together and had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She had a case. Inside the case was something special. It was a toy. The girl brought the case to the park. The park was very peaceful. The trees were tall and the sun was shining. The girl felt happy. The girl opened the case and pulled out the toy. She laughed and played with it. Suddenly, she heard a sigh. It was a small, sad sigh. The girl looked around but she couldn't see anyone. Then she saw a little boy on the bench. He was sad and he had no toys. The girl smiled at him and gave him the toy from her case. The boy smiled and the girl sighed with happiness. The park was peaceful again.

Once upon a time, there was a hungry octopus named Ollie. Ollie lived in the deep blue sea. He had lots of friends, but his best friend was a little fish named Fin. One day, Ollie and Fin were playing a game. They would throw a small rock back and forth to each other. Ollie would use his long arms to throw the rock to Fin. Then, Fin would use his tail to throw the rock back to Ollie. They laughed and had a lot of fun. As they played, Ollie's tummy started to rumble. He said to Fin, "I am very hungry. Let's find some food." Fin agreed and they swam together to look for food. They found a big pile of yummy fish and shared it with each other. After they ate, Ollie and Fin were happy and full. They went back to playing their fun game, throwing the small rock and laughing with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty little girl named Lily. She loved winter because she could play in the snow. One day, Lily went outside to build a snowman. She started to roll a big snowball for the snowman's body. Then, she rolled a smaller one for the head. Lily put the smaller snowball on top of the big one. "Now I need to add a face," Lily said. She found two small rocks for the eyes and a carrot for the nose. She used a long stick for the mouth. Lily's friend, Tim, came over to see her snowman. "Wow, that's a big snowman!" Tim said. "Can I add something too?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, let's add a hat and a scarf to keep him warm!" So they found a hat and a scarf and put them on the snowman. They laughed and played in the snow all day. The pretty winter day was perfect for making new friends and having fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys and equipment. One day, he went to the park with his mom. He was very excited to play on the equipment there. In the park, Tim saw a big chair. He thought it would be fun to sit on it. But when he sat down, he felt uncomfortable. The chair was hard and not nice to sit on. Tim was sad and didn't want to play anymore. Then, something unexpected happened. The big chair started to move! It turned out that the chair was a secret door to a fun play area. Tim's mom helped him go inside, and they found the most amazing play equipment ever. Tim was so happy and played all day long.

One day, a girl named Lucy went with her mom to the store. They needed to buy some food. Lucy's mom let her drive the little toy car cart. Lucy was so happy she could drive. In the store, Lucy saw a big green avocado. She asked her mom, "Can we get the avocado, please?" Her mom said, "Sure, Lucy. It's available. We can buy it." They took the avocado home. Lucy and her mom made a yummy snack with it. They shared it with Lucy's dad and little brother. Everyone liked the avocado snack. Lucy was happy she could help.

Once upon a time, there was a mule. The mule liked to cook. One day, he cooked a big cake. He was very happy. A scary cat saw the mule with the cake. The cat wanted the cake too. The scary cat jumped on the mule. The mule was scared. But then, something unexpected happened. The scary cat did not take the cake. The cat just wanted to help cook. The mule and the scary cat became friends. They cooked a new cake together. They were both happy.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toy cars. He had a big network of roads made with blocks for his cars to drive on. One day, Tim's big sister, Sue, came into his room. Sue wanted to play with her dolls, but Tim did not want to share his roads. They began to fight. Sue got mad and decided to scatter Tim's toy cars all over the room. Tim was very sad and started to cry. As they were fighting, their mom came into the room. She saw the mess and was not happy. She told Tim and Sue to clean up the room and go to bed. That night, both Tim and Sue went to bed sad and angry.

Once upon a time, there was a noisy bird named Bob. Bob loved to sing all day long. One day, he met a big cat named Sam. Sam had big muscles and was very strong. Bob said, "Hi Sam, let's be friends and play together!" Sam replied, "Okay, but we must prepare for a race. I am very fast and you must be fast too!" Bob was worried because he was not as fast as Sam. The day of the race came. Bob and Sam stood at the starting line. The race began and Sam ran very fast. Bob tried to keep up, but he was not fast enough. He felt sad and thought he would lose. Suddenly, Bob had an idea. He used his wings to fly and started to catch up with Sam. Sam was surprised and said, "Wow, you are fast when you fly!" In the end, Bob and Sam finished the race together. From that day on, Bob and Sam became best friends. They learned that they could play together even if they were different. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to a pond. He saw a frog sitting on a rock. Tim said, "Hi, frog! Can you imagine if we could play together?" The frog looked at Tim and said, "Yes, I can imagine! But I need a toy to play with. Can you find one for me?" Tim looked around and found a ball. It was the only available toy. He gave it to the frog, and they started to play. They were having so much fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The ball fell into the pond and started to float away. Tim and the frog were sad. Just then, a friendly fish swam up to the ball and pushed it back to Tim and the frog. They were so happy! They thanked the fish and continued to play together, now with a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a colorful fish named Fin. Fin loved to swim and play with his friends in the big blue sea. One day, Fin saw a square box on the bottom of the sea. He was very curious and wanted to see what was inside. Fin called his friends and said, "Let's dive down and look at the square box!" So, they all swam down to the bottom of the sea. The fish were very excited to see the square box. They swam around it and tried to open it. Finally, the square box opened! Inside, there were many colorful toys for the fish to play with. Fin and his friends had so much fun playing with the toys. They were very happy that they had found the square box. And from that day on, Fin and his friends played with the colorful toys every day.

The little polar bear was very lonely. He lived in a beautiful igloo, but there was nobody else around. He wanted a friend, but he couldn't find one. One day, the polar bear had a brilliant idea. He decided to explore the ice and see what he could find. It was a long journey, but he was determined. After walking for hours, he came across another igloo. Popcorn was cooking inside and he could smell it through the air. He approached the door and knocked. A friendly-looking walrus opened it. "Hello!" he said. The polar bear told the walrus about being lonely and wanting a friend. The walrus smiled and said, "Well, why don't you stay here with me? We'll have lots of fun!" The polar bear was filled with joy. He knew that he had made the right decision! Now, he had a friend and was no longer lonely.

One day, Tom and Sue went to a big house. The big house had a thing called an elevator. The elevator helps people go up and down. Tom and Sue wanted to use the elevator, but they had a quarrel. Tom wanted to go up, and Sue wanted to go down. Tom said, "Let's go up! I want to see the bright sky." Sue said, "No, I want to go down and play with my toys." They were not happy with each other. They did not know what to do. Then, their mommy came. She told them, "You can both have what you want. First, we will go up and see the bright sky. Then, we will go down and play with the toys." Tom and Sue agreed. They went up in the elevator and saw the bright sky. After that, they went down and played with the toys. They were happy and did not quarrel anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big ball of clay. The clay was different colors. It was red, blue, and yellow. The clay lived in a big box with other toys. One day, the clay wanted to play with the toys. The toys were all different too. Some toys were big, and some toys were small. The clay asked the toys, "Can I play with you?" But the toys disagreed. They said, "No, you are too different." The clay was sad. It wanted to play with the toys. So, the clay had an idea. It broke into three parts. The red part played with the big toys. The blue part played with the small toys. And the yellow part played with the toys that were different like the clay. Now, all the toys were happy. They played together and had fun. The clay was not sad anymore. It was happy because it could play with all the toys. And the toys learned that being different is not bad. It can be fun!

One day, a boy named Tim found a pen on the ground. He picked it up and looked at it. It was a very nice pen. Tim wanted to draw a picture with the pen. So, Tim went to his friend, Sam. "Look, Sam! I found a pen!" said Tim. Sam looked at the pen and smiled. "Let's draw a picture together!" said Sam. They started to draw a big, pretty picture. As they drew, they saw a distant hill far away. They wanted to go there. So, Tim and Sam walked to the hill. When they got there, they saw a big, wet puddle. They did not want to get wet, but they wanted to go to the other side. "Let's jump over the puddle!" said Tim. They jumped over the puddle, but Sam fell in. He was all wet! Tim helped Sam up and they laughed. Then, they saw a big, soft towel on the ground. Tim picked it up and helped Sam wipe the water off. After that, they went back to their picture. But something unexpected happened. The picture they drew came to life! They saw a big, pretty bird fly out of the paper. Tim and Sam were so happy. They played with the bird and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Amos who was very hungry. He sniffed around his forest looking for food, but he had no luck. As he walked through the wood, he saw a fox playing with a big fish. Amos asked the fox why he was not eating the fish. The fox answered, "I am going to trade the fish for some water. I am very thirsty." Amos realized that the fox was thirsty and he was hungry. He thought for a moment and then had an idea. He said to the fox, "Let's make a trade. You give me the fish and I'll give you a nice, juicy berry." The fox agreed and the two traded. The fox slurped up his water and Amos gobbled up the fish. The moral of the story is: food can be shared when we are both thirsty and hungry. By trading with one another, we can both get what we need.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who loved to hop. He hopped through the fields, he hopped over the hills, and he even hopped over desks. He hopped and hopped until he was all hot and sweaty. One day, the bunny hopped to a dry desk. It was situated right in the middle of a vast field. He sat on the desk for a moment and soaked in the sun. Then he hopped off. The bunny hopped across the field. Soon he hopped to a dry river. He hopped from stone to stone and crossed the river. Then he hopped to the other side of the field. At the end of the day, the bunny hopped back to the dry desk. With a happy hop and a jump, his long day of hopping was done.

One day, a big clock was in a room. The clock was scary. It had a loud sound. It went "tick-tock, tick-tock" all day and night. The people in the house did not like the clock. They said, "We do not like this scary clock. We want it to go away." A little boy named Tim heard the people. He wanted to help. Tim went to the clock and said, "Clock, you are scary. Can you please be quiet?" The clock stopped making the loud sound. It was quiet now. The people were happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The house was too quiet. The people could not sleep. They missed the clock's sound. They said, "We want the clock to go 'tick-tock' again." So Tim went to the clock and said, "Clock, can you please make the sound again?" The clock went "tick-tock" again, but not too loud. The people were happy and they all slept well.

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there was a little healthy bird. The bird lived in a tree with her family. She loved to fly and sing all day long. One day, while flying, the little bird saw a twig on the ground. She thought it would be perfect for her nest. So, she picked it up with her beak and flew back to her tree. When she got back to her tree, she heard her family singing. They were so happy to see her and the twig. The little bird put the twig in her nest, and they all sang together. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a little bird named Ben. He had a very special skill - he could reverse the world! Poor Ben was always lonely, until one day, something magical happened. A beautiful unicorn appeared in the sky and said, "Ben, would you like to come with me and explore the magical world?" Ben was so excited that he could hardly speak but he managed to say, "Yes please!" The unicorn flew with him through the clouds and showed him all kinds of new places. Ben was amazed by the sights and sounds he experienced. Fluffy clouds, twinkling stars, singing birds and colourful rainbows. But then something strange happened. The unicorn said, "Ben, watch carefully..." and then it used its magical powers to reverse the world. Everything became upside down! Ben was so amazed that he couldn't speak. But then the unicorn said, "Don't worry Ben - I can always reverse the world back if you want." Ben smiled and said, "Yes please!" So the unicorn used its magical powers to reverse the world back and Ben was happy again. From then on, Ben and the unicorn became great friends and they enjoyed exploring the magical world together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a toy boat. He loved to sail it in the water. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He wanted to sail his boat in the pond. At the pond, Tim met a man. The man was not very smart. He was ignorant. The man saw Tim's boat and said, "I want to sail your boat too!" Tim was not happy but said, "Okay, but be careful." The man did not know how to tie the string to the boat. He tried, but it was wrong. The boat started to sail away. Tim was sad. The ignorant man did not know how to get the boat back. The boat sailed far away, and Tim never saw his boat again. The end.
