Spot was very good at counting. They put the cups in a line, from one to five. As they were playing, the wind blew very hard. The cups fell down. Spot and Lily were sad. But then, they had an idea. They put the cups under the big tree. The tree stopped the wind from blowing the cups. Spot and Lily were happy. They played the game all day. They learned that playing together was more fun than playing alone.

Once upon a time, there was a humble ant named Tim. Tim lived in a big ant hill with his family. Every day, Tim and his friends would go to the store to get food for their family. One day, when Tim was at the store, he saw a long line of ants waiting to get food. Tim was very tired, but he knew he had to wait in line to get food for his family. So, Tim waited and waited in the line. While Tim was waiting, a big wind came and blew all the food away. The ants were sad and didn't know what to do. But Tim had an idea. He told all the ants to work together to find more food. The ants worked together and found even more food than before. The ants were happy and learned that working together makes things better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a friend named Tim. They liked to play together. One day, they wanted to make a cake. They were very patient while they waited for all the ingredients. Lucy said, "Let's stir the mix!" Tim agreed and they took turns stirring the cake mix. They stirred and stirred until it was smooth. They were good friends, so they shared the work. When the cake was ready, they put it in the oven. They waited patiently for it to bake. When it was done, they took it out and let it cool. Then, they ate the cake together. They were happy because they made the cake together, and it was very yummy.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Amy loved to skip. She skipped everywhere she went. One day, while skipping, she found a big red alarm. She did not know what it was, but she thought it was pretty. So, she took it home with her. Amy showed the alarm to her mom. Her mom was not happy. She told Amy that the alarm was important and they needed to find who lost it. Amy felt frustrated but knew her mom was right. They went back to the place where Amy found the alarm. As they walked, they saw a fireman looking sad. Amy's mom asked him if he lost something. The fireman said he lost a big red alarm. Amy and her mom gave him the alarm, and he was very happy. The fireman thanked Amy and her mom for their help. They all smiled, and Amy skipped home with her mom, feeling proud of what they did.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to a bright park with her mom. Lily saw a big tree with a cute bird on it. She wanted to say "hi" to the bird, so she walked to the tree. As Lily got close, she saw the bird had a cup in its nest. The cup was blue and shiny. Lily wanted to see the cup up close, so she asked the bird, "Can I see your cup, please?" The bird said, "Yes, but you must raise your hand high to reach the cup." So, Lily raised her hand as high as she could, and the bird gave her the cup. Lily looked at the cup and said, "This is a very nice cup. Thank you for sharing!" Lily gave the cup back to the bird, and they both said "bye" to each other. Then, Lily and her mom went home, happy after a fun day at the bright park.

Tim and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their toy cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. They make sounds like vroom and beep when they move their cars. One day, they find a big bunch of grapes in the kitchen. They think the grapes are shiny and sweet. They want to eat some, but they have an idea. They decide to use the grapes as wheels for their cars. They take some grapes and stick them on their cars. They laugh and say, "Look, our cars have grape wheels!" They take their cars with grape wheels to the living room. They race their cars on the floor. They have fun, but they also make a mess. The grapes fall off their cars and roll everywhere. Some grapes get squished and stain the carpet. Some grapes get under the sofa and the table. Mom comes in and sees the mess. She is not happy. She says, "What are you doing, boys? You made a big mess with the grapes! You cannot use grapes as wheels for your cars. Grapes are for eating, not for playing. You have to clean up this mess right now!" Tim and Sam feel sorry. They say, "We are sorry, Mom. We just wanted to have fun. We did not mean to make a mess." They start to pick up the grapes and put them in a bowl. They also try to wipe the stains with a cloth. Mom says, "Thank you, boys. I know you like to play, but you have to be careful with your toys and your food. Next time, use something else as wheels for your cars. Something that does not make a mess. Like buttons or coins or bottle caps." Tim and Sam nod. They say, "OK, Mom. We will use something else next time. Can we still eat some grapes?" Mom smiles. She says, "Yes, you can eat some grapes. But only after you finish cleaning up. And wash your hands first. And don't forget to brush your teeth later." Tim and Sam say, "OK, Mom. We love you." They hug Mom and finish cleaning up. Then they eat some grapes and share them with their cars. They say, "Here, cars. You can have some grapes too. But don't eat them. Just roll them with your wheels. Like this. Vroom, vroom, reverse, reverse!" They giggle and play with their cars and grapes. They are happy.

One day, a little girl named Mia was playing in her room. She had a lot of toys, but she felt bored. Mia looked around and saw her doll, Amy. She picked up Amy and said, "Let's play together!" Mia and Amy played hide and seek. Mia hid Amy under the bed and then tried to find her. When she found Amy, Mia felt a little pain in her toe. She looked down and saw that she had a small cut. "Oh no, my toe hurts," said Mia. Mia went to her mom and showed her the cut on her toe. Her mom put a band-aid on it and said, "Don't worry, it will be better soon." Mia felt happy and went back to play with Amy. She realized that even if her toys were dull, she could still have fun with them.

Once upon a time, there was a puppy. He was alert and liked to explore. One day, he saw a big box made of cardboard. He wanted to see what was inside so he sniffed around. He put his paw up and looked inside. To his surprise, a bright and shiny toy was waiting for him! He barked in delight and started to play with it. He chewed the toy and rolled it around. He was having so much fun. Suddenly, he stopped and looked up. He heard the sound of footsteps coming closer and closer. He quickly ran away and hid behind the cardboard box. He did not move, he just waited and listened. In a few moments, the footsteps faded away. He breathed a sigh of relief and went back to exploring.

One day, a little girl named Mia saw a dark brick. It was on the ground. She picked it up and stared at it. Mia said, "I want to show my friend, Tim." Mia took the brick to Tim's house. Tim stared at the brick too. He said, "Wow, this is a dark brick!" They played with the brick all day. They built a small tower with other bricks. But then, the dark brick started to shake. Mia and Tim were scared. The dark brick jumped up! It was not a brick at all. It was a frog! The frog said, "Thank you for playing with me!" Mia and Tim laughed. They had a new friend, the frog.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to play and catch things. One day, Fluffy saw a big, red ball in the garden. Fluffy wanted to catch the ball, so she ran after it. As Fluffy was playing, she met a friendly dog named Buddy. Buddy said, "Hi, Fluffy! Do you want to play catch with me?" Fluffy nodded her head and said, "Yes, let's play!" So, Fluffy and Buddy played catch with the big, red ball. After playing, Fluffy and Buddy were tired. They sat under a tree and talked. Fluffy told Buddy about her operation last week. Buddy listened and said, "I'm glad you're okay now, Fluffy." They smiled at each other, happy to be friends and play catch together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a big, round ball. The ball was her favorite toy. She liked to play with it all day long. One day, Sue found a delicate flower in her garden. She was very happy. She wanted to show her mom the pretty flower. Sue picked up the flower very gently. Sue went inside her house to show her mom. Her mom was happy to see the flower. Sue put the flower in a vase. Then, Sue and her mom went outside to play with the round ball together. They had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time there was a naughty little girl called Anna. She was only three years old. Anna liked to make a lot of trouble and misbehave. One day, Anna's mum got frustrated with her behaviour. She told Anna that if she carried on making trouble, she would have to be punished. Anna didn't care and she kept making trouble. Every day, Anna made more and more trouble until finally, mum had to punish her. She had to stay in her room for days without playing with her toys. Anna was so upset. She wished that she had listened to mum but it was too late. She was punished and it was not a happy ending.

Once upon a time, there was a clown. The clown was very foolish. He did not know how to do tricks. The clown wanted to make kids laugh. One day, the clown went to a party. The kids at the party wanted to see tricks. The foolish clown tried to do tricks, but he did not know how. The kids did not laugh. The clown felt sad. The clown tried one last trick. He climbed up a tall tree. The clown did not know how to climb down. The kids went home. The foolish clown was stuck in the tree. The end.

Billy the dog was nosy. He always wanted to look at the tools that his owner, Jack, used in the garden. One day, when Jack had gone to get something from inside the house, Billy started to explore the tools. He picked up a shiny red one and began to laugh. Just then, Jack came outside. "Hey! Put that down!" he yelled. He wanted to make sure that none of the tools were broken, since he had to use them for his job. Billy was scared and tried to run away, but Jack caught him before he could get away. Billy gave him a sad look, his ears and tail drooping down. Jack sighed. He knew Billy was just having fun and was trying to be like him. He smiled and said, "It's alright. Just don't be too nosy and stay away from the tools!" Billy excitedly barked and licked Jack's hands. Jack laughed and said, "Let's go home now."

Once upon a time, in a cheerful park, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his colorful chalk. He would draw big circles, small circles, and lots of lines on the ground. One sunny day, Tim met a new friend named Sue. Sue had a fun idea. She said, "Let's spin around and draw with the chalk at the same time!" Tim thought that was a great idea. They both picked up their chalk and began to spin. As they spun, they laughed and drew funny shapes on the ground. Soon, other kids saw Tim and Sue spinning and drawing with their chalk. They wanted to join in the fun too. All the kids took turns spinning and drawing. Everyone was happy and having a great time. The cheerful park was filled with laughter, spinning, and colorful chalk drawings.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a police named Tom. Tom was very modest and kind. He loved to help people and make them happy. One day, Tom decided to decorate the police station. He wanted to make it look nice for everyone who came there. He used colorful papers and drew fun pictures on them. He put the papers on the walls to make them pretty. The people in the town saw the decorated police station and smiled. They liked how Tom made the place look happy. Tom felt proud and glad that he could make others happy too. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Sarah. Sarah laughed a lot because she was always having fun and making new friends. One day, Sarah's mom and dad took her to a new park. Sarah laughed when she saw the big slide and all the swings. But then something unexpected happened. Sarah was so shocked when a big dog came running up to her! The dog's bark sounded so loud, Sarah stopped laughing. But then the dog licked her and Sarah couldn't help but giggle. Sarah's dull fear quickly changed to happy laughter. Sarah loved the new park and her surprise friend. She felt so glad that she didn't stay scared. Instead, Sarah laughed and ran around with the dog, having lots of fun.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jimmy and Ginnie. They were both 3 years old and played together every day. One day Jimmy found two spikes on the ground, so he picked them up and wanted to use them to play. Ginnie saw this and said, “No Jimmy! Those spikes can be very dangerous!” Jimmy was confused and asked, “But why?” Ginnie smiled and said, “Because elderly people can trip and fall if they see those spikes and it’s important to help them not get hurt.” Jimmy thought about this and felt bad that he almost caused problems to the elderly people. So he put the spikes back on the ground and promised Ginnie he wouldn’t use them anymore. Moral of the story: Always take care of the elderly and help them stay safe.

One day, a little girl and her grandma were taking a walk through the park. Suddenly, the sky became very dark and the rain started to pour. The little girl started to get scared, but her grandma told her "Don't worry, it will be over soon." The girl looked up to the sky and asked "Where will we hide?" Grandma smiled and said "Let's go, I know a place." The grandma took the little girl to a generous lady's house. The lady opened her door and said "Welcome! You can both come in and take shelter from the rain under my roof." The little girl and her Grandma felt so grateful to the lady. When the rain finally stopped, they thanked her and said goodbye. After this, the little girl and her Grandma thought a lot about how generous the lady was. They said to each other "She saved us from the rain, what a kind lady."

One day, a little boy named Tim went on a holiday with his mom and dad. They went to a big park with lots of trees and flowers. Tim saw a cute dog and wanted to play with it. His mom said, "Tim, do not follow the dog. We do not know where it will go." But Tim did not listen. He followed the dog through the park. The dog led him to a tough hill. Tim was scared to climb it, but he wanted to see where the dog was going. So, he climbed the hill and saw something very strange. At the top of the hill, Tim found a big party with lots of dogs and people. They were all having fun and playing games. A man at the party said, "Welcome, Tim! We knew you would follow the dog. This is a special party just for you!" Tim was very happy and had the best holiday ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He had a brother named Sam. They liked to play together in the park. One sunny day, Tom saw some kids playing ball. He wanted to join them. Tom asked Sam, "Can I join them, brother?" Sam said, "Yes, but remember to be calm and share." Tom went to the kids and asked, "Can I play too?" The kids said, "Yes, come join us!" They all played ball together, and Tom was very calm. After playing, Tom thanked the kids and went back to Sam. Sam was happy to see Tom being calm and making new friends. The moral of the story is: when you are calm and share, you can make many friends.

One day, a cute little dog named Max saw a cable on the floor. Max wanted to play with the cable, but he knew he should resist. He remembered his mom telling him not to play with things that were not his toys. Max went to his friend, a bird named Pete. Max told Pete about the cable. "What should I do?" Max asked. Pete thought for a moment and said, "We should ask your mom if it is okay to play with the cable." So, Max and Pete went to find Max's mom. They found her in the kitchen. Max said, "Mom, can I play with the cable I found?" Max's mom shook her head and said, "No, Max. Cables are not toys. They can be dangerous. Let's find you a safe toy to play with." Max and Pete understood. They went to Max's room and found a big, soft ball to play with. They had lots of fun playing with the ball, and Max was happy that he listened to his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved cookies. One day, she saw a big cookie on the table. The cookie was so big and strong, it was hard for her to hold. Sue wanted to eat the cookie, but it was too high for her to reach. She had an idea. She got a chair to stand on. But when she stood on the chair, her foot started to slip. Sue was scared, but she did not fall. She held on tight and got the big, strong cookie. She was very happy. Sue sat down and ate the cookie. It was the best cookie she ever had.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to reach up high to touch the sky. One day, he went for a walk with his mom and dad. The sun was warm and mild on his face. They walked up a big hill together. When they got to the top of the hill, Tim saw a beautiful view. He could see many trees, birds, and a big blue lake. Tim was so happy that he jumped up and down. He reached up to the sky and felt like he could touch the clouds. Tim, his mom, and his dad sat down on the soft grass. They enjoyed the view and the mild sun. They laughed and played together on the hill. Tim reached up high again, trying to touch the sky. And they all lived happily ever after.

Tommy loves his scooter. It is red and shiny and fast. He likes to ride it in the park with his mom and dad. He can go up and down the hills and around the trees. He feels the wind in his hair and the sun on his face. Riding his scooter excites him. One day, he sees a new friend in the park. She has a scooter too. It is pink and sparkly and has a bell. She smiles at Tommy and says hello. She asks him if he wants to play with her. Tommy says yes. He thinks she is good and nice. They ride their scooters together. They race and chase and ring their bells. They laugh and talk and have fun. They share their snacks and drinks. They make a game of finding different things in the park. They find flowers and birds and bugs and rocks. They are happy and proud of their scooters. Tommy and his new friend become best friends. They play with their scooters every day. They learn new tricks and skills. They help each other and cheer each other. They enjoy the park and the nature. They love their scooters and each other. Their scooters bring them joy.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a big mountain. Tim was scared, but he wanted to go up the mountain. He took a deep breath and started to climb. As Tim climbed, he met a talking bird. The bird said, "Hello, Tim! Do you want to play?" Tim was surprised but happy. "Yes, please!" he said. The bird showed Tim how to shut his eyes and count to ten. When Tim opened his eyes, the bird was gone. Tim was sad, but he kept climbing. When he got to the top of the mountain, he found the bird. The bird was not a bird anymore. It was a magic fairy! The fairy said, "You were brave, Tim. I will give you a wish." Tim wished for a friend, and the fairy turned back into a bird. They played together all day and became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely little cat named Lily. Lily was playing with her ball outside when she tripped and fell. She hurt her leg and started to cry. Lily's mom heard her cry and came running to help her. Lily's mom looked at her leg and said, "We need to go to the doctor." They went to the doctor's office, but the doctor was very busy. Lily's mom had to demand that the doctor see Lily right away. The doctor agreed and came to check on Lily's leg. The doctor looked at Lily's leg and said, "It's not a big owie, but it needs a bandage." The doctor put a bandage on Lily's leg and gave her a hug. Lily felt better and thanked the doctor. With her leg all better, Lily went back to playing with her ball, and she was more careful not to trip and fall again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to write. She would write on paper, on the walls, and even in the dirt outside. One day, Lucy's mom asked her to help in the kitchen. Lucy was very happy to help. In the kitchen, Lucy saw a big, light cake. Her mom said, "This is for the party later. Please don't touch it." Lucy wanted to write on the cake, but she remembered her mom's words. So, she helped her mom make more food for the party. Later, at the party, Lucy's mom brought out the light cake. Everyone was so happy to see it. Lucy's mom said, "Thank you, Lucy, for not writing on the cake. Now, everyone can enjoy it!" Lucy felt proud and learned that sometimes it's best not to write on everything.

Once upon a time, there was a world that was not quite complete. The sky was hot and it was always sunny there. Everyone in the world wanted to make it complete, so they started to work. They built roads, houses, and stores. After many days of hard work, the world was finally complete! Everyone was very happy. They could now travel and visit different places in the world. They could buy food and play games, too. But the world was still hot, so they planted lots of trees and made shady spots to keep cool. Every day was a hot, but happy day in this complete world!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a race. Many people came to watch the race. They were excited to see who would win. The race was between a fast dog and an unknown big bird. The dog and the bird were friends, but they wanted to see who was the fastest. The race started near a restaurant. The dog and the bird ran very fast. People cheered for them. The dog was fast, but the unknown big bird was faster. They raced through the town, past the trees, and over the hills. In the end, the unknown big bird won the race. The dog was happy for his friend. They went to the restaurant together to eat. They had a fun day, and the people in the town loved the race. The dog and the unknown big bird were happy to be friends, and they promised to race again someday.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Jane. Jane had a big toy box full of toys. One day, Jane wanted to fit all her toys in the box, but they were too many. She tried and tried, but they just would not fit. Jane's mom saw her trying and said, "Let's have a fair game with your toys. The toys that win can stay in the box, and the others will find a new home." Jane liked the idea and started playing the game. She had a race with her toys, and the toys that won the race got to stay in the box. As Jane played, she got hungry. Her mom made a yummy sauce to put on her food. But, oh no! The sauce spilled on the floor. Jane's toys that were not in the box helped clean up the mess. Jane saw how helpful her toys were and decided that all her toys should stay. She learned that every toy is special and can help in different ways. And from that day on, Jane found a way to fit all her toys in the box and loved them all the same.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park. She saw her friend Tom playing with a ball. Mia felt happy and wanted to play too. She noticed that Tom looked hungry, so she asked him, "Tom, do you want to eat?" Tom said, "Yes, I am hungry. Let's go find some food." They walked and walked until they saw a big red apple on the ground. They picked it up to share, but when they were about to eat it, the apple started to talk! "Please don't eat me!" said the apple. Mia and Tom were very surprised. They decided to be kind and not eat the talking apple. The apple thanked them and told them a secret. "There is a magic tree with lots of food over there," said the apple. Mia and Tom went to the magic tree and found lots of yummy food to eat. They were not hungry anymore and played happily in the park all day.

One day, a girl named Sue wanted to print a big melon. She had a big printer that could print anything. Sue was very happy and felt safe with her printer. She thought it could make her anything she wanted. Sue put the melon on the printer and pressed the button. The printer started to work. It made a loud noise as it printed the big melon. Sue was very excited to see her new, big melon. But something unexpected happened. The printer did not print a big melon. Instead, it printed a big, scary monster! The monster was not safe. It started to chase Sue. Sue ran away, but the monster caught her. The story had a bad ending because Sue could not get away from the monster.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very bossy. Every day she would ask her mom to put a patch on her favourite dress. One day she asked her mom for a special patch that had a rainbow on it. Her mom told her find it herself. So she went out on a mission to find the patch. First, she asked the farmer in the meadow if he had one. But the farmer said no. Then she asked the shopkeeper in the village, but he also said no. Finally, she decided to ask the old lady at the end of the road. The old lady was very kind and she opened up a box, revealing the patch she was looking for. The little girl was over the moon! She quickly thanked the old lady for her kindness and ran back home with the patch. She was so excited to show her mom the patch, and put it on her favourite dress.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play in the farm with their dog, Spot. One day, they see a big mill near the farm. The mill has a big wheel that turns and makes noise. "Let's go see the mill!" Ben says. He runs to the mill with Spot. "No, Ben, wait!" Lily says. She follows him. "Mama said the mill is hot and dangerous. We can't go near it." But Ben does not listen. He wants to touch the mill. He pokes the wheel with his finger. Ouch! The wheel is very hot. It burns his finger. Ben cries. "Ben, are you okay?" Lily asks. She hugs him. She is scared. Spot barks. He sees a man coming out of the mill. The man is angry. He yells at Ben and Lily. "Hey, you kids! What are you doing here? This is not a place to play. This is my mill. Go away, or I will call your mama!" Ben and Lily are sorry. They did not mean to make the man mad. They run away from the mill with Spot. They go back to the farm. They tell their mama what happened. Mama is not happy. She scolds Ben and Lily. She says they should not go near the mill. She says the mill is hot and dangerous. She says they could get hurt. She says they should listen to her. Ben and Lily are sad. They say they are sorry. They hug their mama. They promise to be good. They promise to not go near the mill again. Mama forgives them. She kisses them. She says she loves them. She puts a band-aid on Ben's finger. She says it will get better soon. Ben and Lily are glad. They love their mama. They love their dog. They love their farm. They do not love the mill. They do not want to poke it again. They learned their lesson. The end.

One day, a little girl named Mia was playing in her room. She had a lot of fun with her toys. She played with her ball, her teddy bear, and her doll. Mia was very happy. But then, Mia saw a big bug on the floor. It was a crazy bug! Mia was scared and started to weep. Her mommy heard her and came into the room. "What's wrong, Mia?" her mommy asked. Mia pointed at the bug and said, "Bug, Mommy! Bug!" Her mommy saw the bug and got a towel. She used the towel to catch the bug and take it outside. Mia stopped weeping and smiled. "Thank you, Mommy!" she said. Now Mia could play in her room without being scared of the crazy bug.

Once upon a time, there was a little bug. The little bug loved to crawl on the ground. One day, the bug went on a search for a big, healthy leaf to eat. As the bug crawled, it met a tiny ant. The ant said, "Hi, bug! What are you doing?" The bug said, "I am on a search for a big, healthy leaf to eat. Will you help me?" The ant said, "Yes, let's go find the leaf!" The bug and the ant crawled and crawled. They found a big, healthy leaf. They were so happy! But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird came and took the leaf away. The bug and the ant were sad. They had to start their search again, but they knew it would not be easy.

Once upon a time, there was a messy boat. The boat had a big anchor. The boat liked to sail on the water. One day, the boat met a fish. The fish said, "You are too messy. You should clean up." The boat did not like this. The boat and the fish disagree. The messy boat did not want to clean up. It sailed away from the fish. The boat's anchor got stuck in the water. The boat could not move. The boat was sad. It wished it had listened to the fish. The boat was stuck forever. The end.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They had a fun time playing on the swings and slides. Tim saw a quiet dog sitting near a big tree. He wanted to go and play with the dog, but he was scared. He didn't know if he should dare to go near the dog. Tim's mom saw him looking at the dog. She said, "Don't worry, the dog is nice. You can go and say hi." Tim felt brave and dared to walk up to the quiet dog. He held out his hand for the dog to sniff. The dog wagged its tail and licked Tim's hand. They became friends right away. As Tim and the dog played, they heard a loud noise. It was a big truck with gas in it. The gas truck was going too fast and made a big mess. Tim and the dog were scared. But the truck driver said sorry and cleaned up the mess. Tim and the dog went back to playing, happy that everything was okay.

Tom and Lily are adventurous twins. They like to explore new places and have fun. One day, they find a big box in the garage. They wonder what is inside. "Let's open it!" Tom says. "Maybe it has a surprise!" Lily says. They open the box and see many colorful things. They see hats, flags, drums, and trumpets. They are costumes and instruments for a march. Their dad used to play in a band when he was young. "Wow, this is cool!" Tom says. "Let's try them on!" Lily says. They put on the hats and flags and pick up the drums and trumpets. They look like soldiers in a parade. They decide to march around the house and make some noise. "Left, right, left, right!" Tom says. "Boom, boom, boom!" Lily says. They march and play and have a lot of fun. They go to the living room, the kitchen, the bedroom, and the bathroom. They make everyone laugh and clap. But then, they hear a knock on the door. It is the mailman. He has a big envelope for their dad. He sees the twins in their costumes and smiles. "Hello, little soldiers!" he says. "Are you having a march?" "Yes, we are!" Tom and Lily say. "That's very adventurous of you!" the mailman says. "Do you want to help me with something?" "What is it?" Tom and Lily ask. "I have to send this envelope to your dad. He is away on a trip. Do you want to write something for him?" the mailman says. "Yes, we do!" Tom and Lily say. They take the envelope and a pen. They write "We love you, dad!" and draw some hearts and stars. They also stick some stickers of their costumes and instruments. They give the envelope back to the mailman. "Thank you, little soldiers!" the mailman says. "Your dad will be very happy to get this. You are very sweet and thoughtful." "Thank you, mailman!" Tom and Lily say. They wave goodbye to the mailman and go back to their march. They are proud and happy. They miss their dad, but they know he will be back soon. They hope he likes their surprise. They love him very much.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man. He lived near the big blue sea. He liked to cook food for his friends. One day, a seal came out of the sea. The seal was hungry. The bald man saw the seal and wanted to help. He decided to cook food for the seal too. The bald man cooked fish for the seal. The seal ate the fish and was very happy. The man and the seal became good friends. They played and ate together every day.

Once there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to go to the theater with her mom. One day, they went to see a show with funny people and animals. Amy was so happy. In the show, there was a weak rabbit who needed to rest. The rabbit said to his friend, the bird, "I am so weak. I need to rest." The bird said, "Okay, let's find a place for you to rest." They found a nice, soft spot under a big tree. The rabbit rested there while the bird sang a sweet song. After some time, the rabbit felt better. He said, "Thank you, bird. I feel much better now." Amy and her mom clapped and laughed. They had a great time at the theater.

Tommy liked to tease his sister, Lily. He thought it was funny to hide her toys, pull her hair, and make silly faces at her. Lily did not like it when Tommy teased her. She felt sad and angry, and sometimes she cried. One day, Tommy found Lily's favorite sock. It was a unique sock, with pink and purple stripes and a unicorn on it. Lily loved her sock and always wore it with her other sock, which was plain white. Tommy thought it would be funny to take Lily's sock and hide it under his bed. He ran to his room with the sock and laughed. Lily looked for her sock everywhere. She checked her drawer, her closet, her toy box, and her bed. She could not find her sock. She asked her mom, her dad, and her grandma, but they did not know where it was. She felt very sad and missed her sock. Tommy saw Lily looking for her sock. He felt a little sorry for her, but he still wanted to tease her. He decided to wait until bedtime, and then he would show her the sock and make fun of her. He thought that would be very funny. But Tommy did not know that his mom had seen him take the sock. She knew that Tommy liked to tease Lily, and she did not like it. She wanted to teach Tommy a lesson. She went to his room and took the sock from under his bed. She put it in her pocket and waited. When it was bedtime, Tommy got ready to tease Lily. He went to her room and knocked on the door. He said, "Lily, I have something to show you. It's your sock. I took it and hid it. Ha ha ha!" He opened the door and held out his hand. But his hand was empty. There was no sock. Lily looked at Tommy and smiled. She said, "That's not funny, Tommy. That's mean. And you don't have my sock. Mom has it. She saw you take it and she gave it back to me. See?" She lifted her foot and showed Tommy her unique sock, with pink and purple stripes and a unicorn on it. She said, "I love my sock. And I love mom. She is very nice. You should be nice too, Tommy. Then we can be friends." Tommy felt very silly and ashamed. He realized that he had been a bad brother to Lily. He said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I was wrong to tease you. I don't want to be mean. I want to be nice. And I want to be your friend. Can you forgive me?" Lily nodded and hugged Tommy. She said, "I forgive you, Tommy. And I love you. You are my brother. And you are unique too. Just like my sock."

One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to go on a trip. She was very excited. She wanted to wear her lovely red dress. So, she put on her dress and went to her mom. "Mom, I want to go on a trip today," said Lily. Her mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea! Let's go to the park." At the park, Lily saw her friend Jack. Jack was wearing a lovely blue shirt. They played together on the swings and the slide. They had so much fun on their trip to the park. After playing, Lily and Jack were tired. They sat down on the grass and looked at the sky. Lily said, "I like your lovely blue shirt, Jack." Jack smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. I like your lovely red dress too." Lily and Jack had a great trip to the park. They wore their lovely clothes and played together. They were very happy and couldn't wait for their next trip.

One day, a little girl named Amy found a red ball. She liked the ball very much. She wanted to show her friend, Tom. So, she put the ball in her pocket. Amy went to Tom's house. She said, "Tom, I have something to show you!" Tom was excited. He asked, "What do you have, Amy?" Amy said, "You need to guess!" Tom thought for a moment and said, "Is it a red ball?" Amy was surprised. "How did you know?" she asked. Tom smiled and said, "I saw something red in your pocket when you came in." Amy took the red ball out of her pocket and they played with it all day. They had a lot of fun with the red ball they found.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a pretty dress that she loved to wear. One day, she saw her friend Tom playing. They wanted to play a game. Sue put on her dress and went outside. While they were playing, a big wind came and blew Sue's dress away. Sue and Tom were confused. They did not know what to do. They decided to fight the wind to get the dress back. They ran and jumped, trying to catch the dress. Just when they were about to give up, a nice dog came running with the dress in its mouth. The dog gave the dress back to Sue. She was so happy! The dog had saved the day. Sue and Tom laughed and played with the dog. They had a new friend, and the wind could not take that away.

Sara was very excited to go to school for the first time. She had a new backpack, a new dress and a new friend. Her friend was Lily, who lived next door and was also going to school for the first time. Sara and Lily walked to school together, holding hands and talking. When they got to school, they saw a big building with many windows and doors. They followed their teacher, Miss Lee, to their classroom. Miss Lee was very nice and smiled a lot. She showed them where to put their backpacks, where to sit and where to play. Sara and Lily sat next to each other and looked around. There were many toys, books, crayons and puzzles in the classroom. Sara and Lily wanted to play with everything. But then, they saw a girl with curly hair and a pink dress. She was sitting at the front of the class, next to Miss Lee's desk. She had a big bow on her head and a big smile on her face. She looked at Sara and Lily and said, "Hi, I'm Amy. I'm the best student in the class. I know all the answers and I can do everything. Miss Lee likes me the most. You have to do what I say, because I'm the boss." Sara and Lily did not like Amy. She was very bossy and rude. They did not want to do what she said. They wanted to play and learn and have fun. They whispered to each other, "We don't like Amy. She is not nice. She is not our friend." Miss Lee heard them whispering and said, "Sara and Lily, please don't whisper. We are going to start our lesson soon. I have a surprise for you. I'm going to reveal something very special. Do you want to see it?" Sara and Lily nodded. They liked surprises. They hoped it was something fun and interesting. They wondered what it was. They looked at Miss Lee, who reached for a big box on her desk. She opened the box and took out something very fluffy and cute. It was a bunny! Sara and Lily gasped. They loved bunnies. They wanted to pet the bunny and hold the bunny and play with the bunny. They smiled and clapped. They forgot about Amy and her bossiness. They only cared about the bunny. Miss Lee said, "This is Fluffy. He is our class pet. He is very friendly and gentle. You can take turns to feed him, brush him and cuddle him. But you have to be careful and kind. He is very small and soft. Do you want to meet Fluffy?" Sara and Lily said, "Yes, yes, yes! We want to meet Fluffy! He is so cute! Can we pet him, please?" Miss Lee said, "Of course you can. But you have to wait for your turn. Amy, you can go first. You can hold Fluffy for a minute and then pass him to Sara. Sara, you can hold Fluffy for a minute and then pass him to Lily. Lily, you can hold Fluffy for a minute and then pass him back to me. Is that clear?" Sara and Lily said, "Yes, Miss Lee. That is clear. Thank you, Miss Lee. You are the best teacher ever." Amy said, "But I want to hold Fluffy longer. I want to hold Fluffy all the time. He is mine. I'm the boss." Miss Lee said, "No, Amy. You are not the boss. You have to share Fluffy with your classmates. He is not yours. He is ours. You have to be nice and fair. If you are not, you will not be able to hold Fluffy at all. Do you understand?" Amy said, "Yes, Miss Lee. I understand. I'm sorry, Miss Lee. I'm sorry, Sara and Lily. I will be nice and fair. I will share Fluffy with you. Can I hold Fluffy now, please?" Miss Lee said, "Yes, you can. But remember, only for a minute. Then you have to pass him to Sara. OK?" Amy said, "OK, Miss Lee. Thank you, Miss Lee." Miss Lee gave Fluffy to Amy. Amy held Fluffy gently and smiled. She felt his soft fur and his warm breath. She said, "Hello, Fluffy. You are very cute. I like you. But I also like Sara and Lily. They are my friends. We can all play with you. We can all be happy." Sara and Lily smiled too. They were happy that Amy was being nice and fair. They were happy that they had a new friend and a new pet. They were happy that they were at school. They thought that school was the best place ever. They

Once upon a time, in a big blue sea, there was a huge boat with a sail. The boat had a captain named Jim. He loved to sail the boat over the water. He liked to go fast and feel the wind on his face. The boat's sail was red and white, and it was very big. One day, Captain Jim saw a big fish jump out of the water. The fish was so big and fast, it could shoot water out of its mouth. The fish and the boat started to play a game. The fish would shoot water at the boat, and the boat would sail fast to get away. Captain Jim and the big fish played all day. They laughed and had so much fun. The sun began to set, and it was time for the boat to go home. Captain Jim waved goodbye to the big fish. They knew they would play together again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a big park. In the park, there was a high slide. All the kids loved to play on the slide. One day, the slide broke. The kids were very sad. A man saw the broken slide. He wanted to help. The man was good at fixing things. He said, "I will repair the slide." The kids were happy to hear that. The man worked hard to fix the slide. He made it strong and safe. The kids waited and watched. When the slide was all fixed, the man said, "Now you can play!" The kids were so happy. They took turns going down the high slide. They said "thank you" to the man for making the slide fun again.

Once upon a time, there was a small dog named Max. Max lived in a shelter with many other dogs. Max felt uncomfortable in the shelter because it was too loud and crowded. One day, Max went on a walk with a nice lady from the shelter. They walked to the park, where Max saw a big tree. Max wanted to see the tree up close. When Max got close to the tree, he found a small door at the bottom. Max was curious and went inside. Inside the tree, Max met a talking bird named Tim. Max was surprised to meet a talking bird. Tim told Max that he could grant him one wish. Max wished for a new home where he would feel happy and comfortable. Tim granted Max's wish, and Max found himself in a cozy, quiet home with a loving family. Max was very happy and grateful to have met Tim, the magical talking bird.

One day, a big dog named Tom and a little cat named Sue were playing in the open yard. They saw a box with a weight inside. Tom said, "Let's bury the weight in the ground." Sue agreed and said, "Yes, let's do it!" They dug a hole with their paws and put the weight inside. Then, they covered the hole with dirt. The next day, they came back to the yard and saw that the weight was out of the ground. They were surprised and decided to bury it again. This time, they dug a deeper hole and buried the weight. Tom and Sue were happy with their work and went home to rest.

Once upon a time there was a wealthy prince. He wanted to show everyone how lucky he was. So, one day he invited his friends over and said, "Let's have a toast to my wealth!" His friends agreed and they all gathered around. The prince put out a big plate of toast. Everyone grabbed a piece and the prince took the last piece. The prince ate his toast, but when he finished, he realized something. He said, "When I shared the toast, everyone got a piece but me. It reminded me that real wealth is shared and not kept just for myself." The prince smiled and shared what he had learned. He said, "When you have something to share, even if it is just toast, be generous and reveal it to everyone!" Everyone nodded in agreement and the prince's wise lesson was revealed.

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat named Tom. Tom liked to play with his ball all day. One day, he saw a sign near his home. The sign had a picture of a dog on it. Tom went to his friend, a little girl named Sue. "Sue, what does the sign say?" he asked. Sue looked at the sign and said, "It says a new dog is coming to our street." The next day, the new dog came. He was big and loud. Tom was scared, but he wanted to be brave. He walked up to the dog and demanded, "You must be nice to me and my friends." The dog looked at Tom and said, "I am sorry. I will be nice. I just wanted to make new friends too." Tom and the dog became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a big box of stuff. Amy liked to play with her stuff every day. One day, she met a new boy named Tim. Tim wanted to play with Amy's stuff too. Amy said, "You can play, but you need to know how to use my stuff. It is not easy." Tim was sad. He did not know how to play with Amy's stuff. He wanted to learn, so he asked Amy to teach him. Amy showed Tim her stuff one by one. She said, "This is how you play with it." Tim watched and listened. Soon, he knew how to play with all of Amy's stuff. They played together and had lots of fun. Now, playing with Amy's stuff was easy for Tim. They became best friends and shared everything.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big, impressive tree. Under the tree, he found a big, red strawberry. Tim was very happy. Tim saw his friend, Sue, pass by. He called her, "Sue, come here! Look at my big, red strawberry!" Sue came over and looked at the strawberry. "Wow, Tim! That is a big strawberry!" she said. Tim and Sue wanted to eat the strawberry. But then, a big bird came. The bird took the strawberry away. Tim and Sue were sad. They did not get to eat the big, red strawberry.

Once upon a time, a little girl wanted to go out to play. But her mommy said no, because it was very late. The little girl was angry and frustrated and wanted to whine, but she knew she couldn't. Instead, she went off to bed and got very uncomfortable. But, when she got to her bedroom, she noticed that there was no milk! She was so sad and angry! She just wanted a glass of milk before bed. The little girl asked her mommy for some milk, but her mommy said it was too late. The little girl felt very uncomfortable, but there was nothing she could do. Suddenly, the little girl had an idea! She quickly got dressed and went outside. After a short walk, she arrived at her friend's house. When she knocked on the door, her friend answered it with a huge smile. She had brought some milk for her friend! The little girl was so happy and relieved. They quickly talked and laughed and the little girl drank her milk with a huge grin. After some time, they hugged and said goodbye. The little girl was content as she ended her adventure and went back to her home.

Lila and Ben are playing in the park. They like to spin on the round thing. They hold the bars and go faster and faster. They feel dizzy and happy. "Look at me, Lila! I can spin so fast!" Ben says. "I can spin faster than you, Ben!" Lila says. They spin and spin until they hear a whistle. It is the park lady. She is not happy. She says they have to stop spinning. She says it is time to go home. "But we want to spin more!" Lila and Ben say. "No, you have to go home. It is getting dark and cold. And you are making too much noise. You are not lively, you are loud!" the park lady says. Lila and Ben are sad and angry. They do not want to go home. They want to spin more. They think the park lady is mean. They do not listen to her. They spin faster and faster. They make more noise. The park lady blows her whistle louder and louder. She calls their names. She says they are in trouble. She says she will tell their parents. Lila and Ben are scared. They do not want to be in trouble. They do not want to make their parents angry. They stop spinning. They get off the round thing. They say sorry to the park lady. They go home with her. They do not spin anymore. They do not feel dizzy and happy. They feel sorry and sad. They wish they had listened to the park lady. They hope their parents will not be angry. They hope they can spin again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a curious cat. The cat liked to watch people. One day, the cat saw a man. The man was a lawyer. The cat wanted to see what the lawyer did. The cat went to the lawyer's big house. The cat saw the lawyer talking to people. The cat was very curious. The cat went closer to the lawyer. The cat wanted to touch the lawyer's papers. The cat jumped on the table to slap the papers. The lawyer saw the cat. The lawyer was not happy. The lawyer said, "Go away, cat!" But the cat did not listen. The cat slapped the papers again. Then, something unexpected happened. The lawyer turned into a big dog! The dog chased the cat. The cat was scared. The cat ran away. The cat never went back to the lawyer's house again. The cat learned to not be too curious.

One day, a bird wanted to fly. The bird had long wings. It liked to fly high in the sky. The bird saw a video. The video showed a big bird flying very fast. The bird wanted to fly like the big bird in the video. The bird tried to fly fast. It flapped its long wings harder and harder. The bird flew faster and faster. It was so happy. The bird thought it could fly like the big bird in the video now. But then, something unexpected happened. The bird was not flying fast. It was a big fan that made the bird feel like it was flying fast. The bird was sad but it did not give up. It kept trying to fly fast like the big bird in the video.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to play outside. He had a lot of fun equipment to play with. He had a big ball, a toy car, and a small bike. Tim loved his toys because they were always reliable and never broke. While Tim was playing, it started to rain. He didn't want his toys to get wet, so he put them under a tree. He thought the tree would keep them dry. But the rain was very strong, and the toys began to soak. Tim was sad that his toys were getting wet. But then something unexpected happened. A big, friendly dog came running over to Tim. The dog picked up Tim's toys and carried them to a dry spot under the house. Tim was so happy that his toys were safe and dry. He thanked the dog and they became best friends. From that day on, Tim and the dog played together with the dry toys, and they had many fun adventures.

Once upon a time, in a lovely small house, there was a little girl named Sally. She liked to dance all day long. She danced in the morning, in the afternoon, and even at night. One day, Sally heard a knock on the door. She opened it and saw a little boy. The boy said, "Hi, I am Tim. I saw you dance and I want to dance too. Can you teach me?" Sally smiled and said, "Yes, let's dance together!" Sally and Tim danced and danced. They were very happy. They danced until the sun went down. Then, they said goodbye and Tim went home. From that day on, Sally and Tim became best friends who loved to dance together.

One day, a black cat went to play. The cat saw a big ring on the ground. The cat wanted to find out what the ring did. So, the cat touched the ring with its paw. The cat heard a voice. It said, "Hello, cat! I am a magic ring. If you touch me, I can help you. Just tell me what you want." The cat thought for a moment and said, "I want to be the best at catching mice." The magic ring said, "Okay, cat. I will make you the best at catching mice. But, you must not tell anyone about me." The cat agreed and started to catch mice. The cat caught many mice. Soon, all the mice were gone. The cat was sad because there was no one to play with. The cat told a friend about the magic ring. The friend wanted to try it too. But the magic ring was angry. The cat broke the rule. The ring took away the cat's power to catch mice. The cat was not the best anymore. The cat was sad and learned not to break promises.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily had a plan. She wanted to make a cake for her mom's birthday. Lily was worried because she had never made a cake before. She asked her dad to help her. They went to the kitchen and started to make the cake. They mixed flour, sugar, and eggs in a big bowl. Then, they put the mix in the oven. Lily and her dad waited for the cake to bake. When the cake was ready, they took it out of the oven. It smelled so good! Lily and her dad put candles on the cake. They could not wait to taste it. When mom came home, they all ate the cake together. It was the best cake ever!

Mark wanted to go swimming. He moved very quickly to get to the water. When he got there, the water looked cold and harsh. He shivered a bit, but he was excited to move into the water. He slowly moved further and further in, to the point where it was up over his head. He could feel the coolness of the water, and he wanted to move around and explore. He closed his eyes and moved around, exploring the water with his hands. Suddenly he felt something in the water - an object that he wanted to swim around. He opened his eyes and moved faster and faster, and swam around the mysterious object. As he swam around it, he realized it was an old boat! He smiled and moved around it until he was tired, then he moved back to shore. He left the water feeling happy and exhausted from the harsh cold water.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom. They saw a big boat with a big anchor. Tim asked his mom, "What is that big thing?" His mom said, "That is an anchor. It helps the boat stay in one place." Tim wanted to play with the anchor. His mom said, "Be careful, it is very big and heavy." Tim tried to lift the anchor, but it was not easy. He tried and tried, and then he managed to move it just a little bit. Suddenly, a brilliant light came out from under the anchor. A small fish with bright colors jumped out from under the anchor. The fish said, "Thank you for helping me! I was stuck under the anchor." Tim and his mom were surprised to hear the fish talk. The fish swam away, and Tim and his mom had a fun day at the beach. They always remembered the day they met the talking fish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a little camera that she loved to play with. One day, she went to the park with her mom to test her camera. At the park, Mia saw a cute dog. She wanted to take a picture with her camera. "Mom, look at the dog! Can I take a picture?" Mia asked. Her mom said, "Yes, Mia. Go ahead and test your camera." Mia took a picture of the dog with her little camera. She was very happy. She showed the picture to her mom. "Good job, Mia! Your camera works well," said her mom. They went home and put the picture on the fridge. Mia was so proud of her little camera.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a weird tree. This tree had red cherries on it. The cherries were very yummy. Everyone loved eating them. One day, a big storm came. The wind blew very hard. The weird tree broke! The people in the town were sad. They could not eat the cherries anymore. A kind man wanted to help. He decided to repair the tree. He used some wood and a rope. The weird tree was fixed! The people in the town were happy again. They could eat the yummy cherries once more.

One day, a little girl named Lily was playing outside. The sun was shining bright, and the light made her smile. She saw her friend, Tom, walking towards her with a frown on his face. "Why are you sad, Tom?" Lily asked. "I did something naughty," Tom said. "I took a cookie from the jar when Mom said no. Now, I feel bad." Lily thought for a moment and had an idea. "Let's go say sorry to your Mom," Lily said. They walked to Tom's house, and he said sorry to his Mom. She hugged him and said, "It's okay, but don't do it again." Tom felt happy again, and they went back to play. Just then, a big wind came and blew their toys away. They were sad, but then they saw their toys had landed near a new friend. They all played together and had fun. The unexpected wind brought them a new friend to play with. The moral of the story is that saying sorry can make you feel better, and sometimes unexpected things can bring happiness.

Once upon a time, there was a bossy witch who lived in a small house. She had a big cat and a little dog. The bossy witch liked to cut things with her sharp knife. One day, the bossy witch said to her cat and dog, "I want to cut a big tree today." The cat and dog were scared, but they went with her to the big tree. The witch started to cut the tree with her sharp knife. As the witch was cutting the tree, a little bird came out of the tree and said, "Please don't cut my tree! My family lives here." The bossy witch was surprised and stopped cutting the tree. She said, "I'm sorry, little bird. I didn't know your family lived here." The little bird thanked the witch for stopping. The bossy witch, the cat, and the dog went back to their small house. From that day on, the witch was not bossy anymore, and she never cut trees again. She became friends with the little bird and its family, and they all lived happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom liked to play outside in the dirt. He would get very filthy. One day, Tom was playing near a deep well. He heard a sound. It was a whistle. Tom looked around and saw a small bird. The bird was hurt. Tom wanted to help the bird. He picked up the bird and took it home. He cleaned the bird and gave it some food. The bird started to feel better. Then, something unexpected happened. The bird started to whistle a special song. The song made Tom's house clean! The filthy dirt went away. The bird was not just a normal bird. It was a magical bird! Tom and the bird became best friends, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a lively house, there lived a boy named Tim and his sister, Sue. They loved to play with their toys and run around the house. One day, their mom gave them a lemon from the kitchen. Tim and Sue did not know what to do with the lemon. Tim wanted to make lemon juice, but Sue wanted to draw a face on the lemon. They started to quarrel about what to do with it. They were very loud and could not agree on what was best for the lemon. Their mom heard the quarrel and came to help. She told Tim and Sue to share the lemon. They could make juice and draw a face on it too. Tim and Sue stopped quarreling, and they were happy. They had fun making lemon juice and drawing a funny face on the lemon together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a normal shoe. One day, he went to the park to play. At the park, he saw a big hole. He thought it was fun to fill the hole with sand. Tom met a girl named Sue. Sue said, "Tom, can I help you fill the hole?" Tom said, "Yes, Sue, let's fill the hole together." They played and filled the hole with sand. They were having fun. But then, Tom's normal shoe got stuck in the hole. He tried to pull it out, but it was too deep. Tom and Sue were sad. They could not get the shoe out of the hole. Tom had to go home with only one shoe.

Once upon a time, there was a mailbox. It was a very organized mailbox. It had many letters inside. The mailbox liked to dance when it was happy. One day, the mailbox saw a big red ball. The mailbox wanted to play with the ball. The mailbox danced and danced around the ball. The ball bounced and the mailbox danced even more. The mailbox and the ball became best friends. They played and danced together every day. The mailbox was always happy and organized. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a small town. In this town, there was a big, boring tree. No one liked the tree because it was not fun to play with. The tree was sad. One day, a little spirit came to the town. The spirit saw the boring tree and wanted to help. The spirit went to the tree and said, "I will make you fun, so the kids will play with you." The spirit worked very hard to make the tree fun. The tree did not suffer anymore. It was now a fun tree. The kids in the town came to play with the tree every day. The boring tree was now a happy tree, and the town was happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful dog named Spot. Spot had a big jewel that he loved very much. He always kept it safe in his little dog house. One day, a bird came to visit Spot. The bird saw the jewel and said, "That is a pretty jewel, Spot! Can I see it?" Spot said, "Yes, you can look, but please don't take it away." The bird promised not to take it and looked at the jewel. Suddenly, the bird took the jewel in its beak and flew away. Spot was very sad and cried. But then, the bird came back with the jewel and said, "I'm sorry, Spot. I just wanted to play a trick on you. Here is your jewel back." Spot was happy again, and they both played together with the jewel.

Once upon a time there was a train. The train was rusty and old. The train driver looked at the train and he saw that it needed some oil. So he put some regular oil into the train. The driver said to the train, "Let's go!" The train rolled away. Everything was going fine until the oil ran out. The train started to make a strange noise. Then it stopped. The driver looked around and he saw smoke coming from the engine. The driver said to the train, "Oh no!" The driver tried to fix the train, but it was too late. The engine was broken and the train couldn't move. Everyone on the train was sad. They had to wait for another train to pick them up. The driver looked out at the horizon and sighed. He thought, "That's it. We'll never make it on time."

Once upon a time, there was a bossy cactus named Spike. Spike lived in a big desert with many other plants. He liked to act like he was the boss of all the plants. One day, a new plant came to the desert. Her name was Rosie. Rosie did not like how bossy Spike was. She did not want to listen to him. This made Spike very mad. Spike and Rosie had a big fight. They both acted very mean to each other. But soon, they saw that their friends were sad. They did not like the fight. Spike and Rosie said sorry to each other. They learned to be nice and not bossy. And they all lived happily together in the desert.

One day, a big rubber ball was outside. The ball was red and shiny. It could bounce very high. All the other toys were envious. They wanted to bounce like the rubber ball. The rubber ball said, "I can help you bounce high like me." The other toys were happy. The rubber ball told them to increase their air inside. The toys tried to put more air inside them. Then, something unexpected happened. The toys could not bounce like the rubber ball. They were not made of rubber. The rubber ball felt sad. It wanted to help the toys. But, they all learned they were special in their own way.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who wanted to wash himself. He decided to go to the bathroom and wash. He went to the store to find some soap, but he wanted to buy something cheap. He found a bottle of soap for a very good price and bought it. When he got home he filled the bathroom sink with warm water. Then he put the soap in the water and made lots of suds. The suds were fun to play in. He closed his eyes, put his hands in the water and started washing. He enjoyed washing his hands and face and felt very clean and fresh afterwards. When he was done, he dried himself off with a towel. He was so happy to be nice and clean. He ran off to play, ready to have lots of fun.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a funny bunny named Bob. Bob was always happy and loved to play with his friends. One day, while playing with his friends, he saw a small spirit in the forest. The spirit was sad because he lost his way home. Bob wanted to help the spirit, so he asked his friends to join him. Together, they searched the forest to find the spirit's home. After a long time, they found the spirit's home. The spirit was very happy and thanked Bob and his friends. Bob's friends were mad at him because they missed their playtime. But, when they saw how happy the spirit was, they forgave Bob. From that day on, Bob and his friends became good friends with the spirit and had many more fun adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old man who lived in a small house. He loved to help people in his town. One day, he found an ashtray on the ground. He knew that it was not good for kids to play with it. He saw a little boy playing near the ashtray. The wise old man went to the boy and said, "Please do not play with the ashtray. It is not safe for you." The boy listened to the wise old man and went to play with his toys instead. The boy's mom saw what happened and thanked the wise old man. She said, "Thank you for helping my son. You are very wise and we love you." From that day on, the little boy always listened to the wise old man and stayed away from things that were not safe. The moral of the story is to listen to wise people and stay away from things that can harm you.

Once, there was a little girl, who was very sad. She wanted to go on a holiday to cheer her up. So, she planned to meet all her friends at the beach, on the weekend. When the weekend came, everyone met on the beach. They played with the sand, and ran in and out of the water. The little girl was so happy to see her friends. She felt much better. Her sadness had gone away. But then, it was time to go home. Everyone said goodbye, and the little girl was sad again. She knew she had to wait until the next holiday before she could meet her friends again. Until then, she would have to find things to do to stay happy.

One day, a friendly dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Max wanted to help the bird. Max said, "I can lift you on my back and take you home." The bird was happy and said, "Thank you, Max!" Max lifted the bird onto his back and started to walk. On the way, they saw a big cat. The cat wanted to eat the bird for a meal. Max barked, "No! You cannot eat my friend!" The cat was scared and ran away. Max and the bird were safe. They got to the bird's home and had a fun day together.

One day, a hairy dog named Spot went for a walk. He was very hot and wanted to find some shade to rest in. Spot saw a big tree and thought it would be a good place to sit and rest. As Spot sat under the tree, he saw a little girl named Amy. Amy was sad and started to pray. She said, "Please help me find my lost toy." Spot heard Amy and wanted to help her. He asked, "What does your toy look like?" Amy told Spot that her toy was small and round. Spot looked around and saw something under the tree. It was not a toy, but a big, round rock! Spot and Amy laughed because they did not expect to find a rock instead of the toy. They became friends and kept looking for the toy together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. Lily loved to collect pretty things. One day, she found a shiny plate. The plate was very special. It was big, round, and had a picture of a sun on it. Lily wanted to show her friends her new plate. She went to her friend Tom's house. Tom was a reliable friend. He always helped Lily when she needed it. When Lily showed Tom the plate, Tom was very happy. He said, "Wow! That is a pretty plate!" Lily and Tom decided to share the plate. They took turns keeping it at their houses. They learned that sharing made them both happy. They also learned that it was good to have a reliable friend like Tom. The moral of the story is that sharing and having reliable friends can make you very happy.

Once upon a time, in a small room, there was a bald man. He liked to count. He counted everything he saw. One day, he saw a big box. He wanted to count what was inside the box. He opened the box and found ten small birds. The birds were scared. They wanted to escape. The bald man tried to count them, but they flew around very fast. The birds found a way to escape from the room. They flew out of the window. The bald man was sad. He could not count the birds anymore. The birds were gone and he was all alone. The end.

Once upon a time, in a quiet little town, there lived a cat named Tom. Tom loved to get in tight spots and hide. He had a best friend, a dog named Max, who would always try to find him. One day, Tom found a very tight spot to hide in. He thought Max would never find him there. He waited and waited, but Max did not come. Tom started to get worried. He had never been so quiet and hidden for so long. Then, Tom heard a noise. He thought it was Max and was very happy. But it was not Max! It was a tiny mouse named Jerry. Jerry was scared of Tom, but he saw that Tom was stuck in the tight spot. So, Jerry helped Tom get out. Tom was very thankful and did not chase Jerry. From that day on, Tom, Max, and Jerry were all best friends, and they played hide and seek together.

Sam likes to print with his tool. His tool is a big stamp with a star on it. He dips his tool in red paint and prints on paper. He prints many stars and smiles. "Look, Mom, I print stars!" he says. He shows his paper to his mom. Mom looks at his paper and nods. "You print very well, Sam. But you are also very messy. Look at your hands and the table. They are all red." Sam looks at his hands and the table. He sees the red paint. He frowns. He does not like to be messy. "Sorry, Mom. I will clean it," he says. He gets a cloth and wipes the table. He washes his hands in the sink. He puts his tool and paper away. Mom hugs him and kisses his cheek. "Thank you, Sam. You are a good boy. And I like your stars. They are very pretty."

Once upon a time, there was a huge firework. It lived in a small box. The firework wanted to escape and see the sky. One day, the firework found a way out of the box. It was so happy to escape. The firework saw the sky and wanted to go up. The firework went up into the sky. It made a big boom. But then, the firework was gone. It could not see the sky anymore. The firework was sad.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to play in his backyard. He would run, jump, and roll in the grass. The sun would shine, and Buddy would have lots of fun. One day, Buddy saw a big ball in the backyard. He wanted to play with it. He ran and jumped on the ball. But the ball popped! Buddy felt sad. He did not want the ball to pop. He felt regret for jumping on it. Buddy's mom saw what happened. She hugged Buddy and said, "It's okay." She got a new ball for Buddy to play with. Buddy was happy again. He played with the new ball and had lots of fun in his backyard.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with blocks. He had red blocks, blue blocks, and yellow blocks. He would build tall towers, big houses, and even little cars with his blocks. One day, it was very cold and bitter outside. Tim wanted to play with his blocks, but his mommy did not allow him to play in the living room. She was cleaning the room and did not want the blocks to make a mess. Tim was sad because he really wanted to play with his blocks. Tim's mommy saw how sad he was and thought of an idea. She said, "Tim, you can play with your blocks in your room today." Tim was very happy and thanked his mommy. He went to his room and built a big, beautiful castle with his blocks.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a wild rabbit. Tim said, "Look, Mom! A wild rabbit!" His mom said, "Yes, it's amazing!" Tim and his mom walked closer to the rabbit. The wild rabbit looked at them and then hopped away. Tim laughed and said, "Bye, wild rabbit!" As they walked home, Tim told his mom all about the amazing wild rabbit. They both agreed it was a fun day at the park.

Mrs Jones was walking her daughter, Jemma, to her first day of nursery. Jemma was feeling both excited and scared. To encourage her, Mrs Jones said, "It's going to be so much fun to learn new things and meet new friends". Jemma smiled, but was still a bit worried. At the nursery, Mrs Jones helped Jemma find a seat. Then she gently said, "Remember all the lovely new language you’ll learn. You'll be able to say so many new words". Jemma felt a little bit better. When it was time to start, the teacher said, "I'm afraid this morning we have to start off with a test. It's just to know your basics". Jemma was embarrassed and when she looked up at her mum, Mrs Jones winked, as if to say, "You're going to be fine". Jemma tried her best and luckily, she passed the test. She looked so proud! Mrs Jones was relieved. She was right; Jemma was learning so much already and was off to a great start!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to read. Every day, she would go to her classroom and read many books. Her friends liked to read too. Sometimes, they would read together in the classroom. One day, Lily found a big chair in the classroom. It looked like a fun place to read. She sat down and started to read her book. But the chair was very hard, and Lily felt uncomfortable. She tried to move around, but she still felt uncomfortable. Lily's friend, Sam, saw her feeling uncomfortable. He asked, "Lily, do you want to sit on the soft rug with me?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, please!" So, Lily and Sam sat on the soft rug and read their books together. They were happy and comfortable, and they read many fun stories in their classroom.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Amy. She loved to ask questions and learn new things. One day, she found a book with a poem inside. She wanted to know what the poem said, but she could not read it. Amy went to her big sister, Lisa, and asked, "Can you read this poem to me?" Lisa smiled and said, "Of course, I will help you!" Lisa read the poem out loud to Amy. It was a short and sweet poem about a cat and a dog who became friends. Amy was so happy to accept the help from her sister. She wanted to learn more poems and share them with her friends. And from that day on, Amy and Lisa read many more poems together, and they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little bug named Tim went to the kitchen. He was very hungry. He saw a big piece of toast on the table. Tim wanted to eat the toast, but it was too high for him. So, he started to crawl up the table leg. As Tim was crawling, he met a small ant named Amy. Amy was upset. She said, "I want the toast too, but it's too high for both of us." Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's work together! We can push the toast off the table." Tim and Amy crawled up the table together. They pushed the toast off the table. The toast fell on the floor with a loud "thud!" Now, Tim and Amy could eat the toast together. They were both very happy and not hungry anymore.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a drive with his mom. They were going to a dance party. Tim was very happy. He loved to dance and play with his friends. On their way, they saw a big rock on the road. Tim's mom tried to drive around it, but it was hard. The car hit the rock and made a loud noise. Tim's mom said, "Oh no, the car is broken!" They could not go to the dance party anymore. Tim was very sad. He said, "I wanted to dance with my friends." His mom felt bad too. They had to walk home in the rain.

One day, a curious cat named Tom saw a big red ball of yarn. He wanted to play with it. So, he used his paw to pull the yarn. As he pulled, the yarn started to make a long line on the floor. Tom's friend, a little girl named Sue, saw the cat playing with the yarn. She said, "Tom, what are you doing?" Tom just looked at her and kept pulling the yarn. Sue had an idea. She took the yarn and made a pretty bow for her hair. She showed it to Tom and said, "Look, I made fashion with the yarn!" Tom liked it and they both played with the yarn all day.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom and dad. Tim loved to play in the sand and watch the surf. He liked to see the big waves come and go. Tim was not scared of the water, but he was ignorant about the sea animals that lived there. While Tim was playing, he found a big shell. He was so happy and wanted to show his mom and dad. But when he picked up the shell, he felt a small tear in his hand. Tim was surprised and a little bit scared. Tim ran to his mom and dad to show them the shell and his hand. They looked at the shell and saw a tiny crab inside. The crab had pinched Tim's hand, making the tear. Tim was not scared anymore, but he learned to be more careful with things he finds at the beach.

Lily hated the voice of the big dog next door. It was loud and scary and made her ears hurt. She wanted to play outside with her ball, but the voice always made her run back inside. One day, she saw a new animal in the yard. It was small and white and had long ears. It was a bunny. Lily liked bunnies. They were soft and quiet and cute. She wanted to pet the bunny and give it a carrot. She opened the door and walked slowly to the fence. The bunny saw her and hopped closer. Lily smiled and reached out her hand. But then, the voice of the big dog came from behind the fence. It was angry and loud and mean. It barked and growled and made the bunny run away. Lily was sad and scared. She cried and ran back to the door. She slammed it shut and hugged her teddy bear. She wished the voice would go away. "Are you okay, Lily?" her mom asked. She heard her cry and came to see what was wrong. "I hate the voice, mom. It scared the bunny. It scared me. I want the voice to go away," Lily said. "I know, sweetie. The voice is not nice. But you are safe inside. And maybe the bunny will come back another day. You are brave and graceful, Lily. You can play with the bunny and be its friend," her mom said. She kissed Lily's head and gave her a cookie. Lily felt a little better. She hoped the voice would be quiet and the bunny would be back. She wanted to play outside with her ball and her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He loved to have music in his room. Tim would dance and sing all day. He was very happy, but his big sister, Sue, did not like it. Sue was rude and always told Tim to stop. One day, Tim found a big box. It had a note that said, "Do not open!" But Tim did not listen. He opened the box and found a red button. The note on the button said, "Do not push!" Tim thought that if he pushed the button, he would have more music to dance to. Tim pushed the button. Suddenly, all the music stopped. There was no more music to dance to. Sue came into the room and laughed at Tim. She said, "I told you not to be rude and push the button!" Tim was very sad, and there was no more music in his room ever again.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red barn. In the barn, there was a lot of hay. Many animals lived in the barn, and they all liked to eat the hay. There was a cow, a pig, a horse, and a little mouse. They were all friends. One day, the cow was eating hay when she saw the little mouse. The mouse was trying to carry a big piece of hay to his home. The cow wanted to support the mouse, so she said, "Mouse, let me help you with the hay." The mouse said, "Thank you, cow!"
