Ben and Sam are friends. They like to play in the park. They run and jump and slide. They have fun. One day, they see a dog in the park. The dog is thin and has a hurt leg. The dog looks sad and scared. Ben and Sam want to help the dog. "Hello, dog," Ben says. "What is your name? Where is your home?" The dog does not answer. The dog just whimpers and licks his leg. "Maybe he is hungry," Sam says. "Let's give him some food." Ben and Sam run to their bags and get some bread and cheese. They break them into small pieces and put them on the ground near the dog. "Here, dog," Sam says. "Eat some food. It will make you feel better." The dog smells the food and comes closer. He eats the bread and cheese. He wags his tail and looks at Ben and Sam. "Good dog," Ben says. "Do you want to be our friend?" The dog barks and licks Ben's hand. He answers yes. Ben and Sam smile and hug the dog. They decide to call him Spot. They take him to the vet and get him a bandage for his leg. They ask their moms if they can keep him. Their moms say yes. Ben and Sam are happy. They have a new friend. Spot is happy too. He has a new home. They play in the park every day. They have fun.

Once upon a time, in a nice little town, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to count and learn new things. One day, she wanted to learn a new language. She thought it would be fun to talk to more friends. Lily asked her mom for help. Her mom said, "We can learn a new language together!" They started to learn the new language by counting. They counted one, two, three, and more! Lily was very happy. Soon, Lily could speak the new language. She made many new friends at school. They talked and played together. Lily was glad that she learned the new language. She thought counting was a fun way to learn.

Once upon a time there was a competitive family. A Mommy, Daddy, and their three year old son, Joe. Everyday the family would play games against each other. Joe loved to compete and often won. One day, Mommy and Daddy made a promise to Joe. They told him that if he won a special game, they would shout and congratulate him on his victory. Joe was excited and tried his best to win. Eventually, Joe won the game, and like they promised Mommy and Daddy shouted congratulations and cheered for him. Joe was so happy, and laughed and cheered back. It had been a fun day with lots of shouting, smiles and cheers. Joe couldn't wait for the next game with his family and his chance for another victory.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little oyster named Ollie. Ollie lived in the deep blue sea with his family. He was very shy, so he did not like to open up and talk to others. One sunny day, Ollie saw a pretty pearl on the ocean floor. He wanted to give the pearl to his mom as a gift. But he was too shy to open up and pick it up with his shell. Ollie's friend, a small fish named Fifi, saw him looking at the pearl. Fifi knew Ollie was shy, so she helped him. She pushed the pearl into Ollie's shell. Ollie was so happy and said "thank you" to Fifi. Ollie opened up his shell and gave the pretty pearl to his mom. His mom was so happy and proud of Ollie. From that day on, Ollie was not as shy as before. He learned that opening up to others can bring happiness and new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia was an adventurous girl who liked to explore. One sunny day, Mia went for a walk in the woods with her mom and dad. In the woods, Mia saw a pear tree. She wanted to pick a pear, but they were too high. So, Mia's dad said, "I will raise you up." He lifted Mia so she could reach the pears. Mia picked a big, juicy pear and smiled. Later, they had a picnic under the pear tree. Mia shared her pear with her mom and dad. They all enjoyed the sweet fruit. Mia was happy she could pick the pear, and her adventure in the woods was a success.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to go to class and learn new things. One day, her teacher told the class about a rare bird that lived in a big tree near the school. The teacher said, "If you can get a picture of the rare bird, I will give you a gold star." Mia and her friends were very excited. After class, Mia and her friends went to the big tree to look for the rare bird. They waited and waited, but the bird did not come. Mia's friend Tom said, "I am tired of waiting. Let's go play." But Mia wanted to see the rare bird, so she stayed by the tree. Finally, the rare bird came and sat on a branch. Mia took a picture of the bird with her camera. The next day, she showed the picture to her teacher and got a gold star. Mia's friends were happy for her and learned that sometimes, you have to be patient to get what you want.

Once there was a little girl who wanted a new toy. She noticed a lovely one at a shop but it was very expensive. She was so sad. Just then, her dad said, "I know you can be clever and come up with a way to get that toy". She thought hard and had an idea. She asked a friend if she could mind their pet for a few days. In exchange, her friend said she could have the toy. The little girl was happy and said yes straight away. She went to her friend's house and played with the pet for a few days. The pet was happy and she was happy too. In the end, she got the toy she wanted and thanked her friend for helping her. It was a very clever idea!

Once upon a time, there was a lively little bunny named Bob. Bob loved to hop and play all day long. One day, while playing, Bob found a hole in the ground. He was very curious about what was underground. Bob hopped into the hole and saw a little mole named Max. Max was busy picking up rocks and dirt. Bob said, "Hi Max! What are you doing?" Max replied, "I am picking up rocks to make my home bigger." Bob wanted to help Max, so they both started to pick up rocks together. They worked hard and had fun. After they were done, Max thanked Bob for his help. They became best friends and played together every day. The underground became a lively place for both of them.

Lily and Ben are twins. They have a birthday today. Mom and Dad give them a big gift. They are very happy. "Can we open it now?" Lily asks. "Yes, but be careful. It is fragile," Mom says. Lily and Ben tear the paper. Inside is a beautiful dollhouse. It has many rooms and furniture. Lily and Ben love it. "Wow, it is so pretty!" Lily says. "Can I play with it?" Ben asks. "Sure, but let me show you how to stand it up first," Lily says. Lily tries to stand the dollhouse on the floor. But she is careless. She pushes it too hard. The dollhouse falls over. It breaks into pieces. Lily and Ben are sad. "Look what you did!" Ben cries. "It was an accident!" Lily says. Mom and Dad hear the noise. They come to see what happened. "Oh no, what a mess!" Mom says. "I'm sorry, Mom. I was careless," Lily says. "It's okay, Lily. We can fix it. But you have to be more careful next time," Dad says. He hugs Lily and Ben. He helps them pick up the pieces. He glues them together. He makes the dollhouse stand again. "Thank you, Dad. You are the best," Lily and Ben say. They hug Dad. They play with the dollhouse. They are happy again.

One day, a boy went for a walk. He saw an impressive pebble on the ground. The pebble was shiny and pretty. The boy picked up the pebble and wanted to show it to his friends. The boy walked to his friends' house. He was excited to show them the pebble. When he got there, he saw that his friends were playing with a ball. He wanted to play with them. The boy showed the pebble to his friends. They did not think it was impressive. They wanted to keep playing with the ball. The boy was sad. He put the pebble in his pocket and went home.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree. The tree was very impressive. It had many leaves and branches. The tree loved to hug the soil with its roots. The soil was very happy and gave the tree lots of food and water. One day, a little boy came to play near the tree. He saw the tree hugging the soil. The little boy thought it was fun. He wanted to hug the tree too. So, he ran to the tree and gave it a big hug. The tree was very happy. The tree and the little boy became good friends. They hugged each other every day. Soon, other kids came to play with the tree too. They all hugged the tree and the soil. The tree and the soil were very happy. The kids learned that it is good to love and care for nature. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a fox went to play in the woods. The sun was shining and it was a fine day. The fox was very happy, running and jumping around. While playing, he saw a little bird sitting on a tree branch. "Hello, little bird!" said the fox. "Do you want to play with me?" The little bird looked at the fox and said, "Yes, I want to play, but I can't fly very well. Can you help me?" The fox smiled and said, "Of course! I will help you learn to fly." The fox and the little bird played together all day. The little bird tried to fly, but he kept falling down. The fox was patient and helped the little bird try again and again. Then, something unexpected happened. The little bird finally flew high up in the sky! The fox and the little bird were both very happy. The moral of the story is that with patience and help from friends, we can learn to do new things.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to go to a big meeting. He asked his mom, "Can I go to the meeting?" His mom said, "No, Tim. It is not for kids." Tim was sad but he had an idea. He put on a big hat and a long coat to look like a grown-up. He felt a little stupid, but he wanted to try. He walked to the meeting and opened the door. Inside, people were talking and laughing. Tim tried to act like them but he was too small. A man saw him and said, "Hey, you are just a kid!" Everyone looked at Tim and laughed. Tim felt very bad and ran home.

Tom and Lily were playing with their toy cars in the garden. They liked to race them on the dirt path and make vroom noises. Tom had a red car and Lily had a blue car. They both loved their cars very much. One day, a big dog came into the garden. He saw the toy cars and thought they were bones. He ran towards them and grabbed Tom's red car in his mouth. He bit it hard and tore off one of the wheels. Tom saw this and was very upset. He cried and shouted at the dog. "Bad dog! Give me back my car! You broke it!" Tom said. Lily heard Tom and came to see what was wrong. She saw the dog with the red car and felt sorry for Tom. She also felt scared of the dog. She wanted to help Tom, but she did not know what to do. She remembered that her mom had told her to be kind to animals, even if they did something wrong. She also remembered that her mom had given her a bag of dog treats. She ran to get the bag and came back to the garden. She waved the bag at the dog and said in a soft voice. "Hello, dog. Do you want a treat? Let go of the car and I will give you one." The dog smelled the treat and let go of the car. He wagged his tail and came closer to Lily. Lily gave him a treat and petted him gently. The dog licked her hand and barked happily. Tom stopped crying and picked up his car. He saw that the wheel was gone and felt sad. He looked at Lily and the dog and felt a little better. He said to Lily. "Thank you, Lily. You are very brave and nice. I'm sorry I yelled at the dog. He did not know it was my car." Lily smiled and said to Tom. "You're welcome, Tom. I'm sorry your car is broken. Maybe we can fix it together. Or we can share my car. It has four wheels." Tom nodded and said to Lily. "Okay, Lily. You are a good friend. And the dog is not so bad. Maybe we can play with him too." They hugged each other and played with the dog and the cars. They learned that being kind and forgiving is better than being angry and mean. They also learned that sharing and helping is more fun than fighting and hurting. They had a happy day in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet cat named Kitty. Kitty had a diary. In the diary, she wrote about her day. One day, Kitty went to play outside. She forgot to take her diary with her. Kitty did not want to leave her diary alone. She was scared someone would find it. Kitty ran back home to get her diary. When she found it, she was very happy. She took her diary with her everywhere she went. Kitty and her diary lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a sad little dog named Spot. Spot was sad because he lost his toy bone. He looked everywhere for it, but he could not find it. Spot was so sad that he started to cry. One day, Spot saw smoke coming from a house. He heard a little girl inside yelling, "Help! Help!" Spot wanted to help, so he ran to the house. He found a sharp rock and used it to break the door open. Spot went inside and saw the little girl. She was scared, but happy to see Spot. "Thank you, Spot!" she said. Spot wagged his tail and felt happy. The little girl had found Spot's toy bone! They both played together and were not sad anymore.

Once upon a time, in a peaceful town, there lived a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her toy bunny. One day, Lucy saw the sun disappear, and the sky became dark. It was time for bed. Lucy went to her room, and she could not find her toy bunny. She was sad and asked her mom, "Mom, where is my toy bunny?" Her mom said, "I don't know, let's look for it." They looked in the living room, the kitchen, and even under Lucy's bed. But they could not find the toy bunny. Lucy was very sad, and she thought her toy bunny was gone forever. Then, Lucy's dad came home from work. He saw Lucy crying and asked, "Why are you sad, Lucy?" She told him about her toy bunny. Her dad smiled and said, "I have a surprise for you!" He opened his bag, and there was the toy bunny! It was not lost, but with her dad all along. Lucy was so happy, and she hugged her dad and her toy bunny. They all had a good night and went to bed with smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a little car named Zoom. Zoom was very fast and very loud. Zoom loved to race around the town, making all the people smile. One day, Zoom saw a big cat. The cat was sleepy and let out a big yawn. Zoom thought it was funny and wanted to make the cat laugh. So, Zoom raced around the cat, making loud noises. The cat opened its big eyes and watched Zoom go fast. The cat started to laugh and play with Zoom. They had lots of fun together. And from that day on, Zoom and the big cat were the best of friends.

One day, a big dog and a little cat lived in a small house. The big dog loved to bake yummy treats. The little cat loved to eat them. They were very happy. One sunny day, the big dog was very tired. He wanted to rest on the couch. But the little cat was on the couch too. The big dog said, "Please move, I am tired." The little cat did not want to move. They both wanted the couch. The big dog had an idea. He said, "Let's bake some treats. If you help me, we can both sit on the couch after." The little cat agreed. They baked many treats and shared them. Then, they both sat on the couch, happy and tired.

Tom and Lily are best friends. They like to play together every day. They share their toys and help each other. They are dependable friends. One day, Tom has a surprise for Lily. He takes a big box and puts something inside. He wraps the box with colorful paper and ties a bow on top. He is very excited to give it to Lily. He goes to Lily's house and knocks on the door. Lily opens the door and sees Tom with the box. She smiles and says, "Hi, Tom! What is that?" Tom says, "It is a surprise for you, Lily! I made it for you because you are my best friend. Do you want to open it?" Lily says, "Yes, please! Thank you, Tom! You are so kind and thoughtful!" She takes the box from Tom and puts it on the floor. She carefully unwraps the paper and opens the box. She gasps and claps her hands. Inside the box, there is a beautiful doll with long hair and a pink dress. Lily loves dolls. She hugs the doll and says, "Wow, Tom! This is the best surprise ever! I love it so much! How did you make it?" Tom says, "I used some old clothes and some yarn and some buttons. I sewed them together and stuffed them with cotton. I wanted to make something special for you." Lily says, "You are very clever and creative, Tom! This is the most special doll I ever had. Thank you, thank you, thank you!" She hugs Tom and says, "You are the best friend I ever had!" Tom and Lily are very happy. They play with the doll and have fun. They are dependable friends who make each other happy. They are very lucky to have each other.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play and have fun. One day, Max was invited to a big event. It was a party for all the animals in the town. Max was very excited and could not wait to go. At the party, Max saw a big cake on a table. Max felt guilty because he wanted to eat the cake, but he knew he should not. Max went to his friend, a cat named Lucy, and said, "Lucy, I want to eat the cake. Can you help me?" Lucy did not want Max to feel bad, so she had an idea. She said, "Max, let's request a piece of cake from the host. They might give us some if we ask nicely." Max agreed, and they both went to the host and asked for some cake. The host smiled and gave Max and Lucy each a piece of cake. Max and Lucy were very happy and enjoyed the cake together. The party was a lot of fun, and Max learned that it is always better to ask for something instead of taking it without permission.

Once upon a time, there was a little wet dog named Spot. Spot loved to play in the rain. One day, Spot saw a big car. In the car, there was an infant. The infant was smiling and laughing. Spot wanted to drive the car too. So, he jumped in and sat next to the infant. The infant clapped his hands and giggled. Spot tried to drive the car, but he was too small. The infant tried to help, but he was too little too. Then, a big person came and saw Spot and the infant. The big person smiled and said, "You two are so cute, but you can't drive the car." The big person picked up Spot and the infant, and they all went inside to get dry and warm. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little girl named Sue found a big fan in her room. She did not know what it was for. She asked her mom, "What is this big thing?" Her mom said, "It is a useful fan. It helps us stay cool when it is hot. But it is broken now. We need to mail it to be fixed." Sue was sad because it was very hot, and she wanted the fan to work. She knew her friend Tom was good at fixing things. So, she asked her mom if they could try to fix it before mailing it. Her mom agreed. Sue took the fan to Tom's house. Tom looked at the fan and found a small part that was not right. He fixed the part, and the fan started to work again! Sue was very happy. Sue and Tom took the fan back to Sue's house. Her mom was surprised and said, "You two are very useful! Now we don't have to mail the fan, and we can stay cool." Sue and Tom felt proud that they could help.

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a little bug. The bug was weak and could not fly. It had a friend, a small bird. They liked to play together. One day, the bird said, "Bug, let's sit on the leaf and talk." The bug was happy and said, "Yes, let's do that!" So, they both sat on the leaf and talked about fun things. As they talked, the weak bug saw a pretty flower. It wanted to go there. The bird saw the bug looking and said, "Do you want to go to the flower?" The bug said, "Yes, but I am too weak to fly." The bird smiled and said, "I can help you." So, the bird picked up the bug and took it to the flower. They had a great day playing together.

Once upon a time, in a small yellow house, lived a little girl named Ella. Ella loved to have tea parties with her stuffed animals. One sunny day, Ella set up a tea party in her backyard under a big tree. Ella poured tea into tiny cups for her stuffed animals. She whispered to her favorite teddy bear, "This tea is for you, Mr. Bear." Mr. Bear seemed to smile back at her. As Ella and her stuffed animals enjoyed their tea, a little bird landed on the tree branch above them. The bird looked down and said, "Can I join your tea party?" Ella smiled and whispered, "Yes, you can join us!" The bird flew down and sat with Ella and her stuffed animals, and they all had a lovely yellow tea party together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He had a special thing that could shrink. He loved to play with this incredible thing, but he always kept it a secret. One day, Tom met a friend named Sue. They played together all day long. Tom wanted to show Sue his secret thing, but he was not sure if he should. He asked Sue, "Do you like incredible things?" Sue said, "Yes, I do! I love incredible things!" Tom decided to show Sue his special thing. He took it out and said, "This thing can shrink anything!" Sue was amazed. Tom showed her how it worked. They shrunk a big ball and it became very small. They laughed and played with the tiny ball. They knew that they would have many more fun days with the incredible shrinking thing.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk in the woods. He saw a deep hole in the ground. Tim was curious, so he climbed down into the hole. Inside the hole, he found a small box. He opened the box and saw gold inside. Tim said, "Wow, I found gold! I will show my friend, Sam." So, Tim took the gold and went to find Sam. When he found Sam, he showed him the gold. Sam looked at the gold and said, "I hate gold. It is not fun to play with." Tim was sad that Sam did not like the gold. But then, Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's use the gold to buy toys we both like." Sam smiled and said, "That is a great idea!" So, Tim and Sam went to the store and bought toys with the gold. They played together all day and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had a toy rope that he loved to play with. One day, he saw his friend, a cat named Fluffy, playing with a shiny new toy. Spot felt jealous. Spot went to Fluffy and said, "Can I play with your toy?" Fluffy said, "I will share my toy if you share your rope with me." So, they decided to share their toys and play together. As they played, Spot learned that sharing was more fun than staying jealous. He was happy to have a friend to play with, and they both enjoyed their toys even more. And from that day on, Spot and Fluffy always shared their toys and had lots of fun together. The moral of the story is that sharing is better than being jealous.

Once upon a time there was a brave soldier. He belonged to a special team of soldiers. He wore a smart uniform and a bright hat. Every day, he went out and fought for his country. He was brave and strong, and would never give up. The brave soldier worked hard and was able to help his country to win many battles. Everyone in his team was so proud of him. He always said that he belonged to the very best soldiers. One day, the brave soldier had to go on a special mission. He and his team had to fight the biggest battle ever. They all worked very hard and eventually they won. The team danced and cheered, and the brave soldier was so happy. He knew that he belonged with the best soldiers.

One day, a little ant was walking in the calm woods. The ant liked to look at the trees and the flowers. The sun was shining bright and the sky was blue. The ant was happy. As the ant walked, it saw a big spring. The spring was like a big bed. The ant wanted to play on the spring. The ant climbed up and jumped on the spring. The spring went up and down, and the ant laughed. The ant played on the spring all day. Then, it was time to go home. The ant said goodbye to the spring and walked back to its ant hill. The ant told all its friends about the fun day on the spring.

One day, a little girl named Lucy had a dream. In her dream, she saw an incredible cupboard. It was big and colorful. Lucy wanted to see what was inside the cupboard. She opened the door and found many toys and yummy treats. Lucy's friend, Tom, came over to play. They went to the cupboard and opened it. But this time, it was empty! They were sad. "Where did all the toys and treats go?" Tom asked. Lucy said, "I don't know. They were here in my dream." Then, Lucy's mom came into the room with a big box. She said, "Surprise! I have a gift for you." They opened the box and found all the toys and treats from Lucy's dream! Lucy and Tom were so happy. They played with the toys and ate the treats all day. The incredible cupboard was real, and their day was full of fun and laughter.

One day, a boy named Tom went to the museum with his mom. The museum was big and had many things to see. Tom liked the museum a lot. In the museum, Tom saw a play area. He asked his mom if he could play there. His mom said yes, because she knew Tom was dependable. Tom was very happy. Tom played in the museum with other kids. They had so much fun. After playing, Tom and his mom went home. Tom told his mom that he loved the museum and wanted to go back again.

Lily and Max were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. They liked to slide, swing, and chase each other. One day, they saw a big firework show in the sky. It was incredible. They saw many colors and shapes and heard loud noises. "Wow, look at that!" Lily said. "It is so pretty!" "I want to see more!" Max said. "Let's run closer!" They ran across the street, not looking for cars. They wanted to get to the firework place. They did not see the red light or hear the horn. A big car hit them. They fell down and did not get up. The firework show went on, but they did not see it. They only saw sparks in their eyes. They were hurt very bad. The end.

Once there was a little boy named Ben. He was very obedient; he always obeyed his Mummy and Daddy. One day, Mummy gave Ben a lollipop. He was so excited and he wanted to bounce around. When he started bouncing, Ben saw a big frog. He wanted to give it his lollipop. He asked Mummy if he could, but she said no. Ben got sad, but he was an obedient boy and he listened to Mummy. Then, he saw a squirrel. He asked Mummy if he could bounce to the squirrel and give it the lollipop. She said yes! So Ben excitedly bounced over and gave the squirrel the lollipop. The squirrel was so happy and thanked Ben with a big hug. Ben was delighted. He had been obedient, and still have been able to have a nice time!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Elle. She loved to run around and explore the world around her. One day Elle was running through the park and she came to a very impressive tower. She stopped and looked up. It was so high she couldn't believe it. She suddenly heard a voice from up above. It was a friendly voice and it said: "Hello little girl, why don't you come up and see me?" Elle was so excited! She ran as fast as she could to the tower and soon she reached the top. There she found a friendly old man and he welcomed her. He said "Come, I will show you something amazing". He opened a window and Elle could see a beautiful landscape. She was so impressed by it that she couldn't believe it. She looked around in wonder, feeling so happy and excited. Then the old man said: "Now, come run around with me so you can explore it all!" Elle couldn't be more thrilled! She ran around the tower with the old man and they laughed and played together. Elle was so happy to have found this impressive tower and the beautiful view it opened up to her.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat delicious cookies. One day, he found a big jar in the kitchen. The jar was full of cookies. Tim was very happy. Tim wanted to eat all the cookies, but he knew he should not. He took one cookie and it was very delicious. Tim could not stop. He ate one more, then another, and another. Soon, the jar was empty. Later, Tim's tummy hurt a lot. He felt bad and he knew he should not have eaten all the cookies. Tim felt regret. He wished he had not eaten all the cookies. Now, the jar was empty and Tim's tummy hurt. This was a bad ending for Tim.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little boy named Tim. Tim loved to ride the big, yellow bus to school every day. One day, his mom told him that a new friend would be joining him on the bus ride tomorrow. Tim was very excited to meet his new friend. The next day, Tim got on the bus and looked around for his new friend. He saw a little girl with a big, red bag, sitting all by herself. Tim walked over and sat next to her. "Hi, I'm Tim!" he said with a big smile. The little girl smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Lily!" Tim and Lily became best friends on the bus ride to school. They played games and shared their snacks. One day, Tim had an idea. "Let's add our snacks together and make a big snack for everyone on the bus!" he said. Lily thought that was a great idea. So, Tim and Lily added their snacks together and shared them with all their friends on the bus. Everyone was so happy and grateful. Tim and Lily felt proud that they could make everyone's bus ride more fun. And from that day on, the bus rides to school were always filled with laughter and joy.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the store with her mom. She saw a big jar of candy on a high shelf. She wanted the candy so much, she started to point at it. "Mom, I want that candy, please!" Lucy said. Her mom looked at the jar and said, "No, Lucy. That candy is too high up and it's dangerous for you to try to get it. We can get some other candy instead." But Lucy didn't listen to her mom. She wanted that candy more than anything. When her mom wasn't looking, Lucy tried to climb the shelf to get the candy. She climbed higher and higher, but the shelf was not strong. It started to shake and fall. The candy jar fell too and broke into many pieces. Lucy fell and got hurt. She cried and her mom came running. "I told you it was dangerous, Lucy," her mom said. Now, Lucy had no candy and she was hurt.

One day, a smelly cat named Tom went to the park. He saw a big tree and wanted to sit under it to rest. As he sat down, he saw a little bird named Timmy sitting on a branch. "Hi, Timmy!" said Tom. "Will you sit with me under the tree?" "Okay, Tom," said Timmy, and he flew down to sit with Tom. As they sat, a big wind came and blew away the smelly smell from Tom. But then, a big dog named Max came running. Max saw Tom and Timmy and wanted to play. Max jumped and barked, scaring Timmy away. Tom tried to run, but Max was too fast. Max caught Tom and wouldn't let him go. Tom was very sad and missed his friend Timmy.

Lily loved to play with her toy dragon. It was green and soft and had shiny wings. She liked to pretend that it could fly and breathe fire. Sometimes, she would take it outside and run around the garden with it. One night, Lily had a dream. She dreamed that her toy dragon came to life and took her to a big castle. There, she met a real dragon. He was big and red and had scales and horns. He was very friendly and told her his name was Rolo. He said he was the king of the dragons and he had a very important job. "What is your job?" Lily asked. "I have to glow every night," Rolo said. "I glow so bright that I light up the sky. I help the stars and the moon to shine. I make the night beautiful and safe for everyone." "Wow, that is amazing!" Lily said. "Can I see you glow?" "Of course," Rolo said. "But you have to close your eyes first. It is very bright." Lily closed her eyes and hugged her toy dragon. She felt a warm and gentle light on her face. She heard Rolo roar and felt him flap his wings. She smiled and felt happy. She opened her eyes and saw that she was back in her bed. It was morning and the sun was shining. She looked at her toy dragon and saw that it had a faint glow on its wings. She wondered if it was a gift from Rolo. She kissed it and said, "Thank you, Rolo. You are the best dragon ever."

One day, a lovely cat named Kitty saw a cup of coffee on the table. Kitty was very curious and wanted to know what it was. She jumped up on the table and looked at the coffee. She thought it was a fun toy and wanted to play with it. Kitty's friend, Doggy, came into the room and saw Kitty on the table. Doggy knew that coffee was not a toy, but he wanted to have fun too. He started to clap his paws and dance around the table. Kitty was excited and began to clap her paws too. As Kitty and Doggy clapped and danced, the table started to shake. The cup of coffee wobbled and then fell over. The hot coffee spilled everywhere, making a big mess. Kitty and Doggy were sad because they knew they did something wrong. They learned that coffee was not a toy and that they should be more careful next time.

Lila was a girl who liked to play in the garden. She liked to dig and plant and water the flowers. One day, she found a big, old pumpkin in a corner of the garden. It was round and orange and had a long stem. Lila wondered what was inside the pumpkin. She took a knife from the kitchen and cut a hole in the pumpkin. She looked inside and saw a lot of seeds and pulp. It smelled bad and was wet and mushy. Lila said, "Yuck! This pumpkin is rotting!" She threw the knife away and ran to the house. She told her mom what she had found. Her mom said, "That pumpkin is very old, Lila. It was left over from Halloween. Do you know what Halloween is?" Lila shook her head. She did not know what Halloween was. Her mom said, "Halloween is a fun day when people dress up and go trick-or-treating. They knock on doors and say 'trick or treat' and get candy. Some people also carve pumpkins and make them into lanterns. They cut out eyes and a mouth and put a candle inside. They look scary and funny at night." Lila said, "That sounds fun! Can we do that next Halloween?" Her mom said, "Sure, we can. But we need a fresh pumpkin, not an old one. An old one will rot and smell and attract bugs. We can go to the farm and pick a new one when it is time." Lila said, "OK, mom. But can I keep the old pumpkin for now? I want to make something with it." Her mom said, "What do you want to make, Lila?" Lila said, "I want to make a prince!" Her mom smiled and said, "A prince? How will you do that?" Lila said, "I will use a magic wand and say 'abracadabra' and the pumpkin will turn into a prince. Then he will be my friend and we will play together." Her mom said, "That sounds like a nice idea, Lila. But you know that magic is not real, right? It is only pretend. The pumpkin will not really turn into a prince. It will just stay a pumpkin." Lila said, "I know, mom. But I can pretend. It is fun to pretend. Maybe the pumpkin will pretend too. Maybe he will be happy to be a prince and not a rotting pumpkin." Her mom said, "OK, Lila. You can keep the pumpkin and pretend. But don't forget to wash your hands after you touch it. And don't let it make a mess in the garden. And don't be sad if it falls apart. It is just an old pumpkin, not a real prince." Lila said, "OK, mom. I will remember. Thank you for letting me keep the pumpkin. I will be nice to him and he will be nice to me. He will be the best prince ever!" Lila ran back to the garden with a stick in her hand. She said it was her magic wand. She waved it over the pumpkin and said, "Abracadabra! You are a prince now! Hello, prince! What is your name?" The pumpkin did not answer. It did not move. It did not change. It was still a pumpkin. But Lila did not mind. She smiled and said, "Your name is Prince Pumpkin. You are my friend. Let's play!"

Once upon a time, in a big palace, there was a small cat. The cat had smooth fur. The cat liked to play all day. One day, a new dog came to the palace. The dog was big and liked to play too. But the cat did not want to play with the dog. The cat would complain when the dog tried to play. The dog was sad. The cat and dog did not play together. One day, the dog found a ball. The dog played with the ball and had fun. The cat saw the dog and wanted to play too. The cat and dog played with the ball together. They had lots of fun. They became friends and never complained again. They lived happily in the palace.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the airport with his mom. They were going to visit Tim's grandma. Tim was very excited, as he had never been on a plane before. At the airport, Tim saw a man who looked very rich. The man had a big bag and a fancy hat. Tim went up to the rich man and said, "Hi! Are you going on a plane too?" The rich man looked down at Tim and said, "Yes, I am. But I have a problem. I lost my ticket and I don't know where it is!" Tim wanted to help, so he started to look around for the ticket. Tim looked and looked, but he could not find the ticket. Just when he was about to give up, he saw a little bird fly by with a piece of paper in its beak. It was the rich man's ticket! Tim ran after the bird and caught it. He gave the ticket back to the rich man, who was very happy. The rich man said, "Thank you, Tim! You are a very good helper. I want to give you a gift." The rich man gave Tim a toy airplane to play with. Tim was so happy and couldn't wait to show his mom. As they boarded the plane, Tim's mom said, "You did a great job helping the rich man, Tim. I am so proud of you." Tim smiled and held his new toy airplane tight. He knew that this trip to the airport was one he would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a great big house. In the house, there was an attic. The attic was dark and full of old things. One day, a little boy named Tim went up to the attic. He wanted to find a toy to play with. In the attic, Tim found a box. He opened the box and saw a record. Tim took the record downstairs to show his mom. "Mom, look what I found!" he said. "Can we play it?" His mom said, "Yes, let's play it on the record player." They put the record on the player and started to dance. Suddenly, the record started talking! It said, "Hello, I am a magic record. I will grant you one wish." Tim and his mom were very surprised. They thought about their wish for a moment. Tim said, "I wish for a fun day with my family." The magic record made their wish come true, and they had the best day ever.

One day, a big boat and a small boat were near the water. The big boat said, "I am great because I am big." The small boat felt sad. The two boats started to discuss. The big boat said, "I can carry more people and go fast." The small boat said, "I can go to places you cannot go because I am small." One day, there was a family who wanted to go to a special place. The big boat could not go there because it was too big. The small boat took the family to the special place. The family was happy. The big boat learned that being great is not only about being big. Both big and small boats can be great in different ways. The two boats became friends and helped each other.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a cold metal toy in his toy box. He did not know where it came from. The toy was very different from his other toys. It was shiny and heavy. Tim wanted to play with it, but it was too cold to hold. Tim went to his mom and said, "Mom, this toy is too cold. I can't play with it." His mom looked at the cold metal toy and thought for a moment. She said, "Let's wrap it in a warm blanket, and then you can play with it." So, Tim and his mom wrapped the cold metal toy in a warm blanket. After a while, the toy was not cold anymore. Tim was happy and did not complain. He played with his new metal toy all day long, and it became one of his favorite toys.

John was excited. He was going to the stadium with his momma and dad. He loved going to the stadium. He knew it was going to be so much fun. John and his family arrived at the stadium. It was so big and clean. Everything looked so nice. John couldn't believe how big the stadium was. He saw lots of people walking around. Mom and Dad smiled and nodded to each other. John saw them but he wasn't sure what they were doing. His mom explained. They were nodding to say they were ready to have a great time at the stadium. John was happy. He smiled and nodded too. He felt so excited. His parents grabbed his hand and they all went inside the stadium. John couldn't wait to explore and have an awesome time with his family.

Once upon a time, in a beautiful big barn, there lived a happy cow named Daisy. Daisy loved to play with her friends, the chickens and the pigs. They would run and jump in the warm sun all day long. One day, Daisy's friends said, "Let's play hide and seek!" Daisy was so excited. She closed her eyes and counted, "One, two, three, four, five!" When she opened her eyes, she looked for her friends. She found the chickens behind the hay and the pigs under the tree. But then, something unexpected happened! Daisy heard a tiny voice say, "You didn't find me!" She looked around and saw a little mouse hiding in the grass. "Wow, you're so good at hiding!" said Daisy. The mouse smiled and they all played together, having lots of fun. From that day on, Daisy and her friends loved playing hide and seek with their new friend, the little mouse.

One day, a boy named Tim had a rake. He liked to help his mom by raking the leaves. Tim's mom said, "Thank you, Tim. You are a big help." Tim felt happy. Tim saw an angry cat in the yard. The cat did not like Tim raking its home. Tim did not know the cat lived in the leaves. The cat said, "Stop! You are making me mad!" Tim stopped raking and looked at the cat. He said, "I am sorry, cat. I did not know you lived here." Then, something unexpected happened. The angry cat became a nice cat! The cat said, "Thank you, Tim. Now we can be friends." Tim and the cat played together and had fun.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk in the park. He saw a big slide and wanted to play on it. The sun was very bright and the slide felt hot, but Tim did not mind. Tim walked up the steps and slid down the slide. It was a little harsh because of the heat, but he had so much fun. He saw a little girl named Sue watching him. Tim asked, "Do you want to play with me?" Sue said, "Yes, I want to slide too!" So, they walked to the slide together. They took turns sliding down and laughed a lot. Tim and Sue played until the sun went down. They became good friends and loved playing on the slide together.

One day, a boy named Tim got a smelly sock. He did not like the smell. Tim had an idea. He would send a picture to his friend, Sam, to show him the smelly sock. Tim took a picture of the sock and gave it to Sam. Sam looked at the picture and said, "Wow, that sock looks smelly!" Sam wanted to help Tim. He told Tim to wash the sock. Tim washed the sock and it was not smelly anymore. Tim and Sam were happy. They played with their toys and laughed.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Sue. Sue loved to eat prunes. One day, Sue found a big bag of prunes in the kitchen. She was so excited! Sue's friend, Tim, came over to play. He saw the prunes and said, "Yuck! I don't like prunes." Sue smiled and said, "That's okay, Tim. I will comfort you and help you try one." Tim took a small bite of the prune. He was surprised! "Wow, Sue! This is yummy!" he said. Sue and Tim laughed and ate the prunes together. They were very happy and had a fun day playing.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Lucy and John. Lucy wanted to lend her prize to John. She had won it at the school fair and it was very special. It was a teddy bear with a famous bow. John was very excited. He said, "Can I really borrow it?" "Yes," said Lucy, "but you must take good care of it. And promise me you will bring it back to me." John promised and thanked Lucy. He said, "Thank you for lending me your prize. Now I can show it off to all of my friends!" Lucy smiled. "You're welcome," she said. And that's how Lucy and John shared a famous prize!

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom had a friend, a little bird named Tim. They liked to play and have fun together every day. One sunny day, Tom and Tim decided to perform a show for their friends. Tom would jump and Tim would sing. They practiced and practiced until they were ready. The day of the show came, and all their friends gathered to watch. Tom jumped high and Tim sang a pretty song. Their friends clapped and cheered. "Good job, Tom!" said Tim. "Thank you, Tim! We did it!" Tom replied. Tom and Tim were happy that their friends liked their show. They knew that working together made everything more fun.

Once upon a time, there was an old bell. The old bell loved to ring. It rang every day in a big tower. One sunny day, a little boy named Tim made a sandwich. It was a yummy sandwich with cheese and bread. Tim wanted to eat the sandwich under the big tower. As Tim sat under the tower, the old bell rang. The sandwich fell on the ground. Tim was sad. But then, a friendly dog came and ate the sandwich. Tim and the dog became best friends. They played together every day under the big tower, listening to the old bell ring.

Once upon a time, in a lively park, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her ball. One day, while she was playing, she saw a boy named Tim. Tim had a toy car. Lily thought the car looked fun, so she went to talk to Tim. "Can I borrow your car?" asked Lily. Tim looked at her and said, "Only if you let me play with your ball." Lily agreed, and they played together all day. They had so much fun with the ball and the car. As the sun started to set, Lily and Tim knew it was time to go home. They gave back the toys they borrowed. Tim hugged Lily with his little arm and said, "We should play together again!" Lily smiled and nodded. From that day on, they became the best of friends, always sharing and playing together.

Once there were two friends. One was called Terry and the other was called Sarah. They were playing a game. The game was a lot of fun and it made them laugh. Today when they were playing the game, Sarah was winning. She had the higher score. Terry felt a bit sad. "I want to win," he said to Sarah. Sarah smiled and said "Don't worry Terry. We can play something else. It'll be more interesting." Terry agreed and they chose a different game. This time they both wanted to win. They both tried their best. At the end of the game, Sarah won again! Terry was sad but Sarah said "It's ok. Let's just relax." So they stopped playing and Terry felt better. Even though he didn't win, he had fun playing with Sarah.

One day, a little dog named Max saw a man in a suit. The man looked nice, and Max wanted to follow him. So, Max started to walk behind the man. The man walked to a big shop that had many delicious things to eat. Inside the shop, the man in the suit saw Max and said, "Hello, little dog! Would you like something to eat?" Max wagged his tail and barked, "Yes, please!" The man in the suit gave Max a big, delicious bone to chew on. Max was very happy. After Max finished his bone, he and the man in the suit became good friends. They played games and went for long walks together. Max was so glad that he decided to follow the man in the suit. They had lots of fun and were happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play and run in the park. One day, Spot saw a big red ball. He wanted to play with the ball, so he ran to it. Spot tried to lift the big red ball with his mouth, but it was too heavy. He pushed and pulled, but the ball would not move. Spot felt sad, but he did not give up. He thought and thought about how to lift the ball. Then, Spot saw a little girl in the park. She was strong and could help him. Spot ran to the girl and barked. The girl saw the big red ball and knew Spot needed help. She walked to the ball and helped Spot lift it. They played with the big red ball all day and had lots of fun. Spot was very happy and made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She wanted to paint a picture. She had some paint and a canvas. But she was missing something important. She went outside and looked in the garden. She saw some ash. She thought it was important, so she picked some up. The girl went back inside and started to paint. She put the ash in the paints to make different colours. She painted a beautiful picture! She was so proud of her painting. She showed her mum and dad. They thought it was amazing! The girl was so happy. She knew that using the ash had made her painting even more special and important.

Once upon a time, in a jolly little town, there was a lot of snow. The snow was soft and white. It covered the ground like a big, fluffy blanket. The kids in the town loved to play in the snow. They would run, jump, and make snowmen all day long. One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to care for her snowman. She put a hat on its head and a scarf around its neck. She even found two sticks to use as arms. Lily was very happy with her snowman. She gave it a big hug and said, "I will take care of you, Mr. Snowman." As the days went by, Lily cared for her snowman. She made sure it was always warm and happy. The snowman was her best friend. They played together in the snow every day. And all the other kids in the town loved to play with them too. They were all very jolly and had lots of fun in the snow.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot was a very creative dog. He loved to play and make new games. One day, Spot found a flea on his back. The flea was very small and liked to jump. Spot felt embarrass because of the flea. He wanted to find a way to get the flea off his back. Spot tried to shake the flea off, but it did not work. The flea just jumped and laughed. Spot was sad. Then, something unexpected happened. Spot had an idea. He used his creative mind and made a new game. Spot called the game "Jump and Catch." Spot jumped and the flea jumped too. When the flea was in the air, Spot caught the flea in his mouth. Spot won the game and was not embarrass anymore. He was happy and proud.

Once upon a time, there was a good woman. She lived in a small house with her cat. The woman wanted to make her cat happy. One day, the woman saw a big ball. She thought, "My cat will want this ball to play with." So, she took the ball home. The cat saw the ball and was very happy. Every day, the woman and the cat played with the ball. They had a lot of fun together. The cat loved the good woman, and the woman loved her cat. They lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Tim. Tim liked to eat a lot. Every day, he would follow his owner to the kitchen to get food. Tim's owner would put the food in a dish for him to eat. Tim was always happy when he saw the dish. One day, Tim's owner put a new dish on the floor. It was big and shiny. Tim was so excited to eat from the new dish. He followed his owner to the kitchen, as always. But when he looked inside the new dish, there was no food! Tim was very sad and confused. Then, Tim's owner did something unexpected. She took off the top of the new dish, and there was food inside! It was a surprise for Tim. He was so happy to eat from the new dish. From that day on, Tim loved the new dish even more. And every time he followed his owner to the kitchen, he knew there would be a yummy surprise waiting for him.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim was a very honest boy. He always told the truth. Tim had a toy robot that he loved very much. One day, the toy robot stopped working. Tim was very sad. Tim went to his dad and requested, "Dad, please fix my robot." Dad said, "We need an operation to fix it." Tim watched as his dad tried to fix the robot. Dad took out his tools and started the operation. After a long time, Dad said, "I'm sorry, Tim. The operation did not work. The robot is broken forever." Tim was very sad, but he knew his dad tried his best. Even though the story has a bad ending, Tim still loved his dad because he was honest and tried to help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a friend named Tom. They liked to play with their toys and eat tasty food. One day, they decided to travel to the park. At the park, Lily and Tom saw a big tree. They played hide and seek with their new friend, a cute dog. The dog was very good at finding them. They all laughed and had fun together. After playing, they sat down and ate tasty sandwiches that Lily's mom made for them. They shared the food with their new dog friend. When it was time to go home, they said goodbye to the dog and promised to come back to the park soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ann. She was an obedient girl who always listened to her mom and dad. One day, her mom told her to be careful with the big jar on the table. Ann saw the jar and thought it was so pretty. She wanted to touch it, but she remembered what her mom said. She knew she had to prevent the jar from falling and breaking. Then, her friend Tim came to play. Tim saw the jar too and wanted to touch it. Ann told him "no" and stopped him. She was a good friend and kept the jar safe. Ann's mom was happy, and they all had a fun day playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely boy named Tim. Tim had no friends to play with. One day, he found a toy jeep in his room. The jeep was red and shiny. Tim was very happy. Tim loved to pretend with his jeep. He would drive it around his room, making car sounds. He would pretend the jeep was going on big adventures. The jeep would drive up high mountains and cross deep rivers. Tim and the jeep were best friends. One day, Tim took his jeep outside to play. He pretended the jeep was driving through a big jungle. But, Tim was not careful. He left the jeep on the road. A big car came and ran over the jeep. The jeep broke into pieces. Tim was very sad and lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny who lived in a garden. He was a very sweet bunny who loved to eat carrots. Every day, he would wake to a bright, sunny day, searching for carrots to eat. One day, the bunny saw something different in the garden. It was a pink carrot! The bunny wanted to try it, so he hopped over and grabbed the carrot with his teeth. It was very sweet and yummy! From then on, the bunny couldn't wait to go back to the garden every day. He searched until he found lots of pink carrots. He gained lots of energy from eating them. One day, he hopped into his pink car and drove off into the sunshine. He had a wonderful time and gained lots of fun. He even gained a new friend along the way!

Once upon a time, there was a big, ancient tree. It had a hole in it. Many animals lived in the hole. One day, a little boy named Tim went to the tree. He wanted to display his toys to the animals. He thought it would make them happy. When Tim reached the tree, he put his toys on the ground. He saw a small rabbit come out of the hole. The rabbit looked at the toys and smiled. Tim was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and took all the toys away. Tim and the rabbit were sad. But then, the wind came back and put the toys back on the ground. Tim and the rabbit laughed and played with the toys. The wind had played a trick on them. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim got a gift. He was happy to receive it. The gift was a toy car. Tim loved his new toy car and played with it all day. He took it with him everywhere he went. Tim's friend, Sam, saw the toy car and said, "That's a stupid toy car. I have a bigger and better one." Tim started to worry. He thought maybe his toy car was not good enough. He felt sad and did not want to play with it anymore. Tim's mom saw him feeling sad and asked, "What's wrong, Tim?" Tim told her what Sam said. His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry about what others say. Your toy car is special because it was a gift from someone who loves you. It doesn't matter if it's big or small. What matters is that you enjoy playing with it." Tim smiled and felt better. He played with his toy car again, not caring about what Sam said.

Once upon a time, in a lively jungle, there lived a big rhinoceros. He was very strong and loved to play with his friends. One day, he decided to prepare a big party for all his friends in the jungle. The rhinoceros worked hard to get everything ready for the party. He picked up fruits, made a big cake, and decorated the place with colorful leaves. All his friends were very excited to come to the party. At last, the party day came, and all the animals in the jungle were having fun. They ate, danced, and played games. But then, the rhinoceros got too excited and started running around. He accidentally knocked over a big tree. The tree fell down and broke everything at the party. All the animals were sad because the party was ruined. They went back to their homes, and the rhinoceros was left all alone. From that day on, the rhinoceros learned to be more careful when he played with his friends.

One day, a small boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a dull, gray cat sitting on a bench. Tim walked up to the cat and said, "Hi, cat! What is your name?" The cat looked at Tim and said, "My name is Max. I like to sit here all day." Tim thought it was fun to talk to Max. They sat on the bench together and talked about the park. Max told Tim about the birds he liked to watch and the dogs that ran by. Tim told Max about his favorite games to play with his friends. As the sun began to set, Tim said, "I have to go home now, Max. I had fun talking with you today!" Max smiled and said, "I had fun too, Tim. Come back soon and we can sit and talk some more." From that day on, Tim and Max became good friends. They would sit together at the park and talk about their days. And even though Max was a dull, gray cat, he made Tim's days bright and happy.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a loud dog named Spot. Spot loved to bark all day and all night. The people in the village were not happy with Spot's loud barks. They could not sleep well and the children could not play happily. One day, a wise old man came to the village. He saw the people were sad and asked them why. They told him about Spot's loud barks. The wise old man went to Spot and said, "If you turn your loud barks into soft barks, the people will be happy and they will love you." Spot listened to the wise old man and started to bark softly. The people in the village could sleep well and the children could play happily. They were all very happy with Spot and gave him treats and hugs. The moral of the story is that being kind and gentle can make everyone around you happy, and they will love you more.

Once upon a time, in a tidy little town, there lived a kind man named Tom. Tom had a special copper coin that he loved very much. One day, he met a sad boy who had lost his toy. Tom spoke to the boy, "Why are you sad?" The boy said, "I lost my toy and I can't find it." Tom wanted to help the boy feel better. He thought about his special copper coin and decided to give it to the boy. "Here, take my copper coin. It's special and will make you happy," Tom said. The boy's face lit up with joy. He thanked Tom and ran off to play with his new copper coin. Tom felt happy that he could help the boy. The moral of the story is that sharing can bring happiness to others and yourself.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable boy named Tom. He had a toy sword that he loved very much. Tom played with his sword every day and took it everywhere he went. One sunny day, Tom was playing with his sword in the park when a little frog hopped up to him. The frog looked at Tom and said, "Please, kiss me." Tom was surprised because frogs don't talk! But, he thought it would be fun, so he gave the frog a little kiss. Suddenly, the frog turned into a big, friendly dog! Tom was very happy because now he had a new friend to play with. They played with the sword together and had lots of fun. From that day on, Tom and his dog were always together, and they lived happily ever after.

Jim was walking down the street when he noticed a newspaper on the ground. He reached down and picked it up. "Maybe I can find something interesting inside," He thought. When he opened it, he saw a dead fly sitting on the front page. He was surprised. He looked around to see if anyone was watching, but no one was there. He tried to pick up the fly, but it was too hard. He didn't want to crush it, so he decided to try a different way. He got his net and was able to scoop it up. He put the fly in a jar and brought it home. He showed it to his three-year-old daughter. She was fascinated by it. "Can I keep it?" She asked. Jim smiled. "Well, you can try," he said. "But it's already dead, so I don't think it will last very long." He watched as she handled the fly with care. Jim was glad he had stopped to pick up that newspaper, and was happy his daughter had found something interesting in it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had an uncle who liked to sell things. His uncle had a regular shop in the town. Tim loved to visit his uncle's shop. One day, Tim went to his uncle's shop. He saw a big red ball. Tim wanted the ball very much. He asked his uncle, "Can I have the red ball, please?" His uncle smiled and said, "Yes, you can have it." Tim played with the red ball all day. He was very happy. His uncle was happy too, because he could make Tim smile. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a family that wanted to celebrate. They had a party and everyone was so excited. They turned on the lamp and it lit up the room. Everyone laughed and sang and played games. But then something bad happened. A careless boy knocked over the lamp and it broke. Everyone was sad and stopped playing. The family had to find a way to cheer everyone up. So they decided to celebrate in a different way. They all started singing and dancing and jumping around! It ended up being even more fun than the party before. Everyone laughed and had a great time. The family celebrated for the rest of the day and had lots of fun. They were all very glad that the lamp broke, because it made the celebration even better!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Ben. Ben liked to play in the tunnel near his home. One day, he went to the tunnel to play. He was always careful when he played there. While Ben was playing, he saw a big bear. The bear was sad. Ben asked the bear, "Why are you sad?" The bear said, "I am hungry, and I can't find any food." Ben wanted to help the bear. He thought he could provide some food for the bear. Ben went back to his home and got some food. He brought the food to the bear. The bear was very happy. Then, something unexpected happened. The bear said, "Thank you, Ben. I am not a real bear. I am a magic bear!" The magic bear gave Ben a wish for helping him. Ben wished for more friends to play with in the tunnel. The magic bear made Ben's wish come true, and they all played together in the tunnel.

Mary and Mommy were in the kitchen. Mary saw a shiny faucet. The faucet was round and had a heavy handle. Mommy saw her looking at it and said, "Let's spread some water!" Mommy grabbed the heavy handle and twisted it. Suddenly, water came out of the faucet. It made a funny sound as it flowed. Mary smiled and laughed. She felt the water on her hands and it was cold and wet. She used her hands to spread the water around. Soon Mommy turned the heavy handle the other way and the water stopped coming out. Mary waved her hands around and made the water move and splash. Mommy and Mary had a lot of fun spreading the water around!

Once upon a time, there was a cute dog named Spot. Spot loved to perform tricks for his family. He could sit, jump, and roll over. His family would clap and cheer when he did his tricks. One day, Spot's family had a fancy party. They wore pretty clothes and had yummy food. Spot wanted to show the guests his tricks. So he went to his family and said, "Watch me!" Spot performed all his tricks in front of the guests. They clapped and cheered, just like his family did. Spot felt very happy. After the party, his family gave him a big reward. They gave him a new toy and a big hug. Spot knew that he was a very good dog.

Once upon a time there were two big lions. The lions loved to fight each other. One day, they were fighting in the soil when suddenly a branch broke. They were so frightened that they ran away. The branch that broke was too close to the soil for them. They were scared and fought no more. But the soil was broken and messy after the lions fought. The two lions looked at each other sadly. They were sad that they had made the soil so broken. After a while, they ran off to find more nice soil where they could play safely. And from that day on they decided no more fighting in the soil.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a big, strong lion. The lion was very kind and liked to protect the village from any danger. All the animals in the village were happy and safe because of the lion. One day, a fearful wolf came to the village. He wanted to scare and hurt the animals. The lion saw the wolf and knew he had to protect his friends. The lion roared very loud and chased the wolf away. The wolf ran far away and never came back. The animals in the village were very thankful to the lion for protecting them. They learned that being kind and helping others is important. The lion taught them that they should always protect their friends and family, just like he did. And they all lived happily ever after.

Tom and Mia like to play in the park. They see a big grill with fire and smoke. They want to go near the grill and touch it. "No, no, no!" says Mom. "The grill is hot and dangerous. It can hurt you. You cannot go near the grill. Mom does not permit it." Tom and Mia are sad. They want to have fun. They look around the park. They see a slide, a swing, a sandbox and a ball. They smile. "Look, Mom!" says Tom. "There are many things to play with. We can have fun here. We do not need the grill." "Yes, you are right, Tom," says Mom. "You are smart and flexible. You can find other ways to have fun. You can play with the slide, the swing, the sandbox and the ball. Mom permits it." Tom and Mia run to the slide. They take turns to slide down. They laugh and giggle. They are happy. They forget about the grill. They have fun in the park. Mom is happy too. She watches them play. She is proud of them. They are good children.

One day, in a normal town, a big dog named Max was playing with his ball. Max liked to play with his ball every day. He was very happy. Suddenly, there was an earthquake. Max was scared. He did not know what to do. He ran to his house to find his mom. She was not there. Max was sad and scared. Max decided to delay looking for his mom and play with his ball to feel better. He threw his ball high in the air. When the ball came down, it hit a big red button. The earthquake stopped! Max was a hero. His mom came home and they were happy again.

One day, a black pig was walking through the forest. Suddenly, she saw something that made her stop and point. There in the clearing was another pig, but this one was pink! The black pig was very curious and decided to approach the other pig. "Hello!" said the pink pig. "My name is Gwen. What is your name?" The black pig was so excited to be talking to another pig that she almost forgot her name. "I'm, uh, Paige!" Gwen smiled. "It is so nice to meet you, Paige. Do you want to explore the forest together?" "Oh, yes!" said Paige. Suddenly, all the trees around them seemed to come alive. Paige and Gwen jumped back in surprise, and then laughed together. "Come on, let's have an adventure!" said Gwen. Paige eagerly followed Gwen through the forest, not knowing what was waiting around the corner. Suddenly, they arrived at a large pond. Gwen pointed to the water and said, "Do you want to go swimming?" Paige was nervous. All around the pond were black creatures with long noses swimming in the water. She had never seen anything like it before and was scared. But Gwen jumped into the water without any hesitation. "Come on, Paige, don't be scared. They're just friendly swimming pigs, like

One day, a little girl named Lily was eager to play. She put on her shoes and went outside. She saw a cat sitting near a tree. The cat was not moving. Lily wanted to see the cat in motion. Lily went to the cat and tried to make it move. She clapped her hands and jumped up and down. The cat did not move. Lily started to cry. She wanted to see the cat in motion so badly. A nice lady came and saw Lily cry. The lady picked up the cat and put it on the ground. The cat started to walk and run. Lily stopped crying and was happy. She finally saw the cat in motion and played with it all day.

Mum wanted to make a surprise picnic for her three year old daughter, Amy. She wanted to invite her friends to join her, so she called them all up. When everyone arrived, Amy was so excited to see them! She showed them all her new coat, which she was very proud of. Together they walked to the park, and soon they arrived. The sun was shining, the birds were singing, and it was so peaceful. Amy put her coat down and the picnic began! They laughed, sang, and ate until the sun set. When it was time to leave, Amy invited her friends to come to the park again. Everyone was happy, and excited for the next picnic.

Once upon a time, there was a fragile bunny named Bobo. Bobo loved to eat carrots. One day, he found a big carrot in the garden. Bobo tried to eat the carrot, but it was too hard. He started to complain. "This carrot is not good," said Bobo. He felt sad because he could not eat his favorite food. Then, Bobo's friend, a bird named Chirpy, came to help. Chirpy told Bobo to wait and flew away. Chirpy came back with a soft carrot for Bobo. Bobo was happy and said thank you to Chirpy. They both ate the carrot together and played in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a brown dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to play and run all day. He lived in a big park where he would meet many friends. One day, Buddy found a big surprise. He saw a king sitting on a bench. The king had a shiny crown and a big smile. Buddy was so happy to see the king in the park. Buddy ran to the king and wagged his tail. The king laughed and petted Buddy's soft fur. They played together all day. The king was so happy with Buddy that he made him the king's best friend. From that day on, Buddy and the king had many fun days together in the park.

One day, a big circle and a little circle were playing in the park. They liked to roll around and have fun. The big circle said, "Let's play a game where we part and then come back together!" The little circle agreed and said, "Yes, let's do that!" So, the big circle and the little circle went in different ways. They rolled far away from each other. After a while, they both turned around to come back to the middle of the park. But something rare happened! They could not find each other. The big circle and the little circle were sad. They wanted to be together again. Just when they thought they would never find each other, a kind wind blew them both to the same spot. They were so happy to see each other again! The big circle said, "Let's never part again!" The little circle agreed, and they played together all day, never leaving each other's side.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to nap under a big tree. The tree was very high and had many leaves. Max's owner, a kind girl named Lily, liked to play with Max near the tree. One sunny day, Max and Lily were playing with a ball. Lily threw the ball high into the air. Max jumped and tried to catch the ball, but it went too high and got stuck in the tree. Max and Lily looked up at the ball, wondering how to get it down. Lily said, "Max, let's get the ball down!" They tried to shake the tree, but the ball was still too high. Just then, a friendly bird flew by and saw Max and Lily. The bird flew up high and pushed the ball out of the tree. The ball fell down, and Max caught it with a big smile. Lily said, "Thank you, bird!" Max and Lily were very happy. After playing some more, Max took a long nap under the big tree with Lily by his side.

Once there was a baby, who was very weak. He couldn't talk or even walk yet. But he had a dream, he wanted to grow. One day he met a tree, with its branches moving in the wind. It told him, "Grow like me little one. You won't be weak forever." The baby didn't know how to grow, but he stayed near the tree everyday. One morning he was surprised to see that he was bigger. He had grown overnight! He got up, and tentatively stepped towards the tree. When he got there,he could suddenly talk and walk, he had finally grown. The tree smiled, and said, "Welcome to the big world. You won't be weak any more my friend."

Once upon a time, there was a little otter. The otter was very careless. He liked to play all day in the water. One day, the otter found a big box. The box had a word on it. The word was "mail." The otter wanted to see what was inside the box. He tried to open it, but it was too hard. He asked his friends, the fish and the frog, to help him. They all pushed and pulled, but the box did not open. Then, a big bird came and saw them. The bird said, "I can help you open the box." The otter, the fish, and the frog were happy. The bird used its beak to open the box. Inside the box, there were toys for all of them. They played with the toys all day and had lots of fun.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a big, plastic toy. It was a crazy-looking dinosaur. Tim liked the dinosaur very much. He wanted to show it to his friend, Sue. Tim took big steps to Sue's house. He knocked on the door. Sue opened it and saw the dinosaur. "Wow!" Sue said. "That is a crazy dinosaur!" They played with the dinosaur all day. They made it step on toy cars and pretend to eat toy trees. They had so much fun with the crazy, plastic dinosaur.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim loved to sing loud songs every morning. He would sit on a twig and sing for all his friends to hear. One day, a big bear named Billy came to the forest. Billy did not like Tim's loud songs. He wanted to sleep in the morning, but Tim's songs made it hard for him to sleep. So, Billy went to Tim and said, "Please stop singing so loud, I want to sleep." Tim did not want to make Billy sad, but he loved singing his loud songs. So, Tim and Billy disagreed. They did not know what to do. Then, a wise old owl named Oliver had an idea. He told Tim to move to another part of the forest where Billy could not hear him sing. Tim agreed and moved to a new twig far away from Billy. Now, Tim could sing his loud songs, and Billy could sleep. They both were happy, and they became good friends. And from that day on, everyone in the forest lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion named Leo. Leo loved to roar loudly. One day, Leo saw a small bird with a camera. The bird liked to take pictures of his friends. Leo was curious and asked the bird, "Can I see the pictures?" The bird showed Leo the camera, but it was empty. There were no pictures inside. Leo was sad and said, "I want to see my friends." The bird had an idea. "Let's take pictures of all our friends together!" So they went to the forest and found all their friends. Leo, the bird, and their friends took many pictures. They had so much fun. In the end, Leo learned that it is more fun to share happy moments with friends than to roar alone. The camera was no longer empty, and they had many memories to look at together.

Once upon a time, there was a nice farm with a big red barn. In the barn, there lived a cow named Bessie and a pig named Pippa. They were good friends. One day, Bessie said, "I hope we can go outside and play today." Pippa agreed, "Yes, I hope so too!" So, they went outside, and the sun was shining. They played in the grass near the barn. After a while, they got tired and went back inside the nice, cool barn. They lay down in the soft hay and fell asleep. Bessie and Pippa were very happy on their farm.

One day, a little girl called Sarah needed to earn some money. She decided to sell some of her old toys. As she was about to leave the house, her mom stopped Sarah and said, “Remember to keep your toys clean. If you don’t, no one will want to buy them!” Sarah knew her mom was right and she wanted to make sure her toys were clean. She spent a long time scrubbing them until they sparkled. Once they were clean, Sarah proudly put her toys out to sell. But no one paid any attention to them. A burly man with a large mustache came thundering down the street and stopped right in front of Sarah’s toys. “I want to buy these!” he said. “It’ll cost you a lot of money!” said Sarah. “That’s fine! Here’s a pile of money!” said the man as he put a large stack of coins on the ground. Sarah reached for the money, but then she remembered what her mom said. She paused and asked the man, “Are you sure you want to buy these toys? They’re very special and I want them to go to a good home.” The man became angry and yelled, “What do you mean, special? One day, a cat and a dog wanted to bake a cake. They went to the kitchen to find the things they needed. The cat found some wheat and the dog found some spicy peppers. The cat said, "Let's put the wheat in the cake." The dog agreed and said, "And let's add the spicy peppers too!" They mixed all the things together and put the cake in the oven. After a while, the cake was ready. The cat and the dog took it out of the oven and let it cool. They cut the cake and took a bite. The cat said, "This cake is yummy!" The dog agreed and said, "Yes, the wheat makes it soft and the spicy peppers make it fun!" They shared the cake with their friends and everyone loved it. The cat and the dog were very happy that they could bake such a tasty cake.

One day, a big bus went down the street. The bus driver was a bit careless. He did not look where he was going. The bus went very fast. The people on the bus started to panic. A little girl named Lily was on the bus with her mom. Lily said, "Mom, I am scared. The bus is going too fast!" Her mom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I am here with you." The bus stopped at a red light. The people on the bus were happy. They told the bus driver to be more careful. The bus driver said sorry and promised to drive slow. Everyone felt safe again, and they all went home.

Sam liked to play with his vest. It was red and had many buttons. He put it on and pretended to be a hero. He ran around the house and said, "I am Sam the brave!" One day, he found an ancient box in the attic. It was big and dusty. He opened it and saw many old things. He saw a book, a hat, a doll and a necklace. He wanted to see them better. He took them out of the box and put them on the floor. He saw the necklace was shiny and had many beads. He wanted to wear it with his vest. He put it around his neck and said, "I am Sam the king!" He felt very happy. But then, he heard a snap. The necklace was too old and weak. It broke and the beads fell off. They rolled everywhere. Sam was sad and scared. He did not want to break the necklace. He did not know what to do. He heard his mom coming up the stairs. He quickly put the things back in the box and closed it. He hid the broken necklace under his vest. He hoped his mom would not see it. He said, "Hi, mom. I was just playing with my vest." He smiled and tried to act normal.

Once upon a time, there was a mouse called Sam. He was an amazing mouse because he could measure anything with his whiskers! One day, Sam was walking through the woods. Suddenly, he heard a voice.
