Mom gave him a hug, and he never forgot the lesson. From then on he was always gentle with the delicate dictionary!

Once upon a time, there was a cat named Blink. Blink was a mild cat who liked to play with her friends. She lived in a big house with her family. Blink loved to run and jump in the sun. One day, Blink saw a bottle of wine on the table. She did not know what it was, but it looked fun to play with. She jumped on the table and tried to push the bottle with her paw. The bottle of wine fell on the floor and broke. The wine spilled everywhere. Blink was scared and ran to hide. Her family came to clean up the mess. They were not mad at Blink. They knew she was just playing. From that day on, Blink learned to be careful around things she did not know.

Anna likes peaches very much. She likes to eat them when they are soft and sweet. She has a big peach tree in her garden. Every day, she picks some peaches and puts them in a basket. One day, she wakes up early and goes to the garden. She sees many peaches on the tree. She is very happy. She climbs the tree and picks the biggest peach she can find. She holds it in her hand and smells it. It smells good. But then, she hears a loud noise. She looks up and sees a big bird. The bird is black and has a long beak. The bird is angry. It wants the peach. It flies to Anna and tries to take the peach from her hand. Anna is scared. She holds the peach tight and shouts. She wants the bird to go away. But the bird does not go away. It pecks at Anna's hand with its beak. It hurts Anna. Anna drops the peach and falls from the tree. She lands on the ground and cries. The bird picks up the peach and flies away. It eats the peach and makes a loud sound. It is happy. Anna is not happy. She is sad and hurt. She has no peach and no fun. She thinks the bird is bad and the peach is not interesting. She wishes she had stayed in bed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She lived with her mom, dad, and her sweet aunt in a small house. Sue loved her aunt very much. They would play games, sing songs, and have fun together. One day, Sue's aunt was making food in the kitchen. She was cooking something yummy for Sue and her family to eat. Sue could smell the food and it made her hungry. She wanted to see what her aunt was doing, but her mom said, "No, Sue. It's hot in the kitchen. You could get hurt." Later, Sue heard a loud noise from the kitchen. She ran to see what happened. Her sweet aunt had dropped a hot pan on the floor. The food inside started to burn. Sue's mom and dad came to help. They put out the fire and made sure everyone was okay. After that, Sue learned to be careful around hot things. She knew her mom was right about the kitchen being a dangerous place for a little girl. Sue and her sweet aunt still had fun together, but they made sure to stay safe while doing it.

Once upon a time, there were two honey bees. One was called June and the other was called Jim. They both lived in a hive together. June was quite smart and could make lots of honey from the flowers outside. Jim was jealous of her and tried hard to make more honey than her. One day, Jim became so angry with June for making much more honey than him. He tried to steal some of June's honey. June was angry too, so she shouted at Jim, "You mustn't steal my honey!" Jim didn't want to yield, so he kept trying to steal June's honey. June was getting really frustrated with Jim, so she asked all the other bees in the hive to help her. Everyone got angry at Jim and crowded around him. At last, Jim had to yield and stopped stealing the honey. June was glad that the bees in the hive had helped her to stop Jim from stealing her honey. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a dog named Max went for a jog. He liked to run and play in the sun. Max was very happy. But soon, he felt hot and wet. Max wanted to find some shade to rest. Max saw a big tree with lots of shade. He ran to the tree and lay down. Max felt nice and cool in the shade. He was so happy, he started to wag his tail. Then, something unexpected happened. A little cat named Luna came out from the tree. Max and Luna looked at each other. They were not friends. But Luna said, "We can share the shade and be friends." Max was happy and wagged his tail. They both lay down in the shade and became friends. The moral of the story is that even if we are different, we can still be friends and share what we have.

One day, a cat and a dog were in a big, soft bed. They were very comfortable. The cat said, "I think I have a joke." The dog was happy and wanted to hear the joke. The cat told the joke, but the dog did not laugh. The dog thought the joke was not funny. The cat was sad and a little mad. They started to fight about the joke. The fight made the bed not comfortable anymore. Then, a little mouse came in the room. The mouse said, "I have a joke, too." The cat and the dog stopped fighting and listened. The mouse told the joke, and they all laughed. The cat and the dog did not think a mouse could be funny, but they were wrong. They became friends with the mouse, and the bed was comfortable again.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a puzzle. The puzzle had many crazy colors. Tim was very happy to play with it. He wanted to finish the puzzle before he went to play on the swing. Tim sat down and started to put the puzzle together. He worked and worked, but the puzzle was very hard. He felt sad because he could not finish it. He wanted to go play on the swing, but he did not want to leave the puzzle. Tim's friend, Sam, came over and saw Tim was sad. Sam said, "Let's go play on the swing!" But Tim did not want to leave the puzzle. Sam tried to help Tim with the puzzle, but they still could not finish it. Then, it was time for Sam to go home. Tim was still sad because he could not finish the puzzle. He did not get to play on the swing with his friend. Tim learned that sometimes it is better to play with friends than to try to finish a hard puzzle alone.

Once upon a time, there was a gloomy day. A little girl named Mia and a little boy named Max were friends. They wanted to play outside, but it was too wet and cold. They felt sad. Mia had an idea. She found a journal in her room. Mia and Max decided to unite and write a story in the journal. They thought it would be fun. They wrote about a big, happy sun that made the day bright and warm. As they wrote, something unexpected happened. The sun in their story came to life! The sun jumped off the page and went into the sky. The gloomy day became bright and warm. Mia and Max were very happy. They played outside and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was an alligator who loved exploring. One day, he went for a walk in the forest. He looked for hidden things! He searched and searched, but he couldn't find anything. Suddenly, the alligator heard a noise. He looked around and saw a hidden spot, so he peeked in. Inside, he found a secret spot! But when he stepped inside, he noticed something strange - he started to disappear! The alligator said, "What's happening?!" Just then, a fairy appeared. She said, "This is a magical place. Whenever something disappears here, it reappears somewhere else." The alligator said, "Oh, so I will reappear soon?" The fairy nodded and waved her wand. And just like that, the alligator reappeared in the exact spot he had disappeared from! The alligator was so happy. He said, "Thank you, fairy! I'm going to explore this hidden spot again and again!" The alligator waved goodbye, and the fairy flew away, leaving him to explore the magical hidden spot.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a broken rake. Sue's mom asked her to clean up the leaves in the yard, but Sue did not want to. She said "no" and refused to do it. One day, Sue saw her friend, Tim, playing in the park. She wanted to play with him, but her mom said, "First, you must clean up the leaves with your rake." Sue was sad, but she knew she had to do it. So, she went to the yard and started to clean up the leaves with her broken rake. As Sue was cleaning, a big wind came and blew all the leaves away. Sue was so happy! Now she didn't need to use her broken rake. The wind had done the job for her. Sue went to her mom and said, "Look, the leaves are all gone!" Her mom smiled and let Sue go play with Tim at the park.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He brought his favorite toy, a model car. Tim loved to play with his car and make it go fast. The park was big and had many things to do. Tim saw a tall tree with a distant branch. He wanted to pick a leaf from the branch. Tim asked his mom, "Can I pick a leaf from the tree?" His mom said, "No, Tim. It's too high for you. Stay close to me and play with your car." Tim was sad but listened to his mom. While playing with his car, Tim saw a girl named Lily. Lily had a toy plane. Tim wanted to play with the plane, but Lily did not want to share. They both started to argue. Tim's mom came over and said, "Why don't you both play together and share your toys?" Tim and Lily agreed and became friends. They played with the model car and toy plane, and had a great time at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful little girl named Mia. She loved to play and laugh all day. Mia had a big heart and was always happy to help others. One day, Mia saw a lot of waste in the park. The waste made the park look dirty and sad. Mia wanted to clean the park, so she went home to get a big bag. She worked hard to pick up all the waste and put it in the bag. When she was done, the park looked clean and happy again. That night, Mia said a prayer before going to bed. She prayed, "Please help me keep the park clean and make others happy too." The next day, Mia's friends saw her hard work and decided to help. They all worked together to keep the park clean and beautiful. And the moral of the story is: when we work together and pray, we can make the world a better place.

Once upon a time, in a sleepy city, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to look at the big buildings and the cars that went by. One day, Tim saw a big red ball in the park. He thought, "I will play with the ball later." The next day, Tim went to the park to play. He looked for the big red ball, but it was not there. Tim felt sad. He walked around the park, looking for the ball. Then, he saw a big tree with a hole in it. Tim thought, "Maybe the ball is in the tree." Tim went to the tree and looked inside the hole. And there it was - the big red ball! Tim was so happy. He took the ball out of the tree and played with it all day. From that day on, Tim always knew where to look for his big red ball. The sleepy city was now a fun place for Tim to play.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they find a big box in the garage. The box has many things inside. They see a candle, a lighter, a doll, a car, and more. Lily wants to play with the doll. Ben wants to play with the car. They both grab the toy they want. But they also want the candle and the lighter. They think they are fun and pretty. They do not know they are dangerous. They start to fight over the candle and the lighter. They pull and push and yell. They do not share. They do not listen. They are angry and mean. The lighter falls on the floor. It makes a spark. The spark hits the candle. The candle lights up. The flame is hot and bright. It burns the box. It burns the toys. It burns the garage. Lily and Ben are scared. They drop the doll and the car. They run away from the fire. They scream for help. But it is too late. The fire is big and fast. It burns the house. It burns everything. Lily and Ben are sad. They lose their toys and books. They lose their home. They lose their friend. They are sorry. They wish they did not fight. They wish they did not play with the candle and the lighter. They wish they were safe and happy. But they are not. The end.

Once there was a little girl named Kari and she was 3-years-old. Kari loved to play in the garden and explore the world around her. One day Kari saw a caterpillar in the garden and she wanted to show it to her mommy. But Kari's mommy was very troubled that day so she couldn't find the time to come and see the caterpillar. Kari was sad but she knew she had to help her mommy. So she started cleaning the house and whenever she was done her mommy was very happy. Kari had made a difference and her mommy's face was no longer troubled. So every day Kari would increase her style of cleaning until she was becoming quite good at it. Kari's mommy was so proud of her little girl and one day, together, they finally went to the garden to see the caterpillar!

One day, a mole was in his new hole. He liked his new home a lot. The sun was up and the mole wanted to play. He went outside and saw a big red ball. The ball had a long string. The mole wanted to pull the string and play with the ball. The mole said, "Hi, ball! Can I pull your string and play with you?" The ball did not say anything. So, the mole started to pull the string. As he pulled, the ball started to move. The mole was very happy. But, as he pulled more, the ball went up in the sky. The mole was scared. He did not know that the ball could fly! The mole held on tight to the string. He went up and up in the sky. The mole saw his new home from the sky. It was very small. The mole said, "Wow, this is fun! I did not know I could fly!" The mole loved his new adventure.

John had been helping mum tidy the kitchen. He liked to clean but it was hard work. He finished and was looking around the room when he noticed the sink. It had a disgusting smell and was filled with yucky water. John had a feeling something was in there, and he wanted to take a look. He got a bowl and scooped some of the water out. Suddenly, something slimy and gross jumped out! It was a frog! John screamed and dropped the bowl. He was so scared he ran out of the room. Mum laughed when John told her what he saw. She said it was okay and showed him how to put the frog back in the garden. John was relieved to have put the slimy frog back outside. He had learned his lesson, and from then on, he paid closer attention to the sink for signs of anything slimy or disgusting.

Once upon a time there was a very weak girl. She always felt alone and was too weak to play with the other kids. One day the girl went out to explore. She walked through a field and saw the beauty of nature. She was amazed at how green the trees were and how pretty the flowers smell. She felt so happy. Suddenly she heard something. She hid behind a tree, and saw a baby bird. The bird had fallen out of its nest and couldn't get back. She was so small and weak, but she knew she had to help. The girl carefully picked up the bird and placed it back in the nest. The other birds were very happy, and thanked her with chirruping noises. The little girl smiled and was happy she was able to help the baby bird. She thanked nature for giving her the chance to help. She knew that she was weak, but she was also strong in her own way.

One day, a clumsy dog named Spot wanted to help his mom. She was making a big salad for lunch. Spot saw a sack on the floor. He thought, "I can put the salad in the sack!" Spot went to his mom and said, "Mom, can I help you with the salad?" His mom smiled and said, "Of course, Spot! You can put the salad in the sack." Spot felt happy and proud. He picked up the salad with his paws, but he was clumsy. He dropped the salad on the floor! Spot felt sad. His mom said, "It's okay, Spot. We can make a new salad together." They made a new salad and put it in the sack. Spot learned that it's okay to make mistakes, and helping is always good.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny spider named Spidey. Spidey lived in a big tree. One day, he saw a yummy, delicious cake on a table in a house. Spidey wanted to eat the cake, but the door was closed. Spidey thought of a plan to get the cake. He made a long, long web to reach the cake. But when he got to the cake, a big wind came and blew Spidey away. The wind broke his web, and Spidey was sad. Spidey did not give up. He worked hard to make a new web. He made it stronger this time. Spidey used his new web to get the cake. He ate the delicious cake and was very happy. Spidey learned that if he worked hard, he could restore what was broken and fix his problems.

Once upon a time, in a cheerful forest, there was a little bunny named Bob. Bob loved to hop, play, and chew on sweet carrots. One sunny day, he heard about a big race in the forest. The prize for the race was a huge, tasty carrot. Bob wanted to win the prize very much. All the animals in the forest came to watch the race. Bob saw his friends, like the fast fox, the strong bear, and the quick squirrel. They all wanted to win the prize too. Before the race started, Bob found a secret path. He thought it could help him win. The race began, and all the animals ran as fast as they could. Bob took the secret path he found. It was a little scary, but he kept going. He hopped and hopped until he reached the finish line first. All his friends were so happy for him. Bob won the big, tasty carrot prize. He felt very proud and shared the prize with all his friends. They all chewed on the yummy carrot together. From that day on, the cheerful forest was filled with even more laughter and fun.

Once upon a time there was a fox and a rabbit. They were friends, but they rarely saw each other due to living in different areas. The fox was very adventurous and loved playing games. The rabbit was gentle and loved to sing. One day the fox found a magical flute. He thought it would be fun to play and he wanted to share it with his friend. With the flute, he went to meet the rabbit. The fox showed the rabbit the flute and the rabbit was so excited! The two friends decided to play together, each taking turns to make beautiful music with the flute. Their music was so joyful, it could be heard for miles around. The music united the fox and the rabbit. This made them feel closer and it reminded them how important it was to be kind and thoughtful to all living things. From then on, they made it a point to meet up and share special moments together. The fox and the rabbit had learned that together, they could do amazing things. All thanks to the magical and playful flute.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Booker and Faith. Booker and Faith both liked to play together in the park every day. One day while they were playing they noticed a bird high up in the sky. Booker wanted to join the bird and wanted to find the way to reach it. Faith told him it was impossible but Booker wasn't convinced. Faith asked the birds around in the park if they could help Booker join the bird in the sky. The birds said they couldn't help but they said that Booker should join their voices in singing. Booker did as they said and began singing with them. When Booker had joined their voices, the birds in the park sung even louder and the bird high up in the sky began to hear them. Soon the bird swooped down and joined in by singing along too. The singing was so beautiful the sourness in the air turned sweet. Booker realised that when we join together it can create something really wonderful!

Once upon a time, there was a nosy cat named Tom. Tom loved to play games with his friends. His favorite game was to mix things up. One day, Tom and his friends were playing the mixing game. They mixed toys, food, and colors. They had so much fun! But then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came to play with them. The dog was very big and very nosy too. The dog wanted to play the mixing game with Tom and his friends. They were scared of the big dog, but they let him play. The big dog started to mix things up. He mixed food with toys and colors with food. Tom and his friends were surprised. The big dog was very good at the mixing game. They all had so much fun together. In the end, Tom and his friends learned that even a big nosy dog can be a good friend and play the mixing game with them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She liked to play with her ball in the park. One day, while she was playing, a funny man came up to her. He was a stranger, but he had a big smile and a red nose. "Hi there!" said the funny stranger. "Do you want to play with me?" Sue didn't recognize him, but she thought he looked nice. She said, "Okay, let's play!" They played with the ball for a while, and Sue laughed at the funny man's red nose. Then, something unexpected happened. The funny man took off his red nose, and Sue saw that it was her dad! She couldn't believe it. "Daddy!" Sue said, very surprised. "I didn't know it was you!" Her dad laughed and said, "I wanted to surprise you, sweetie." They both laughed and played together in the park, happy that they had such a fun time together.

Once upon a time there was a black gear. It lay there peacefully in a pile of toys, waiting to be used. One day, a little girl picked up the black gear and decided to act. She put it in a big machine and began to turn it around. Suddenly, the machine made a loud noise and the gear began to move. But, instead of turning and helping the machine run, the black gear started to get stuck. The little girl tried to act and carefully pull the gear out, but it was too tightly stuck. She yelled and asked for help, and soon her mom came and tried to help her. Together, they managed to loosen the black gear and pull it out. The little girl was so proud that she had acted and fixed the machine. The machine started working again and the little girl was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to play outside in the light sun. One day, she found a silver rock. She was very happy and took the rock home. In her room, Amy wanted to cut the rock to see what was inside. She got a small knife and tried to cut it. But the rock was too hard. Amy felt sad and went to bed. At night, while Amy was sleeping, the silver rock started to glow. It was not a rock at all! It was a magic egg! The egg opened slowly and a little, friendly dragon came out. The dragon and Amy became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little chicken. The chicken liked to play games. The chicken was very competitive. It always wanted to win. One day, the chicken played a game with a frog. They wanted to see who could jump the farthest. The chicken jumped very far. The frog jumped even farther. The chicken was sad because it did not win. Then, a big dog came to the chicken. The dog said, "I will help you win." The chicken was happy. The dog told the chicken to close its eyes and wait. The chicken closed its eyes. But, instead of helping, the dog gave the chicken a big kiss. The chicken was surprised and scared. The chicken ran away and never played games again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim loved to sing songs all day long. One day, it seemed very cold outside. The wind was icy, and Tim's feathers were not warm enough. Tim saw a big bear named Ben. Ben was very big and warm. Tim wanted to be friends with Ben. He sang a nice song to Ben. Ben liked the song and became friends with Tim. Now, Tim and Ben were friends, they helped each other. Tim sang songs to make Ben happy, and Ben helped Tim stay warm in the icy weather. The moral of the story is that we should help each other and be good friends.

The sun was shining on the hill. There was a motor at the bottom of the hill. A girl named Jamie stepped out of her house. She was excited to ride the motor. But, when she got to the bottom of the hill, she saw that something was wrong. Her motor wasn't there. She looked around but it was nowhere to be seen. Suddenly, an angry man stepped out of the bushes. He was holding Jamie's motor. He said he had taken it because he was angry that she hadn't been more careful with it. Jamie was sad and confused. She was scared too. But, she was also angry. She took a deep breath and stepped forward. She bravely asked the man to give her back the motor. The man looked taken aback. He must have been surprised by her courage. He handed her the motor and stepped away. Jamie wheeled the motor back up the hill with a smile on her face. She was proud of herself for standing up for what was hers.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He lived in a small house in the west with his mom and dad. Tim liked to play outside with his ball. One day, while playing with his ball, it rolled far away from him. Tim ran after the ball and he stumbled on a big rock. He fell down and felt frightened. He looked around and saw that he was lost. Tim didn't know what to do. But then, Tim saw a friendly dog. The dog wagged its tail and barked. Tim followed the dog and they found the way back to his house. Tim's mom and dad were so happy to see him. From that day on, Tim and the dog were best friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Mia. Mia had a furry cat named Whiskers. They were best friends and liked to play together. One day, Mia found a big boot in her room. She looked at Whiskers and said, "Let's try to play with this boot!" Whiskers meowed happily and they started to play. They took turns trying to put the boot on their feet and paws. Mia laughed as Whiskers tried to walk with the boot on his paw. As they played, Mia's mom came into the room. She saw them playing and smiled. "Mia, you and Whiskers are having so much fun with that boot!" she said. Mia and Whiskers looked at each other and laughed. They knew they had found a new fun toy to play with together.

Once there was a little girl named Sally. She liked to play with her brother and her friends. One day, the group was playing a game with matches. Sally's turn came, but she couldn't get the match to light. Everyone laughed, and Sally felt very embarrassed. Her cheeks were bright red and very pale. She wanted to run away and hide, but her friends were still there. They kept playing the game, but it wasn't as much fun without Sally. Luckily, Sally's brother had an idea. He jumped up and quickly lit the match. Everyone was so amazed that they forgot about Sally's embarrassing moment. Sally was so happy that her brother had saved her. They played the game for the rest of the day and had lots of fun.

One day, Peter was playing in his garden. He wanted to climb his favourite tree. He grabbed his toy weapon and began to climb up the tree. As Peter climbed higher, he heard a loud noise. He looked down to see a big dog growling at him. He was very upset and shouted to the dog "go away!" The dog barked at him even louder. So, Peter held up his toy weapon. The dog was so surprised that it ran away! Peter was very relieved, and he climbed down the tree. When he got back to the ground, he shouted, "Yay!". Peter finished his climb, and he was very happy. He had used his toy weapon to scare away the dog, and he no longer felt upset.

Once upon a time, in a cold winter, there was a big baking contest in a small town. Many people wanted to win. They were very competitive. They all made yummy cakes and cookies to show off their skills. One day, a little girl named Sally wanted to join the contest too. She loved to bake with her mom. Sally made a cake with a big smiley face on it. Her cake was not fancy, but it made people happy. Sally was not competitive like the others. She just wanted to share her cake with everyone. On the day of the contest, a big wind came and blew all the fancy cakes away. Everyone was sad. But Sally's cake was still there. She shared her cake with everyone, and they all felt happy again. The people learned that it's not about winning, but about sharing and making others happy. And that winter, they all became better friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing with his toy car. His mom called out, "Tim, hurry! It's time for dinner!" Tim ran as fast as he could to the table. He was very hungry. Mom put a big, heavy plate of food in front of Tim. There were yummy things like chicken, peas, and carrots. Tim looked at the food and said, "Wow, this dinner looks so good!" Tim ate and ate until his tummy was full. He thanked his mom for the tasty dinner. After eating, Tim went back to playing with his toy car, feeling happy and full.

Mummy and Daddy were taking Mary to the train station. They said, "Mary, come on, we are getting the train now!" Mary was excited and couldn't wait. When they arrived at the station, Mary saw a lovely garden. There were lots of different coloured flowers and trees, with butterflies flying all around. She said, "Oh, look at all the lovely colours!" Mummy and Daddy took Mary to the ticket counter. There was a friendly person there who smiled and asked, "Where are you going?" Mummy and Daddy said, "We are getting the train to Grandma's house. Can you help us get the tickets please?" The friendly person said, "Of course!" She gave them the tickets and said, "Have a lovely journey!" Mary and her parents got on the train and waved goodbye to the station. They had a great time on the train and when they arrived at Grandma's house, Mary was so excited to hug her!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Amy. She loved to play outside. One day, she saw something brilliant in the grass. It was a gold key! Amy picked up the key and showed it to her friend, Tom. "Look, Tom! I found a gold key!" said Amy. Tom looked at the key and thought it was very special. They decided to hurry and find out what the key could open. They ran to the big tree in the park. There was a small door at the bottom of the tree. Amy put the gold key in the door and turned it. The door opened, and inside was a secret room full of toys! "Wow, Amy! This is amazing!" said Tom. They played with the toys all day and had so much fun. When it was time to go home, they locked the secret room and promised to come back and play again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to watch her favorite show on the TV. One day, after school, she went to turn on the TV, but it was not working. Sue was sad because she could not watch her show. Sue had a pet dog named Max. Max saw that Sue was sad and wanted to help. Max had an idea! He would find a way to fix the TV for Sue. Max looked around the house and found a spicy pepper. He thought maybe the spicy pepper could make the TV work again. Max put the spicy pepper next to the TV and barked. Suddenly, the TV turned on! Sue was so happy to see her show again. But then, the TV started to shake! The spicy pepper was making the TV too hot. Sue and Max had to escape from the room before the TV got too hot. They ran outside and played in the yard instead. Sue was happy to have a friend like Max, and they had fun playing together.

One day, a little brown dog named Max went to the park with his friend, a girl named Lily. They were having lots of fun playing with a ball. They laughed and ran around the park. Max loved to play with Lily. As they played, Max saw a big screen. "What's that?" he asked Lily. "It's a movie, Max!" she said. They went to watch the movie together. The movie was about a brave dog who saved his friends. Max and Lily liked the movie very much. While they were watching the movie, a butterfly flew by. Max tried to catch it, but he tripped and fell. Lily helped Max up and gave him a kiss to make him feel better. Suddenly, the butterfly turned into a fairy! "Thank you for your kindness," the fairy said. "I will give you a wish." Max and Lily were very surprised. They wished for more fun days together, and the fairy made their wish come true.

Once upon a time, there was a fierce lion named Leo. He lived in a big forest. Leo was very strong and all the animals were scared of him. One day, Leo saw a small bird near a sink. The bird was sad because its nest had burned down. The bird said, "My nest is gone. I am very sad." Leo wanted to help the bird. He said, "Don't be sad. I will help you make a new nest." Leo and the bird worked together to make a new nest. They found sticks and leaves. They put them on a safe tree. The bird was very happy. It said, "Thank you, Leo, for helping me." From that day on, the fierce lion and the small bird were good friends. They played and had fun in the forest. All the other animals saw that Leo was not so scary after all. They all became friends and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl who wanted to join her friends. She was very excited, but she was also a bit scared because of the pain she sometimes felt. The girl asked her mum what to do, and her mum told her to close her eyes and try to join her friends. The girl took a deep breath, closed her eyes and wished for the pain to go away. When she opened her eyes, the girl noticed something very attractive. She saw a path that she could join and run on with her friends. The path was filled with beautiful trees and flowers, and it felt very inviting. The girl started skipping down the path and joined her friends in a game of tag. From then on the small girl always looked forward to joining her friends in their games.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw his friend, Sue. Sue was sad. Her shoe had a big knot. Tim wanted to help Sue. "Let me replace the knot," Tim said. He was calm. He worked on the knot. But then, a big dog came. The dog took Sue's shoe. "Hey! Give it back!" Sue said. The dog did not listen. Tim and Sue ran after the dog. They wanted the shoe back. At last, they found the dog. The dog was with a baby bird. The bird had a hurt wing. The dog had used the shoe to make a soft bed for the bird. Tim and Sue were happy. They let the bird keep the shoe.

Once upon a time, in a big pond, there was a smart duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to play with his friends, the fish and the frogs. They played all day, every day. Ducky was the smartest duck in the pond, and he always helped his friends when they needed it. One day, Ducky saw a big rock near the pond. He thought it would be fun to jump off the rock and splash into the water. He told his friends, "I will jump off the rock and make a big splash!" His friends were excited to see Ducky's big splash. Ducky climbed up the rock, but it was very slippery. He tried to be careful, but he slipped and fell into the water with a big splash! All his friends laughed and clapped. Ducky was happy that he made them laugh, even though he slipped. From that day on, Ducky and his friends played on the slippery rock, and they always had fun.

One day, a baby and a cat were playing in the house. The baby was very happy, and the cat was very crazy. They played with a big, red ball. The baby laughed, and the cat jumped high. The baby said, "Cat, let's study this ball!" The cat looked at the ball and then looked at the baby. The baby showed the cat how to roll the ball and chase it. The cat liked this game and played with the baby. After a while, the baby and the cat were tired. They sat down and looked at the ball. The baby said, "We had so much fun today, cat! We studied and played with the ball." The cat meowed and the baby smiled. They were very happy friends.

Tom and Lily went to a restaurant with Mom and Dad. They liked the restaurant because it had many pictures on the walls and colorful plates. Mom and Dad told them to be careful and not to make a mess. Tom and Lily sat on their chairs and looked at the menu. They saw many things they liked, such as pizza, pasta, and ice cream. They told Mom and Dad what they wanted to eat. Mom and Dad nodded and called the waiter. The waiter came and took their order. He smiled and said he would bring their food soon. Tom and Lily waited patiently. They played with their napkins and crayons. They drew some pictures on the paper. Soon, their food arrived. It smelled good and looked yummy. Tom and Lily thanked the waiter and started to eat. They enjoyed their pizza and pasta. They ate with their forks and spoons. They tried not to spill or drop anything. But then, something bad happened. Tom reached for his glass of water, but he was not careful enough. He knocked over the glass and the water spilled all over the table. It wet the napkins, the crayons, and the paper. It also wet Lily's dress and Tom's shirt. Lily was very upset. She did not like to be wet. She started to cry. She yelled at Tom. She said, "Tom, you are so clumsy! You made a big mess! You ruined my dress and my picture!" Tom felt sorry. He did not mean to spill the water. He tried to calm Lily down. He said, "Lily, I'm sorry. It was an accident. Don't cry. Don't yell. Mom and Dad will help us. Maybe we can still have ice cream." Mom and Dad heard the noise. They saw the water and the mess. They were not happy. They asked the waiter for some towels. They cleaned up the table and the children. They said, "Tom, Lily, you have to be more careful. You have to be quiet and polite in the restaurant. You have to say sorry to the waiter and the other people." Tom and Lily felt ashamed. They said sorry to the waiter and the other people. They said sorry to Mom and Dad. They said sorry to each other. They hugged and made up. Mom and Dad were glad. They said, "It's okay. We all make mistakes sometimes. We still love you. You are good children. You can still have ice cream if you want." Tom and Lily smiled. They said, "Thank you, Mom and Dad. We love you too. We want ice cream. We will be more careful next time." The waiter brought them ice cream. It was cold and sweet. Tom and Lily ate their ice cream and forgot about the water. They were happy again. They had a good time at the restaurant.

Once upon a time, there was a big, interesting toy store. In the store, there was a small crib with a cute baby doll. One day, a mommy and her little girl, named Emma, went to the store to buy a toy. Emma saw the crib and said, "Mommy, can we bring this crib home for my doll?" Mommy smiled and said, "Yes, Emma, we can bring it home." Emma was very happy and clapped her hands. They took the crib home and put it in Emma's room. Emma put her doll in the crib and sang a soft song to help her doll sleep. Every night, Emma played with the crib and her doll. She loved her new toy and was very happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing in his chamber. He felt impatient because it was raining outside, and he wanted to go out and play. "I wish the rain would go away," he said, looking out the window. Suddenly, the rain stopped, and the sun came out. Tim ran outside to play, but he saw that everything was still wet. He wanted to play, but he didn't want to get wet. So, he thought of a plan. "I will wait for the sun to dry everything," he said. As Tim waited, he saw a big bird fly down from the sky. The bird had a long beak and big wings. The bird used its wings to fan the ground, and everything became dry very fast. Tim was surprised and happy. He thanked the bird, and they played together all day long.

One day, a girl named Amy was playing with her toy drum. She loved the rhythm she made by hitting the drum. Her friend Tom came over and said, "Your drum is dull. I have a better toy to play with." Amy just shrugged and went on playing her drum. Tom brought out a big, shiny toy car. He started to play with it, but then it stopped moving. Tom looked sad and didn't know what to do. Amy stopped playing her drum and said, "Maybe we can play with both toys together." Amy started playing her drum again and the rhythm made the toy car move! Tom was happy and surprised. They played together, making the toy car dance to the beat of the drum. The dull drum turned out to be fun after all.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved popcorn. One day, Tim's mom said, "Tim, let's make some great popcorn!" Tim and his mom went to the kitchen. They put the popcorn in a big pot. Tim's mom turned on the stove. Soon, the popcorn started to pop. Tim was so happy. "Mom, can I release the popcorn?" Tim asked. "Yes, Tim," said his mom. "But be careful, it's hot!" Tim opened the pot and the popcorn jumped out. It was like a popcorn party! Tim and his mom laughed and ate the great popcorn. They had so much fun. And that's the story of Tim and the great popcorn release.

Once upon a time, there was a rich man named Tom. He lived in a big house with many toys. Tom loved to create new things. One day, he decided to make a new friend. Tom used his toys to create a new friend named Wink. Wink was a funny little robot. Wink had a big smile and could do a special thing. Wink could wink one eye at a time. Tom and Wink played together every day. They had so much fun. Wink would wink at Tom, and Tom would laugh. They were very happy. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big river. It was very long, but nobody knew how long it was. The people wanted to know how long the river was. They found a stick and decided to measure it. So the people found a long stick and started to measure from one end of the river to the other. They counted each step carefully, and the stick got shorter and shorter. Finally, after a long time, they reached the other side of the river. They had measured the whole thing! Now the people knew how long the river was. They were very happy, and they made sure to always remember how long the river was.

Once upon a time, in a bright green forest, there was a turkey named Tim. Tim liked to play with his friends, the bunny and the squirrel. They played hide and seek, tag, and other fun games. One sunny day, Tim and his friends decided to play with a big, bright, red ball. They took turns kicking the ball and chasing it. Tim was very fast and could kick the ball very far. The bunny and the squirrel laughed and clapped when they saw Tim kick the ball. As the sun went down, Tim, the bunny, and the squirrel were tired from playing all day. They said goodbye to each other and went to their homes. Tim the turkey was happy he had so much fun playing with his friends. He couldn't wait to play with them again the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was a very tidy girl. She liked to keep her room clean and her toys in place. One day, her mom gave her a task. She asked Lily to help her put away the dishes. Lily's mom whispered to her, "Lily, can you please help me with the dishes?" Lily whispered back, "Yes, Mom, I can help you." They both smiled and started to work on their task. As they put the dishes away, they talked and laughed. Lily's mom was proud of her tidy girl. When they finished the task, Lily's mom gave her a big hug. "Thank you for helping me, Lily," she said. "You are the best little helper."

Once upon a time, there was a big van. The van was very dry. It was a sunny day. The van was going to the park. The park was full of flowers and trees. At the park, there was a spring. The spring had water. The animals came to the spring to drink water. The animals were happy. They liked the water. One day, a little boy came to the park. He saw the van. He saw the spring. He saw the animals. The little boy played with the animals. They all had fun. They played all day long. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a seal named Sam. Sam lived in the sea with his friends. They liked to play and swim all day. One day, Sam found a big, sour lemon. He wanted to weigh it to see how heavy it was. So, he put it on a big rock and pushed it with his nose. The lemon was very heavy. Sam and his friends laughed and played with the sour lemon. They had lots of fun. Then, they swam away to find more fun things to do in the sea. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy dog named Max. Max did not like to go for walks. One day, his owner, a little girl named Lily, wanted to take him for a walk. She put a leash on Max and said, "Come on, Max! Let's go for a walk!" Max did not want to go. He sat down and would not move. Lily tried to pull him, but he was too heavy. She felt sad and said, "Please, Max, let's go for a walk. It will be fun!" Max saw that Lily was sad. He did not want her to be sad. So, he decided to go for a walk with her. As they walked, Max started to feel happy. He began to shake his tail and wag it side to side. Lily saw Max shaking his tail and smiled. "See, Max? Going for a walk is fun!" Max agreed and wagged his tail even more. From that day on, Max was not a grumpy dog anymore. He loved going for walks with Lily, and they had lots of fun together.

Ben and Lily were playing in the sand. They had a big bucket and a small bucket. They filled the big bucket with sand and turned it over. They made a big hill. "Look at our hill!" Ben said. "It is so big and strong!" Lily nodded. She liked their hill. She wanted to make it bigger. She took the small bucket and ran to the water. She filled it with water and ran back. "Watch this!" she said. "I will make a river on our hill!" She poured the water on the hill. The water made a hole in the sand. The hill started to fall down. "Oh no!" Ben said. "Our hill is breaking!" Lily was scared. She did not mean to break their hill. She dropped the small bucket and hugged Ben. "I'm sorry, Ben!" she said. "I did not want to scare you!" Ben hugged her back. He was not angry. He was just sad. "It's okay, Lily," he said. "We can make another hill. But next time, let's not use water. Water is not good for sand hills." Lily nodded. She learned something new. She picked up the small bucket and smiled. "Okay, Ben," she said. "Let's make another hill. But this time, let's make it with shells and stones. They are pretty and strong!" Ben smiled too. He liked that idea. He took the big bucket and followed Lily. They went to look for shells and stones. They forgot about the broken hill. They were happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat oats for breakfast. One day, he wanted to measure how many oats he could eat. He started to eat the oats. After eating a lot, Tim found a disgusting bug in his oats. He didn't like the bug and stopped eating. Tim told his mom about the bug. His mom took away the disgusting oats and gave him new, clean oats. Tim was happy and ate his new oats.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She liked to complete puzzles. One day, she saw a big puzzle with a picture of a dangerous lion on it. She wanted to complete it. Lily started to put the pieces together. It was a sunny day, so she played outside. But then, the sky became dark and it started to rain. Everything became wet. Lily was sad because she could not play outside anymore. Lily went inside her house and continued to complete her puzzle. She was careful with the wet pieces. Finally, she finished the puzzle and saw the dangerous lion. She was so happy. From that day on, Lily loved to complete puzzles, even on wet days.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy oyster named Ollie. Ollie lived in the deep blue sea. He had many friends like fish, crabs, and turtles. They all played together and had fun. One day, Ollie said to his friend, the crab, "I want to change. I don't want to be clumsy anymore." The crab said, "Why don't you try to be more careful when you move?" So, Ollie tried to be more careful. He moved slowly and watched where he was going. His friends helped him too. They showed him how to swim and walk without being clumsy. After some time, Ollie became less clumsy. He was happy and his friends were proud of him. They all played together and had even more fun. And from that day on, Ollie was not a clumsy oyster anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She wanted to relax with her family. They sat on the big, soft couch. Sue felt happy and warm. Sue saw a shiny ornament on the tree. It was red and sparkly. She wanted to touch it. Sue stood on her tippy-toes to reach the ornament. It was very high up. Sue felt uncomfortable. Her feet hurt. Mom and Dad saw Sue. They helped her get the ornament. Sue smiled and said "thank you". Now Sue could relax with her family again.

Once upon a time, there was a strong boy named Tim. Tim was very good at choosing things. One day, Tim's mom gave him some money to buy a toy. She said, "Tim, choose a toy you like." Tim went to the toy store with his money. He saw many toys but he liked a big red ball the most. He gave the money to the man at the store and took the ball home. Tim was very happy. The next day, Tim went to the park to play with his ball. When he threw the ball high in the sky, something unexpected happened. The ball turned into a big red bird! The bird said, "Thank you, Tim, for choosing me. I was a bird stuck in a ball. Now, I am free." Tim was surprised but happy to have a new friend. They played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to climb. One day, he saw a big rocket in his yard. Tim was very happy and impatient to see what was inside the rocket. Tim said, "Mom, can I climb the rocket, please?" His mom said, "Yes, but be careful, Tim." Tim was very excited. He started to climb the rocket. He went up and up until he reached the top. When Tim was at the top, he saw a big button. He pushed the button and the rocket door opened. Inside, he found many toys and games. Tim played with the toys and had a lot of fun. After a while, he climbed down from the rocket and told his mom about his adventure. They both laughed and played with the toys together.

One day, a fat owl was in the tree. He liked to work at night, but today he was awake. He saw a little girl named Sue. Sue saw the owl and said, "Hi, Mr. Owl! Why are you awake?" The owl said, "I don't know, Sue. I just can't sleep." Sue had an idea. "I can help you, Mr. Owl! Let's play a game. You close your eyes and I will hide. You try to find me." The fat owl closed his eyes and Sue ran to hide. When the owl opened his eyes, he saw a big, bright light in the sky. It was the sun! The owl said, "Oh no, I can't see well in the day. How can I find Sue now?" But then, something unexpected happened. The clouds covered the sun, and the day became dark. The owl could see again. He found Sue and they played all day. When the night came, the fat owl went back to work, happy and ready to sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a busy fisherman named Tom. Every day, Tom would go to the sea to catch fish. He liked to catch big fish and small fish. The fish were very good to eat. One day, while Tom was fishing, he saw a little fish trying to hide behind a rock. Tom said, "Hello, little fish! Why are you trying to hide?" The little fish said, "I am scared of the big fish. They want to eat me." Tom wanted to help the little fish. He said, "Don't worry, little fish. I will help you hide." Tom put the little fish in his pocket and took him home. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a brilliant girl named Lily. Lily loved to print pictures to put on her wall. One day, Lily wanted to print a picture of a dish. She thought it would be fun to have a dish on her wall. But when Lily tried to print the dish, the printer did not work. Lily was sad. She tried to fix the printer, but she did not know how. Lily's friend, Tom, came over to play. He saw that Lily was sad and asked her what was wrong. Lily told Tom about the printer and the dish. Tom knew how to fix the printer. He helped Lily, and they fixed it together. Lily was so happy! She printed the dish and put it on her wall. Tom and Lily played all day with the dish on the wall, and they had lots of fun. The end.

One day, a little fish named Finny lived near a reef. The reef was his home. Finny had many friends in the reef. They were all different, but they liked to play together. One day, a big shark came to the reef. He looked scary, but he said, "I am harmless. Will you be my friend?" The little fish were scared. They did not know if they could trust the big shark. Finny said, "Let's unite and be friends with the big shark. He is harmless." The little fish listened to Finny and became friends with the big shark. They all played together and had fun. The big shark was happy to have new friends. He helped the little fish when they needed help. They all lived happily in the reef. The moral of the story is: Don't judge someone by how they look. Sometimes, people who look scary can be harmless and kind.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He had a pretty bike and a big helmet. One day, Tim wanted to go to the park. At the park, Tim saw a girl with an attractive red helmet. She was riding a bike too. Tim said, "Hi! I like your red helmet. Want to play?" The girl smiled and said, "Yes! My name is Amy. Let's ride our bikes together!" So, Tim and Amy rode their bikes around the park. They had so much fun. And from that day, they became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, blue sheet that she loved very much. She took the sheet everywhere she went. She played with it, slept with it, and even wore it like a cape. One day, Lily was playing with her sheet outside. She was running and laughing when a strong wind came. The wind took her sheet up, up, up into the air. Lily was very sad. She looked up and saw her sheet stuck in a tall tree. She didn't know how to get it back. Lily asked her friend Tom for help. Tom had an idea. He found a long stick and used it to part the branches of the tree. The sheet fell down, and Lily caught it. She was so happy to have her sheet back. Lily and Tom played with the sheet for the rest of the day, and Lily was not sad anymore.

Once upon a time there lived a mighty flood. It was so powerful that it spread far and wide, sweeping away everything in its path. One day a brave little boy called Bobbie decided to try and fix the mighty flood. He grabbed his shovel and started digging a ditch. His grandma saw him and went over. "What are you doing, my dear Bobbie?" asked grandma. "I'm trying to fix the flood," said Bobbie. Grandma smiled and said, "That's very kind of you, Bobbie. But I'm afraid nothing can fix a mighty flood, not even you. But you can help by clearing debris from it. That way, the flood will be a little less mighty." Bobbie nodded and threw his little shovel aside. Instead, he ran over to the flood and started clearing the debris away. He worked hard all day until he had cleared the flood enough to make it a little less mighty. It was hard work, but Bobbie had learnt a good lesson that day. He realised that no matter how mighty something may seem, we can always do something to make it better -- even if it's just a little.

One day, a boy named Tim had sunglasses. He loved them because they were cool. He had a dog named Max. Max was a dependable dog. They played together every day. One sunny day, Tim and Max went to the park. Tim wore his sunglasses. They saw a big tree. Tim said, "Max, I will climb the tree. You stay here." Tim climbed the tree. But then, his sunglasses fell down. Max saw the sunglasses fall. He called, "Tim, your sunglasses fell down!" Tim looked down and saw his sunglasses were gone. He felt sad. He climbed down to get them. But when Tim got to the ground, he saw a little girl wearing his sunglasses. She said, "I found these sunglasses. They are mine now." Tim was surprised. Max barked, "Give them back!" The little girl gave the sunglasses back to Tim. They all played together and became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat pastry. One day, she went to the bakery with her mom. Lily was very happy. In the bakery, Lily saw a big pastry. She wanted to eat it. Lily asked her mom, "Mom, can I have the big pastry, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, you can have it." Lily tried to pull the pastry from the shelf, but it was too high. She tried again and again. Finally, her mom helped her. They pulled the pastry together. Lily and her mom went home and ate the pastry. They were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom loved to sleep all day long. He had a favorite toy, a small triangle. Tom would play with the triangle when he was not sleeping. One day, Tom was playing with the triangle. He was tossing it up in the air and catching it. He was having so much fun. But then, Tom threw the triangle too hard. It hit the wall and broke. Tom was sad that his triangle broke. He did not know what to do. He decided to ask his friend, a clever dog named Max, for help. Max knew how to fix things. Max helped Tom fix the broken triangle. Tom was very happy and thanked Max. From that day on, Tom and Max became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree with many roots. One root was very important. It was the biggest and strongest root of them all. One day, a little bunny was looking for food near the tree. The bunny saw a sign near the important root. The sign said, "Do not dig here." The bunny was very good at reading signs. The bunny knew the sign was important, so he did not dig near the big root. Instead, he hopped away to find food somewhere else. The tree was happy because its important root was safe. And so, the tree and the bunny both lived happily in the forest, always remembering to follow the signs and protect the important root.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a big dog named Max. Max was very obedient. Mia loved to draw pictures with her colors. One day, Mia drew a pretty picture of Max. She wanted to give the picture to her grandma. Mia asked her mom, "Can we mail my picture to grandma?" Her mom said, "Yes, but first we need a frame to make it look nice." Mia and her mom went to the store and bought a pretty frame for the picture. When they got home, Mia put the picture in the frame. Then, she and her mom put the framed picture in a box. They wrote grandma's address on the box. Mia and her mom took the box to the post office. They mailed the box to grandma. A few days later, Mia's grandma called. She was so happy with her gift. Mia felt proud and knew her grandma loved the picture.

Once upon a time, in a big green forest, there was a small cave. In this cave lived a little green frog named Snap. Snap was a happy frog who liked to play and jump around the forest. One day, Snap found a big stick near the cave. He thought it looked fun to play with, so he picked it up with his mouth. He hopped around the forest, waving the stick in the air. Snap felt like he was a big, strong frog with the stick. Later that day, a big bird came to the forest. The bird wanted to eat Snap! Snap was scared, but then he remembered the big stick he found. He picked it up with his mouth and waved it at the bird. The bird was scared of the big stick and flew away. Snap was safe! He was so happy that he found the stick near his cave. From that day on, Snap knew that sometimes, little things could make a big difference.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was very helpful and often tried to help out her family. One day Sally's mum asked her to go to the store and bring some salt. Sally was excited to help as she had never gone to the shop alone before. Sally went to the shop and asked the man for some salt. The man said, “Here you go Sally!” Sally was very happy, thanked the man and carefully brought the salt back to her mother. When Sally gave the salt to her mother, her mother smiled and said, “Thanks, Sally. You are very helpful.” Sally was so proud of herself for being helpful and for going to the store all by herself. She would remember this day forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hockey with her friends, but sometimes they would be rude to her. One day, Lily decided she would not complain and just play the game. While they were playing hockey, a big, friendly dog came to watch them. The dog started to bark and wag its tail. The rude friends thought the dog wanted to play hockey too, so they gave the dog a hockey stick. But, something unexpected happened! The dog did not want to play hockey. Instead, it picked up the stick and ran away with it. The rude friends were sad because they could not play hockey anymore. Lily, who did not complain, found another hockey stick and shared it with her friends. They all learned to be kind and not rude when playing together. And from that day on, they always had fun playing hockey with their new friend, the big, friendly dog.

Tommy heard something behind him. He spun around and saw a gift on the floor. It was wrapped in paper with a large bow on top. Tommy recognized that it was unusual. He stepped closer and heard a rattling sound. He carefully unwrapped the gift and inside he found a shiny new toy car! Tommy was so excited he jumped up and down clapping his hands. It was the most unusual gift he ever heard!

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Mia and her cat, Tia. They were the best of friends and loved to play together. One sunny day, Mia and Tia went to the park to play. At the park, they saw a boy named Tim who was upset. Mia asked, "Why are you upset, Tim?" Tim said, "I lost my toy and I can't find it." Mia and Tia wanted to help Tim, so they looked everywhere in the park. After a while, Tia found the toy under a big tree. Mia picked it up and gave it to Tim. Tim was so happy that he said, "Thank you, Mia and Tia! You are very kind." Mia, Tia, and Tim played together for the rest of the day and became good friends. They had lots of fun and went home with big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a little toy named Ted. Ted lived on a high shelf in a big room. He was not happy on the shelf. He wanted to become a real friend to the little girl named Amy who lived in the house. One day, Ted saw Amy playing with her toys. He called out to her, "Amy, please take me down from the shelf. I want to play with you and be your friend." Amy heard Ted and took him down from the shelf. Ted was so happy to be safe in her arms. Amy and Ted played together every day. They had lots of fun and became best friends. Soon, Amy learned to put her toys back on the shelf when she was done playing. This way, her room stayed clean and her toys stayed safe. The moral of the story is that we should always put things back where they belong and take care of our friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing outside. He saw a big tree with many leaves. He wanted to climb the tree and have fun. He started to climb the tree but then he saw something unknown. It was a small box. Tim looked at the box and said, "What is this? I want to open it." He opened the box and found a toy inside. The toy was a little dog. Tim was very happy and said, "Wow, a new friend!" Tim played with the toy dog and they had lots of fun. But then, the toy dog started to tremble. Tim was scared and said, "What's wrong, dog?" The toy dog changed into a real dog! Tim was surprised but happy. Now he had a real dog friend to play with.

Ben likes to play with his toy cars. He has many cars of different colors and sizes. He likes to make them zoom and crash on the floor. He likes to make loud noises with his mouth, like a motor. But sometimes, Ben gets too excited and noisy. His mom tells him to relax and play quietly. She says he needs to be slow and gentle with his toys, or they will break. She says he can play with his cars, but not too fast or loud. Ben listens to his mom. He does not want to break his cars or make his mom angry. He picks up his favorite car, a red one with a shiny motor. He makes it go slow and smooth on the floor. He makes a soft noise with his mouth, like a purr. He feels calm and happy. He looks at his mom and smiles. She smiles back and gives him a hug. She says he is a good boy and she loves him. She says he can play with his cars for a little longer, then it is time for a snack. Ben nods and says thank you. He relaxes and enjoys his play.

One day, a boy named Tim saw his dad polish the floor. It was so shiny and light. Tim wanted to help his dad. He looked up and saw the ceiling. Tim had a fun idea. Tim said, "Dad, can I polish the ceiling?" His dad laughed and said, "Sure, but be careful." Tim took the polish and a big stick. He put the polish on the stick and started to rub it on the ceiling. But then, something unexpected happened. The ceiling became too shiny and light. Tim and his dad could not see well. They bumped into things and fell down. The house was a big mess. Tim was sad that his idea did not work.

Once there was a little boy named Sam. He wanted to thank the moon for its beauty. Every night, he looked at the moon and said a thank you. The moon was so peaceful and calm, it made Sam happy. One night, Sam thanked the moon a little louder than usual and the moon started to fall from the sky! Sam was so scared. He quickly ran away, but the moon was too fast. Soon, it reached the ground and made a huge crash. Everyone was so frightened and upset. No one ever thanked the moon again. The end. Everyone was sad and there was no more peaceful moon in the sky.

One day, a smart boy named Tim went to his club. At the club, he liked to watch his friends play. They played with big, colorful balls and had so much fun. "Can I play too?" Tim asked his friend, Sam. Sam smiled and said, "Yes, come join us!" So, Tim played with Sam and their other friends at the club. They laughed and played all day. Tim was happy he went to the club. He liked to watch and play with his friends. They all had a great time together.

Once upon a time, there was a big mountain. It was very difficult to go up the mountain. Many people tried, but they could not do it. One day, a small boy named Tim decided to try. He wanted to show that he could do it. Tim started to climb the mountain. It was not easy, but he did not give up. As he went up, he saw a big rock in his way. He did not want the rock to prevent him from reaching the top. So, he pushed the rock very hard. The rock moved and something unexpected happened. Behind the rock, there was a hidden door. Tim opened the door and found a secret path. The path made it easy to go up the mountain. He went up the secret path and reached the top. Tim was very happy. He showed everyone that even if something is difficult, you can still do it if you try hard and never give up.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Ben. Ben lived in a fair meadow with his family. He loved to play with his friends and enjoy the sun. One day, Ben's mom made a yummy salad for lunch. Ben did not like salad. He only wanted to eat sweet things. His mom said, "Ben, you must eat your salad. It is good for you." Ben did not want to listen and ran away to play. While playing, Ben saw his friend, Sam the squirrel, eating a salad. Sam told Ben, "I love eating salad. It makes me strong and fast!" Ben decided to try the salad. He found out that he liked it too! From that day on, Ben always ate his salad and became healthy and strong. The moral of the story is to always try new things, as they might be good for you.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Jordan and Joe. Every day they used to go outside and play. One day when they were in the park, Jordan found a mysterious object. It was a hook. Joe said he was scared of it. Jordan said, "It's just a harmless hook, don't be scared." Joe replied, "But it looks scary, I don't want to go near it!" Jordan said, "See, nothing is happening! It's harmless. Let's go closer and take a closer look." So they both went closer and saw that the hook was rusty but harmless. They both stayed there for a few minutes and when they were done looking, they went back to play.

Lily and Ben were hungry. They wanted to eat pasta with sauce. Mom said she would make it for them. She put water in a big pot and turned on the fire. Then she opened a can of sauce and poured it in a small pot. "Can we help you, Mom?" Lily asked. "Sure, you can help me. Lily, you can stir the sauce with this spoon. Ben, you can get the cheese from the fridge," Mom said. Lily and Ben were happy. They liked to help Mom. They did what she said. Lily stirred the sauce slowly and carefully. Ben opened the fridge and looked for the cheese. He saw a yellow block of cheese and a green bottle of sauce. "Mom, what is this sauce?" Ben asked. "That is salad sauce, Ben. We don't need it for pasta. We need cheese," Mom said. "Oh, I see. Here is the cheese, Mom," Ben said. He took the cheese and closed the fridge. He shut it hard. "Be careful, Ben. Don't shut the fridge so hard. You might break it," Mom said. "Sorry, Mom. I didn't mean to shut it so hard," Ben said. "It's okay, Ben. I know you were trying to help. Thank you for the cheese," Mom said. She grated some cheese and sprinkled it on the pasta and sauce. She put the plates on the table and called Lily and Ben. "Come on, kids. Pasta with sauce is ready. It's hot and yummy," Mom said. Lily and Ben ran to the table. They smelled the pasta and sauce. They saw the cheese on top. They were very happy. "Thank you, Mom. This looks delicious," Lily said. "Yes, thank you, Mom. You are the best," Ben said. They ate the pasta with sauce and cheese. They enjoyed every bite. They told Mom how much they liked it. Mom smiled and hugged them. "You're welcome, kids. I'm glad you liked it. You are the best, too," Mom said.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a soft, pink blanket that she loved very much. Lucy would bring her blanket with her everywhere she went. It was her favorite thing in the whole world. One day, Lucy was playing with her friend, Tom. Tom saw her blanket and said, "Lucy, your blanket is so soft! Can I touch it?" Lucy said, "Yes, you can touch it, but please be gentle." Tom touched the blanket and smiled. He liked how soft it was on his skin. Lucy and Tom played together all day long. When it was time to go home, Lucy and Tom said goodbye. Lucy took her soft blanket and went back to her house. She was happy that she could share her special blanket with her friend Tom.

One day, there was a boy called Jack. He was three years old. He saw something black sticking out of the freezer. He pointed and said, "What's that?" His mum came up to him and said, "That is a box Jack. It looks like a black box." Jack asked, "What's in it?" His mum said, "Let's have a look!" and opened the box. Inside was a soft blanket. Jack's mum said, "This is a blanket. It will keep us warm when it's cold. Let's put it on the sofa and cover ourselves up!" Jack was so excited! He grabbed the blanket, covered himself in it and giggled. He was warm and happy. Jack's mum said, "Let's cover the box and put it back in the freezer so it'll stay nice and warm." So they put the blanket back and Jack covered the box with the lid. Jack smiled and said, "That was fun, Mum!"

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack who wanted to explore the big world outside the four walls of his house. He went out and saw an attractive wall with a door in it. He ran to the door and tried to open it but it was locked. No matter how much Jack tried he couldn't open it! He started crying and a kind old man walked up to him. The man said "Why are you crying, little one?" Jack told him that he wanted to open the door but he couldn't. The old man smiled and said "Don't worry, I know the secret code to open the door. Would you like to know it?" Jack was excited and said "Yes, please!" The old man told him the code and Jack entered the magical world behind the wall. He was filled with awe at the sight before him. He had never seen such an attractive place before. He waved goodbye to the old man and went in to explore his new world. After that day Jack kept visiting the magical world as often as he could.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. One day, it rained a lot and there were many puddles on the ground. Ben and Lily put on their boots and coats and ran to the puddles. They jumped and splashed and laughed. They had a lot of fun. But they did not see that their neighbor, Mr. Lee, was sleeping on his porch. He worked at night and needed to rest during the day. The noise from the puddles woke him up and made him grumpy. He came out and shouted at Ben and Lily. "Stop making so much noise! You are bothering me! Go away!" Ben and Lily were scared and sad. They did not mean to upset Mr. Lee. They ran back to their house and told their mom what happened. Their mom said, "I'm sorry, Ben and Lily. You did not know that Mr. Lee was sleeping. But you should always be quiet and respectful of other people's feelings. How would you feel if someone woke you up when you were sleeping?" Ben and Lily thought about it and felt sorry. They decided to do something nice for Mr. Lee. They made a card and a cake and brought them to his door. They knocked gently and said, "We are sorry, Mr. Lee. We did not mean to make noise. We hope you like this card and cake. We want to be your friends." Mr. Lee was surprised and touched. He smiled and said, "Thank you, Ben and Lily. You are very kind and thoughtful. I forgive you. I'm sorry I was rude to you. I was tired and cranky. I appreciate your gift. You are welcome to play in the puddles, but please be quiet when I'm sleeping." Ben and Lily nodded and said, "We understand, Mr. Lee. We will be quiet when you're sleeping. We hope you have a good nap. Bye!" They waved and went back to their house. They learned to be more careful and considerate of others. They also made a new friend. They were happy.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a pale cat named Fluffy. Fluffy had a best friend named Max, who was a dog. They liked to play and support each other when they were sad. One sunny day, Fluffy and Max were playing outside. They saw a big ball near the fence. Fluffy wanted to play with the ball, but Max wanted to wait. Fluffy said, "Let's play with the ball!" Max said, "No, we should wait." Fluffy didn't want to wait, so she tried to get the ball. But the ball was stuck! Fluffy and Max started to argue. They both wanted to be right. Then, they decided to work together and support each other. They got the ball and played happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a powerful cat named Tom. Tom was very big and strong. One day, Tom saw a little sheet of paper on the floor. He was curious about the sheet. Tom went to his friend, a small mouse named Jerry. Tom asked, "Jerry, what do we do with this sheet?" Jerry said, "Let's start drawing on it!" So, Tom and Jerry took some colors and began to draw. They drew a big tree, a house, and a sun. They were having lots of fun. When they finished, they looked at their drawing and smiled. Tom and Jerry were happy that they found the sheet and started drawing together. They played and drew every day, and they became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a creative girl named Lucy. She loved to draw and make things with her hands. One day, she wanted to make a surprise for her mom. Lucy had a great idea. She wanted to make a drawing and put it on the refrigerator. Lucy found paper and colors. She drew a big, happy sun with a smiley face. She also drew flowers and trees. Lucy was so happy with her drawing. She ran to the refrigerator to put it on. But when Lucy opened the refrigerator, she saw something unexpected. Inside, there was a little, talking cat. The cat said, "Hello, Lucy! I can explain." Lucy was very surprised. The cat told her that he was a magic cat. He could make her drawing come to life. Lucy was excited. She showed the cat her drawing. The magic cat touched the drawing with his paw. Suddenly, the sun, flowers, and trees jumped off the paper. They were alive! Lucy was so happy. She thanked the magic cat. Her mom came into the room and was amazed. Lucy and the magic cat had made a beautiful surprise together.

One day, a big cat named Tom was out for a walk. He saw a pretty sunset in the sky. The colors were pink, orange, and red. Tom felt happy when he saw the sunset. He wanted to lay down and watch it. So, he found a soft spot on the grass and lay down. As Tom lay there, a small mouse named Tim came by. Tim saw Tom and felt a little scared. But he wanted to be brave, so he went up to Tom and said, "Hi, I'm Tim. Do you want to be friends?" Tom was surprised because he didn't think a mouse would want to be friends with a cat. Tom said, "Yes, I want to be friends. I'm sorry if I scared you." Tim was happy to hear that. Just then, a big wind came and blew the clouds away. The sunset was gone! Tom and Tim were sad, but they knew they could still have fun together. So, they played and laughed until it was dark. And that's how Tom the cat and Tim the mouse became best friends.

Lily and Sam like to play with blocks. They want to design a tower with many colors and shapes. They work hard and put one block on top of another. They are happy with their tower. "Look at our tower!" Lily says to Sam. "It is so nice and tall!" "Yes, it is!" Sam says. "We are good designers!" But then, Tom comes. Tom is mean. He does not like to share or play nice. He sees Lily and Sam's tower and he wants to break it. He runs to the tower and pushes it with his hands. "Hey, stop!" Lily and Sam shout. "That is our tower! We made it!" But Tom does not listen. He laughs and knocks down the tower. The blocks fall and scatter on the floor. Lily and Sam are sad and angry. They cry and yell at Tom. "Tom, you are bad!" Lily says. "You ruined our tower!" "Tom, you are mean!" Sam says. "You are not our friend!" Tom does not care. He walks away and looks for something else to break. Lily and Sam hug each other and try to fix their tower. But it is not the same. They wish Tom would be nice and play with them. But he never does.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane loved to play with bubbles. She would blow them and watch them float away. One day, she saw a big, distant bubble in the sky. Jane wanted to understand where it came from. She followed the bubble and met a kind old woman. The woman said, "I made the bubble for you, Jane." The woman told Jane that if she was nice to others, she would get more bubbles. Jane was happy and said thank you. Jane started being nice to everyone she met. She shared her toys and helped her friends. One day, as she was playing, the sky filled with many bubbles. Jane understood that being kind made her world more beautiful.

One day, a little girl named Lily was watching her favorite cartoon on TV. She loved the cartoon so much that she wanted to order a toy of her favorite character. She asked her mom, "Can I please order the toy, Mommy?" Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. Let's order the toy for you." They went online and found the toy. Lily was so happy when they placed the order. A few days later, the toy arrived in a big, deep box. Lily opened it and found her new toy inside. She played with it all day and night, pretending they were in the cartoon world together. She even showed it to her friends, who thought it was really cool.

One day, a boy named Tim found a rod. It was not a regular rod. It was a magic rod. Tim was very happy. He thought the rod would support him in doing fun things. Tim went to his friend, Sam. He said, "Look, Sam! I found a magic rod. It can help us do anything we want." Sam was excited too. They both thought of all the fun they could have. They played with the magic rod all day. But then, something unexpected happened. The rod stopped working. Tim and Sam were sad. They did not know what to do. The magic rod did not support them anymore. The fun was over.
