But when he tried to eat the apple, a big bird came and took it away. Bob was sad and still hungry. He tried again to cut another apple, but the bird came back and took it away. This happened many times. Bob had to repeat his plan to get an apple. Bob was tired of the bird taking his apples. He thought of a new plan. He cut an apple and waited for the bird. When the bird came to take the apple, Bob jumped and grabbed the bird's leg. The bird was surprised and flew away, leaving the apple behind. Bob was happy and finally ate the apple. From that day on, the bird never took Bob's apples again, and Bob was never hungry.

Once upon a time there was a huge, enormous elephant. He was really big and walked around the forest, looking for something delicious to eat. One day, he spotted a bowl of yummy cream sitting on a log. He quickly rushed over to it and started to gobble it all up. Just then, a little bird flew over to him. "Hey Mr. Elephant!" the bird said, "That cream belongs to me! You can't eat it all!" The elephant thought for a bit, and then he had a great idea. He bent down close to the ground and used his trunk to kick the bowl straight back to the little bird. "Here," the elephant said, "This way you can still enjoy the cream!" The bird was very happy. He thanked the elephant and said, "You are so kind! I will share my cream with you any time!" After that, the elephant and the bird became the best of friends. They would often play together, and share the cream with each other. They would laugh and giggle, and it was the happiest sight ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play in the water and splash all day. One day, he found a letter in a bottle. It was an amazing letter from a friend far away. The friend was sad and needed help. Tim wanted to help his friend, so he asked his mom and dad what to do. They told him to be kind and share with others. Tim thought about it and decided to send a letter back to his friend. He shared his toys and his love in the letter. After some time, Tim got another letter from his friend. The friend was now happy because of Tim's kindness. Tim learned that sharing and being kind can make others happy. And that made Tim happy too.

Anna and Ben are friends. They live next to each other. They like to play together in the yard. One day, they see a big truck in front of a new house. They are curious. "Who lives there?" Anna questions. "I don't know. Maybe a new neighbor," Ben says. They walk closer to the truck. They see a man and a woman carrying boxes. They also see a girl and a boy. The girl and the boy are holding a dog and a cat. "Hi!" Anna and Ben say. "Hi!" the girl and the boy say. "What are your names?" Anna questions. "I'm Lily and this is Max. And this is Spot and Fluffy," the girl says, pointing to the dog and the cat. "I'm Anna and this is Ben. We live next to you," Anna says. "Do you want to play with us?" Ben questions. "Yes, please!" Lily and Max say. They put the dog and the cat down. They run to the yard with Anna and Ben. They play tag and hide and seek. They have fun. The man and the woman smile. They are happy to see their children make new friends. They finish carrying the boxes. They are ready to start their new life.

One day, a boy named Tim found a pistol in his dad's room. He knew he should not touch it, but he felt guilty because he wanted to play with it. Tim took the pistol outside to show his friend, Sam. "Look what I found!" said Tim to Sam. They both knew it was wrong, but they played with the pistol anyway. They pretended to be heroes, but they were not being safe. Suddenly, the pistol went off and a bird in the tree vanished. Tim and Sam felt very sad and guilty. They knew they should not have played with the pistol. They learned that playing with dangerous things can lead to bad endings. The moral value is to always listen to adults and never play with things that can hurt others.

One day, Bob saw a clay pot on the ground. He walked over and picked it up. It felt soft and smooth. Bob looked up and saw his Mom. "Mom, what is this?" "That's clay, son. It's something special. When it gets wet it turns hard. You can use it to make all kinds of things." Bob smiled and said, "I trust it." Bob and his Mom went home. Bob put the clay pot in a safe place. Then he spent the rest of the day playing with his friends. That night, Bob remembered all the things his Mom told him about clay. He went back to get the pot and felt something wet. He realized he'd forgotten to put it away and it had gotten wet in the rain. Bob didn't know what to do. But he trusted his Mom's words and decided to wait and see what happened. The next morning, Bob looked inside the clay pot. It had turned hard. Bob found that something he trusted in had worked out just like his Mom had said. Bob was sure now that he could trust clay.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong tree in the park. The tree had many leaves and branches. It was very tall and pretty. Every day, many friends would come to visit the tree. One day, a little girl named Lucy came to visit the strong tree. She liked to play under the tree with her toys. She would sit and draw pictures of the tree with her crayons. Lucy loved the tree very much. One sunny day, Lucy and her friends had a picnic under the strong tree. They shared yummy food and played fun games. They laughed and had a great time. The tree was happy to have so many friends visit. And they all promised to come back and visit the tree again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toy cars and run wild in the park. One day, Mom asked Tim to go to the grocery store with her. Tim didn't want to go because he wanted to play. At the grocery store, Tim saw a big, wild dog. The dog was barking and running around. Tim was scared and wanted to leave. But Mom said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will encourage you to be brave." Tim took a deep breath and tried to be brave. He walked with Mom, and they got all the things they needed from the grocery store. When they left, the wild dog was gone. Tim was happy that he was brave, and Mom was proud of him. They went home and had a fun day playing with toy cars.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a curious cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to explore and find new things. One day, she smelled something yummy and wanted to find it. Kitty looked around the house and found a big cup of milk on the table. She was very happy and wanted to drink it all. But she knew the milk was not hers. She thought about what to do. Kitty decided to be a good cat and not drink the milk. She knew it belonged to someone else. Later, her owner saw her being good and gave her a small cup of her own milk to drink. Kitty was happy she did the right thing. The moral of the story is to be honest and not take things that are not yours.

Once upon a time, there was a noisy bee named Buzz. Buzz loved to perform for his friends in the garden. He would fly high, then low, and do loops in the air. His friends, the flowers, would clap and cheer. One day, Buzz found a big jar of honey. He wanted to share it with his friends. So, he planned a special show for them. He told all his friends to come and watch him perform. The day of the show, Buzz was very excited. He flew high, then low, and did loops in the air. His friends clapped and cheered. After the show, Buzz shared the honey with everyone. They all had a sweet and happy day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to play outside. One day, he found a big box. The box was locked. Tim wanted to see what was inside the box. He thought it was a treasure. Tim tried to unlock the box. It was not easy. He tried and tried. Then, he found a key. The key was under a rock. Tim was happy. He used the key to unlock the box. Inside the box, there was a treasure! It had toys and candy. Tim was very happy. He shared the treasure with his friends. They all played and ate candy together. It was a fun day for everyone.

Once upon a time, in a cold wood, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim was always cold, so he wore a big, warm coat. One day, while Tim was walking in the wood, he met a small bird. The bird was shivering and looked very cold, too. "Hello, bird," said Tim. "You look cold. Do you know where your nest is?" The bird chirped sadly, "I don't know where my nest is. I am lost and cold." Tim wanted to help the bird. "Don't worry, bird. I will help you find your nest." Tim and the bird walked through the wood, looking for the bird's nest. They looked high and low, near and far. Finally, they found the nest in a big tree. The bird was so happy, it sang a beautiful song. "Thank you, Tim," said the bird. "Now I am not cold anymore." From that day on, Tim and the bird were the best of friends. They played in the wood every day and always kept each other warm.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play outside. It was an icy cold day, but he was excited to play in the snow. He put on his warm coat, hat, and gloves, and stepped outside. As Tim walked, he saw a small bird shivering on a tree branch. The bird looked very cold. Tim said, "Hello, bird! Are you cold?" The bird nodded its head and opened its mouth to sing. But no sound came out because it was too cold. Tim wanted to help the bird. He thought for a moment and had an idea. He said, "I will give you my warm hat to wear." He took off his hat and put it on the bird's head. The bird was so happy, it started to sing again. The little bird sang a song with a number in it. It went, "One, two, three, thank you, Tim!" Tim smiled and said, "You're welcome, bird!" And they both laughed and played in the snow together.

Once upon a time, there was a messy boy named Tom. Tom liked to play in the mud and his pants always got dirty. His mom would tell him to change his pants, but he didn't listen. One day, Tom saw a big, red ball in the park. He wanted to carry the ball home, but it was too big. Tom tried and tried, but he could not carry the ball. He was sad. Then, a nice girl named Sally came to help Tom. She said, "Let's roll the ball together!" They rolled the ball all the way home. Tom's mom was happy to see them help each other. She gave them clean pants to wear and they played with the big, red ball all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot lived in a gloomy house with his family. One day, Spot saw an open door and decided to escape. He wanted to go on a walk outside. As Spot walked down the street, he met a big cat named Tom. Tom said, "Hi Spot, where are you going?" Spot replied, "I am going on a walk. I escaped from my house." Tom said, "That sounds fun. Can I come with you?" Spot said, "Yes, let's go together." Spot and Tom walked and played all day. They had so much fun. But as the sun started to set, Spot knew it was time to go home. Tom said, "Bye, Spot. I had a great time." Spot said, "Me too, Tom. Let's play again soon." Spot went back to his house and was happy to see his family. They all hugged Spot and were happy he was home.

Once upon a time, there was a blue soldier. He lived in a small house. The blue soldier had a friend named Tom. They played together every day. One day, Tom said, "Blue soldier, let's go to the park!" But the blue soldier wanted to stay home. Tom was sad. He went to the park alone. While Tom was gone, the blue soldier heard a loud noise. He was scared. Then, Tom came back with a big surprise. It was a blue dog! The blue soldier was happy. The loud noise was just the dog barking. They all played together and became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Fluffy. Fluffy liked to play outside. One day, Fluffy saw a ball on the pitch. The ball was big and red. Fluffy wanted to play with the ball. Fluffy ran to the ball and tried to move it. But the ball was too big. Fluffy felt helpless. She did not know what to do. Then, Fluffy had an idea. She started to rub her head on the ball. The ball began to move. Fluffy was happy. She played with the ball all day. She was not helpless anymore. Fluffy learned that she could do anything if she tried.

Sara is a girl who likes to play with dolls. She has many dolls, but she wants more. She thinks she needs more dolls to be happy. She sees a doll in the shop that is very pretty. It has a pink dress and long hair. Sara asks her mom to buy the doll for her. Mom says no. She says Sara has enough dolls. She says they do not have a lot of money. She says they are not rich. She says they need to save money for other things. Sara is sad and angry. She cries and stomps her feet. She says she needs the doll. Mom hugs Sara and tries to calm her down. She says she loves Sara very much. She says Sara does not need more dolls to be happy. She says Sara has many things that make her happy. She says Sara has a family, friends, toys, books, and a home. She says Sara is rich in other ways. She says maybe Sara can get the doll later, but not yet. Sara stops crying and thinks. She looks at her mom and smiles. She says she loves her mom very much. She says she is sorry for being mean. She says she does not need the doll. She says she is happy with what she has. She says she is rich in other ways. She says maybe she can get the doll later, but not yet. Mom smiles and kisses Sara. They go home and play with the dolls Sara already has. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside with his friends. One day, while they were playing, Tim saw something on the ground. It was a big, disgusting bug. Tim screamed, "Yuck! Look at that bug!" His friend, Lily, came over and looked at the bug too. She said, "Oh, it's just a bug. Don't be scared, Tim. It won't hurt you." Tim felt a little better, but he still didn't like the bug. Lily had an idea. She said, "Let's help the bug. We can take small steps and move it to the grass." Tim and Lily worked together to move the bug. They hoped it would be happy in the grass. And it was! The bug crawled away into the tall green grass. The moral of the story is to not judge something by how it looks. Sometimes, things that seem scary or disgusting can be harmless and just need a little help.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to collect loops. He had many loops in many colors. One day, he saw a big red loop in a tree. He wanted it very much. Tim asked his friend, Sam, to help him. "Sam, can you help me get the loop?" Tim said. Sam was tall and strong. Sam said, "Yes, I will help you, Tim." They tried to get the loop, but it was too high. Tim and Sam found a long stick. They used the stick to get the loop. But the stick was hurt and broke. The loop fell down, and Tim was so happy. He said, "Thank you, Sam!" They both smiled and played with the new red loop all day.

One day, a large dog and a small cat had a fight. They were very loud. The dog barked and the cat hissed. A little boy named Tim saw them and felt sad. Tim walked up to them and said, "Why are you fighting?" The dog and the cat stopped for a moment. The dog said, "I want the big bone, but the cat won't let me have it." The cat said, "I want the soft bed, but the dog won't let me have it." Tim thought for a moment and then had an idea. He asked the dog and the cat, "Why don't you share? The dog can have the big bone and the cat can have the soft bed." The dog and the cat looked at each other and agreed. They stopped fighting and became friends. From that day on, the large dog and the small cat shared everything. They played together and never had a fight again. Tim was happy to see them being friends and he knew that asking a question can sometimes solve a problem.

One day, a little dog went for a walk. He saw a wide tree with big branches. The dog was tired, so he went under the tree. The tree was a good shelter for him. He felt safe and happy under the wide tree. The dog saw a bird on a branch. The bird was looking for food to add to its nest. The dog wanted to help the bird. So, they both looked for food together. They found some bugs and worms to add to the bird's nest. The bird and the dog became good friends. They played under the wide tree and shared the shelter. They were happy to help each other and add to each other's lives. They lived happily ever after under the wide tree.

There was once a silly map that recorded everything. It even recorded bad things. One day, a three-year-old wanted to play with the map. So, she touched it. Suddenly, the map started to get angry. The three-year-old was scared and tried to run away, but it was too late. The map zapped her and she fell to the ground. Sadly, the three-year-old was never seen again.

A young boy named Tim had a toy box. One day, he found a small key. He thought, "Maybe this key can lock my toy box!" He tried the key and it fit. The toy box was now locked. That night, Tim saw a spark in his room. The spark talked! "Hi Tim, I am a magic spark. I can make your toys come to life, but you must unlock the toy box." Tim was happy and unlocked the toy box. The spark did its magic, and the toys came to life! Tim played with his toys all night. But then, the toys did not want to go back to the toy box. Tim said, "Please go back!" The toys listened and went back. Tim locked the toy box again and thanked the magic spark.

One day, a nice cat named Tom went to the store with his mom. They wanted to get food for dinner. Tom saw a big freezer with lots of yummy things inside. He asked his mom, "Can we get ice cream from the freezer, please?" His mom said, "Yes, Tom! But first, you have to perform a little dance for me." Tom was so happy, he danced and jumped around the store. The people in the store laughed and clapped. Tom's mom was very proud of him. After the dance, Tom and his mom went to the freezer and picked out a big box of ice cream. They went home and had a nice dinner. After dinner, they had the ice cream for dessert. Tom was very happy, and he knew that his dance made his mom happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little crab who lived by the shore. He had a friend, a tiny fish. They played together every day. The crab was very happy, but sometimes, he was a little foolish. One day, the crab saw a big rock in the water. He wanted to climb it. The tiny fish told him, "Don't do it! It's not safe!" But the foolish crab did not listen. He climbed the big rock anyway. As the crab reached the top, he slipped and fell into the water. The tiny fish tried to save him, but the crab was too heavy. The crab could not swim, and he was washed away by the waves. The tiny fish was very sad, and he knew that he would miss his friend forever.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Emily. She was very eager to learn new things. Whenever Emily was asked what she loved most, she would always reply: "I love to study". One day, at noon, Emily was walking in the woods. The sky was very gloomy and the sun was hiding behind the clouds. Suddenly, Emily heard a voice calling her. She turned around and saw a little fairy. The fairy asked her, "Why do you love to study so much?" Emily thought for a moment and then smiled. She said, "Because I believe knowledge brings joy and strength to my life!" The fairy nodded and smiled back. She said,"You are a very wise girl, indeed. You are right. Only by studying and learning, can you become powerful and brave. Always remember that". Then she fluttered away. Emily looked up to the sky and sang a cheerful song. She was so thankful for the life lessons she had learned. The moral of the story is that knowledge is a beautiful gift that can bring joy and strength to our lives. So, take time out to study and learn something new each day.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Jane. Jane was very brave, but she didn't like anything that was too scary. One day, her mom was cutting up a big piece of beef for dinner. The sight of all the cuts was a bit scary for Jane. "Don't worry," said mom. "It's just a piece of beef, so nothing to be afraid of." But Jane still felt scared. She closed her eyes and took a deep breath. "It's ok," she said. "I can be brave!" The next day, Jane went to the movies with her friends. Jane was a bit scared when the movie started, but she was brave and watched it until the end. When the credits rolled, Jane turned to her friends. "That wasn't so scary at all!" she said. Jane had been brave and faced her fear. She now knew that if she could face a big piece of beef, she could face anything.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom saw snow outside. He wanted to play in the snow. He put on his warm clothes and went out. Tom saw an ugly snowman in the snow. He did not like the snowman. Tom decided to ignore the ugly snowman and play with the snow. Tom made a small snowball and threw it at a tree. The ugly snowman saw Tom and wanted to play too. But Tom did not want to play with the ugly snowman. The ugly snowman felt sad and walked away. Tom played alone in the snow. Then, something unexpected happened. The ugly snowman came back with a big snowball. He threw it at Tom. The snowball hit Tom and he fell down. The ugly snowman laughed. Tom was sad and cold. He went back home. The ugly snowman won and Tom learned not to ignore others just because they look different.

Johnny was a young boy who always wanted to be obedient. One day, his father gave him a pistol to practice with. Johnny was surprised and afraid. “But, dad, I’m just a little kid,” said Johnny timidly. “Don’t be scared, Johnny,” said his father with a gentle smile. “This pistol will help you learn how to be obedient. You must follow my instructions carefully and always yield.” Johnny nodded, a little nervous but excited too. He grabbed the pistol carefully and listened to his father’s instructions. Johnny aimed the pistol and shot it. He eagerly waited for the sound of the shot and was pleased when it came. His father patted him on the back, proud at how obedient he had been. From then on, Johnny was a natural at being obedient. He would practice with his pistol each day, yielding to his father’s instructions and learning more each time.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max and a small cat named Luna. They both lived in a house with a girl named Amy. Amy loved Max and Luna very much. Max and Luna were jealous of each other because they both wanted Amy's love. One day, Amy found a big red ball. She wanted to play with Max and Luna. Max and Luna wanted to touch the ball first. They ran fast to the ball, but something unexpected happened. A little bird flew down and took the ball away! Max and Luna looked at each other in surprise. They decided to work together to get the ball back. They chased the bird and jumped high. Finally, Max and Luna got the ball back. They learned that they could both have Amy's love and be friends.

Once upon a time, in a small harbor, there lived a happy boat. The boat loved to balance on the waves. It would go up and down, up and down, all day long. The boat was never sad, always playing and having fun. One day, a big and serious boat came to the harbor. The serious boat saw the happy boat playing and said, "You should not play all the time. You need to learn how to be serious and work hard." The happy boat listened and thought maybe the big boat was right. The happy boat tried to be serious and work hard. But it missed playing and having fun. Soon, the happy boat learned that it was important to balance work and play. The big boat saw this and learned from the happy boat too. Both boats now knew that to be happy, they needed to balance being serious and having fun. And from that day on, the harbor was a happier place for all the boats.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She loved to make art and drawings. She always wanted to have pretty stamps to make her art look even better. One day, the girl went to the store with her mom. She asked her mom if she could buy some stamps, but her mom said no. The girl felt very helpless and didn't know what to do. "Please mama, I would really love some stamps," the little girl said. Her mom looked at her with a kind smile and said, "OK sweetheart, if it will make you happy, we can buy some stamps at the store." The girl was so happy that she jumped up and down. Together they went to the store and the girl picked out some pretty stamps. She put them in her pocket and ran back home to make more beautiful art.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom liked to run fast. One day, he wanted to gather all his friends to play a game. He ran to each friend's house and told them to come to the park. At the park, Tom saw a camera on a bench. He wanted to take a picture of his friends playing the game. But when he picked up the camera, a girl named Sue said, "That's mine!" Tom and Sue both wanted to use the camera. Tom had an idea. "Let's race!" he said. "If I win, I can use the camera. If you win, you can use it." Sue agreed. They ran as fast as they could. Tom won the race, but he decided to share the camera with Sue. They took pictures of their friends and had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very gifted. Her name was Daisy. Daisy had a special friend named Josh. One day, Daisy asked Josh, "What is your name?". Josh smiled and said, "My name is Josh". Daisy smiled back and said, "That's a nice name!". Then, they both decided to play hopscotch. They hopped and played until it was getting dark. Then, Daisy said goodbye to Josh and went home. The next day, Daisy and Josh were back together again and now, they were playing with dolls. Daisy gave Josh a doll, which he named Princess. Daisy was very happy with her gifted friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to step in the park every day. One day, he went to the park at noon. The sun was bright, and the sky was blue. Tim was happy to be outside. As Tim was stepping, he saw a small, frightened cat. The cat was hiding under a bench. Tim wanted to help the cat. He slowly walked closer, so he would not scare the cat more. Tim talked to the cat in a soft voice. The cat started to trust Tim. Tim picked up the cat and took it home. They became best friends and played together every day. The frightened cat was not scared anymore, and Tim was happy to have a new friend.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the gym. The gym was big and quiet. Tim liked to play with his ball there. He saw his friend, Sue, at the gym too. Sue was a nice girl with a big smile. "Hi Sue!" said Tim. "Do you want to play with me?" "Yes, Tim!" said Sue. "Let's play catch with your ball." Tim and Sue played catch. They had lots of fun. Then, Tim saw a mark on the wall. The mark was red and round. Tim showed Sue the mark. "Look, Sue!" said Tim. "I found a mark on the wall." "Oh no!" said Sue. "We need to clean it." Tim and Sue cleaned the mark. The wall was clean again. They went back to playing catch. They had a great day at the quiet gym.

One day, a little mouse named Max was feeling very hungry. He looked around for food, but there was no food available. Max was so tired from searching, he let out a big yawn. "Oh, I need to find something to eat," Max said. Max saw a big tree and decided to climb it. When he reached the top, he found a big nest. Inside the nest, Max found a small bag of oats. "Yay! I found food!" Max said with a big smile. Just then, a bird named Bella flew to the nest. "Hello, little mouse. Are you hungry?" Bella asked. Max nodded and said, "Yes, I am. Can I eat these oats?" Bella smiled and said, "Of course, you can. Let's eat together!" Max and Bella shared the oats and became good friends.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Ben and Tim. Ben was a big boy and Tim was a little boy. Ben and Tim went to play in the park. They played on the swings and they ran around. They had so much fun! Suddenly, Ben wanted a snack. He didn't have anything to eat. But Tim had a snack! He had a yummy apple. He gave it to Ben. Ben was so happy and he thanked Tim for being so nice. He said "You are not stupid, you are my best friend!" They ate their snack and then went home. Ben and Tim were best friends forever!

There was a big city where many people lived. One day, a small cat came to the city. The cat felt uncomfortable because the city was very loud and busy. The cat met a kind dog. The dog said, "Why do you look sad?" The cat said, "The city is too loud for me. I don't like it here." The dog thought for a moment and said, "Come with me. I know a place where you will be happy." The dog took the cat to a quiet park in the city. The cat felt better in the park because it was not loud like the rest of the city. The cat and the dog played together and became good friends. The cat learned that even in a big, loud city, you can find quiet places and good friends to make you feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a big, ugly bug. The bug had many legs and a tiny face. The bug lived in a pretty garden with many flowers. Every day, the bug would walk around and look at the flowers. One day, a little bird saw the bug. The bird flew down and said, "Hey, ugly bug! Why are you so ugly?" The bird liked to tease the bug. The bug felt sad and walked away. For a whole week, the bird teased the bug every day. The bug was very sad. One day, a kind cat saw the bird teasing the bug. The cat walked up to the bird and said, "Stop teasing the bug. It is not nice." The bird felt bad and said sorry to the bug. The bug and the bird became friends. They played together in the pretty garden every day. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a girl named Mia went to the zoo. Mia saw many pretty animals. She saw a big lion, a tall giraffe, and a funny monkey. Mia was very happy. As Mia walked, she heard a loud sneeze. "Achoo!" She looked around to find who sneezed. She saw a little mouse with a big hat. The mouse sneezed again, "Achoo!" Mia thought it was funny to see a mouse sneeze. Then, something unexpected happened. The mouse took off its big hat, and it was not a mouse at all! It was a tiny elephant with a long nose. The tiny elephant sneezed one more time, "Achoo!" Mia laughed and clapped her hands. The zoo was full of surprises.

Once upon a time, in a big park, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy was an adorable girl with a big smile. She loved to play on the swings, and every day, she would go to the park with her mom to swing high in the sky. One day, while Amy was swinging, she saw a beautiful temple in the park. The temple was very big and had many colors. Amy wanted to see the temple up close, so she asked her mom if they could go there. Her mom said yes, and they walked hand in hand to the temple. When they reached the temple, Amy saw many people singing and dancing. She felt very happy and started to dance too. After dancing, Amy and her mom went back to the swings, and Amy swung even higher than before. The day was full of fun and joy, and the temple made it even more special for Amy and her mom.

Once upon a time, there was an honest dog named Max. Max loved to chew on things. His favorite thing to chew was a big tire. The tire was old and not used on a car anymore. One sunny day, Max was chewing on his tire. He was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The tire started to move! Max did not know what to do. He held on tight and kept chewing the tire. As Max chewed, the tire took him on a fun ride. It rolled and bounced all around. Max was surprised but he liked the new adventure. At the end of the day, the tire stopped moving. Max was back home, safe and sound. He had a big smile on his face. From that day on, Max and the tire were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a large, happy sun. It loved to shine bright in the sky. Every day, it would wake up and shine its light all over the world. The sun had a big smile on its face as it shined. One day, the sun saw a gear on the ground. The gear was shiny and round. The sun thought the gear looked fun to play with. So, the sun shined its light on the gear, making it shine even more. The gear started to spin and dance in the sunlight. As the gear danced, it made all the little animals laugh and play. The sun was happy to see this. It shined even brighter, making the gear spin faster. The large sun, the shiny gear, and the little animals all played together in the sunshine, having the best day ever.

One day, Tom and Tim went to play. It was a hot day. They had a ball. Tom said, "Let's pass the ball." Tim said, "Okay, let's play." They passed the ball back and forth. Then, the ball went into a bush. Tim went to get the ball. In the bush, Tim found a watch. "Look, Tom!" said Tim. "I found a watch!" Tom and Tim looked at the watch. It was a magic watch! They put the watch on and wished for ice cream. Suddenly, ice cream appeared in their hands. They were very happy and ate the ice cream. From that day on, they used the magic watch to have fun and help their friends.

Once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a little fly. The little fly loved to fly high in the sky. One day, while flying, the little fly met a big bird. The big bird was blue and pretty. "Hi, big bird! I like to fly. Do you like to fly too?" asked the little fly. The big bird looked at the little fly and said, "Yes, I love to fly. I am an honest bird, and I like to help my friends." The little fly was happy to meet an honest bird. They became good friends. They flew together in the sky, playing and having fun. The little fly and the big bird were happy because they had each other. One day, the little fly saw a red fruit on a tree. The little fly wanted to eat the red fruit, but it was too high. The honest big bird saw the little fly and said, "Don't worry, little fly. I will help you get the red fruit." The big bird flew up to the tree and got the red fruit for the little fly. The little fly was very happy and thanked the big bird. They ate the red fruit together and continued to be good friends, flying and playing in the sky.

Once upon a time, there were twin cats, Tom and Tim. They loved to play and run in the park. They were very obedient and listened to their mom. One sunny day, Tom and Tim went to the park. They saw a big tree with a hole in it. They wanted to see what was inside. Tom said, "Let's squeeze in and look!" Tim nodded, and they both squeezed into the hole. Inside the tree, they found a toy ball. They were so happy! They took turns playing with the ball. Tim said, "We found a fun toy!" Tom agreed and said, "Let's take it home and show Mom!" They squeezed out of the hole and ran home to show their mom the toy ball. Their mom was proud of them for being obedient and playing nicely together. They all played with the toy ball and had a great day.

Lily loved to sing. She sang every day, in the morning, in the afternoon, and at night. She sang to her toys, to her mom, to her dad, and to her cat. She sang happy songs, sad songs, silly songs, and sweet songs. One day, she saw a dove outside her window. The dove was white and soft and had a shiny beak. Lily thought the dove was adorable. She wanted to sing to the dove, too. She opened the window and said, "Hello, dove. Do you want to hear a song?" The dove looked at Lily and nodded. It flew closer to the window and listened. Lily sang a song about the sun, the sky, the clouds, and the rain. She sang with a big smile and a loud voice. The dove liked the song very much. It cooed and flapped its wings. "Thank you, dove. You are a good listener. Do you want to sing with me?" Lily asked. The dove nodded again. It opened its beak and sang a song back to Lily. It sang a song about the trees, the flowers, the grass, and the wind. It sang with a soft voice and a gentle tone. Lily liked the song very much. She clapped and giggled. "You are a good singer, dove. You have a beautiful voice. Do you want to be my friend?" Lily asked. The dove nodded once more. It flew to the window sill and nuzzled Lily's cheek. Lily hugged the dove and said, "You are my friend, dove. You are adorable. I love you." The dove cooed and nuzzled Lily back. It said, "You are my friend, Lily. You are adorable. I love you, too."

One day, a bald man went to the zoo. He wanted to see all the animals. He had a ticket in his hand. The bald man was very happy. At the zoo, he met a nice lady. The lady said, "Hello, I am Jane. Who are you?" The bald man said, "I am Tom. Nice to meet you!" Tom and Jane walked around the zoo together. They saw many animals. They had fun. Tom had a secret. He had another ticket in his pocket. He wanted to introduce Jane to his favorite animal. They walked to the big lion cage. Tom gave Jane the ticket. They both smiled and watched the lion. They had a great day at the zoo.

One day, a cool cat named Mark went to a hotel. The hotel was big and fun. Mark wanted to play with his friends inside. He saw many other animals there too. Mark met a dog named Sam. Sam said, "Let's play in the hotel!" Mark and Sam played hide and seek. They laughed and had a great time together. They found a big room with many toys. In the room, they met a bird named Tina. Tina said, "I like this hotel. It's so cool and fun!" Mark, Sam, and Tina played with the toys all day. They had a big party with cake and juice. At the end of the day, Mark, Sam, and Tina were very happy. They loved the cool hotel and made new friends. They said goodbye and went home. They could not wait to come back and play again.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia wanted to prepare a cake for her mom's birthday. She looked for all the available things she needed in the kitchen. Mia took a big bowl and a measure cup. She put in the flour, sugar, and other things to make the cake. She mixed them all together and poured it into a cake pan. Mia was very happy. She put the cake in the oven and waited. When it was done, she took it out and let it cool. Mia put candles on the cake and surprised her mom. They all enjoyed the yummy cake and had a great day.

One day, a little girl named Suzy went to a big building with her mom. She saw a big box with doors. Her mom said, "That's an elevator, Suzy." Suzy wanted to go inside the elevator, but her mom said it was difficult to use. Suzy's mom went to talk to a man. Suzy saw the elevator doors open. She wanted to peek inside. Suzy went in the elevator and the doors closed. She pushed some buttons and the elevator went up and down. Suzy was scared. A man found Suzy in the elevator. He said, "Are you lost?" Suzy cried and said, "I want my mom." The man tried to help Suzy find her mom, but they couldn't find her. Suzy felt sad because she didn't listen to her mom.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a stone in his yard. The stone was very big and had a shiny spot on it. Tim wanted to touch the shiny spot, but his mom said, "No, don't touch! It might hurt." Tim was sad and asked his mom, "Why will it hurt?" His mom said, "The stone is very old and sharp. If you touch it, you might get a boo-boo." Later, Tim saw a little girl named Sue in the yard. Sue saw the stone too and wanted to touch it. Tim told her, "No, don't touch! It might hurt." Sue was sad, but she listened to Tim. Together, they found a soft ball to play with instead. They had fun playing with the ball and forgot about the stone. Tim and Sue became good friends and always played safely.

One day, a little girl named Mia was walking with her mom. They went to the park. Mia felt anxious because she had never been to this park before. She saw a bench and asked her mom, "Can we sit on the bench, please?" Her mom said, "Of course, Mia. Let's sit down and watch the birds." They sat on the bench and saw many birds. Mia loved the pretty birds. They were blue, red, and yellow. Mia felt happy now. A little boy named Tim came to the park too. He saw Mia and her mom on the bench. He asked, "Can I sit with you?" Mia's mom said, "Yes, you can sit with us." They all sat on the bench and watched the birds together. Mia and Tim became good friends and loved to play at the park.

One day, a boy was walking in the park when he saw a big, furry dog. He wanted to pet the dog, but he was too scared. He poked the dog with his finger instead. The dog was startled, but he did not seem angry. The boy hesitated, but then he decided to pet the dog. The dog was very soft, and he liked being petted. The boy smiled. Suddenly, the sky got dark and it began to rain. The boy and the dog had to run for shelter! It was difficult to find a place where they could stay dry. The boy used his sweater to keep the dog warm. The dog was very happy, and he licked the boy's face to thank him for his kindness. The boy laughed and patted the dog. They stayed together until the rain stopped. The boy said goodbye to the dog and went home. He had a hard time saying goodbye, but he knew he would see the dog in the park again. With a smile on his face, the boy went home.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had a big red ball. He loved to play with the ball. Spot's mom would always warn him not to play near the road. Spot was a good dog and listened to his mom. One day, Spot's ball went near the road. He stopped and looked at the road. He remembered his mom's words. He felt his nose wiggle, and he was glad he did not go near the road. Then, something unexpected happened. A kind cat named Whiskers saw Spot and his ball. Whiskers pushed the ball back to Spot with her nose. Spot was so happy and thankful. From that day on, Spot and Whiskers became best friends, and they always played safely together.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Emma got an invitation. It was for a party at the park. Emma was very happy. She did not know who sent the invitation, but she wanted to go. At the park, Emma saw a big slide. She was scared but wanted to try it. A boy named Jack saw her and said, "Don't be scared, I will help you." Emma and Jack went down the slide together. They had lots of fun. The party was over, and it was time to go home. Emma asked Jack, "Did you send the invitation?" Jack said, "No, it was not me." They found out it was an unknown friend who sent it. The moral of the story is that sometimes, the best things happen when we face our fears and make new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big forest. In the forest, there was a small, happy village. The village was full of peace. The people in the village were nice and kind. They always remember to help each other. One day, a big, dangerous lion came to the village. The people were scared. They did not know what to do. The lion was very hungry and wanted to eat the people. But then, something unexpected happened. A little girl came out of her house. She was not scared of the lion. She went up to the lion and gave it a big hug. The lion started to feel happy and not hungry anymore. The lion and the little girl became best friends. From that day on, the lion was not dangerous anymore, and peace came back to the village. The people always remember the brave little girl and her lion friend.

Once upon a time, in a big brown house, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside with his best friend, a dog named Max. They played all day long in the warm sun. One day, as the sunset came, Tim and Max were still playing. Tim's mom called out, "Tim, it's time to come inside!" Tim did not want to stop playing, so he had an idea. He said to Max, "Let's scare mom and hide!" Tim and Max hid behind a big tree. When mom came looking for them, they jumped out and yelled, "Boo!" Mom was scared, but then she laughed. She said, "You scared me, but it's still time to come inside." From that day on, Tim learned that it's important to listen to his mom. Even though it was fun to scare her, he knew he should go inside when she said. And so, Tim and Max always played until sunset, but they never scared mom again.

One day, a brave cat named Tim went for a walk. The sky was gray and there was fog everywhere. Tim could not see very far. He wanted to find a new friend to play with. As he walked, he saw two animals. One was a big dog and the other was a little mouse. Tim had to choose which one to play with. He thought, "The dog is big and strong, but the mouse is small and cute." Tim said, "Mouse, will you play with me?" The mouse was happy and said, "Yes, let's play!" So, Tim and the mouse played in the fog all day. They were very happy and became good friends.

One day, a cow saw an alert dog. The cow laughed. It was so funny! The dog barked and the cow laughed harder. Then, the dog chased the cow around the farm. The cow was so fast, the dog couldn't catch it. The cow was having so much fun that it kept laughing. All the other animals on the farm noticed and they laughed too. Even the farmer laughed too, so hard that he had to sit down and catch his breath. Then, suddenly, the sun came out and everything was so bright. Everyone laughed even harder and the cow joined in, too. Everyone was so happy and the cow was the most alert of all. The cow laughed so hard, nothing could make it stop.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play with his ball in the park. He saw a big tree and thought it would be fun to kick the ball at it. Tim kicked the ball very hard, and it went high up in the tree. Tim was sad because he could not reach the ball. A bird in the tree saw Tim's sad face and said, "Don't be sad, I will help you get your ball back." The bird flew up and pushed the ball out of the tree. The ball fell down and returned to Tim. Tim was very happy and said, "Thank you, bird!" But then, something bad happened. A big wind came and blew the bird's nest out of the tree. The bird was very sad because her nest was gone. Tim saw this and said, "Don't worry, bird. I will help you get your nest back." Tim picked up the nest and put it back in the tree. The bird was happy again, and they both played together in the park.

One day, a big red ball was rolling fast down a hill. A small boy saw it and wanted to play with it. He ran fast to catch the ball before it went away. But the ball was too fast for him. As the boy chased the ball, he saw a big rock in the way. The ball hit the rock and split into two smaller balls. The boy was very surprised. He did not know what to do with two balls, yet he was happy. The boy took the two smaller balls and started to play with them. Then, something unexpected happened. The two balls became friends and started to play with the boy. They all played together and had lots of fun every day. The boy was happy that the big ball had split, because now he had two new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a pink bunny named Bop. Bop loved lunch time. One day, Bop saw a big, yummy carrot across the street. He wanted to eat it for lunch. Bop's mommy said, "Bop, don't go! The street is not safe!" But Bop could not resist the big, yummy carrot. He hopped across the street. Bop got the carrot, but a big, mean dog saw him. The dog chased Bop. Bop was scared. He hopped and hopped, but the dog caught him. The dog took Bop's carrot and Bop was sad. He should have listened to his mommy.

Lily was a young bee who liked to fly around the flowers. She wanted to learn more about the world, so she often asked her mother questions. "Mom, why do we make honey?" she asked one day. "Honey is our food, dear. We work hard to collect nectar from the flowers and turn it into honey in our hive. Honey gives us energy and keeps us warm in the winter," her mother explained. "Can I see the hive, mom?" Lily asked. "Of course, dear. But you have to be careful. The hive is our home, but it is also where the queen bee lives. She is the most important bee in the colony. She lays all the eggs and makes sure we are healthy and happy. You have to be respectful and quiet when you see her," her mother said. Lily nodded and followed her mother to the hive. It was a big and busy place, full of bees and honeycombs. Lily saw many bees doing different jobs, like guarding, cleaning, feeding, and making honey. She was amazed by how much they worked together. "Mom, can I meet the queen bee?" she asked. "Maybe another day, dear. She is very busy right now. But you can say hello to her from a distance. Look, there she is, in the middle of the hive. She is bigger and brighter than the other bees. Can you see her?" her mother pointed. Lily looked and saw the queen bee. She was surrounded by other bees who took care of her and listened to her. Lily felt a warm and happy feeling in her heart. She waved her little wing and said, "Hello, queen bee. Thank you for being our leader. I hope you have a good day." The queen bee noticed Lily and smiled. She nodded her head and said, "Hello, young bee. You are very brave and curious. I am proud of you. Keep learning and growing. You have a bright future ahead of you."

One day, a sweet little girl named Jane was walking in the park. She saw a cute dog. The dog had a ball. Jane wanted to play with the dog. She ran to the dog, but she did not see a rock. Jane stumbled on the rock and fell down. Her shoulder hurt a lot. A nice woman saw Jane fall. She came to help her. The woman said, "Oh no! Are you okay?" Jane said, "My shoulder hurts. I just wanted to play with the dog." The woman smiled and said, "That is my dog. His name is Max. Let me help you." The woman helped Jane stand up. Then, something unexpected happened. The dog, Max, picked up the ball and gave it to Jane. Jane was happy. She threw the ball, and Max ran to get it. Jane and the woman laughed and played with Max together. Jane's shoulder felt better, and she made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was only three years old. Her name was Lucy. Every morning, Lucy would go outside to the garden and look for something special. One day, Lucy saw something unusual in the dirt. It was a small, green mint leaf. She was very curious and removed it from the dirt. When Lucy looked back at the spot she found it, she saw that it was covered in lots of filthy dirt. Lucy decided to take the mint leaf inside and asked her mother what she should do. Her mother looked at the mint and said to Lucy, “You know, if you plant this mint in some soil, it could grow into a pretty plant. What do you think?” Lucy was very excited at the thought of growing the mint. She quickly grabbed a pot, added some soil and planted the mint. The next day, Lucy went outside and took a closer look at her mint. To her surprise, the mint had grown bigger and now had two more leaves! Lucy was so happy with the result, she ran inside to tell her mother about it. Her mother smiled and said, “See, I told you that if you removed the mint from the dirt and planted it in soil, it would grow!” Lucy was very happy that she was able to make something beautiful from something filthy. Lucy learned a big lesson that day, that with a little bit of

One day, the sky was a light blue color. All of a sudden, the sky got very dark. Then, it started to rain. The rain was fierce. It fell from the sky like a waterfall. The ground got wet and slippery. That's when all the people ran for cover. They ran to a stadium, which was nearby. It was so big, and it had lots of people in it. Inside the stadium, everyone was safe from the fierce rain. They stayed there for a long time, until the rain stopped. Then, everyone went home. They were very happy that the fierce rain was gone.

Charlie and Lily were happy outside playing. Lily had a big blue box and inside was a red strip. She put it on the grass and said "Let's slide!" Charlie laughed and said "Yay!" They both sat on the red strip and held each other's hands. They pushed themselves and started to slide. They laughed as they slid along and faster and faster. Suddenly, as they reached the end of the slide, Charlie and Lily both shouted "Whee!". They felt so happy. Lily said "Let's do that again". Charlie smiled and they both started sliding again. They had lots of fun sliding all morning and they just couldn't stop!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to watch cartoons on TV. Every day after playtime, he would sit and watch his favorite cartoon friends. One day, Tim saw a fancy dress in a store. He thought it would be perfect for his mom. He pointed at the dress and said, "I want to get that for Mommy!" His dad smiled and bought the dress for Tim to give to his mom. When they got home, Tim gave the fancy dress to his mom. She was so happy and gave him a big hug. That night, they all watched cartoons together, and Tim felt very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong guard. He had a very important job. He had to keep the big gate safe. One day, a small, silly cat came to the guard. The cat wanted to go through the gate. The guard said, "No, you cannot go in." The cat did not like the guard's answer. The cat tried to get in, but the guard said, "No, you are too stupid to go in." The cat was sad, but it did not give up. The cat had a plan. It would find a way to get past the guard. The cat found a big, scary dog. The cat asked the dog to help. The dog was very mean and said, "I will help you, but you must give me something." The cat gave the dog a toy. The dog went to the guard and scared him away. The cat was happy and went through the gate. But the cat did not know that there was a big, scary monster behind the gate. The cat saw the monster and was very scared. The cat tried to run away, but the monster caught the cat. The cat should have listened to the guard. The cat was in trouble and could not get out. The cat was very sad and wished it had not been so stupid.

Sammy and his mom were walking through the park. His mom held his hand as they passed all the trees and swings. Sammy wanted to try next. “Mom, can I swing?” Sammy asked. Mom smiled and said, “Sure!” Sammy ran to the swing and Mom pushed him high up in the air. He laughed and felt so happy. Sammy and Mom left the park and went to the store. He saw lots of tasty things, like chocolates and candies. “Yum,” he said. Mom chose some things for Sammy and he smiled. When they were done, Sammy and Mom went back home. They held hands all the way, and Sammy was ready for a tasty snack.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Lily. She had a big cloth that was very special to her. The cloth was a gift from an unknown friend. Lily loved to play with the cloth every day. One sunny day, Lily took her cloth outside to play. She saw a tree with many leaves. Lily thought it would be fun to shake the cloth near the tree. So, she held the cloth tight and began to shake it. As Lily shook the cloth, something magical happened. The leaves on the tree started to dance and sing. The unknown friend had given Lily a magical cloth! Lily was so happy and played with her magical cloth all day long.

Maggie and Daddy were going for a special day out. Maggie was so excited! They drove to the park, where there were lots of great things to do. Daddy got a golf club and a ball, and he showed Maggie how to hit it. Maggie tried hard, and eventually she found the perfect way. Soon she was driving the balls around the park, just like Daddy! Maggie was so proud of her new skill; she thought it was the most perfect way to spend the day. She and Daddy had so much fun!

One day, a big, ugly billboard was put up in the town. It had a picture of a mean-looking man on it. The people in the town did not like the billboard. They would walk by and tell each other how ugly it was. A little girl named Sue walked by the billboard and saw the mean man. She said, "Hello, Mr. Billboard. Why do you look so mean?" The billboard did not say anything, but Sue thought she saw a tear in the mean man's eye. The next day, Sue came back with a big smile on her face. She told the billboard, "I have a surprise for you!" She took out a big, colorful painting she made and hung it on the billboard. The mean man was now hidden behind the beautiful painting. The people in the town were happy and clapped for Sue. The ugly billboard was now a pretty one, and the town was a happier place.

Once upon a time, there was a unique woman. She loved to help people improve. She had a magic wand. The wand could make things better. The woman was very happy. One day, the woman went to the park. She saw a sad cat. The cat was very dirty. The woman wanted to help the cat. She used her magic wand to improve the cat. But something unexpected happened. The cat turned into a big lion! The lion was not mean. The lion was happy to be clean. The woman was scared at first. Then, the lion became her friend. They played in the park. The woman and the lion helped more people improve. They were a unique team.

Once upon a time, in a pretty forest, a little snake lived under a big rock. The snake had many friends. One day, the snake met a new friend, a small bird. The bird had pretty feathers and a sweet voice. They played together and had lots of fun. "Let's race to the big tree," said the snake to the bird. The bird agreed, and they started the race. The snake moved fast, but the bird flew faster. The bird reached the big tree first and won the race. The snake was happy for the bird and said, "You are very fast!" One day, while they were playing, the snake accidentally bit the bird. The bird felt hurt and cried. The snake felt sad and said, "I am sorry, I did not mean to bite you." The bird forgave the snake, and they continued to play together. From that day on, the snake was more careful when playing with its friends. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a funny mole went to play outside. He liked to observe things around him. He saw big trees, pretty flowers, and many bugs. He felt happy when he played with his friends. One time, the funny mole saw his friend, a little bird, having a hard time. The bird could not find food. The mole thought, "I can help my friend." So, the funny mole shared his food with the bird. The bird was very happy and said, "Thank you, funny mole!" After that, all the animals saw what the funny mole did. They learned that it is good to help friends. They all helped each other and played together. The funny mole and his friends were happy. The moral of the story is, when we help others, we feel good and make friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a shop. In the shop, there were many toys. The shop was run by a nice man named Tom. Tom was very flexible. He could bend and stretch like a snake. One day, a little girl named Lily came to the shop. She wanted to order a toy. She asked Tom for a toy car. Tom looked everywhere for the toy car, but he could not find it. He was sad because he wanted to make Lily happy. Then, something unexpected happened. Tom's flexible body helped him find the toy car. He bent down and saw the toy car hiding behind a big box. He stretched his arm to reach it. Lily was very happy and thanked Tom. They both laughed and played with the toy car. And from that day on, Lily and Tom became good friends.

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a big wardrobe in her room. It was very big and very old. Lucy wanted to see what was inside. She opened the door and saw many pretty clothes. She felt happy and thought, "I want to play dress-up." Lucy went into the wardrobe to find a pretty dress. But when she walked in, it was very cold. She saw a new place with lots of snow and ice. She said, "It's too cold here, I need a warm coat." She found a big, warm coat in the wardrobe and put it on. Now she felt warm and cozy. Lucy saw a nice snowman in the cold place. She said, "Hello, snowman! Can we play together?" The snowman smiled and said, "Yes, let's play!" So Lucy and the snowman played in the snow all day. When it was time to go home, Lucy said goodbye to the snowman and went back through the wardrobe. She was happy to have a fun day in the cold place with her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a small fish who lived in a big lake. He was comfortable and happy in the lake and enjoyed swimming around with his friends. One day, he heard a voice from outside the lake. It said: "shut up, little fish - we don't want to hear any noise from you!". The little fish was shocked and scared. He didn't understand why the voice wanted him to be quiet. He told his friends what had happened, but they couldn't help him. The little fish was so scared that he hid deep in the lake, unable to come out. He stayed there, feeling lonely and scared, unable to be comfortable the way he used to be. The moral of the story is that it is important to be kind to everyone, no matter how small they are. We should always treat people with respect and not shut them out.

One day, a cat and a dog had a quarrel. They were not happy with each other. The cat said, "You are a fake friend!" The dog was sad and walked away. Today, the cat and the dog went to play in the park. They wanted to forget the quarrel and be friends again. They played with a big red ball. They were having fun and laughing. But then, something bad happened. A big bird came and took the red ball away. The cat and the dog were sad. They thought they could be friends again, but the bird took their fun away. Now, they were not friends anymore.

One day, a wealthy boy named Tim had a big house. He loved to own many toys. From his room, he had a nice view of the park. Tim saw other kids play, but he felt sad because he had no friends. One day, a girl named Sue came to his door. She said, "Hi, I saw you from the park. Do you want to play with me?" Tim was so happy and said, "Yes, let's play with my toys!" They played and laughed all day. But then, something unexpected happened. Tim's toys broke! He was sad, but Sue said, "Don't worry, we can still play at the park!" They went to the park and found new friends. Tim learned that friends are better than owning many toys.

Molly was a little girl with long, blonde hair. She was walking through the park and saw a flute lying on the ground. She bent down and picked it up. "What should I do with this?" Molly asked herself. Suddenly, a hairy old man walked up to her. “Why don't you choose to play the flute?” he said. Molly thought about it and decided that the man was right. She lifted the flute to her lips and began to play. Molly quickly learned how to make beautiful music. As she played, the old man said "You have chosen wisely. You make me very happy". Molly was so proud of herself. She had chosen correctly and knew that she wanted to continue making music with her new flute forever.

One day, Jimmy was playing with his clay. It was white and shiny, and Jimmy was really happy with it. He wanted to make something special and special. But then he heard his mom shouting, and he frowned. He thought she was unhappy with him and his clay. He quickly put away his clay and hid it under the bed. But his mom was just happy, she was celebrating because she had bought him a new toy. Jimmy was relieved and felt silly for thinking that his mom was angry with him for playing with the clay. He brought out his clay and resumed playing with it. This time he was extra careful not to make too much noise. His mom smiled, happy to see him playing again.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to play in her bedroom, and there was a big, wooden table in her room. One day, Sarah saw her cuddly blanky puppy on top of the table, and he looked so adorable. Sarah wanted to give the pup a hug, but he was too far away. So she decided to push the table. At first, Sarah didn't think she could move the table. But she kept pushing, and pushing until she was able to slide it across the room. When it was close enough, she grabbed her pup and gave him a big hug. Sarah felt so happy, and her pup looked so adorable too. She kissed him on the nose, and thanked him for being so cute. Sarah and her pup were the best of friends, and they were both very happy!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars and trucks. One day, he found a new toy in his toy box. It was a missile! Tim was so excited to play with it. Tim wanted to add the missile to his toy car. He thought it would make his car go super fast. So, he asked his mommy to help him. Mommy helped Tim add the missile to his toy car. Now, Tim's car was ready to race. After playing with his car and missile, Tim was very hungry. Mommy made him a yummy sandwich for lunch. Tim ate his yummy sandwich and felt so happy. He couldn't wait to play with his car and missile again after lunch. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big, thick refrigerator. It lived in a small house with a little boy named Tim and his mom. The refrigerator was very happy because it could keep all the food nice and cold for Tim and his mom. One day, Tim's mom wanted to tell Tim a secret. She said, "Tim, the refrigerator has a surprise for you!" Tim was very excited and ran to the refrigerator. He opened the door and saw a big, cold ice cream inside! Tim's eyes got big and he smiled a big smile. Tim and his mom ate the ice cream together. It was so cold and yummy. The thick refrigerator was happy that it could keep the ice cream cold for Tim and his mom. From that day on, Tim would always remember the special surprise from the refrigerator.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sue went to the park. She had a cart with her. The cart was modern and very fun. Sue liked her cart a lot. At the park, Sue saw her friend Tom. Tom loved Sue's cart. They took turns riding in the cart. They laughed and had a great time. After playing with the cart, Sue and Tom went to the swings. They swung high in the sky. The sun was setting, and it was time to go home. Sue and Tom said bye and went home, happy after a fun day at the park.

One day, a little red car was working at the tire factory. He was a hard worker, and he had been working all day. Suddenly, the little red car saw his friend the tire. He stopped what he was doing and said, “Hello tire! What are you doing?” The tire said, “I’m here to get printed. The factory is going to turn me into an automobile tire!” The little red car was very excited, but he quickly became sad. He knew that after the tire was printed, he could never see his friend again. He said, “This is so sad. I’ll never see you again.” The tire replied, “It’s all right, it’s just part of the job. Now I’ve got to go get printed. Goodbye, little red car.” The little red car watched sadly as his friend went off to get printed. He had a bitter feeling inside. He knew he would never see the tire again. The little red car never saw the tire again. He was sad and bitter, and he wouldn’t forget that day.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little bird named Tim. Tim was upset because he could not find his way home. He started to worry. One day, Tim met a kind frog. The frog said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will help you find your home." Tim felt better and thanked the frog. They started to look for Tim's home together. They walked and walked until they reached a big tree. Tim saw his nest in the tree! The frog pointed east and said, "Look, Tim, your home is there!" Tim was so happy and said, "Thank you, frog!" Tim was no longer upset and they became good friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big, modern bell. The bell was shiny and new. It was in the middle of the town for everyone to see. One day, a nice man came to the town. He wanted to show people how to sign with their hands. He thought it would be fun for everyone to learn. So, he stood by the bell and started signing. The people in the town saw the man signing by the bell. They thought it was interesting. They wanted to learn how to sign too. So, they all came to the bell and the man taught them. They had a great time learning and signing together.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a well. The well was very deep, and it was where everyone got their water. One day, a funny bird came to visit the well. The bird was very colorful and liked to dance. The bird said to the well, "Hello, well! I heard you have the best water in town. Can I have some?" The well replied, "Of course, funny bird! You can have as much as you want." So, the bird drank some water and started to dance. As the bird danced, something unexpected happened. The water in the well began to rise. It rose higher and higher, until it was almost at the top. The people in the town were amazed and gathered around the well. They all said, "Wow, the funny bird made the water rise! Now we have more water for everyone!" The bird smiled and said, "I'm happy I could help. I love to dance and make friends." The people in the town thanked the funny bird and invited it to stay with them. From that day on, the bird lived in the town, and they all had plenty of water to drink.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He saw a toy gun on the ground. Tim picked it up and said, "Look, Mom! I found a toy gun!" His mom looked at the toy gun and said, "That's disgusting, Tim! Put it down." Tim put the toy gun down and they walked away. They saw a girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her toy gun. Tim told Sue, "I saw a toy gun over there!" Sue went to find her toy gun and was very happy. Sue said, "Thank you, Tim!" Tim was happy to help Sue. He admired how nice Sue was. Then, something unexpected happened. The toy gun changed into a pretty flower! Sue and Tim were surprised and laughed. They played together in the park, and the flower made their day even more fun.

Once upon a time, there was a flea. This flea was very rare. It was not like other fleas. It liked to design things. It was a very helpful flea. One day, the flea met a dog. The dog had a big problem. The dog needed a new bed. The flea wanted to help the dog. So, the flea decided to design a bed for the dog. The flea worked hard to make the best bed. The dog was very happy when it saw the bed. The dog and the flea became good friends. They lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a kind cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with her friends in the park. One day, Kitty found a big ball with a zipper on it. She was very curious about what was inside the ball. Kitty tried to open the zipper, but it was stuck. She pulled and pulled, but the zipper would not move. Just then, her friend Doggy came by. Doggy saw Kitty trying to open the zipper and decided to help. Together, they pulled and pulled, and finally, the zipper opened. Inside the ball, they found a very soft pillow. Kitty and Doggy were so tired from opening the zipper that they both let out a big yawn. They decided to lay down on the soft pillow and take a nap. And so, Kitty and Doggy slept on the pillow, happy to have worked together and shared their new find.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful cat named Lily. Lily loved to dance and play all day. She was friends with a dog named Max. Max and Lily would always choose to play together. One day, they found a big box. It looked like a jail. Max said, "Let's go inside!" Lily said, "Okay!" They went inside the jail and the door closed behind them. They were stuck! But then, a small bird came and opened the door. Lily and Max were so happy. They said, "Thank you, bird!" The bird said, "You're welcome!" And they all played together. From that day on, they always chose to play with the bird, too.

One day, a child named Tom went to the park. He saw a big tree with a bird on it. Tom wanted to call the bird to come down and play. He said, "Bird, come down, let's play!" The bird looked at Tom and said, "You are ignorant, child. I am not a bird, I am a cat!" Tom was very surprised. He did not know that cats could talk or sit in trees. Tom said, "Sorry, cat. I did not know. Can we still play?" The cat came down from the tree and they played together. They had so much fun, and Tom learned that not all things in trees are birds.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a toy called Laser. Laser was a small, red car. Tim loved to play with Laser all day. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He took Laser with him. At the park, Tim saw a girl named Sue. Sue had a big, green ball. Tim looked at the ball and felt jealous. He wanted a green ball too. Tim said to Sue, "I want your green ball." Sue looked at Laser and said, "I want your red car." They thought for a moment. Then, they decided to share. Tim played with the green ball, and Sue played with Laser. They both had fun and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a wise cat. The cat liked to help people. One day, the cat met a little boy. The boy was sad. He lost his license. The license let him ride his bike. The cat wanted to help the boy. The wise cat asked the boy, "Where did you see it last?". The boy said, "I don't know". The cat said, "Let's guess where it is". They looked in the park. They looked by the store. They looked by the boy's house. They could not find the license. At last, the wise cat said, "Let's look in your bag". The boy looked in his bag. He found his license! The boy was happy. He said, "Thank you, wise cat". The cat was happy too. They became good friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He was very careful as he walked. He did not want to trip and fall. As he walked, he heard a sound. It was a bird singing in a tree. Tim looked up and said, "Hello, bird! I like your song. Will you be my friend?" The bird looked at Tim and said, "Yes, I will be your friend. Let's play together!" So, Tim and the bird played all day long. As they played, something unexpected happened. The bird found a big red ball. The bird said, "Look, Tim! I found a ball. Let's play with it!" But when the bird touched the ball, it started to float! Tim and the bird were very surprised. They had never seen a ball that could float before. They played with the floating ball and had even more fun. And from that day on, Tim and the bird were the best of friends.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Max and John. They enjoyed playing together every day. One day they decided to go on a hike. When they reached a cliff, they wanted to see what was on the other side. Max suggested they climb the cliff to get over to the other side. John said it was too high and very dangerous. Max made a persistent effort to convince John to climb the cliff, but John did not give in. Finally, after much persuasion, Max agreed he and John could think of another way to get to the other side. That night Max and John discussed their options and eventually decided to build a bridge to get over the cliff. The next day, they began work on the bridge. After a few hours, their bridge was complete, and Max and John crossed over to the other side of the cliff. The moral of the story is to never give up when faced with a challenge. No matter how big the challenge may seem, it is important to always think of creative solutions. Persistence and hard work will help you reach any goal.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park. She saw a swing and ran to it. Mia loved to swing high in the sky. She felt like a famous bird when she swung. Mia saw a boy named Tom at the park. He wanted to swing too. But there was only one swing. Mia did not want to share. Tom was sad. Mia saw the sad image of Tom and felt bad. Mia thought about it and decided to share the swing with Tom. They took turns swinging high in the sky. They both felt like famous birds. Mia and Tom became good friends. The moral of the story is that sharing can make everyone happy.

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play in the farm. They see many animals and plants. They see cows, pigs, chickens, and corn. One day, they see a big brown bird. It has a long neck and big wings. It is a goose. The goose is eating corn from the field. "Look, Ben, a goose!" Lila says. "Wow, it is big and brown!" Ben says. They run to the goose. They want to touch it. But the goose is scared. It makes a loud noise. Honk! Honk! It flaps its wings. It flies away. "Bye, goose!" Lila and Ben say. They watch the goose fly in the sky. They wish they could fly too. They pretend to be geese. They flap their arms. They make honk noises. They laugh and have fun. They are happy.

Lily was a chubby girl who liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite one was Rosie, who wore a pink blouse and had long yellow hair. Lily liked to brush Rosie's hair and dress her up in different clothes. One day, Lily's cousin Tom came to visit. Tom was a big boy who liked to play with cars and trucks. He did not like dolls at all. He saw Lily playing with Rosie and said, "Dolls are silly. Cars are better. Give me your doll." Lily did not want to give Tom her doll. She said, "No, Rosie is mine. Go play with your cars." She hugged Rosie and turned away from Tom. Tom was angry. He wanted to take Rosie from Lily. He ran to Lily and tried to grab Rosie. Lily held on to Rosie and said, "Stop, Tom. You are hurting me and Rosie." Tom did not stop. He pulled Rosie harder and harder. Lily felt Rosie's blouse rip in her hands. She cried out, "No, Tom. You broke Rosie's blouse. You are mean." Tom did not care. He pushed Lily and ran away with Rosie. Lily fell to the floor and sobbed. She looked at the torn blouse in her hands and felt very sad. She loved Rosie and did not want her to be hurt. Lily's mom heard Lily crying and came to see what was wrong. She saw Lily on the floor and the torn blouse in her hands. She saw Tom running away with Rosie. She was angry with Tom and said, "Tom, come back here. You have to say sorry to Lily and give her back her doll. You cannot push and take things that are not yours." Tom did not want to say sorry or give back Rosie. He said, "I don't care. I don't like dolls. They are stupid." Lily's mom said, "Dolls are not stupid. They are Lily's toys and she loves them. You have to respect her feelings and her things. You have to be kind and share. Now, give Rosie back to Lily and say sorry." Tom did not want to, but he knew he had to. He gave Rosie back to Lily and said, "Sorry, Lily. I was wrong. I should not have pushed you and taken your doll." Lily took Rosie and hugged her. She said, "Thank you, Tom. I forgive you. But please don't do that again. Rosie is my friend and I don't want her to be hurt." Lily's mom said, "That's very good, Lily. You are very sweet and generous. And Tom, you have to learn to be more gentle and polite. You can play with your cars, but you have to ask before you touch other people's toys. And you have to say please and thank you. Do you understand?" Tom nodded and said, "Yes, I understand. I'm sorry, Lily. I'm sorry, mom. Can I play with you and Rosie?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, you can. But you have to be nice and careful. Rosie likes to play with cars too, sometimes. But she also likes to have her hair brushed and her blouse fixed. Can you help me with that?" Tom said, "OK, I can try. Maybe dolls are not so silly after all." Lily's mom said, "That's very good, Tom. I'm proud of you. Now, let's go and find some thread and a needle and fix Rosie's blouse. And then you can all play together nicely."

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball. One day, Max's ball rolled into the woods. Max was sorry that he had lost his ball. He went into the woods to find it. In the woods, Max met a big bear. The bear had Max's ball. Max said, "Please, may I have my ball back?" The bear looked at Max and said, "I will give you your ball if you can bring me a measure of honey." Max thanked the bear and went to find honey. Max found a bee who had honey.
